words.enDefinition: a distance acuity measure matching standard clarity at twenty feet

examples.en: I asked what the 20/20 vision entry meant on my eye exam report.
examples.zh: 我问眼部检查报告上的「20/20视力」这一项是什么意思。

examples.en: The optometrist explained why 20/20 vision describes only one part of the exam.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么「20/20视力」只代表检查的其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: a blood test reflecting average blood sugar over recent months

examples.en: I asked what A1C test meant after seeing it on my test order.
examples.zh: 我在检验申请上看到「糖化血红蛋白检测」，就问这是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician pointed to the A1C test entry in the results list.
examples.zh: 医生指了指结果清单里「糖化血红蛋白检测」那一项。

words.enDefinition: a finding that differs from the test's expected criteria

examples.en: I asked to discuss the abnormal result with the clinician who ordered the test.
examples.zh: 我请开检验单的医生和我谈谈那个「异常结果」。

examples.en: The clinic told me whom to contact about the abnormal result on my report.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，报告里的「异常结果」应该找谁咨询。

words.enDefinition: a change to study requirements addressing a student's individual needs

examples.en: I asked whether moving my lab section would count as an academic adjustment.
examples.zh: 我问换一个实验课班是否算「学业安排调整」。

examples.en: The adviser put the academic adjustment in writing so I could tell my tutor.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学业安排调整」写了下来，方便我告知导师。

words.enDefinition: stress related to courses, grades or academic demands

examples.en: I told my adviser how academic pressure had changed since the start of term.
examples.zh: 我告诉顾问，开学以来我的「学业压力」是怎么变化的。

examples.en: The workshop focused on academic pressure around weeks when several assignments are due.
examples.zh: 工作坊关注多个作业同时截止那几周的「学业压力」。

words.enDefinition: to see people who arrive without an advance booking

examples.en: I called before leaving campus to ask if the clinic would accept walk-ins that afternoon.
examples.zh: 离开校园前，我打电话问诊所当天下午会不会「接待未预约患者」。

examples.en: The notice explains when staff can accept walk-ins and when patients need to book ahead.
examples.zh: 告示说明了什么时候可以「接待未预约患者」，什么时候需要提前约。

words.enDefinition: taking on people who have not used a practice before

examples.en: I asked if the practice was accepting new patients after moving away from campus.
examples.zh: 搬离校园后，我问那家诊所是否「正在接收新患者」。

examples.en: The clinic explained why it was not accepting new patients at its smaller branch.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了为什么较小的分诊点没有「接收新患者」。

collocations: check which providers are accepting new patients

words.enDefinition: requirements for making a service usable and accessible

examples.en: The appointment form asked about accessibility needs so staff could prepare the room in advance.
examples.zh: 预约表询问了「无障碍需求」，以便工作人员提前准备好诊室。

examples.en: I told the clinic about my accessibility needs when I phoned to confirm the booking.
examples.zh: 我打电话确认预约时，告诉了诊所我的「无障碍需求」。

words.enDefinition: a classroom arranged so people with access needs can use it

examples.en: The coordinator moved our seminar to an accessible classroom near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 协调员把我们的研讨课换到了主入口附近的「无障碍教室」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the accessible classroom shown on my new timetable.
examples.zh: 我问新课表上写的「无障碍教室」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a room designed or adapted for people with access needs

examples.en: I asked for an accessible room close to the student accommodation office.
examples.zh: 我申请了一间靠近学生住宿办公室的「无障碍房间」。

examples.en: The online listing showed photos of the accessible room and its bathroom.
examples.zh: 网上的房源信息展示了「无障碍房间」及其卫生间的照片。

collocations: an accessible room near the lift

words.enDefinition: a toilet designed to be usable by people with disabilities

examples.en: I asked reception where to find the accessible toilet near the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我问前台报告厅附近哪里有「无障碍卫生间」。

examples.en: The event map showed an accessible toilet next to the main meeting room.
examples.zh: 活动地图标出主会议室旁边有一间「无障碍卫生间」。

collocations: an accessible toilet on this floor

words.enDefinition: transport designed or arranged for people with access needs

examples.en: The student office gave me a number to call about accessible transport.
examples.zh: 学生事务办公室给了我一个咨询「无障碍交通」的号码。

examples.en: I asked whether accessible transport went directly to the rehabilitation facility on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我问星期天的「无障碍交通」是否直达康复机构。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames made of a plastic called cellulose acetate

examples.en: I found acetate frames in the same color as my old glasses.
examples.zh: 我找到一副和旧眼镜同色的「醋酸纤维素镜架」。

examples.en: The shop explained why these acetate frames cost more than the basic pair.
examples.zh: 店里解释了这副「醋酸纤维素镜架」为什么比基础款贵。

words.enDefinition: a substance that produces the intended effect of a medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the active ingredient on the side panel of both boxes.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了两个盒子侧面板上的「活性成分」。

examples.en: I asked whether the active ingredient had a different name on the second label.
examples.zh: 我问第二张标签上的「活性成分」是不是用了别的名称。

words.enDefinition: basic personal tasks such as dressing, bathing, and eating

examples.en: The form asked what help I needed with activities of daily living at home.
examples.zh: 表格问，我在家做「日常生活活动」时需要什么帮助。

examples.en: The therapist explained why activities of daily living had their own section in the report.
examples.zh: 治疗师说明了为什么报告给「日常生活活动」单列了一部分。

collocations: support with activities of daily living
difficulty with activities of daily living

words.enDefinition: limits placed on which activities someone can do or how

examples.en: I sent my placement supervisor the letter that listed my temporary activity restrictions.
examples.zh: 我把列有临时「活动限制」的信发给了实习主管。

examples.en: The therapist explained where the activity restrictions appeared on the updated report.
examples.zh: 治疗师指出了更新后的报告在哪里列了「活动限制」。

words.enDefinition: short-term care for illnesses or injuries needing prompt attention

examples.en: The nurse explained the difference between acute care and the follow-up service near my campus.
examples.zh: 护士解释了「急性期医疗」和校园附近的复诊服务有什么区别。

examples.en: The hospital brochure described acute care and listed where people could ask questions about visits.
examples.zh: 医院手册介绍了「急性期医疗」，还列出了可以咨询就诊问题的地方。

words.enDefinition: a hospital unit assessing and treating acute medical cases

examples.en: The nurse showed my roommate how to find the acute medical unit on the hospital map.
examples.zh: 护士在医院地图上指给室友看，「急症内科病区」在哪里。

examples.en: My record showed that the acute medical unit had received the notes from emergency care.
examples.zh: 我的病历显示，「急症内科病区」已经收到急诊转来的记录。

collocations: transfer to the acute medical unit
a bed in the acute medical unit

words.enDefinition: eating utensils adapted to make them easier to hold or use

examples.en: I asked the therapist where the adaptive cutlery was shown in the catalogue.
examples.zh: 我问治疗师，「辅助餐具」在目录的哪里。

examples.en: The residence kitchen showed me a drawer with several sets of adaptive cutlery.
examples.zh: 宿舍厨房工作人员给我看了一个抽屉，里面放着几套「辅助餐具」。

words.enDefinition: a claim revised after an error in its filing or processing

examples.en: The clinic sent an adjusted claim after fixing the date on my bill.
examples.zh: 诊所更正了账单上的日期后，提交了「调整后的理赔申请」。

examples.en: I compared the adjusted claim with the original one before calling the adviser.
examples.zh: 给顾问打电话前，我先对照了「调整后的理赔申请」和原记录。

words.enDefinition: a revised schedule modified to meet someone's needs or circumstances

examples.en: The department sent me an adjusted timetable before I returned to the residence hall.
examples.zh: 我回宿舍楼之前，系里发来一份「调整后的课表」。

examples.en: I checked the adjusted timetable to see where my lab would be held.
examples.zh: 我查了「调整后的课表」，看看实验课会在哪里上。

words.enDefinition: problems getting used to a new situation or change

examples.en: I mentioned adjustment difficulties at my first meeting with the student wellbeing adviser.
examples.zh: 第一次见学生身心健康顾问时，我提到了自己的「适应困难」。

examples.en: The guide talks about adjustment difficulties during the first term of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 指南谈到了留学第一个学期的「适应困难」。

words.enDefinition: the clinical team accepting a patient for inpatient care

examples.en: The admitting team called after reviewing the note that had come from the emergency department.
examples.zh: 「收治团队」检查了急诊科转来的记录后，打来了电话。

examples.en: I asked whether the admitting team had a place where my family could wait.
examples.zh: 我问「收治团队」那里有没有可供家人等候的地方。

collocations: hand over to the admitting team

words.enDefinition: make it harder to do things you normally do

examples.en: The clinician asked whether the cramps affect daily activities such as cooking or walking.
examples.zh: 医生问痉挛是否「影响日常活动」，比如做饭或走路。

examples.en: I said the pain can affect daily activities on the days it lasts longer.
examples.zh: 我说疼痛持续时间较长的那些天，可能会「影响日常活动」。

words.enDefinition: a clinic that sees patients outside normal office hours

examples.en: Reception gave me the address of an after-hours clinic when I asked about evening appointments.
examples.zh: 我问有没有晚间预约时，前台给了我一家「非工作时间门诊」的地址。

examples.en: I looked up how to reach the after-hours clinic by bus from my university.
examples.zh: 我查了从学校坐公交怎么去「非工作时间门诊」。

words.enDefinition: a patient-facing summary of a completed healthcare visit

examples.en: I read the after-visit summary because it listed who to contact about the next appointment.
examples.zh: 我读了「就诊后摘要」，因为上面写了下一次预约该联系谁。

examples.en: The nurse said the after-visit summary would appear in the portal later that day.
examples.zh: 护士说「就诊后摘要」当天晚些时候会出现在平台上。

words.enDefinition: a check using a brief puff of air to estimate eye pressure

examples.en: The technician told me the air puff test was on the list for today.
examples.zh: 技术人员告诉我，「吹气测眼压检查」是今天的项目之一。

examples.en: I asked whether the air puff test would be done in a separate room.
examples.zh: 我问「吹气测眼压检查」会不会在另一个房间做。

collocations: results from the air puff test

words.enDefinition: a notice that a product may contain a particular allergen

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where to find the allergen warning on the medicine leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问药师，药品说明书上的「过敏原提示」在哪里。

examples.en: The shop printed the allergen warning beneath the list of inactive ingredients.
examples.zh: 药房把「过敏原提示」印在非活性成分列表下方。

collocations: an allergen warning on the label

words.enDefinition: a wristband marking a recorded allergy or allergy alert

examples.en: The nurse checked the allergy band before asking me to confirm what was in my record.
examples.zh: 护士先查看了「过敏提示腕带」，再请我确认记录里写了什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the allergy band should display my name along with the warning.
examples.zh: 我问「过敏提示腕带」上除了警示外，是不是还应该写我的姓名。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount a plan recognizes for a covered service

examples.en: The allowed amount on my statement was lower than the clinic's original charge.
examples.zh: 账单上的「核准计费金额」低于诊所原先收取的金额。

examples.en: I asked why the allowed amount had changed since my first visit.
examples.zh: 我问了为什么第一次看诊以来，「核准计费金额」变了。

words.enDefinition: reduced vision that develops when the brain and eye do not work normally together

examples.en: The specialist asked whether amblyopia was mentioned in my childhood eye exam records.
examples.zh: 专科医生问，我小时候的眼部检查记录里有没有提到「弱视」。

examples.en: I found the word amblyopia in a clinic letter that my parents had kept.
examples.zh: 我在父母保存的一封诊所函件里找到了「弱视」这个词。

words.enDefinition: a designated area where ambulances bring patients to hospital

examples.en: I waited by the public doors while the crew pulled up at the ambulance bay.
examples.zh: 我在公众入口等着，救护人员把车开到了「救护车停靠区」。

examples.en: The map marks the ambulance bay separately from the entrance used by people arriving on foot.
examples.zh: 地图上，「救护车停靠区」和步行到院人员使用的入口是分开标注的。

words.enDefinition: the staff working together on an ambulance

examples.en: The ambulance crew spoke with the hospital nurse while my roommate waited by the doors.
examples.zh: 「救护车工作人员」和医院护士沟通时，我室友在门边等着。

examples.en: I handed my friend's bag to the ambulance crew before following them inside the hospital.
examples.zh: 跟着进医院前，我把朋友的包交给了「救护车工作人员」。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of patient information and responsibility on arrival

examples.en: I waited outside while the ambulance handover took place between the crew and the nurse.
examples.zh: 救护人员和护士做「救护车到院交接」时，我在外面等着。

examples.en: The receiving nurse checked the paperwork after the ambulance handover was complete.
examples.zh: 「救护车到院交接」完成后，接收的护士检查了文件。

words.enDefinition: transporting a patient in an ambulance

examples.en: The clerk confirmed that ambulance transport had been arranged between the two hospital buildings.
examples.zh: 接待人员确认，两栋医院楼之间已安排「救护车转送」。

examples.en: My friend asked who could explain the arrangements for ambulance transport to the other hospital.
examples.zh: 朋友问有谁能说明转去另一家医院的「救护车转送」安排。

words.enDefinition: a difference in refractive power between the two eyes

examples.en: The optometrist explained why the term anisometropia appeared alongside two different figures.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么两个不同的数字旁边写着「屈光参差」。

examples.en: I asked the specialist whether anisometropia referred to the difference between my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，「屈光参差」指的是不是我两只眼睛的差异。

words.enDefinition: a general health examination scheduled about once a year

examples.en: The clinic's website shows which forms to fill out before an annual checkup.
examples.zh: 诊所网站说明了「年度体检」前要填写哪些表格。

examples.en: My annual checkup was on a Friday, so I changed my afternoon study group.
examples.zh: 「年度体检」在星期五，我就调整了下午的小组学习安排。

words.enDefinition: the scheduled time each year for joining or changing a plan

examples.en: The annual enrollment period began while I was deciding whether to study overseas.
examples.zh: 我还在考虑是否出国学习时，「年度投保期」就开始了。

examples.en: I saved the annual enrollment period in my calendar to review the new options.
examples.zh: 我把「年度投保期」记进日历，好在那时看看新选项。

words.enDefinition: a layer on lenses designed to reduce surface reflections

examples.en: The optician showed me a lens sample with an anti-reflective coating in the shop.
examples.zh: 配镜师在店里给我看了一片带「减反射镀膜」的样品镜片。

examples.en: The anti-reflective coating appeared as a separate option on the printed quote.
examples.zh: 打印出的报价单把「减反射镀膜」列为单独的选项。

collocations: a quote for an anti-reflective coating

words.enDefinition: whether and when appointments are open for booking

examples.en: The receptionist checked appointment availability while I looked up the dates of my exams.
examples.zh: 前台查「可预约情况」时，我查了一下自己的考试日期。

examples.en: The website shows appointment availability for both branches after you choose a clinician.
examples.zh: 选择医务人员后，网站会显示两个分诊点的「可预约情况」。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a requested appointment is booked

examples.en: The clinic sent an appointment confirmation as soon as I selected a time on the website.
examples.zh: 我在网站上选好时间，诊所随即发来了「预约确认」。

examples.en: I checked the appointment confirmation because the clinic has two offices on the same street.
examples.zh: 诊所在同一条街上有两个地点，我就核对了「预约确认」。

words.enDefinition: the level of urgency assigned to an appointment request

examples.en: A nurse checked the appointment priority after the receptionist took notes during our call.
examples.zh: 前台在通话中做了记录后，护士核对了「预约优先级」。

examples.en: I asked how appointment priority was shown on the form before submitting my request.
examples.zh: 提交申请前，我问表格上是怎么显示「预约优先级」的。

words.enDefinition: a shaped wire that links brackets along a row of teeth

examples.en: The dentist pointed out the archwire in the picture from my orthodontic file.
examples.zh: 牙医在我的正畸档案照片上指出了那根「正畸弓丝」。

examples.en: I asked whether the archwire was included in the cost listed on the estimate.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上列的费用是否包含「正畸弓丝」。

words.enDefinition: the way in which a patient reached the facility

examples.en: We checked the arrival mode on the report because the clerk had recorded it incorrectly.
examples.zh: 接待人员记错了，我们核对了报告上的「到院方式」。

examples.en: The nurse confirmed my arrival mode before attaching the earlier notes to my hospital record.
examples.zh: 护士先确认了我的「到院方式」，再把之前的记录附到院内病历上。

words.enDefinition: the clock time at which someone reached the facility

examples.en: The clerk asked us to confirm the arrival time shown on the hospital screen.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我们确认医院屏幕上显示的「到院时间」。

examples.en: I wrote down the arrival time while my roommate parked the car across the street.
examples.zh: 室友把车停到街对面时，我记下了「到院时间」。

words.enDefinition: to reach a medical facility in an ambulance

examples.en: The clerk asked whether my friend would arrive by ambulance or his roommate would drive him.
examples.zh: 接待人员问我朋友会「乘救护车到院」，还是由室友开车送他。

examples.en: She said I would arrive by ambulance at the hospital on the other side of town.
examples.zh: 她说我会「乘救护车到」城另一头的医院。

collocations: arrive by ambulance at the hospital

words.enDefinition: to request a change to another counselor

examples.en: I asked the receptionist how to ask for a different counselor if needed.
examples.zh: 我问前台，必要时该怎么「请求更换咨询师」。

examples.en: The leaflet says where to ask for a different counselor at the campus centre.
examples.zh: 宣传页上写了可以在校内中心什么地方「请求更换咨询师」。

collocations: can I ask for a different counselor
want to ask for a different counselor
how to ask for a different counselor

words.enDefinition: lenses with a surface whose curvature varies across it

examples.en: I asked the optician what aspheric lenses meant on the printed comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 我问配镜师，打印的对比表上「非球面镜片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The shop listed the price for aspheric lenses in a separate column.
examples.zh: 商店把「非球面镜片」的价格单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: a space where hospital staff carry out patient assessments

examples.en: The nurse directed me to an assessment bay across the corridor from the waiting area.
examples.zh: 护士指引我去候诊区走廊对面的「评估区隔间」。

examples.en: My flatmate waited by the doors while I was called into the assessment bay.
examples.zh: 我被叫进「评估区隔间」时，室友在门边等着。

collocations: direct someone to an assessment bay

words.enDefinition: notes documenting what a clinician assessed and found

examples.en: I asked whether the assessment notes would go with me when I changed wards.
examples.zh: 我问转病房时，「评估记录」会不会随我一起转过去。

examples.en: The nurse read the assessment notes before asking which details were missing from my file.
examples.zh: 护士先读了「评估记录」，再问档案里还缺哪些细节。

words.enDefinition: a first assessment carried out when someone reaches a service

examples.en: The nurse recorded the assessment on arrival and read back the notes to confirm them.
examples.zh: 护士记录了「到院初评」，并把记录读给我听作了确认。

examples.en: I asked where the assessment on arrival would take place after checking at the front desk.
examples.zh: 去前台确认后，我问在哪里做「到院初评」。

collocations: notes from the assessment on arrival

words.enDefinition: an item helping someone carry out a task more independently

examples.en: The therapist explained what counted as an assistive device on the form.
examples.zh: 治疗师解释了表格里哪些东西算「辅助器具」。

examples.en: I asked whether an assistive device could be delivered to my residence hall.
examples.zh: 我问「辅助器具」能不能送到我的宿舍楼。

collocations: an assistive device for everyday tasks

words.enDefinition: a focusing error caused by uneven curvature of the cornea or lens

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out where astigmatism was recorded on the printed results sheet.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了打印结果单上记录「散光」的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the figures for astigmatism were different in my two eyes.
examples.zh: 我问两只眼睛的「散光」数据是不是不一样。

words.enDefinition: a fully trained doctor overseeing care in a hospital team

examples.en: The attending physician introduced herself before explaining what was written in the emergency department record.
examples.zh: 「主诊医生」先做了自我介绍，然后讲解了急诊科病历上的内容。

examples.en: I asked the nurse when the attending physician would be available to discuss the summary.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「主诊医生」什么时候有空和我谈这份摘要。

words.enDefinition: a reference identifying an insurance approval for a service

examples.en: The clinic asked me to keep the authorization number until the claim was settled.
examples.zh: 诊所让我保留「审批编号」，等理赔处理完再说。

examples.en: I copied the authorization number from the letter into the online form.
examples.zh: 我把信里的「审批编号」填进了网上表格。

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to receive a specific document or information

examples.en: I checked who the authorized recipient was before the clinic sent the records.
examples.zh: 诊所发病历之前，我确认了「获授权接收人」是谁。

examples.en: The form asked me to enter the name of the authorized recipient clearly.
examples.zh: 表格请我清楚填写「获授权接收人」的姓名。

words.enDefinition: an instrument that estimates the eye's focusing error

examples.en: The technician recorded the numbers from the autorefractor before I saw the optometrist.
examples.zh: 我见验光师之前，技术人员记下了「自动验光仪」显示的数字。

examples.en: I asked whether the printout from the autorefractor belonged in my record.
examples.zh: 我问这张「自动验光仪」打印单是否要放进我的档案。

words.enDefinition: a secondary pharmacy label adding information to the main one

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the auxiliary label next to the main label.
examples.zh: 药师指了指主标签旁边的「附加药品标签」。

examples.en: I asked about a symbol printed on the small auxiliary label by the lid.
examples.zh: 我问瓶盖旁那张小小的「附加药品标签」上印的符号是什么意思。

collocations: an auxiliary label on a bottle

words.enDefinition: waiting until an appropriate hospital bed becomes available

examples.en: The status showed awaiting a bed, so I asked which desk could explain the delay.
examples.zh: 状态显示「等待床位」，我就问哪个服务台可以解释延误。

examples.en: I was still awaiting a bed when my friend returned with a charger that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上朋友带充电器回来时，我还在「等待床位」。

words.enDefinition: waiting for a medical imaging examination to take place

examples.en: The tracker showed awaiting imaging even though the team had already explained the next step.
examples.zh: 团队虽然已经讲了下一步，进度页面仍显示「等待影像检查」。

examples.en: I was awaiting imaging when my roommate called to ask which hospital building I was in.
examples.zh: 室友打来问我在哪栋医院楼里时，我正「等待影像检查」。

words.enDefinition: waiting for a clinician to examine existing information

examples.en: The doctor said the notes were awaiting review by the team responsible for the ward.
examples.zh: 医生说，记录在「等待临床复核」，由负责病区的团队处理。

examples.en: The portal showed awaiting review after the new entry appeared in my visit record.
examples.zh: 就诊档案里出现新记录后，平台显示「等待临床复核」。

words.enDefinition: one of the first teeth that develop in childhood

examples.en: My niece showed the dentist her loose baby tooth before sitting in the chair.
examples.zh: 我外甥女坐到牙椅上之前，给牙医看了她那颗松动的「乳牙」。

examples.en: The dentist used a picture of a baby tooth to explain my nephew's chart.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张「乳牙」的图片，给我外甥讲他的检查记录图。

words.enDefinition: billing a patient for the gap between charges and the allowed amount

examples.en: The benefits office explained balance billing when I asked about the extra amount.
examples.zh: 我问起多出的那笔金额时，福利办公室给我解释了「差额收费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unexpected charge was an example of balance billing.
examples.zh: 我问那笔意料外的费用是不是「差额收费」的一种。

words.enDefinition: an initial evaluation recorded for comparison with later findings

examples.en: The clinician explained which measurements belonged to the baseline assessment on my form.
examples.zh: 医生解释了表上哪些测量值属于「基线评估」。

examples.en: I asked if the baseline assessment would be available in the student health portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在学生健康平台上查看「基线评估」。

words.enDefinition: a person's abilities at the point used for later comparisons

examples.en: The therapist asked about my abilities before the illness to establish my baseline function.
examples.zh: 治疗师询问我生病前能做哪些事，以确定我的「基线功能水平」。

examples.en: The report listed baseline function separately from what I could manage that week.
examples.zh: 报告把「基线功能水平」和我那周能完成的事分开记录。

words.enDefinition: whether a service has a free hospital bed

examples.en: The team said bed availability would affect when my friend could move to the ward.
examples.zh: 团队说，「床位可用情况」会影响我朋友什么时候能转去病房。

examples.en: I asked whether bed availability was the reason the transfer had not happened yet.
examples.zh: 我问转运迟迟没安排，是不是因为「床位可用情况」。

words.enDefinition: new information explained in person beside the patient's bed

examples.en: The nurse gave a bedside update while my roommate sat with me that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午室友陪我坐着时，护士做了「床旁情况通报」。

examples.en: I asked whether my sister could listen to the bedside update over the phone.
examples.zh: 我问姐姐能不能通过电话听「床旁情况通报」。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to store a patient's personal items

examples.en: The nurse labeled the belongings bag before placing my shoes and jacket inside it.
examples.zh: 护士给「随身物品收纳袋」贴好标签，再把我的鞋和外套放进去。

examples.en: I asked the porter whether my belongings bag was still beside the bed downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问运送人员，我的「随身物品收纳袋」是不是还在楼下床边。

collocations: place items in a belongings bag

words.enDefinition: a booklet describing the details of an insurance plan

examples.en: I marked the page about dependents in the benefits booklet from the university.
examples.zh: 我在学校发的「保险保障手册」里标了讲家属的那页。

examples.en: The benefits booklet lists separate support numbers for policy questions and claims.
examples.zh: 「保险保障手册」分别列出了保单咨询和理赔咨询的电话。

words.enDefinition: lenses with two distinct areas for different viewing distances

examples.en: I saw a visible line on the sample pair of bifocal lenses.
examples.zh: 我在那副「双光镜片」样品上看到了明显的分界线。

examples.en: The optician showed my father where bifocal lenses appeared on the price sheet.
examples.zh: 配镜师给父亲指出了价目表上的「双光镜片」。

words.enDefinition: the amount a provider initially charges for a service

examples.en: The billed amount appears on the left side of my benefits statement.
examples.zh: 我的理赔说明单左侧列着「账单原始金额」。

examples.en: I compared the billed amount with the price listed on the clinic's receipt.
examples.zh: 我把「账单原始金额」和诊所收据上列的价格作了对比。

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a charge in a billing system

examples.en: The clinic explained which billing code appeared next to the charge I had questioned.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了我提出疑问的那笔费用旁是什么「计费代码」。

examples.en: I read the billing code aloud while the adviser looked up the claim.
examples.zh: 顾问查理赔时，我把「计费代码」念给了对方。

words.enDefinition: the office responsible for charges and payments at an organisation

examples.en: I called the billing department to ask why the statement showed my old address.
examples.zh: 我给「账单部门」打电话，问为什么账单显示的是旧地址。

examples.en: The receptionist transferred me to the billing department after I mentioned the charge.
examples.zh: 我提到那笔费用后，前台把我转接到了「账单部门」。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement about whether a charge is correct

examples.en: Our student advocate helped me identify who could handle a billing dispute.
examples.zh: 学生权益顾问帮我弄清了谁能处理「账单争议」。

examples.en: I kept the two statements together while the clinic looked into my billing dispute.
examples.zh: 诊所调查这起「账单争议」时，我把两份账单放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: a question or request about a charge on an account

examples.en: I sent a billing inquiry because the date on the statement looked wrong.
examples.zh: 账单上的日期似乎有误，所以我提交了「账单查询」。

examples.en: The email says my billing inquiry was forwarded to the clinic's accounts team.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我的「账单查询」已经转给了诊所财务组。

words.enDefinition: a statement showing charges, payments and the amount remaining

examples.en: The billing statement shows both the visit charge and what I paid that day.
examples.zh: 「费用对账单」既列了看诊费用，也列了我当天付的钱。

examples.en: I downloaded the billing statement before calling the university benefits adviser for help.
examples.zh: 给学校福利顾问打电话求助前，我下载了「费用对账单」。

words.enDefinition: vision formed when both eyes work together

examples.en: The examiner said the next part of the appointment would check binocular vision.
examples.zh: 检查人员说，就诊的下一个环节会检查「双眼视觉」。

examples.en: I asked where the results for binocular vision would appear in my online record.
examples.zh: 我问「双眼视觉」的结果会显示在网上记录的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: the way the upper and lower teeth fit together

examples.en: The orthodontist used a model to explain my bite alignment during the appointment.
examples.zh: 就诊时，正畸医生用模型给我说明了我的「咬合排列」。

examples.en: I asked whether the previous scan recorded my bite alignment clearly enough for comparison.
examples.zh: 我问之前的扫描有没有把我的「咬合排列」记录得够清楚，方便对比。

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how the upper and lower teeth meet

examples.en: The dentist added a bite check to my appointment after I mentioned discomfort when chewing.
examples.zh: 我提到咀嚼时不舒服，牙医就给这次就诊加了一项「咬合检查」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bite check was listed separately on my appointment summary.
examples.zh: 我问就诊摘要上是不是单独列了「咬合检查」。

words.enDefinition: an image showing the crowns of nearby upper and lower teeth

examples.en: The dentist opened my bitewing X-ray on screen so we could discuss the findings.
examples.zh: 牙医在屏幕上打开了我的「咬翼片」，方便我们讨论检查发现。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic could email my bitewing X-ray to the new practice.
examples.zh: 我问诊所能不能把我的「咬翼片」发邮件给新诊所。

words.enDefinition: gums from which blood comes during brushing or at other times

examples.en: I noted bleeding gums on the form because the question was about oral symptoms.
examples.zh: 表格问到了口腔症状，我就在上面注明了「牙龈出血」。

examples.en: The hygienist asked how often I had noticed bleeding gums since my last appointment.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师问我，从上次就诊后多久会碰到一次「牙龈出血」。

words.enDefinition: bleeding noted when a dentist gently examines the gum with a probe

examples.en: The dentist explained what bleeding on probing meant in the notes from my examination.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了我的检查记录里「探诊出血」是什么意思。

examples.en: The chart recorded bleeding on probing at several sites around the back teeth.
examples.zh: 检查记录图记载，后牙周围好几个位置有「探诊出血」。

words.enDefinition: a pack with separate raised pockets to hold individual items

examples.en: The medicine was supplied in a blister pack instead of a small bottle.
examples.zh: 这款药用的是「泡罩包装」，不是小瓶装。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy whether the blister pack was part of the original packaging.
examples.zh: 我问药房，这个「泡罩包装」是不是原装的一部分。

words.enDefinition: the formation of small sacs of fluid on skin

examples.en: I noticed blistering on one heel after taking off my walking boots.
examples.zh: 脱掉徒步靴后，我发现一边脚后跟「起水疱」了。

examples.en: The nurse asked when the blistering started and where I'd first seen it.
examples.zh: 护士问「起水疱」是什么时候开始的，我最早在哪里看到它。

words.enDefinition: a feeling that the belly is unusually full or swollen

examples.en: The bloating is usually worse after dinner and better by the next morning.
examples.zh: 「腹胀」通常在晚饭后更严重，到第二天早上会好一些。

examples.en: I mentioned the bloating because my jeans felt tight by the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我提到「腹胀」，因为到了下午牛仔裤就开始勒得慌。

words.enDefinition: checking blood sugar to look for possible problems with its regulation

examples.en: The event flyer listed blood glucose screening as one of the available checks.
examples.zh: 活动宣传单把「血糖筛查」列为可以做的检查之一。

examples.en: I asked whether my blood glucose screening result would appear on the clinic's portal.
examples.zh: 我问自己的「血糖筛查」结果会不会出现在诊所的平台上。

words.enDefinition: blood present in stool, visible or detected by a test

examples.en: I noticed blood in the stool this morning and mentioned it during my appointment.
examples.zh: 我今天早上发现「便中带血」，看诊时把这件事告诉了医生。

examples.en: The clinician asked if I had seen blood in the stool before today.
examples.zh: 医生问我今天之前有没有发现过「便中带血」。

collocations: signs of blood in the stool

words.enDefinition: blood present in urine, visible or detected by a test

examples.en: I noticed blood in the urine for the first time on Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我星期二早上第一次发现「尿中带血」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the blood in the urine had appeared more than once.
examples.zh: 护士问「尿中带血」是不是出现过不止一次。

collocations: check for blood in the urine

words.enDefinition: measurement of the pressure exerted by blood on artery walls

examples.en: The campus health office listed a blood pressure check on the event poster.
examples.zh: 校园健康办公室在活动海报上列了「血压测量」。

examples.en: I asked the nurse where my blood pressure check was recorded on the form.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「血压测量」记录在表格的哪里。

words.enDefinition: the measured values for a person's blood pressure

examples.en: The nurse entered my blood pressure reading in the computer after checking my name.
examples.zh: 护士核对我的姓名后，把「血压读数」录入了电脑。

examples.en: I asked whether the blood pressure reading would be included in the printed summary.
examples.zh: 我问打印的摘要里会不会包括「血压读数」。

words.enDefinition: a portion of blood taken for a laboratory test

examples.en: I asked which report corresponded to the blood sample mentioned in my record.
examples.zh: 我问哪份报告对应我的记录里提到的那个「血液样本」。

examples.en: The nurse checked that the blood sample identifier matched the clinic's paperwork.
examples.zh: 护士确认了「血液样本」编号与诊所的材料一致。

collocations: a report for a blood sample

words.enDefinition: soreness or pain felt in several parts of the body

examples.en: The body aches were worse in the evening, especially across my shoulders and legs.
examples.zh: 「全身酸痛」到晚上更厉害，尤其是肩膀和腿。

examples.en: I told the nurse that the body aches had lasted since Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，「全身酸痛」从星期一早上就开始了。

words.enDefinition: a number calculated from a person's height and weight

examples.en: I asked why body mass index was listed beside height on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格为什么把「体重指数」列在身高旁边。

examples.en: The clinician pointed out where my body mass index was recorded in the summary.
examples.zh: 医生给我指出了摘要里记录我的「体重指数」的位置。

collocations: a field for body mass index

words.enDefinition: checking bone mineral density to assess possible bone loss

examples.en: I asked whether the hospital had written information about bone density screening in English.
examples.zh: 我问医院有没有「骨密度筛查」方面的英文书面资料。

examples.en: The clinic listed bone density screening on its separate page for scheduled checks.
examples.zh: 诊所在单列的预约检查页面上写了「骨密度筛查」。

collocations: a description of bone density screening

words.enDefinition: to arrange a time to meet with a counselor

examples.en: I used the student portal to book a counseling session after my exam.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，我用学生门户「预约了一次心理咨询」。

examples.en: The reception desk explained who could book a counseling session at the university.
examples.zh: 前台说明了哪些人可以在学校「预约一次心理咨询」。

collocations: book a counseling session by phone
book a counseling session in advance

words.enDefinition: a telephone line used for making appointments

examples.en: The hospital letter gave me a separate booking line for changing the date of my visit.
examples.zh: 医院来信提供了一条单独的「预约专线」，用来更改就诊日期。

examples.en: I reached the booking line just after the office opened on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 星期一早上办公室刚开门，我就打通了「预约专线」。

words.enDefinition: an additional dose aimed at maintaining or restoring vaccine protection

examples.en: I asked where the booster dose appeared on my immunization printout.
examples.zh: 我问免疫接种记录打印单上哪里注明了「加强剂次」。

examples.en: The nurse checked whether the booster dose was listed under the right year.
examples.zh: 护士核对了「加强剂次」有没有列在正确的年份下面。

collocations: the date of a booster dose

words.enDefinition: a finding close to the cutoff between different test classifications

examples.en: The clinician explained the term borderline result in the summary of my test.
examples.zh: 医生解释了检测摘要里的「临界结果」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which entry on the report was labeled as a borderline result.
examples.zh: 我问报告上哪一项标成了「临界结果」。

words.enDefinition: orthodontic appliances commonly using brackets and wires to move teeth

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me two kinds of braces on the models in her office.
examples.zh: 正畸医生用诊室里的模型给我看了两种「牙齿矫治器」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic's written estimate for braces included later visits.
examples.zh: 我问诊所给「牙齿矫治器」的书面估价是否包含后续就诊。

words.enDefinition: a feeling of mental cloudiness that makes thinking harder

examples.en: The brain fog made it hard to follow the reading this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上「脑子昏沉」，我很难读懂手头的材料。

examples.en: I described the brain fog as feeling slow and muddled throughout the day.
examples.zh: 我描述了「脑子昏沉」的感觉，就是一整天思路都迟缓又混乱。

words.enDefinition: medicine sold under a manufacturer's distinctive commercial name

examples.en: I asked whether the brand-name medicine was listed under a different name on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问这款「品牌药」在收据上是不是用了不同的名称。

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where the brand-name medicine was named on the clinic's electronic order.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了诊所的电子处方上注明这款「品牌药」名称的位置。

collocations: compare a brand-name medicine with a generic

words.enDefinition: the frame measurement across the gap between the two lenses

examples.en: The optician wrote down the bridge width before showing me another frame.
examples.zh: 配镜师先记下「鼻梁架宽度」，再给我看另一款镜框。

examples.en: Online, the bridge width was listed beside two other frame measurements.
examples.zh: 网上把「鼻梁架宽度」和另外两个镜框尺寸列在了一起。

collocations: the bridge width on a frame

words.enDefinition: counseling offered over a limited number of meetings

examples.en: The adviser explained how brief counseling was organised for students during the term.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了学期内学校怎样为学生安排「短程心理咨询」。

examples.en: I asked whether brief counseling referred to the number or length of the sessions.
examples.zh: 我问「短程心理咨询」指次数少，还是每次时间短。

words.enDefinition: a visit for which the provider accepts the Medicare benefit as full payment

examples.en: The clinic's website explains who can book a bulk-billed appointment at that practice.
examples.zh: 该诊所的网站说明了哪些人可以预约「医保全额直结就诊」。

examples.en: I wrote down the difference between a bulk-billed appointment and one with a gap fee.
examples.zh: 我写下了「医保全额直结就诊」和需要付差额费用的就诊之间的区别。

words.enDefinition: an Australian arrangement accepting the Medicare benefit as full payment for eligible services

examples.en: The Australian practice explained who could use bulk billing for the campus appointment.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这家诊所解释了哪些人可以在那次校内预约中使用「澳洲医保全额直结」。

examples.en: I asked whether patients with OSHC and no Medicare could use bulk billing.
examples.zh: 我问只有赴澳留学生医疗保险、没有 Medicare 的患者能不能用「澳洲医保全额直结」。

words.enDefinition: pain that feels as if the area is burning

examples.en: The burning pain in my chest began shortly after I finished dinner.
examples.zh: 我刚吃完晚饭不久，胸口就出现了「烧灼样疼痛」。

examples.en: I told the nurse that the burning pain kept me awake last night.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，昨晚的「烧灼样疼痛」让我一直睡不着。

collocations: a burning pain in the chest

words.enDefinition: a feeling of heat or stinging in one area

examples.en: I felt a burning sensation across the back of my hand yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我感觉手背上有一阵「灼烧感」。

examples.en: The nurse asked if the burning sensation was still there after dinner.
examples.zh: 护士问我吃完晚饭后还有没有「灼烧感」。

words.enDefinition: releasing gas from the stomach through the mouth

examples.en: I noticed more burping than usual after lunch at the student dining hall.
examples.zh: 我在学生食堂吃过午饭后，发现「嗳气」比平时多。

examples.en: I mentioned the burping when the nurse asked what happened after I ate.
examples.zh: 护士问我饭后有什么情况时，我提到了「嗳气」。

words.enDefinition: a button or device used by patients to summon staff

examples.en: The nurse showed me the call bell and wrote her name on the board nearby.
examples.zh: 护士指给我看「护士呼叫铃」，还把自己的名字写到旁边的板上。

examples.en: I asked whether the call bell beside my bed would alert someone at the desk.
examples.zh: 我问床边的「护士呼叫铃」会不会通知服务台的人。

collocations: a call bell by the bed

words.enDefinition: the telephone number someone should use to call back

examples.en: The receptionist repeated my callback number to make sure I had given it correctly.
examples.zh: 前台把我的「回拨号码」重复了一遍，确认我报对了。

examples.en: I left a different callback number because my old phone was being repaired that week.
examples.zh: 那周旧手机正在维修，我就留了另一个「回拨号码」。

words.enDefinition: the university office that provides counseling and support

examples.en: I stopped at the campus counseling center after my afternoon seminar finished early.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课提前结束后，我去了趟「校内心理咨询中心」。

examples.en: The campus counseling center sent me a map showing its entrance from the courtyard.
examples.zh: 「校内心理咨询中心」发给我一张图，标出了从庭院进去的入口。

words.enDefinition: a university event offering health information or services to students

examples.en: I picked up a screening brochure at the campus health fair after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在「校园健康活动」上领了一份筛查资料。

examples.en: The campus health fair included a table where students could ask about local clinics.
examples.zh: 「校园健康活动」上设了咨询桌，学生可以问附近有哪些诊所。

collocations: a booth at the campus health fair

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy located on university grounds for campus users

examples.en: The campus pharmacy is across from the student clinic in the same building.
examples.zh: 「校园药房」在学生诊所对面，都在同一栋楼里。

examples.en: I asked if the campus pharmacy would still be open after my afternoon lab.
examples.zh: 我问下午的实验课结束后，「校园药房」是否还营业。

collocations: a prescription at the campus pharmacy

words.enDefinition: a central campus location for finding wellbeing services

examples.en: The campus wellbeing hub was open when I passed the main library at lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭时路过主图书馆，「校园身心健康服务站」开着。

examples.en: My tutor sent me a link to the campus wellbeing hub before the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假前，导师给我发了「校园身心健康服务站」的链接。

words.enDefinition: withdraw an issued medication order before it is filled

examples.en: I called the clinic to cancel a prescription that had been sent to the wrong branch.
examples.zh: 我给诊所打电话，请他们「取消发错分店的处方」。

examples.en: The pharmacist asked who could cancel a prescription if an old order was still active.
examples.zh: 如果旧处方仍然有效，药师想知道谁能「取消处方」。

collocations: the clinic can cancel a prescription
a reason to cancel a prescription

words.enDefinition: a list of people offered times that others cancel

examples.en: I asked to join the cancellation list because I could come in at short notice.
examples.zh: 我随时都能抽出时间，就请前台把我加进「退约候补名单」。

examples.en: The receptionist called someone from the cancellation list when the early appointment became free.
examples.zh: 早上的预约一空出来，前台就给「退约候补名单」上的人打了电话。

collocations: put someone on the cancellation list
call someone from the cancellation list

words.enDefinition: a pointed tooth between the incisors and the premolars

examples.en: The dentist pointed to my canine tooth while explaining the position shown on screen.
examples.zh: 牙医指着我的「尖牙」，说明屏幕上标的是哪个位置。

examples.en: I could see the tip of the canine tooth clearly in the photograph.
examples.zh: 我在照片上能清楚看见那颗「尖牙」的尖端。

words.enDefinition: cannot eat without vomiting afterward

examples.en: I told my flatmate I can't keep food down even when I eat slowly.
examples.zh: 我跟室友说，哪怕慢慢吃，我也「吃什么都吐」。

examples.en: I told the nurse I can't keep food down, even after a very small breakfast.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，我才吃了一点早饭，还是「吃什么都吐」。

collocations: say you can't keep food down
notice you can't keep food down

words.enDefinition: a small shell that contains medicine in solid or liquid form

examples.en: I asked whether the order on the screen showed a capsule formulation.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的订单是不是写了「胶囊」剂型。

examples.en: The leaflet included a picture of a capsule next to its product name.
examples.zh: 说明书在产品名称旁边印了一张「胶囊」的图。

words.enDefinition: a device that tracks the heart's activity over time

examples.en: I asked the nurse what the beeping from the cardiac monitor next to my bed meant.
examples.zh: 我问护士，床边「心脏监护仪」发出来的哔哔声是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse checked the name on the chart before connecting the cardiac monitor beside me.
examples.zh: 护士先核对记录表上的姓名，再连接我身旁的「心脏监护仪」。

words.enDefinition: plans for who provides care and when it happens

examples.en: I called my mother once the ward had confirmed the care arrangements.
examples.zh: 病区确认「照护安排」后，我给妈妈打了电话。

examples.en: The social worker wrote down our care arrangements before meeting my flatmate.
examples.zh: 社工和室友见面前，先记下了我们的「照护安排」。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps organize a patient's services

examples.en: The care coordinator helped me work out which clinic would handle the next appointment.
examples.zh: 「照护协调员」帮我弄清了下次就诊归哪家诊所安排。

examples.en: I emailed the care coordinator because two departments had sent me conflicting appointment dates.
examples.zh: 两个科室发来的预约日期有冲突，我就发邮件给「照护协调员」。

words.enDefinition: a review to establish what practical or personal support someone needs

examples.en: I described how far I lived from campus during the care needs assessment.
examples.zh: 在「照护需求评估」中，我说明了自己的住处离学校有多远。

examples.en: The social worker asked if my family could join the care needs assessment.
examples.zh: 社工问我的家人能不能参加「照护需求评估」。

collocations: the outcome of a care needs assessment

words.enDefinition: a timetable showing when support or care will be provided

examples.en: My family shared the care schedule so everyone knew who was coming.
examples.zh: 家人分享了「照护时间表」，这样大家都知道谁会来。

examples.en: I checked the care schedule before agreeing to meet my tutor that afternoon.
examples.zh: 答应当天下午和导师见面之前，我看了一下「照护时间表」。

words.enDefinition: the group of people supporting someone's healthcare

examples.en: I asked who on the care team could answer a question about my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「医疗照护团队」里有谁能回答我的预约问题。

examples.en: The message told me how to contact the care team if my schedule changed.
examples.zh: 消息里写明，如果我的日程变了，如何联系「医疗照护团队」。

collocations: a member of the care team

words.enDefinition: someone who looks after a person needing help with daily life

examples.en: I asked my caregiver to join the discussion about support after I went home.
examples.zh: 我请「照护者」也参加关于我回家后支持安排的讨论。

examples.en: The form asked whether a caregiver would be available in the evenings.
examples.zh: 表格问晚上是否有「照护者」能提供帮助。

words.enDefinition: a professional discussion about how to support a particular client

examples.en: The counselor explained what a case consultation meant in the centre's privacy information.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了中心隐私说明里的「个案讨论」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which staff members attended a case consultation at the counselling service.
examples.zh: 我问咨询机构哪些工作人员会参加「个案讨论」。

words.enDefinition: clouding of the natural lens inside the eye

examples.en: The ophthalmologist pointed to the note about the cataract in my grandfather's referral letter.
examples.zh: 眼科医生给爷爷指出了转诊信上关于「白内障」的备注。

examples.en: I asked the translator how to explain the word cataract to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我问口译员该怎么向外婆解释「白内障」这个词。

words.enDefinition: vaccination intended to make up doses that were missed earlier

examples.en: I asked the nurse what catch-up vaccination meant on the clinic's services page.
examples.zh: 我问护士，诊所服务网页上的「疫苗补种」是什么意思。

examples.en: The school's guide listed a phone number for questions about catch-up vaccination.
examples.zh: 学校指南列出了一个电话号码，可以咨询「疫苗补种」。

words.enDefinition: the geographic area a particular service normally covers

examples.en: I checked the catchment area before choosing a practice near my new student flat.
examples.zh: 我先查了「服务覆盖区」，再选自己新租的学生公寓附近的诊所。

examples.en: The receptionist asked for my postcode to check whether I lived in the catchment area.
examples.zh: 前台问我的邮编，核对我是否住在「服务覆盖区」内。

words.enDefinition: a hole in a tooth caused by decay

examples.en: I asked whether the cavity shown on the screen was from my latest image.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的「龋洞」是不是出现在我最近拍的那张片子上。

examples.en: The dentist explained which surface of the tooth had the cavity.
examples.zh: 牙医说明了「龋洞」在这颗牙的哪一面。

words.enDefinition: sight directly ahead where someone is looking

examples.en: The optometrist asked whether the change in my central vision was noticeable during reading.
examples.zh: 验光师问我，阅读时是否能察觉「中心视力」有变化。

examples.en: The report described central vision and peripheral vision in two separate sections.
examples.zh: 报告分成两部分，分别描述「中心视力」和周边视野。

words.enDefinition: fixed orthodontic appliances with brackets made of ceramic

examples.en: I asked to see how ceramic braces looked on the display model.
examples.zh: 我想看看展示模型戴上「陶瓷牙套」是什么样子。

examples.en: The clinic listed ceramic braces separately from the standard metal option on its sheet.
examples.zh: 诊所在表上把「陶瓷牙套」和标准的金属牙套分开列了出来。

words.enDefinition: a preventive check looking for signs of risk of cervical cancer

examples.en: The clinic's booklet listed a separate phone number for cervical screening queries.
examples.zh: 诊所的册子里单独列了一个咨询「宫颈筛查」的电话号码。

examples.en: I asked who could explain the cervical screening entry in my online record.
examples.zh: 我问谁能解释我网上记录里的「宫颈筛查」这一项。

words.enDefinition: a difference in the way a patient is doing

examples.en: The nurse asked when we first noticed a change in condition during the wait.
examples.zh: 护士问我们在等候期间最早是什么时候注意到「病情变化」的。

examples.en: The doctor added a note to the record describing a change in condition that evening.
examples.zh: 医生在病历上加了一条备注，描述了那天晚上的「病情变化」。

words.enDefinition: a nurse responsible for overseeing a unit on a shift

examples.en: The charge nurse checked which room was available before directing us to the next area.
examples.zh: 「值班主管护士」先确认哪个房间空着，再指引我们去下一区域。

examples.en: My roommate asked the charge nurse where she could wait for news about the transfer.
examples.zh: 室友问「值班主管护士」，她可以在哪里等转运消息。

words.enDefinition: free or reduced-cost healthcare for patients who meet financial criteria

examples.en: A billing adviser explained how the hospital's charity care program reviews applications.
examples.zh: 账单顾问解释了医院的「减免式医疗援助」项目怎样审核申请。

examples.en: The form shows what information is needed to be considered for charity care.
examples.zh: 表上写明了申请「减免式医疗援助」需要提供哪些资料。

words.enDefinition: to tell front desk staff that you have arrived

examples.en: The email asked me to check in at reception fifteen minutes before the scheduled time.
examples.zh: 邮件让我在预约时间前十五分钟「到前台报到」。

examples.en: I went to check in at reception before taking a seat near the window.
examples.zh: 我先去「前台报到」，然后在窗边找了个座位。

collocations: arrive early to check in at reception
check in at reception upon arrival
remember to check in at reception

words.zhGloss: 联系并关心某人的近况
words.enDefinition: to contact a person to see how they are doing
acceptedZhAnswers: 联系并关心某人的近况

examples.en: After the exams, I wanted to check in on someone from my study group.
examples.zh: 考试过后，我想「联系并关心一下」学习小组里一位同学的近况。

examples.en: We talked about how to check in on someone who had missed several meetings.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了该怎么「联系并关心」一位缺席了几次聚会的同学。

collocations: offer to check in on someone
remember to check in on someone
take time to check in on someone

words.enDefinition: a feeling of pressure or squeezing in the chest

examples.en: I noticed chest tightness while carrying my laundry up the stairs yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天抱着衣服上楼时，我觉得「胸口发紧」。

examples.en: The nurse asked when the chest tightness began and how long it lasted.
examples.zh: 护士问我「胸口发紧」是什么时候开始的，持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray examination that produces images of the chest

examples.en: The clinician checked that the report from my chest X-ray was in the hospital record.
examples.zh: 医务人员核实了我的「胸部X线检查」报告是否在医院病历里。

examples.en: The nurse explained where the chest X-ray would take place while my roommate waited nearby.
examples.zh: 室友在旁边等着，护士告诉我「胸部X线检查」要去哪里做。

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet designed to be chewed before swallowing

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed to the words chewable tablet on the new label.
examples.zh: 药师指了指新标签上写的「咀嚼片」字样。

examples.en: I asked whether the picture in the leaflet showed a chewable tablet.
examples.zh: 我问说明书的图片上画的是不是「咀嚼片」。

words.enDefinition: a closure designed to be harder for young children to open

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the child-resistant cap when she showed me the medicine bottle.
examples.zh: 药师给我看药瓶时，指了指上面的「儿童防护瓶盖」。

examples.en: The child-resistant cap on this bottle looked different from the cap on my previous order.
examples.zh: 这瓶药的「儿童防护瓶盖」看起来和上一次拿到的药瓶盖不一样。

collocations: a bottle with a child-resistant cap

words.enDefinition: a sensation of cold that can cause shaking or shivering

examples.en: I had chills even though the room was warm and I wore a sweater.
examples.zh: 房间很暖，我也穿着毛衣，但我还是「发冷打寒战」。

examples.en: The chills began yesterday, halfway through my afternoon walk back from campus.
examples.zh: 「发冷寒战」是昨天开始的，当时我下午正走在回宿舍的路上。

words.enDefinition: a tooth with a small piece broken off

examples.en: I told the clinic about the chipped tooth after noticing a rough edge.
examples.zh: 发现牙边上有一处粗糙后，我向诊所说明了「崩缺的牙齿」的情况。

examples.en: The dentist took a photograph of the chipped tooth before we discussed the report.
examples.zh: 我们谈报告前，牙医给那颗「崩缺的牙齿」拍了照。

words.enDefinition: the ability to choose which therapist to see

examples.en: I asked whether the service offered a choice of therapist for online sessions.
examples.zh: 我问在线上接受咨询时，有没有「选择治疗师的余地」。

examples.en: The intake adviser explained how much choice of therapist students had at the centre.
examples.zh: 初评顾问介绍了在中心接受咨询的学生有多少「选择治疗师的余地」。

collocations: ask about the choice of therapist

words.enDefinition: checking cholesterol levels as part of a preventive assessment

examples.en: I asked where cholesterol screening was listed on the clinic's services page.
examples.zh: 我问诊所的服务网页哪里列了「胆固醇筛查」。

examples.en: The campus clinic had a leaflet explaining the term cholesterol screening in plain language.
examples.zh: 校园诊所有一份宣传单，用通俗的话解释「胆固醇筛查」。

words.enDefinition: a health condition that persists over a long period

examples.en: The form asked whether I received regular care for a chronic condition in my home country.
examples.zh: 表格问我之前在自己的国家有没有为「慢性疾病」定期就诊。

examples.en: I brought a letter about my chronic condition when I met the new doctor.
examples.zh: 见新医生时，我带了一封关于自己「慢性疾病」的信。

words.enDefinition: the process of deciding whether and how much to pay on a claim

examples.en: The adviser explained claim adjudication when I asked why my request was taking time.
examples.zh: 我问申请为什么还没结果时，顾问给我解释了「理赔审核裁定」。

examples.en: The portal refers to claim adjudication in the page about reviewing the submitted bill.
examples.zh: 在线系统在介绍如何审核已提交账单的页面提到了「理赔审核裁定」。

words.enDefinition: a request for an insurer to review its claim decision

examples.en: I gathered my documents before filing a claim appeal through the insurer's portal.
examples.zh: 我先整理了材料，再通过保险公司系统提起「理赔申诉」。

examples.en: The benefits adviser asked what decision I wanted reviewed in my claim appeal.
examples.zh: 福利顾问问，我希望在这次「理赔申诉」中复核哪项决定。

words.enDefinition: a plan's agreement to pay all or part of a submitted claim

examples.en: I received an email about claim approval while waiting for the campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 等校车时，我收到了一封「理赔获批」的邮件。

examples.en: The claim approval notice lists the amount the plan intends to pay toward the bill.
examples.zh: 「理赔获批」通知列有保险计划方打算承担的账单金额。

words.enDefinition: a decision to refuse payment of a claim or part of it

examples.en: I asked the benefits office to explain the claim denial in simple language.
examples.zh: 我请福利办公室用简单的话解释这笔「理赔拒付」。

examples.en: The claim denial described which documents the insurer had used in its review.
examples.zh: 「理赔拒付」通知写明了保险公司审核时用了哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: the last date a plan accepts a claim submission

examples.en: I found the claim filing deadline in the guide sent by the insurer.
examples.zh: 我在保险公司发的指南里找到了「理赔申报截止日」。

examples.en: The adviser wrote down the claim filing deadline for the receipt I brought.
examples.zh: 顾问记下了我带来的那张收据所对应的「理赔申报截止日」。

words.enDefinition: a form used to request an insurance payment

examples.en: I entered the appointment date on the claim form before attaching the receipt.
examples.zh: 我先把就诊日期填进「理赔申请表」，再附上收据。

examples.en: The insurance office sent a new claim form after I selected the wrong policy.
examples.zh: 我选错保单后，保险办公室发来一张新的「理赔申请表」。

words.enDefinition: a reference number for a particular insurance claim

examples.en: I wrote down the claim number so I could refer to it later.
examples.zh: 我记下了「理赔编号」，以后就能用它查询。

examples.en: The adviser used my claim number to find the correct record online.
examples.zh: 顾问用我的「理赔编号」，在网上找到了相应记录。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or result of an insurance claim

examples.en: I signed into the portal to check my claim status during lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我登录在线系统，查了一下「理赔进度」。

examples.en: The adviser said my claim status would change once the corrected bill arrived.
examples.zh: 顾问说，修正的账单一到，我的「理赔进度」就会更新。

words.enDefinition: an online system for submitting or checking insurance claims

examples.en: The claims portal showed a new message about my submitted receipt this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，「在线理赔平台」上多了一条关于我提交的收据的消息。

examples.en: I signed into the claims portal from my room to check the status.
examples.zh: 我在房间里登录「在线理赔平台」查看进度。

words.enDefinition: skin that feels cool and slightly damp to touch

examples.en: My roommate noticed my clammy skin while we waited in the clinic lobby.
examples.zh: 我们在诊所大厅等候时，室友发现我的「皮肤又湿又冷」。

examples.en: I told the nurse about the clammy skin and when it first appeared.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士我的「皮肤湿冷」，并说了这种情况最早什么时候出现。

words.enDefinition: to make the expected following actions clear

examples.en: I asked the receptionist to clarify the next steps after the specialist changed my appointment.
examples.zh: 专科医生改了预约后，我请前台帮我「弄清下一步安排」。

examples.en: We met briefly after the consultation to clarify the next steps for booking a return visit.
examples.zh: 问诊后我们简单碰了个面，以便「弄清下一步安排」，预约再次就诊。

collocations: ask someone to clarify the next steps
clarify the next steps in writing
meet to clarify the next steps

words.enDefinition: a clear removable tray designed to gradually move the teeth

examples.en: The orthodontist let me examine a clear aligner during the introductory consultation.
examples.zh: 初次咨询时，正畸医生让我仔细看了看一个「透明矫治器」。

examples.en: I asked which items in the estimate were related to the clear aligner.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪些项目和「透明矫治器」有关。

words.enDefinition: approved by the clinical team to leave hospital care

examples.en: My roommate waited by the entrance until I was cleared for discharge that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，室友一直在入口等到我「获准出院」。

examples.en: The status changed to cleared for discharge shortly before the nurse printed my paperwork.
examples.zh: 护士打印我的文件前不久，状态改成了「获准出院」。

collocations: wait to be cleared for discharge

words.enDefinition: the times a clinic is open to see patients

examples.en: The clinic hours changed during the university holidays, so I checked the notice board.
examples.zh: 学校放假期间「诊所开放时间」有变化，我就查看了公告栏。

examples.en: I checked the clinic hours before walking across town to drop off the form.
examples.zh: 我在步行穿过市区交表之前，先查了「诊所开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: a staff member handling visitors and bookings at a clinic

examples.en: The clinic receptionist asked me to confirm which day I could come in person.
examples.zh: 「诊所前台接待员」让我确认哪一天能到现场就诊。

examples.en: I told the clinic receptionist that the appointment message displayed the wrong campus building.
examples.zh: 我告诉「诊所前台接待员」，预约消息里显示的校园楼号不对。

words.enDefinition: a clinician's evaluation of a person's condition and needs

examples.en: The specialist explained what the clinical assessment would cover before discussing my previous records.
examples.zh: 专科医生先解释了「临床评估」会涉及什么，再谈我之前的记录。

examples.en: I received a short message about where to go for the clinical assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我收到一条短消息，告诉我下周去哪里做「临床评估」。

collocations: the results of a clinical assessment

words.enDefinition: a worsening of a patient's medical condition

examples.en: The handover mentioned clinical deterioration and recorded when the staff first noticed the change.
examples.zh: 交接提到了「病情恶化」，并记录了工作人员什么时候第一次察觉变化。

examples.en: I asked the doctor what clinical deterioration meant in the note my friend had shown me.
examples.zh: 我问医生，朋友给我看的记录里「病情恶化」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: observations and results that a clinician records during an assessment

examples.en: The doctor explained the clinical findings before asking whether I wanted someone to join the call.
examples.zh: 医生先解释了「临床所见」，再问我想不想请人加入通话。

examples.en: The summary included the clinical findings but left out the time of my arrival.
examples.zh: 摘要包含「临床所见」，但没写我的到院时间。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of patient information and responsibility between clinicians

examples.en: The nurse explained that the clinical handover would take place when the next team arrived.
examples.zh: 护士说明，下一班团队到达时会做「临床交接」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinical handover would include the notes from my earlier visit.
examples.zh: 我问「临床交接」时，会不会把我上一次就诊的记录也交过去。

words.enDefinition: a psychology professional trained in assessing and treating mental health concerns

examples.en: The university website says a clinical psychologist helps oversee its student assessment service.
examples.zh: 学校网站说，一位「临床心理学家」参与监督学生评估服务。

examples.en: I looked up the clinical psychologist named in the email from student health.
examples.zh: 我查了学生健康服务发来的邮件中提到的那位「临床心理学家」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare professional who works directly with patients

examples.en: The receptionist asked which clinician I wanted to see before checking the available times.
examples.zh: 前台先问我想看哪位「临床医务人员」，再查可约时间。

examples.en: I gave the clinician the letter that the previous practice had sent to me.
examples.zh: 我把原来诊所寄给我的信交给了「临床医务人员」。

words.enDefinition: tinted attachments that clip onto a pair of regular glasses

examples.en: The shop measured my frames before showing me a pair of clip-on sunglasses.
examples.zh: 店员先量了我的镜框，才给我看一副「夹片式太阳镜」。

examples.en: The clip-on sunglasses came in a small pouch separate from the glasses.
examples.zh: 「夹片式太阳镜」有个单独的小袋子，没和眼镜装在一起。

words.enDefinition: a therapy addressing links between thoughts, feelings and behaviour

examples.en: The clinician explained the name cognitive behavioral therapy after I saw it in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我在小册子里看到「认知行为疗法」这个词后，治疗师给我作了解释。

examples.en: The university invited someone to speak about cognitive behavioral therapy at the wellbeing fair.
examples.zh: 学校邀请了一位讲者在身心健康活动上介绍「认知行为疗法」。

words.enDefinition: the patient's percentage of the allowed amount for a covered service

examples.en: The benefits adviser explained coinsurance when I asked why the charge wasn't fixed.
examples.zh: 我问金额为什么不是固定的，福利顾问给我解释了「按比例自付」。

examples.en: The plan summary lists coinsurance for some visits and a fixed charge for others.
examples.zh: 保障摘要写着，有的就诊「按比例自付」，另一些按固定金额收费。

words.enDefinition: sweating accompanied by a sudden feeling of cold

examples.en: I broke out in a cold sweat when the pain suddenly got worse.
examples.zh: 疼痛突然加剧时，我冒了一身「冷汗」。

examples.en: I woke up in a cold sweat shortly after the discomfort first started.
examples.zh: 不舒服刚出现没多久，我就冒着「冷汗」醒了过来。

collocations: break out in a cold sweat
wake up in a cold sweat
be covered in a cold sweat

words.enDefinition: a reference code used to verify a specific pickup

examples.en: The system sent me a collection code when my order was ready.
examples.zh: 订单备好后，系统给我发了一个「取药核验码」。

examples.en: I showed the collection code to the clerk because the app wouldn't load.
examples.zh: 应用加载不出来，我就把「取药核验码」出示给了药房人员。

collocations: a text with a collection code

words.enDefinition: the date a specific test sample was obtained

examples.en: The report showed a collection date different from the date it was released.
examples.zh: 报告显示的「采集日期」和报告发布日期不一样。

examples.en: I asked whether the collection date appeared next to my name on the record.
examples.zh: 我问记录上「采集日期」是不是写在我的名字旁边。

words.enDefinition: the place where samples are obtained for laboratory testing

examples.en: The booking email gave directions to the collection site behind the library.
examples.zh: 预约邮件说明了怎么到图书馆后面的「标本采集点」。

examples.en: I checked whether the collection site on my form had an accessible entrance.
examples.zh: 我确认了表格上那个「标本采集点」有没有无障碍入口。

words.enDefinition: difficulty distinguishing certain colors that others can tell apart

examples.en: I asked what color vision deficiency meant on the form from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问诊所表格上的「色觉缺陷」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician recorded color vision deficiency separately from the measurements of visual sharpness.
examples.zh: 医务人员把「色觉缺陷」和视敏度的测量结果分开记录。

collocations: a report noting color vision deficiency

words.enDefinition: a test of how well someone can distinguish different colors

examples.en: The color vision test used pages filled with dots in different shades.
examples.zh: 「色觉测试」用的每一页上都布满了不同颜色的圆点。

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether the color vision test was part of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，这次预约是否包括「色觉测试」。

collocations: results from a color vision test

words.enDefinition: testing to look for early colorectal cancer or signs of risk

examples.en: I noticed information about colorectal cancer screening on the health office's noticeboard.
examples.zh: 我在健康办公室的公告栏上看到了「结直肠癌筛查」资料。

examples.en: The booklet listed a separate helpline for questions about colorectal cancer screening.
examples.zh: 册子单独列了一个电话，可以咨询「结直肠癌筛查」。

words.enDefinition: an outpatient facility providing healthcare to a local population

examples.en: I found a community health center within walking distance of the library near my flat.
examples.zh: 我家附近的图书馆旁有一个步行可达的「社区卫生中心」。

examples.en: The community health center told me which desk would handle my first visit there.
examples.zh: 「社区卫生中心」告诉我第一次来该到哪个窗口办理。

words.enDefinition: local support and care for people with mental health concerns

examples.en: The university adviser explained how to contact the community mental health service after graduation.
examples.zh: 学校顾问说明了毕业后如何联系「社区心理健康服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the community mental health service offered appointments near my new flat.
examples.zh: 我查了「社区心理健康服务」是否在我新公寓附近有可约的地点。

collocations: contact a community mental health service
access a community mental health service

words.enDefinition: a local pharmacy serving people in the surrounding area

examples.en: The clinic sent my prescription to the community pharmacy near our bus stop.
examples.zh: 学校诊所把处方发到了公交站附近的「社区药房」。

examples.en: I called the community pharmacy to check whether their counter stayed open at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我给「社区药房」打电话，问他们的柜台午休时间开不开。

collocations: collect medicine from a community pharmacy

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation provided by local services outside a hospital stay

examples.en: I got a call from the community rehabilitation team on my first day home.
examples.zh: 我回家第一天，就接到了「社区康复」团队的电话。

examples.en: The nurse explained how community rehabilitation differed from appointments at the hospital.
examples.zh: 护士说明了「社区康复」与去医院就诊有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a blood test measuring the amounts and characteristics of blood cells

examples.en: The clinician pointed out the complete blood count section on my printed report.
examples.zh: 医生给我指出了打印报告里「全血细胞计数」那一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the complete blood count was the test the nurse had mentioned.
examples.zh: 我问「全血细胞计数」是不是护士之前提到的那项检测。

words.enDefinition: a usually tooth-colored restoration made of composite resin

examples.en: The estimate listed a composite filling and included a short description of the material.
examples.zh: 估价单列了「复合树脂补牙填充体」，并简单介绍了这种材料。

examples.en: I asked the dentist to point out the old composite filling in my photograph.
examples.zh: 我请牙医在我的照片上指出原来的「复合树脂补牙填充体」。

collocations: an estimate for a composite filling

words.enDefinition: a medicine prepared by combining or adapting ingredients for a specific need

examples.en: The pharmacy told me when the compounded medication would be ready for collection.
examples.zh: 药房告诉我什么时候可以来领「定制调配药」。

examples.en: I asked whether the leaflet for the compounded medication would be included in the bag.
examples.zh: 我问袋子里会不会附上「定制调配药」的说明书。

words.enDefinition: an examination checking vision as well as overall eye health

examples.en: I asked how long the comprehensive eye exam would take before booking it.
examples.zh: 预约前我问了「全面眼部检查」大概要做多久。

examples.en: The clinic emailed a summary of my comprehensive eye exam the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，诊所用电子邮件把「全面眼部检查」的摘要发给了我。

words.enDefinition: a consultation whose discussion is kept private

examples.en: The clinic offered a confidential consultation in a room away from the waiting area.
examples.zh: 诊所在远离候诊区的房间安排了「保密问诊」。

examples.en: I requested a confidential consultation because I wanted to discuss something sensitive without my roommate present.
examples.zh: 我想在室友不在场时聊一件敏感的事，就申请了「保密问诊」。

words.enDefinition: counseling where information is protected under rules and agreed limits

examples.en: The website describes confidential counseling and links to the service's privacy information.
examples.zh: 网站介绍了「保密心理咨询」，并链接到服务的隐私说明。

examples.en: Before sharing anything, I asked how confidential counseling worked at this university.
examples.zh: 讲自己的事之前，我先问了本校的「保密心理咨询」是怎么做的。

words.enDefinition: the rules for protecting and sharing personal information

examples.en: I read the confidentiality policy before filling out the counseling intake paperwork online.
examples.zh: 在网上填心理咨询初评材料之前，我先读了「保密政策」。

examples.en: The counselor pointed out a section of the confidentiality policy that I had missed.
examples.zh: 咨询师给我指出了「保密政策」中我漏看的一节。

words.enDefinition: a follow-up test intended to verify an earlier finding

examples.en: I asked what confirmatory test meant in the letter from the screening clinic.
examples.zh: 我问筛查诊所寄来的信里，「确认检测」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinician explained why the confirmatory test had a separate entry in my records.
examples.zh: 医生解释了为什么我的记录里单独列了「确认检测」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording someone's permission for a particular action

examples.en: I read the consent form and asked about a line that I did not understand.
examples.zh: 我看了「同意书」，还问了一句自己没弄懂的话。

examples.en: The receptionist offered me a translated consent form after I asked for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我说需要人帮忙看，前台就给了我一份翻译过的「同意书」。

words.enDefinition: a client's agreement to receive counseling after learning about it

examples.en: The form asks for consent to counseling and explains how the centre handles records.
examples.zh: 表格询问是否「同意接受心理咨询」，还说明了中心如何处理记录。

examples.en: I asked the counselor about the wording of consent to counseling before signing.
examples.zh: 签字前，我向咨询师问了「同意接受心理咨询」那一栏的措辞。

words.enDefinition: pain that does not stop during the time described

examples.en: I have constant pain in my wrist, even when I'm not using it.
examples.zh: 我的手腕「一直疼」，即使不用它的时候也疼。

examples.en: The constant pain started three days ago and hasn't let up since.
examples.zh: 「持续不断的疼痛」三天前开始，此后一直没停。

collocations: constant pain in the lower back

words.enDefinition: difficulty passing stool or passing it less often than usual

examples.en: I mentioned the constipation when the nurse asked about changes during my trip.
examples.zh: 护士问我旅途中身体有什么变化时，我提到了「便秘」。

examples.en: The clinician asked how long the constipation had continued since I came home.
examples.zh: 医生问我回家后，「便秘」持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: written details recorded by a clinician during a consultation

examples.en: The doctor reviewed the consultation notes before sending a message about our last appointment.
examples.zh: 医生先看了「问诊记录」，再发来有关我们上次就诊的消息。

examples.en: I asked whether the consultation notes would be available through the clinic's online portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在诊所的网上平台里看到「问诊记录」。

collocations: request a copy of the consultation notes

words.enDefinition: a private room for talking with a healthcare professional

examples.en: The pharmacist offered to talk in the consultation room away from the busy queue.
examples.zh: 药师提出到「咨询室」聊，避开排队的人群。

examples.en: There was a sign for the consultation room next to the pharmacy's back counter.
examples.zh: 药房后面那个柜台旁边有一块「咨询室」的指示牌。

words.enDefinition: a measurement describing the curvature of the inner side of a contact lens

examples.en: I asked where the contact lens base curve appeared on the printed form.
examples.zh: 我问打印表格上的「隐形眼镜基弧」标在哪里。

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out the contact lens base curve on the side of the box.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了盒子侧面标注的「隐形眼镜基弧」。

collocations: check the contact lens base curve
the printed contact lens base curve
record a contact lens base curve

words.enDefinition: an individual sealed pocket holding a contact lens

examples.en: The assistant showed me the information printed on the contact lens blister.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了「隐形眼镜独立泡罩」上印的信息。

examples.en: I asked where the product name appeared on the contact lens blister.
examples.zh: 我问「隐形眼镜独立泡罩」的哪个位置写了产品名称。

collocations: the label on a contact lens blister

words.enDefinition: a small container with compartments for storing contact lenses

examples.en: The optical shop had a travel contact lens case next to the register.
examples.zh: 眼镜店收银台旁放了一个旅行用的「隐形眼镜盒」。

examples.en: My roommate found her contact lens case in the side pocket of her bag.
examples.zh: 室友在包的侧袋里找到了自己的「隐形眼镜盒」。

collocations: the lid of a contact lens case

words.enDefinition: a visit to review contact lens fit and eye health

examples.en: I moved my contact lens check to a day when I had no lectures.
examples.zh: 我把「隐形眼镜复查」改到了没有课的一天。

examples.en: The clinic sent me a reminder for a contact lens check next month.
examples.zh: 诊所发来一条提醒，告诉我下个月有一次「隐形眼镜复查」。

collocations: have a routine contact lens check

words.enDefinition: the measurement from one edge of a contact lens to the opposite edge

examples.en: The contact lens diameter was printed beside the other measurements on the label.
examples.zh: 「隐形眼镜直径」印在标签上，就在其他尺寸旁边。

examples.en: I asked if the contact lens diameter should appear on both pages of the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告的两页上是否都应标注「隐形眼镜直径」。

collocations: the contact lens diameter on the prescription

words.enDefinition: an unpleasant sensation associated with wearing contact lenses

examples.en: I described the contact lens discomfort when the optometrist asked about my experience.
examples.zh: 验光师问我佩戴感受时，我描述了「戴隐形眼镜时的不适」。

examples.en: The clinic's questionnaire asked when I first noticed contact lens discomfort that week.
examples.zh: 诊所问卷问我那周最早是什么时候觉得「戴隐形眼镜不舒服」。

collocations: a history of contact lens discomfort

words.enDefinition: an appointment to assess whether particular contact lenses fit the eyes

examples.en: I booked a contact lens fitting at the same clinic as my eye exam.
examples.zh: 我在做眼部检查的同一家诊所预约了「隐形眼镜验配」。

examples.en: The reception team explained how long the contact lens fitting would take that afternoon.
examples.zh: 前台工作人员说了当天下午的「隐形眼镜验配」大概要多久。

words.enDefinition: the substance from which a particular contact lens is made

examples.en: The optometrist pointed to the contact lens material listed on the box.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了盒子上标注的「隐形眼镜材质」。

examples.en: I asked where I could find the contact lens material in the product description.
examples.zh: 我问在商品说明的哪里能找到「隐形眼镜材质」。

collocations: a leaflet about contact lens material

words.enDefinition: a written specification of lenses fitted to the wearer's eyes

examples.en: I asked for a copy of my contact lens prescription before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我要了一份「隐形眼镜处方」副本。

examples.en: The shop asked whether I had a contact lens prescription on file.
examples.zh: 店员问我的「隐形眼镜处方」有没有存档。

collocations: a copy of a contact lens prescription

words.enDefinition: a liquid formulated for contact lens care or storage

examples.en: I showed the optician the label on my bottle of contact lens solution.
examples.zh: 我给配镜师看了我那瓶「隐形眼镜护理液」上的标签。

examples.en: The pharmacy moved the contact lens solution to the shelf beside the cases.
examples.zh: 药房把「隐形眼镜护理液」挪到了隐形眼镜盒旁边的架子上。

collocations: a bottle of contact lens solution
the label on contact lens solution

words.enDefinition: coordinated care that remains consistent over time and across visits

examples.en: I asked about continuity of care because I was changing practices at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期结束时我要换诊所，就问了怎么保证「医疗照护连续性」。

examples.en: The clinic mentioned continuity of care when it explained how teams share patient records.
examples.zh: 诊所说明各团队怎么共享病历时，提到了「医疗照护连续性」。

words.enDefinition: ongoing tracking of a patient's condition over time

examples.en: The nurse explained where my visitor could sit during continuous monitoring in the next room.
examples.zh: 护士说明了我在隔壁房间接受「持续监测」期间，访客可以坐在哪里。

examples.en: The summary mentioned continuous monitoring without listing the individual measurements from that evening's visit.
examples.zh: 摘要提到了「持续监测」，没有列出当天晚上就诊时的每次测量数据。

words.enDefinition: an amount removed from a charge under an insurance agreement

examples.en: The contractual adjustment explains part of the difference between the two figures on my bill.
examples.zh: 这笔「合同减记额」解释了账单上两个数字的一部分差额。

examples.en: I asked the billing office where the contractual adjustment appeared on the revised statement.
examples.zh: 我问账单部门，修正后的账单上哪里显示「合同减记额」。

words.enDefinition: a condition or circumstance making a medicine unsuitable to use

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the word contraindication in the patient leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释患者用药说明书里「禁忌证」这个词。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a contraindication under a heading I hadn't noticed before.
examples.zh: 说明书把一项「禁忌证」列在我之前没有注意到的小标题下面。

words.enDefinition: how well someone distinguishes objects from similar backgrounds

examples.en: I asked what contrast sensitivity meant when it appeared on the test report.
examples.zh: 我在检查报告上看到「对比敏感度」，就问了这个词的意思。

examples.en: The examiner used several rows of pale letters to record my contrast sensitivity.
examples.zh: 检查人员用好几行浅色字母来记录我的「对比敏感度」。

words.enDefinition: rules that determine how multiple health plans share claim payment

examples.en: I had to complete a coordination of benefits form after adding a second plan.
examples.zh: 加保第二份保险后，我得填一份「多份保险给付协调」表。

examples.en: The insurer explained how coordination of benefits affected the payment for that appointment.
examples.zh: 保险公司说明了「多份保险给付协调」如何影响那次就诊的赔付。

words.enDefinition: a fixed amount a patient pays for a covered service

examples.en: The receptionist told me the copay amount before I checked out that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午我离开前，前台告诉了我「定额自付费用」的金额。

examples.en: I noticed that the campus clinic copay was listed separately on the plan summary.
examples.zh: 我留意到保障摘要把校医院的「定额自付费用」单独列了出来。

words.enDefinition: learned abilities that help someone deal with stressful situations

examples.en: The workshop outline said students would discuss coping skills in small groups.
examples.zh: 工作坊提纲说，学生会分小组讨论「应对技能」。

examples.en: I talked about coping skills I had learnt while studying far from home.
examples.zh: 我谈到了自己离家读书时学到的「应对技能」。

words.enDefinition: ways a person deals with difficulties, emotions, or stress

examples.en: We discussed coping strategies that I had already tried during my first term.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了我第一学期已经尝试过的「应对策略」。

examples.en: The workshop compared coping strategies that different students said were helpful to them.
examples.zh: 工作坊比较了不同学生自述有用的「应对策略」。

words.enDefinition: the clear curved front surface of the eye

examples.en: The doctor used a simple diagram to show me where the cornea sits.
examples.zh: 医生用一张简单的图给我指了「角膜」的位置。

examples.en: I asked whether the notes about my cornea would go to the new clinic.
examples.zh: 我问有关「角膜」的记录会不会发给新诊所。

words.enDefinition: the vision someone has while using corrective lenses

examples.en: The report gave a figure for corrected vision when I was wearing my glasses.
examples.zh: 报告给出了我戴眼镜时的「矫正后视力」数值。

examples.en: I asked whether the figure for corrected vision was based on my current lenses.
examples.zh: 我问「矫正后视力」的那个数值是不是用我现在的镜片测的。

words.enDefinition: the portion of covered costs that a patient must pay

examples.en: I read the cost sharing section to understand what my own share might be.
examples.zh: 我读了「医疗费用分担」那一节，想了解自己可能承担多少。

examples.en: The comparison sheet shows cost sharing separately from the monthly insurance payment.
examples.zh: 对比表将「医疗费用分担」与每月交的保险费分开呈现。

words.enDefinition: bring mucus out of the airways by coughing

examples.en: I cough up mucus most mornings before I leave for my first class.
examples.zh: 我大多数早晨出门上第一节课之前，都会「咳出痰」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether I cough up mucus or just have a dry cough.
examples.zh: 护士问我会不会「咳出痰」，还是只是干咳。

collocations: cough up mucus in the morning

words.enDefinition: a spell of repeated coughing that is difficult to stop

examples.en: I had a coughing fit during the lecture and stepped into the hallway.
examples.zh: 上课时我「一阵猛咳」，就走到了走廊里。

examples.en: The coughing fit lasted several minutes before I could speak clearly again.
