examples.zh: 我「一阵猛咳」，过了几分钟才能重新说清楚话。

words.enDefinition: changes or outcomes a client wants to work towards in counseling

examples.en: We talked about my counseling goals after I described what had brought me there.
examples.zh: 我说完为什么来做咨询后，我们谈了我的「心理咨询目标」。

examples.en: I wrote down two counseling goals to discuss at the start of my next visit.
examples.zh: 我记下了两个「心理咨询目标」，准备下次会面一开始就讨论。

words.enDefinition: a first conversation to understand concerns and arrange suitable counseling

examples.en: The counseling intake took place in a small room near the reception desk.
examples.zh: 「心理咨询初评」在前台附近的一间小房间里进行。

examples.en: I asked whether the counseling intake would be by phone or in person.
examples.zh: 我问了「心理咨询初评」是打电话做，还是要本人到场。

words.enDefinition: information kept by a service about counseling appointments and care

examples.en: The counselor explained where counseling records were stored and who could access them at our centre.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了本中心的「心理咨询记录」存在哪里、谁能查阅。

examples.en: I asked whether my counseling records could go to the new provider with my consent.
examples.zh: 我问了经我同意，能否把我的「心理咨询记录」转给新的服务机构。

words.enDefinition: a recommendation directing someone to a counseling service

examples.en: The nurse sent a counseling referral after I asked which services the university offered.
examples.zh: 我问了学校有哪些服务后，护士发出了一份「心理咨询转介」。

examples.en: I asked where the counseling referral would go after the initial meeting with my adviser.
examples.zh: 我问第一次跟顾问见面后，「心理咨询转介」会发给哪个部门。

collocations: follow up on a counseling referral

words.enDefinition: a list of people waiting for counseling appointments

examples.en: The adviser added me to the counseling waitlist and confirmed my contact details.
examples.zh: 顾问把我加到「心理咨询候补名单」上，并确认了我的联系方式。

examples.en: I checked whether I was still on the counseling waitlist after the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假过后，我查了自己是否还在「心理咨询候补名单」上。

collocations: contact people on a counseling waitlist

words.enDefinition: a trained professional who helps people discuss personal or emotional concerns

examples.en: My counselor asked what I wanted to get out of our first meeting.
examples.zh: 我的「心理咨询师」问我，希望第一次见面能谈出些什么。

examples.en: I asked the counselor which room we would use for the next session.
examples.zh: 我问「心理咨询师」，下次咨询会用哪个房间。

words.enDefinition: the times when a counselor has space to meet someone

examples.en: The student portal shows counselor availability for the next two weeks at our university.
examples.zh: 学生门户列出了本校未来两周「咨询师的可约时间」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist about counselor availability during the winter break and exam week.
examples.zh: 我问前台寒假和考试周「咨询师的可约时间」。

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming a person's enrollment and active insurance dates

examples.en: I attached the coverage confirmation letter to my application for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 我把「保险确认函」附在交换项目申请上。

examples.en: The school sent a coverage confirmation letter once my insurance record was updated.
examples.zh: 我的保险记录更新后，学校发来了「保险确认函」。

words.enDefinition: a service or situation specifically left outside an insurance policy

examples.en: I noticed a coverage exclusion in the plan and asked the insurer to explain it.
examples.zh: 我发现保险方案中有一条「除外责任」，就请保险公司解释。

examples.en: The office explained why a coverage exclusion showed up in my plan summary.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了为什么我的保障摘要里会出现一条「除外责任」。

words.enDefinition: a period when a person has no active insurance coverage

examples.en: I asked the office whether changing plans midterm would create a coverage gap.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，中途换方案会不会出现「保障空档」。

examples.en: The confirmation letter showed a coverage gap between July and September that I hadn't noticed.
examples.zh: 确认函显示七月到九月有一段我之前没注意到的「保障空档」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount or extent of protection provided by a policy

examples.en: The insurer told me where to find the coverage limit for that service.
examples.zh: 保险公司告诉我到哪儿查该服务的「保障上限」。

examples.en: I noted the coverage limit beside each option while comparing the university plans.
examples.zh: 比较学校的几个保险方案时，我在每个选项旁标了「保障上限」。

words.enDefinition: the day an insurance plan begins covering a person

examples.en: I checked the coverage start date because I arrived three days before orientation.
examples.zh: 我比迎新早到了三天，所以查了「保障生效日」。

examples.en: The email confirms a coverage start date in August for the new policy.
examples.zh: 邮件确认了新保单的「保障生效日」在八月。

words.enDefinition: the day when protection under an insurance plan ends

examples.en: I asked the adviser to confirm the coverage termination date after my graduation.
examples.zh: 我请顾问确认我毕业后的「保障终止日」。

examples.en: The coverage termination date appears on the notice beside my current address.
examples.zh: 通知上的现住址旁边印着「保障终止日」。

words.enDefinition: a check of whether an insurance plan is active or applies

examples.en: The campus clinic began coverage verification when I provided my new insurance details.
examples.zh: 我提供新的保险资料后，校医院开始了「保险保障核验」。

examples.en: The receptionist said coverage verification was still in progress for the new policy.
examples.zh: 前台说这份新保单的「保险保障核验」还没完成。

words.enDefinition: an eligible family member insured under another person's plan

examples.en: The policy lists my spouse as a covered dependent during my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 保单把我配偶列为交换学期内的「受保家属」。

examples.en: I checked whether my child appeared as a covered dependent on the new card.
examples.zh: 我查了一下新卡上是否把我的孩子列为「受保家属」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare service eligible for payment under a plan

examples.en: The adviser helped me check whether the blood test was a covered service.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我查了这项验血是不是「承保服务」。

examples.en: The statement lists each covered service separately from the items I paid for myself.
examples.zh: 清单把每项「承保服务」和我全额自费的项目分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a tooth with a split but possibly no missing piece

examples.en: The chart mentioned a cracked tooth near the back of my lower jaw.
examples.zh: 检查记录提到，我下颌靠后有一颗「有裂纹的牙齿」。

examples.en: I asked the dentist whether the cracked tooth appeared on the image we reviewed.
examples.zh: 我问牙医，我们刚看的片子上能不能看到那颗「有裂纹的牙齿」。

words.enDefinition: pain that repeatedly tightens and relaxes like a cramp

examples.en: The cramping pain came in waves while I was sitting in the library.
examples.zh: 我坐在图书馆的时候，「痉挛性疼痛」一阵阵袭来。

examples.en: I told the nurse where I felt the cramping pain last night.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，昨晚身体哪个部位有「痉挛性疼痛」。

words.enDefinition: a very serious and potentially unstable medical state

examples.en: The staff member explained that critical condition was the term used in the latest update.
examples.zh: 工作人员说明，最新通报里用的是「病情危重」这个词。

examples.en: My friend listened while the nurse explained what critical condition meant in the written report.
examples.zh: 朋友听护士解释书面报告中「病情危重」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a bite in which some opposing teeth meet in a reversed inside-outside position

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the crossbite on the left side of the model.
examples.zh: 正畸医生指了指模型左侧的「交叉咬合」。

examples.en: I asked what kind of crossbite the dentist had recorded in my notes.
examples.zh: 我问牙医在我的记录里写的是哪种「交叉咬合」。

words.enDefinition: a lack of space for teeth to line up normally

examples.en: The chart showed crowding in the lower teeth after I moved to a new clinic.
examples.zh: 我转到新诊所后，检查记录图上显示下排有「牙列拥挤」。

examples.en: I asked the orthodontist what the note about crowding meant in my case.
examples.zh: 我请正畸医生解释，对我来说关于「牙列拥挤」的备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the identification of a condition recorded as present now

examples.en: I asked the clinician whether the current diagnosis was listed in the summary available online.
examples.zh: 我问医务人员，网上的摘要里有没有列出「当前诊断」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the current diagnosis against the information the previous clinic had sent.
examples.zh: 护士把「当前诊断」和上一家诊所发来的资料做了核对。

words.enDefinition: the orientation of the astigmatism correction on a lens prescription

examples.en: The form shows the cylinder axis in a column beside the cylinder power.
examples.zh: 表格里，「柱镜轴位」在柱镜度数旁边的一列。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist why the cylinder axis had a different symbol beside it.
examples.zh: 我问验光师为什么「柱镜轴位」旁边的符号不一样。

collocations: the cylinder axis for each eye

words.enDefinition: the amount of lens correction for astigmatism

examples.en: The optometrist pointed to the cylinder power printed beside the sphere value.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了球镜数值旁边印的「柱镜度数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the cylinder power had changed since my appointment last year.
examples.zh: 我问和去年就诊时相比，「柱镜度数」有没有变化。

collocations: the cylinder power on a prescription

words.enDefinition: single-use contact lenses designed for one day's wear

examples.en: The optical shop stocked daily disposable lenses in boxes of several sizes.
examples.zh: 眼镜店的「日抛隐形眼镜」有几种不同大小的盒装规格。

examples.en: I looked up the price of daily disposable lenses before asking for a quote.
examples.zh: 询价前，我先查了「日抛隐形眼镜」的价格。

collocations: a pack of daily disposable lenses
an order for daily disposable lenses

words.enDefinition: packaging with damage such as a tear, split, or dent

examples.en: I took the damaged packaging to the counter because the label was partly torn.
examples.zh: 标签有一部分撕破了，我把「受损的包装」拿到了柜台。

examples.en: The clerk photographed the damaged packaging and recorded the product number in the system.
examples.zh: 药房人员给「受损的包装」拍了照，把产品编号记进系统。

words.enDefinition: the calendar date on which someone attended a service

examples.en: I checked the date of attendance because the visit had started close to midnight.
examples.zh: 因为就诊开始时已经接近午夜，我核对了「到院就诊日期」。

examples.en: The hospital letter included the date of attendance but did not list every test.
examples.zh: 医院的信上写了「到院就诊日期」，但没有列出所有检查。

collocations: an entry for the date of attendance

words.enDefinition: the date when a condition was identified by a clinician

examples.en: The form asked for the date of diagnosis, but I only remembered the year.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写「确诊日期」，但我只记得是哪一年。

examples.en: I checked the old letter for the date of diagnosis before contacting the new clinic.
examples.zh: 联系新诊所前，我在旧信里查了「确诊日期」。

collocations: ask for the date of diagnosis

words.enDefinition: the date when healthcare was provided or a service occurred

examples.en: The date of service isn't the same as the date my statement arrived.
examples.zh: 「就诊服务日期」和我收到这份账单的日期不一样。

examples.en: I checked the date of service to see which appointment the claim referred to.
examples.zh: 我核对了「就诊服务日期」，确定这笔理赔对应哪次预约。

words.enDefinition: feeling unusually sleepy during hours normally spent awake

examples.en: I noticed daytime sleepiness while trying to take notes in my morning lectures.
examples.zh: 我上午上课想记笔记时，发现自己「白天犯困」。

examples.en: The counselor asked how long daytime sleepiness had been affecting my afternoon study time.
examples.zh: 咨询师问「白天犯困」影响我下午学习有多久了。

words.enDefinition: room to change a deadline when someone's circumstances require it

examples.en: I emailed my tutor about deadline flexibility after my return date had changed.
examples.zh: 返校日期变了之后，我给导师发邮件咨询「截止时间弹性」安排。

examples.en: The course coordinator outlined how deadline flexibility would work for the group project.
examples.zh: 课程协调员介绍了小组项目的「截止时间弹性」安排怎么执行。

words.enDefinition: an amount you pay before a plan starts sharing certain costs

examples.en: I checked the deductible before comparing the two student health plans online.
examples.zh: 我先看了「免赔额」，才在网上比较两种学生医疗保险。

examples.en: My statement showed what remained on the deductible after the clinic visit.
examples.zh: 账单显示了在诊所看诊后还剩多少「免赔额」未达到。

words.enDefinition: used when a service is subject to the plan's deductible

examples.en: The table says deductible applies beside the entry for my particular lab test.
examples.zh: 表格在我的那项化验旁标了「适用免赔额」。

examples.en: Ask what deductible applies means on this line if the statement is unclear.
examples.zh: 如果账单说得不清楚，可以问这一行「适用免赔额」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a letter explaining why an insurer rejected a claim

examples.en: The denial letter came after I had already sent the clinic receipt twice.
examples.zh: 我已经发了两遍诊所收据，之后才收到「拒付通知函」。

examples.en: I asked the student adviser to read the denial letter with me.
examples.zh: 我请学生顾问陪我一起看那封「拒付通知函」。

words.enDefinition: the explanation a plan gives for declining a claim

examples.en: I checked the denial reason listed beneath the appointment date on the letter.
examples.zh: 我查了信里看诊日期下面列出的「拒付原因」。

examples.en: The insurer gave a different denial reason after receiving the updated record.
examples.zh: 收到更新后的记录，保险公司给了不同的「拒付原因」。

words.enDefinition: used when a claim is refused because the plan excludes the service

examples.en: My claim was denied as not covered, so I asked which exclusion the insurer applied.
examples.zh: 我的理赔「因不承保而被拒付」，于是我问保险公司适用的是哪条除外条款。

examples.en: The notice says denied as not covered beside the appointment I had asked about.
examples.zh: 通知在我询问的那次看诊旁标了「因不承保而拒付」。

words.enDefinition: a pocket of pus caused by infection in dental tissues

examples.en: I asked what dental abscess meant after reading that term in my dentist's report.
examples.zh: 我在牙医报告里看到「牙源性脓肿」这个词，就问它是什么意思。

examples.en: The dentist noted a suspected dental abscess and explained why another examination was needed.
examples.zh: 牙医记录了疑似「牙源性脓肿」，并解释了为什么还需要再检查。

words.enDefinition: an arranged time to see a dental professional

examples.en: I booked a dental appointment for Friday because my last lecture ends at noon.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科预约」约在周五，因为那天最后一节课中午就结束了。

examples.en: The receptionist called to confirm my dental appointment at the clinic near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近的诊所前台打电话确认了我的「牙科预约」。

words.enDefinition: a worker who supports the dentist during patient care

examples.en: The dental assistant showed me where to put my backpack before I sat down.
examples.zh: 我坐下前，「牙科助理」告诉我背包可以放在哪里。

examples.en: I asked the dental assistant whether there was somewhere to leave my coat.
examples.zh: 我问「牙科助理」有没有地方放外套。

words.enDefinition: a fixed restoration that replaces one or more missing teeth

examples.en: The specialist showed me a model with a dental bridge in place.
examples.zh: 专科医生给我看了一个装有「牙桥」的模型。

examples.en: I asked which terms in the estimate referred to the dental bridge we discussed.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪些术语指的是我们谈到的「牙桥」。

collocations: an estimate for a dental bridge

words.enDefinition: a diagram or record showing findings for individual teeth

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether my dental chart had arrived from the previous practice.
examples.zh: 前台查了我原来那家机构有没有发来「牙科检查记录图」。

examples.en: The dentist marked a small chip on my dental chart during the exam.
examples.zh: 检查时，牙医在我的「牙科检查记录图」上标了一处小崩缺。

collocations: mark a finding on the dental chart

words.enDefinition: a request for insurance payment for a covered dental service

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I wanted the office to submit the dental claim.
examples.zh: 前台问我是否要让诊所提交这笔「牙科理赔申请」。

examples.en: I called my insurer to check why the dental claim was still pending.
examples.zh: 我给保险公司打电话，问为什么那笔「牙科理赔申请」还在处理中。

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning to remove deposits from the teeth

examples.en: I booked a dental cleaning at the university clinic after my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课结束后，我在大学诊所约了「牙齿专业清洁」。

examples.en: The receptionist checked how much time was set aside for the dental cleaning.
examples.zh: 前台查看了给「牙齿专业清洁」预留了多长时间。

collocations: the cost of a dental cleaning

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits available for eligible dental services

examples.en: I asked the student benefits team where to check my dental coverage online.
examples.zh: 我问学生福利团队，在哪里可以网上查我的「牙科保险保障」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what the term dental coverage meant on our plan summary.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了保障摘要里的「牙科保险保障」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a fitted cap covering a prepared tooth or supported by an implant

examples.en: The dentist used a model to explain where the dental crown sits.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型给我说明了「牙冠修复体」戴在哪个位置。

examples.en: The dental crown was mentioned in an estimate I brought from my former clinic.
examples.zh: 我从原来诊所带来的估价单上提到了「牙冠修复体」。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of charges for planned dental services

examples.en: I brought the dental fee estimate to the campus benefits office for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科费用估算单」带到学校福利办公室，请他们帮我看。

examples.en: The dental fee estimate showed separate amounts for the examination and taking images.
examples.zh: 「牙科费用估算单」分别列了检查和拍片的金额。

words.enDefinition: a list of charges or payment rates for dental services

examples.en: I asked the clinic for its dental fee schedule before discussing the written estimate.
examples.zh: 在谈书面估价以前，我先向诊所要了它的「牙科收费价目表」。

examples.en: The student adviser showed me where the dental fee schedule was published on the website.
examples.zh: 学生顾问给我指出网站上哪里公布了「牙科收费价目表」。

words.enDefinition: material placed in a tooth to restore a damaged area

examples.en: The dentist checked the dental filling on my back tooth during the examination.
examples.zh: 牙医在检查时查看了我后牙上的「补牙填充体」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the bill covered the dental filling on the left side.
examples.zh: 我问账单上哪个项目对应左侧的「补牙填充体」。

words.enDefinition: a record of previous oral problems and dental care

examples.en: The dentist asked about my dental history because I had studied abroad last year.
examples.zh: 我去年在国外读书，牙医问了问我的「牙科就诊史」。

examples.en: I brought a short summary of my dental history from my old clinic.
examples.zh: 我带了一份旧诊所出具的简短「牙科就诊史」摘要。

words.enDefinition: a dental professional who provides cleaning and preventive oral care

examples.en: The dental hygienist asked me which areas were difficult to reach when brushing.
examples.zh: 「口腔卫生师」问我刷牙时哪些地方不好刷到。

examples.en: I scheduled time with the dental hygienist on the same day as my checkup.
examples.zh: 我把见「口腔卫生师」的时间安排在我做检查的同一天。

collocations: a visit with the dental hygienist

words.enDefinition: a fixture in the jawbone that supports a replacement tooth

examples.en: I asked which part of the diagram represented the dental implant in the jaw.
examples.zh: 我问图中哪一部分表示颌骨里的「牙种植体」。

examples.en: The report listed the crown and dental implant as separate items on the plan.
examples.zh: 报告把牙冠和「牙种植体」作为方案里的两个项目分开列出。

collocations: a dental implant in the upper jaw
an estimate for a dental implant

words.enDefinition: a negative mold of the teeth and nearby oral structures

examples.en: The receptionist told me how long the dental impression appointment was likely to last.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，做「牙齿印模」的预约预计会花多久。

examples.en: I asked whether the new clinic could use my previous dental impression for reference.
examples.zh: 我问新诊所能不能参考我以前做的「牙齿印模」。

collocations: send a dental impression to the lab

words.enDefinition: a form collecting information before a patient's first dental visit

examples.en: I completed the dental intake form on my phone before the first visit.
examples.zh: 第一次就诊前，我在手机上填了「牙科初诊登记表」。

examples.en: The dental intake form asked for the date of my last visit to a dentist.
examples.zh: 「牙科初诊登记表」问我上一次看牙医是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: a bill listing charges for services provided by a dental office

examples.en: I asked the clinic for a dental invoice with the date of service shown.
examples.zh: 我请诊所开一份显示就诊日期的「牙科账单」。

examples.en: The dental invoice listed the examination separately from the new pictures of my teeth.
examples.zh: 「牙科账单」把检查和这次新拍的牙齿影像分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a dental service in a billing schedule

examples.en: The Australian clinic printed a dental item number beside each entry on the estimate.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的这家诊所在估价单每个项目旁都印了「牙科项目编号」。

examples.en: I asked which dental item number referred to the service we had just discussed.
examples.zh: 我问刚谈到的服务对应哪个「牙科项目编号」。

words.enDefinition: a place where a dentist sees and treats patients

examples.en: I called the dental office to ask how long the first appointment would take.
examples.zh: 我给「牙科诊所」打电话，问初诊大概需要多久。

examples.en: The dental office is upstairs, across the hall from the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 「牙科诊所」在楼上，隔着走廊和校园书店相对。

words.enDefinition: the most a dental plan pays within one plan year

examples.en: I asked whether the dental plan annual maximum was a limit on insurance payments.
examples.zh: 我问「牙险年度赔付上限」是不是对保险赔付金额设的上限。

examples.en: The summary showed the dental plan annual maximum alongside the period it applied to.
examples.zh: 摘要列出了「牙险年度赔付上限」及其适用时段。

collocations: check a dental plan annual maximum
an increase in the dental plan annual maximum
services counting toward the dental plan annual maximum

words.enDefinition: a business or organization that provides dentistry services

examples.en: My roommate found a dental practice that was still accepting new patients.
examples.zh: 我室友找到一家还在接收新患者的「牙科诊疗机构」。

examples.en: The dental practice offered me an appointment on a day without lectures.
examples.zh: 这家「牙科诊疗机构」给我安排了一个没课的日子就诊。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who handles calls and appointments for a dentist

examples.en: The dental receptionist helped me find an appointment between my two afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 「牙科前台接待员」帮我在下午两节课之间找到了一个就诊时段。

examples.en: I told the dental receptionist that my phone number had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 我告诉「牙科前台接待员」，上学期之后我的手机号换了。

collocations: a dental receptionist at the front desk

words.enDefinition: a request to another provider for dental assessment or care

examples.en: I received a dental referral after the dentist reviewed the images with me.
examples.zh: 牙医和我一起看了影像后，我收到了「牙科转诊」。

examples.en: The specialist's office asked when the dental referral had been sent to them.
examples.zh: 专科诊所问这份「牙科转诊」是什么时候发给他们的。

words.enDefinition: professional removal of deposits from the surfaces of teeth

examples.en: I asked the hygienist where dental scaling was listed on the written estimate.
examples.zh: 我问口腔卫生师，书面估价单上「洁牙刮治」列在哪里。

examples.en: The clinic's price list showed dental scaling under its gum care services.
examples.zh: 诊所价目表把「洁牙刮治」列在了牙龈护理服务下面。

words.enDefinition: a coating placed in tooth grooves to protect those surfaces

examples.en: The dentist showed us where the dental sealant was recorded on the child's chart.
examples.zh: 牙医给我们指出了孩子检查记录图上注明「窝沟封闭剂」的位置。

examples.en: I asked which line of the estimate referred to the dental sealant on the molar.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪一行对应磨牙上的「窝沟封闭剂」。

collocations: a dental sealant on a molar

words.enDefinition: a document or outline describing proposed dental care

examples.en: I took home the dental treatment plan so I could read it after class.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科治疗方案」带回去，打算下课后再看。

examples.en: The dentist highlighted the sections of the dental treatment plan that we had discussed.
examples.zh: 牙医在「牙科治疗方案」上标出了我们已经谈过的几部分。

collocations: a copy of the dental treatment plan

words.enDefinition: a thin layer bonded to the front of a tooth

examples.en: The dentist showed me the difference between a dental veneer and a crown.
examples.zh: 牙医给我展示了「牙贴面」和牙冠修复体的区别。

examples.en: I asked which tooth the dental veneer referred to on the written estimate.
examples.zh: 我问书面估价单里的「牙贴面」指的是哪颗牙。

collocations: a consultation about a dental veneer

words.enDefinition: hard tissue beneath enamel or cementum that surrounds the pulp

examples.en: The diagram showed dentin between the enamel and the central soft tissue.
examples.zh: 图上显示，「牙本质」在牙釉质与中央的软组织之间。

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the word dentin in the handout during our discussion.
examples.zh: 讨论时，牙医指了指资料上的「牙本质」一词。

words.enDefinition: health insurance that extends to eligible family members

examples.en: The enrolment form asks whether I want dependent coverage for my family.
examples.zh: 投保表问我是否要给家人加上「家属保险保障」。

examples.en: I asked our student benefits office how dependent coverage works during school breaks.
examples.zh: 我向学生福利办公室询问假期里「家属保险保障」如何运作。

words.enDefinition: the ability to judge how far away objects are

examples.en: The optometrist explained what the simple pictures could show about my depth perception.
examples.zh: 验光师解释，这些简单图案能反映我的「深度知觉」，也就是我判断距离的能力。

examples.en: I mentioned my depth perception when the clinician asked about judging distances outdoors.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我在室外怎么判断远近，我提到了自己的「深度知觉」。

words.enDefinition: to explain what changes or problems you are experiencing

examples.en: The first question on the form says to describe your symptoms in your own words.
examples.zh: 表单的第一个问题让你用自己的话「描述你的症状」。

examples.en: The interpreter can help you describe your symptoms during the appointment if needed.
examples.zh: 如果需要，口译员可以在问诊时帮你「描述你的症状」。

collocations: describe your symptoms in your own words
describe your symptoms to the clinician

words.enDefinition: a person named as the authorized visitor for a patient

examples.en: I listed my roommate as my designated visitor because my family was overseas.
examples.zh: 家人都在国外，我就把室友列为「指定探视人员」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the designated visitor had already checked in at reception.
examples.zh: 护士问「指定探视人员」有没有在接待处登记。

words.enDefinition: a standard code used to represent a medical diagnosis

examples.en: The referral form included a diagnosis code that the specialist's office asked me to confirm.
examples.zh: 转诊表里有个「诊断代码」，专科医生的办公室请我核对一下。

examples.en: I asked which diagnosis code was listed on the copy of my claim.
examples.zh: 我问了理赔单副本上列的是哪个「诊断代码」。

words.enDefinition: the use of medical images to examine internal structures

examples.en: The nurse said diagnostic imaging would take place in another part of the hospital building.
examples.zh: 护士说，「诊断性影像检查」将在医院大楼的另一个区域做。

examples.en: I asked which signs to follow for diagnostic imaging after leaving the emergency reception desk.
examples.zh: 离开急诊接待处后，我问做「诊断性影像检查」应该跟着哪些标牌走。

words.enDefinition: frequent bowel movements that are loose or watery

examples.en: I had diarrhea several times on Saturday and noted when it began.
examples.zh: 我星期六「腹泻」了好几次，并记下了开始的时间。

examples.en: The nurse asked if the diarrhea made me leave class more than once.
examples.zh: 护士问我是不是因为「腹泻」好几次离开课堂。

words.enDefinition: trouble getting to sleep after trying to do so

examples.en: I had difficulty falling asleep because the pain in my shoulder kept returning.
examples.zh: 由于肩膀的疼痛反复出现，我「入睡困难」。

examples.en: The doctor asked when I first noticed difficulty falling asleep after moving here.
examples.zh: 医生问我搬来以后，最早什么时候开始出现「入睡困难」。

words.enDefinition: trouble moving food, liquid, or saliva down the throat

examples.en: I had difficulty swallowing bread at lunch but could still drink water.
examples.zh: 午饭吃面包时，我觉得「吞咽困难」，不过还是能喝水。

examples.en: The clinician asked how long the difficulty swallowing had been troubling me.
examples.zh: 医生问这种「吞咽困难」困扰我多久了。

words.enDefinition: trouble relaxing and setting worries or tasks aside

examples.en: I described difficulty switching off when I went back to my room at night.
examples.zh: 我描述了自己晚上回房后「难以停止思虑」的情况。

examples.en: The workshop discussion included difficulty switching off after working on several projects at once.
examples.zh: 工作坊谈到了同时做几个项目后「难以停止思虑」的情况。

words.enDefinition: an eye examination with widened pupils to see internal structures

examples.en: I booked a dilated eye exam after checking the available dates with the clinic.
examples.zh: 我与诊所核对了可约日期，然后预约了「散瞳眼部检查」。

examples.en: The ophthalmologist explained the images taken during my dilated eye exam the previous week.
examples.zh: 眼科医生解释了上周「散瞳眼部检查」时拍下的影像。

collocations: results of a dilated eye exam

words.enDefinition: the unit used to express the focusing power of a lens

examples.en: I asked what a diopter meant after seeing the letter D on my report.
examples.zh: 我在报告上看到了字母 D，就问「屈光度」是什么意思。

examples.en: The leaflet described a diopter in a section explaining the numbers on a prescription.
examples.zh: 小册子在解释处方数字的部分介绍了「屈光度」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement where a provider sends charges straight to an insurer

examples.en: The clinic confirmed it offered direct billing for my particular student insurance plan.
examples.zh: 诊所确认我的这份学生保险可用「直接向保险方结算」。

examples.en: I asked whether direct billing was available at the clinic across from campus.
examples.zh: 我问了学校对面的诊所能不能「直接向保险方结算」。

words.enDefinition: written information explaining how a particular product is intended to be used

examples.en: I asked where the directions for use were printed on the back of the carton.
examples.zh: 我问「使用说明」印在纸盒背面的什么位置。

examples.en: The pharmacist read the directions for use aloud because the leaflet's print was very small.
examples.zh: 说明书的字太小，药师把「使用说明」读给我听。

collocations: the directions for use on the package

words.enDefinition: a staff member advising people on disability-related access and support

examples.en: I booked a meeting with the disability adviser before my first week back.
examples.zh: 返校第一周之前，我约了和「无障碍支持顾问」见面。

examples.en: The disability adviser asked which parts of campus had been hardest to reach.
examples.zh: 「无障碍支持顾问」问，校园里有哪些地方最难到达。

words.enDefinition: leaving hospital despite the care team's recommendation to stay

examples.en: The interpreter explained the term discharge against medical advice on the hospital form.
examples.zh: 口译员解释了医院表格里「违背医嘱出院」这个词。

examples.en: I asked the nurse what discharge against medical advice meant in the translated leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问护士，翻译后的宣传单里「违背医嘱出院」是什么意思。

collocations: a record of discharge against medical advice
a form for discharge against medical advice

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check before leaving hospital

examples.en: The nurse went through the discharge checklist while I packed my belongings.
examples.zh: 我收拾个人物品时，护士过了一遍「出院核对清单」。

examples.en: The discharge checklist had a space for the phone number of my local clinic.
examples.zh: 「出院核对清单」上留了位置填本地诊所的电话号码。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who helps arrange a patient's departure and support

examples.en: The discharge coordinator called me back after I had checked my ride home.
examples.zh: 我确认了回家的车之后，「出院协调员」给我回了电话。

examples.en: I wrote down the discharge coordinator's number in case I had another question.
examples.zh: 我记下了「出院协调员」的电话号码，以防还有问题。

words.enDefinition: the day someone is due to leave or leaves hospital

examples.en: The ward clerk asked me to confirm the discharge date with my roommate.
examples.zh: 病区办事员请我和室友确认一下「出院日期」。

examples.en: I wrote the discharge date in my calendar beside the start of term.
examples.zh: 我在日历的开学日期旁边记下了「出院日期」。

words.enDefinition: a decision about ending a patient's current hospital care

examples.en: The doctor said the discharge decision would be recorded after speaking with the team.
examples.zh: 医生说和团队沟通后，会记录「出院决定」。

examples.en: I asked whether the discharge decision had been sent to my regular clinic yet.
examples.zh: 我问「出院决定」是不是已经发给我常去的诊所了。

words.enDefinition: where a patient is expected to go after discharge

examples.en: The clerk asked me to confirm the discharge destination listed on the hospital form.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我确认医院表格上写的「出院去向」。

examples.en: The record showed my discharge destination as my new student flat near the station.
examples.zh: 记录显示我的「出院去向」是车站附近新租的学生公寓。

words.enDefinition: the transition from hospital care back to one's own home

examples.en: The ward team discussed discharge home after finding out who could meet me there.
examples.zh: 弄清楚谁可以在家等我之后，病区团队讨论了「出院回家」的安排。

examples.en: I asked whether discharge home was still the plan for Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问星期五下午是否仍按计划「出院回家」。

words.enDefinition: directions given to a patient at the end of care

examples.en: The nurse reviewed the discharge instructions while my flatmate wrote down the clinic's phone number.
examples.zh: 护士讲解「出院注意事项」时，室友记下了诊所的电话号码。

examples.en: I asked for printed discharge instructions because the online portal would not load on my phone.
examples.zh: 因为手机打不开在线平台，我要求拿一份打印的「出院注意事项」。

collocations: a copy of the discharge instructions

words.enDefinition: an area for patients waiting to finish leaving hospital

examples.en: My brother found the discharge lounge after asking at the main reception desk.
examples.zh: 我哥哥到总服务台问了路，找到了「出院等候区」。

examples.en: I waited in the discharge lounge until my flatmate arrived to meet me.
examples.zh: 我在「出院等候区」等到室友来接我。

collocations: a seat in the discharge lounge

words.enDefinition: a discussion about a patient's departure and plans for later support

examples.en: I asked if my sister could join the discharge meeting by phone.
examples.zh: 我问姐姐能否通过电话参加「出院安排会议」。

examples.en: The ward team gave me time to ask questions during the discharge meeting.
examples.zh: 病区团队在「出院安排会议」中留出时间让我提问。

collocations: take notes at a discharge meeting

words.enDefinition: the documents completed when a patient leaves hospital care

examples.en: I waited by the desk while the nurse printed the discharge paperwork for me.
examples.zh: 护士给我打印「出院文件」时，我在服务台旁边等。

examples.en: My roommate kept the discharge paperwork in a folder so it would not get lost.
examples.zh: 室友把「出院文件」放在文件夹里，免得弄丢。

words.enDefinition: an outline of departure and ongoing support after hospital care

examples.en: The discharge plan listed who would contact me when I got home.
examples.zh: 「出院计划」里列出了我回家后谁会联系我。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the discharge plan to share with my family.
examples.zh: 我要了一份「出院计划」的副本和家人分享。

words.enDefinition: coordinating the practical steps required before a patient leaves

examples.en: The nurse said discharge planning included checking who would meet me at the entrance.
examples.zh: 护士说，「出院安排」包括确认谁会在入口处接我。

examples.en: The hospital asked whether I could join a phone call about discharge planning that afternoon.
examples.zh: 医院问我，那天下午能不能参加一个关于「出院安排」的电话沟通。

words.enDefinition: a concise account of hospital care for a departing patient

examples.en: I checked the discharge summary because I needed the exact date for my college.
examples.zh: 我核对了「出院小结」，因为学校需要准确的日期。

examples.en: The nurse explained when the discharge summary would be available through the patient portal.
examples.zh: 护士说明了什么时候能在患者服务平台上看到「出院小结」。

words.enDefinition: a place where medicines are prepared and handed out

examples.en: The nurse pointed me to the dispensary on the ground floor of the clinic.
examples.zh: 护士指了指诊所一楼的「配药室」，让我去那里。

examples.en: The dispensary had a separate window for people whose prescriptions were already ready.
examples.zh: 「配药室」有一个专用窗口，给已经配好药的人取药。

words.enDefinition: prepare and give out medicine as authorized for a patient

examples.en: I asked which counter was used to dispense medication for patients from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问哪个柜台是给诊所患者「调剂发药」用的。

examples.en: The hospital has a separate team to dispense medication for people going home that day.
examples.zh: 医院有个单独的团队，为当天出院的人「调剂发药」。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in preparing or supplying a prescribed medicine

examples.en: The pharmacy reviewed a possible dispensing error after I reported the mismatched label.
examples.zh: 我报告标签与订单不符后，药房核查了可能的「配药错误」。

examples.en: I asked who would contact me about the dispensing error noted on the order.
examples.zh: 我问，谁会就订单里备注的「配药错误」联系我。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy charge for preparing and supplying a prescription

examples.en: The receipt showed a dispensing fee below the price of the medicine itself.
examples.zh: 收据在药品价格下面另列了一笔「配药服务费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the dispensing fee was already included in the total on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上显示的总额是否已经包含「配药服务费」。

words.enDefinition: a record of medicines a pharmacy has previously supplied

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy to send me a copy of my dispensing history.
examples.zh: 我请药房发给我一份「历次配药记录」的副本。

examples.en: The pharmacist looked at my dispensing history to find last autumn's order.
examples.zh: 药师查了我的「历次配药记录」，找出去年秋天的订单。

collocations: request a copy of the dispensing history

words.enDefinition: a professional who fits and supplies glasses from a prescription

examples.en: The dispensing optician measured the frames after I brought in my prescription.
examples.zh: 我拿来处方后，「配镜师」量了镜框的尺寸。

examples.en: I asked the dispensing optician how the two frames differed in width.
examples.zh: 我问「配镜师」这两个镜框的宽度有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: lens specifications for clear vision when looking far away

examples.en: I asked which line of the form contained my distance prescription for glasses.
examples.zh: 我问表格里哪一行写的是我的「远用眼镜处方」。

examples.en: The shop compared my distance prescription with the one I had used last year.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把我现在的「远用眼镜处方」和去年用过的那份对照了一下。

collocations: a change in the distance prescription
glasses made to a distance prescription

words.enDefinition: the ability to see details clearly at a distance

examples.en: The optometrist recorded my distance visual acuity before checking how well I read up close.
examples.zh: 「远视力」记录完后，验光师才检查我能不能看清近处的文字。

examples.en: My report listed distance visual acuity separately from the results of my reading test.
examples.zh: 报告把「远视力」和阅读测试的结果分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a nurse in a UK community service who visits people at home

examples.en: The ward gave me a number for the district nurse covering my area.
examples.zh: 病区给了我一个服务我所在区域的「片区上门护士」的号码。

examples.en: The district nurse asked if the side entrance was easier to find.
examples.zh: 「片区上门护士」问我，侧门是不是更容易找到。

collocations: a visit from a district nurse

words.enDefinition: a feeling of unsteadiness, spinning, or possible fainting

examples.en: I felt some dizziness after standing up quickly during the library group meeting.
examples.zh: 图书馆小组开会时，我猛地站起来，感觉有点「头晕」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the dizziness had happened while I was sitting down.
examples.zh: 护士问我是不是坐着的时候也会「头晕」。

words.enDefinition: a short written statement from a doctor about someone's health

examples.en: I asked whether the university would accept a doctor's note for the class I missed.
examples.zh: 我问学校缺课时能不能用「医生证明」来说明情况。

examples.en: The clinic told me where to collect my doctor's note after the appointment that morning.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，那天上午就诊后到哪里领取「医生证明」。

words.enDefinition: support in a person's home with personal and daily tasks

examples.en: The social worker explained the difference between domiciliary care and clinical visits.
examples.zh: 社工解释了「上门生活照护」和医务人员上门看诊的区别。

examples.en: I asked what times the domiciliary care service usually visited our area.
examples.zh: 我问「上门生活照护」服务通常几点到我们这个区域。

words.enDefinition: the eye someone tends to favor for certain visual tasks

examples.en: The optometrist wrote down which was my dominant eye during the fitting appointment.
examples.zh: 配镜时，验光师记下我哪只眼睛是「主视眼」。

examples.en: I asked what dominant eye meant when I saw it on the information sheet.
examples.zh: 我在资料表上看到了「主视眼」，就问了这个词的意思。

words.enDefinition: the raised or flat strip at the bottom of a doorway

examples.en: I sent the housing office a photo of the door threshold at our entrance.
examples.zh: 我给住宿办公室发了一张入口「门槛」的照片。

examples.en: The therapist asked whether the door threshold remained the same after the repair.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，维修后「门槛」是否和原来一样。

collocations: a door threshold at the entrance

words.enDefinition: the physical form in which a medicine is supplied

examples.en: I asked which dosage form appeared next to the medicine name in the app.
examples.zh: 我问应用里药名旁边写的是哪一种「药品剂型」。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the dosage form before giving me the printed copy of the order.
examples.zh: 药师核对了「药品剂型」，才把打印出来的处方副本交给我。

words.enDefinition: a booking that uses two ordinary appointment slots together

examples.en: The receptionist booked a double appointment so there would be extra time for the interpreter.
examples.zh: 前台安排了「双时段预约」，给口译多留一些时间。

examples.en: I asked whether a double appointment would be available on my day off next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周我休息的那天能不能约到「双时段预约」。

words.enDefinition: counseling available during designated hours without a prior booking

examples.en: The sign said drop-in counseling was available on Thursday afternoons at the student centre.
examples.zh: 标牌上写着，学生中心周四下午有「无需预约的心理咨询」。

examples.en: I asked where to wait for drop-in counseling after arriving at the new building.
examples.zh: 到新楼后，我问了「无需预约的心理咨询」在哪里等候。

words.enDefinition: leave a written order with a pharmacy to prepare

examples.en: I stopped at the pharmacy to drop off a prescription on my way to the library.
examples.zh: 我去图书馆的路上顺道去了药房，「提交纸质处方」。

examples.en: The clinic told me where I could drop off a prescription before I went home.
examples.zh: 回家前，诊所告诉我可以到哪里「提交纸质处方」。

collocations: drop off a prescription in person
drop off a prescription before class
a place to drop off a prescription

words.enDefinition: a small bottle with a device that releases individual drops

examples.en: The package contained a dropper bottle and its separate instruction leaflet in the carton.
examples.zh: 纸盒里有一个「滴管瓶」，还附着一份单独的使用说明书。

examples.en: My pharmacist checked whether the dropper bottle and the outside box had matching numbers.
examples.zh: 药师检查了「滴管瓶」和外盒上的号码是否一致。

words.enDefinition: a feeling of being close to falling asleep

examples.en: The drowsiness is worst after lunch, especially during lectures in warm rooms.
examples.zh: 「困倦」在午饭后最明显，尤其是在温暖的教室里听课时。

examples.en: I noticed drowsiness every afternoon for several days before my appointment last week.
examples.zh: 上周看诊前，我连续几天下午都觉得「困倦」。

words.enDefinition: a list of medicines covered or preferred by a health plan

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the drug formulary after confirming which insurance plan I was on.
examples.zh: 药师确认我的保险方案后，查了「保险药品目录」。

examples.en: I found the drug formulary under the prescriptions tab in my insurer's portal.
examples.zh: 我在保险公司系统的处方页面找到了「保险药品目录」。

collocations: look up a drug in the drug formulary

words.enDefinition: a change in how a medicine acts because of another substance

examples.en: I saw the words drug interaction on the printout and asked what they meant.
examples.zh: 我在打印件上看到「药物相互作用」几个字，就问是什么意思。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the note about a potential drug interaction before preparing my order.
examples.zh: 药师配药前查看了关于潜在「药物相互作用」的备注。

words.enDefinition: the name used to identify a specific medicine

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy to check the drug name printed beside the order number.
examples.zh: 我请药房核对印在订单号旁边的「药品名称」。

examples.en: The drug name was easier to read in the app than on the tiny sticker.
examples.zh: 应用里的「药品名称」比那张小贴纸上印的更容易看清。

words.enDefinition: a situation in which available medicine supplies cannot meet demand

examples.en: The pharmacy gave me the clinic's number when it mentioned a drug shortage.
examples.zh: 药房提到「药品短缺」时，把诊所电话号码给了我。

examples.en: I asked whether the drug shortage was listed on the health department website.
examples.zh: 我问卫生部门网站上有没有列出这次「药品短缺」。

words.enDefinition: a cough that does not bring up mucus

examples.en: I developed a dry cough halfway through the week of my exams.
examples.zh: 我那周考到一半时，开始「干咳」。

examples.en: The dry cough usually starts after I lie down for the night.
examples.zh: 我晚上躺下后通常就会开始「干咳」。

words.enDefinition: the motions of vomiting without bringing up stomach contents

examples.en: I started dry heaving before breakfast, but nothing came up at all.
examples.zh: 早饭前我开始「干呕」，但什么也没吐出来。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long the dry heaving had lasted that morning.
examples.zh: 护士问我，那天早上的「干呕」持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: a feeling of unusual dryness inside the mouth

examples.en: I woke up with dry mouth several times during the night last week.
examples.zh: 上周夜里我好几次因为「口干」醒来。

examples.en: I told the clinician that the dry mouth was most noticeable in the morning.
examples.zh: 我告诉医生，早上「口干」最明显。

words.enDefinition: a persistent low feeling of pain without a sharp edge

examples.en: I still had a dull ache in my back when I got home.
examples.zh: 我到家后，背上还是有一点「隐隐的钝痛」。

examples.en: What started as a dull ache became more noticeable later in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 最开始只是「隐隐的钝痛」，到了下午晚些时候就明显了。

collocations: a dull ache in the back

words.enDefinition: the pharmacist responsible for the pharmacy during a shift

examples.en: The duty pharmacist came over when I asked someone to explain the label.
examples.zh: 我请人解释标签时，「值班药师」走了过来。

examples.en: I left a message for the duty pharmacist because she was helping another customer.
examples.zh: 「值班药师」正在帮另一位顾客，我便给她留了言。

words.enDefinition: a liquid preparation packaged for delivery in drops into the ear

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me the word ear on the ear drops box.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了「滴耳液」盒子上标的 ear 一词。

examples.en: I took the ear drops package to the counter to ask about its label.
examples.zh: 我把「滴耳液」包装拿到柜台，想问标签上的内容。

collocations: a sealed box of ear drops

words.enDefinition: become less intense or less uncomfortable

examples.en: The pain began to ease up a few minutes after I sat down.
examples.zh: 我坐下几分钟后，疼痛就开始「有所缓解」。

examples.en: The cramps usually ease up by lunchtime, but the fatigue tends to linger.
examples.zh: 痉挛通常到了午饭时间会「有所缓解」，但疲倦往往还会持续。

collocations: wait for the cramps to ease up

words.enDefinition: a closure designed to open with less effort

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether the bottle in the display had an easy-open cap.
examples.zh: 我问药师，展示区里的那个瓶子有没有「易开瓶盖」。

examples.en: The easy-open cap looked different from the other bottle cap in the pharmacy display.
examples.zh: 「易开瓶盖」和药房展示区的另一种瓶盖看起来不一样。

collocations: a bottle with an easy-open cap

words.enDefinition: a tablet that fizzes and dissolves when placed in water

examples.en: The pharmacist explained what effervescent tablet meant on the side of the tube.
examples.zh: 药师解释了管装药侧面写的「泡腾片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The package said effervescent tablet in much larger letters than the brand name.
examples.zh: 包装上「泡腾片」的字比品牌名字大得多。

words.enDefinition: a powered brush whose head moves to clean teeth

examples.en: I asked whether my electric toothbrush had a label showing the model number.
examples.zh: 我问我的「电动牙刷」上有没有标出型号的标签。

examples.en: My roommate packed her electric toothbrush in a separate case for the trip.
examples.zh: 我室友把她的「电动牙刷」装在单独的盒子里带去旅行。

words.enDefinition: a digital record of someone's healthcare information

examples.en: The clinician opened my electronic health record to check which clinic had seen me before.
examples.zh: 医务人员打开我的「电子健康档案」，查看我之前去过哪家诊所。

examples.en: I asked whether a change of address would show up in my electronic health record.
examples.zh: 我问地址更改后，我的「电子健康档案」里会不会显示。

words.enDefinition: a medicine order created and transmitted in digital form

examples.en: I asked which pharmacy would receive the electronic prescription before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我问了这张「电子处方」会发到哪家药房。

examples.en: The pharmacist found my electronic prescription while I waited at the collection window.
examples.zh: 我在取药窗口等着的时候，药师找到了我的「电子处方」。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering a patient's arrival for emergency care

examples.en: The clerk asked for my date of birth during emergency check-in at the hospital.
examples.zh: 医院「急诊登记」时，接待人员问了我的出生日期。

examples.en: My roommate stayed with me during emergency check-in and helped confirm my contact number.
examples.zh: 室友陪我做了「急诊登记」，帮我确认了联系电话。

words.enDefinition: insurance protection for qualifying urgent or emergency care

examples.en: The plan summary has a section on emergency coverage outside my university town.
examples.zh: 保险摘要里有一节讲离开学校所在城镇时的「急诊保障」。

examples.en: I asked which documents describe emergency coverage while students are studying abroad.
examples.zh: 我问哪些文件说明了学生在海外学习期间的「急诊保障」。

words.enDefinition: a visit arranged promptly for a serious dental problem

examples.en: I asked whether an emergency dental appointment was available after I broke a tooth.
examples.zh: 牙齿摔断后，我问有没有「牙科急诊预约」的空位。

examples.en: The receptionist called with an emergency dental appointment while I was waiting outside the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆门外等的时候，前台打电话说帮我约到了「牙科急诊」。

words.enDefinition: keeping admitted patients in emergency care while beds are unavailable

examples.en: The hospital explained emergency department boarding while my family asked about the delayed ward transfer.
examples.zh: 我家人问转病房为什么延误时，医院解释了什么是「急诊滞留待住院床位」。

examples.en: A patient liaison described emergency department boarding in the leaflet given to my roommate.
examples.zh: 患者联络员在给我室友的折页里介绍了「急诊滞留待住院床位」。

words.enDefinition: an administrative worker who handles records and arrivals in emergency care

examples.en: The emergency department clerk checked my friend into the system and printed a label.
examples.zh: 「急诊科行政接待员」把我朋友登记入院内系统，并打印了标签。

examples.en: I asked the emergency department clerk which entrance my flatmate should use to meet me.
examples.zh: 我问「急诊科行政接待员」，室友该走哪个入口来找我。

collocations: speak to the emergency department clerk
check with an emergency department clerk
an emergency department clerk at reception

words.enDefinition: a hospital entrance leading directly to emergency care

examples.en: My flatmate read the map aloud while I looked for the emergency entrance sign.
examples.zh: 我找「急诊入口」标牌时，室友把地图上的说明念给我听。

examples.en: The security guard pointed out the emergency entrance from the far end of the car park.
examples.zh: 保安从停车场另一头指给我看「急诊入口」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a worker trained to provide basic prehospital emergency care

examples.en: The emergency medical technician wrote down the number my roommate gave him for the hospital.
examples.zh: 「急救医疗技术员」记下了室友提供的号码，准备交给医院。

examples.en: I asked the emergency medical technician where the crew would take my friend that evening.
examples.zh: 我问「急救医疗技术员」，那天晚上救护人员会把我朋友送去哪儿。

collocations: work as an emergency medical technician
speak to an emergency medical technician

words.enDefinition: the medical specialty dealing with urgent illness and injury

examples.en: The doctor said she worked in emergency medicine rather than on one of the hospital wards.
examples.zh: 医生说自己从事「急诊医学」，不在医院病区工作。

examples.en: My course invited a specialist in emergency medicine to explain how the local department was organized.
examples.zh: 我的课程请了一位「急诊医学」专家来介绍当地急诊科的组织方式。

words.enDefinition: a nurse who works in hospital emergency care

examples.en: An emergency nurse checked the name on my wristband before bringing me to another room.
examples.zh: 一位「急诊护士」先核对了我腕带上的姓名，再带我去另一个房间。

examples.en: I asked the emergency nurse which desk my friend should use to ask for an update.
examples.zh: 我问「急诊护士」，朋友想打听最新情况该去哪个服务台。

words.enDefinition: a doctor working in hospital emergency care

examples.en: The emergency physician reviewed my notes and told me who would come to speak next.
examples.zh: 「急诊医生」看了我的记录，告诉我接下来会有谁来沟通。

examples.en: I asked the emergency physician to explain which department would receive the records after our visit.
examples.zh: 我请「急诊医生」说明这次就诊结束后，哪个科室会接收记录。

words.enDefinition: the front desk for visitors arriving for emergency care

examples.en: My friend asked emergency reception where family members could wait for an update from staff.
examples.zh: 朋友问「急诊接待处」，家属可以在哪里等工作人员的消息。

examples.en: The hospital moved emergency reception closer to the main doors during the renovations last month.
examples.zh: 医院上个月翻修时，把「急诊接待处」搬到了更靠近大门的位置。

words.enDefinition: a record of a patient encounter in emergency care

examples.en: I requested my emergency visit record because another clinic asked for the date and notes.
examples.zh: 另一家诊所想看就诊日期和记录，我就申请了自己的「急诊就诊记录」。

examples.en: The emergency visit record showed when my friend had arrived and which team saw her.
examples.zh: 「急诊就诊记录」显示了我朋友的到院时间，以及哪个团队给她看了诊。

words.enDefinition: a state of significant emotional upset or suffering

examples.en: The service described who students could contact when they experienced emotional distress on campus.
examples.zh: 服务部门说明了学生在校园里遇到「情绪困扰」可以联系谁。

examples.en: My tutor asked how the emotional distress affected my ability to finish the project.
examples.zh: 导师问「情绪困扰」是怎么影响我完成项目的。

words.enDefinition: feeling emotionally drained after prolonged demands or strain

examples.en: I used the phrase emotional exhaustion to describe how I felt after exams.
examples.zh: 考试过后，我用「情绪耗竭」来描述自己的感受。

examples.en: The counselor asked how emotional exhaustion was affecting my time outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 咨询师问「情绪耗竭」对我的课外生活有什么影响。

words.enDefinition: feeling disconnected from emotions or unable to feel them fully

examples.en: I used emotional numbness to describe feeling distant from things I usually cared about.
examples.zh: 我用「情感麻木」来形容自己对平时在意的事情感到疏离。

examples.en: The counselor asked what emotional numbness felt like to me in daily life.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我在日常生活中体会到的「情感麻木」是什么感觉。

words.enDefinition: the process of managing and responding to one's emotions

examples.en: The workshop included a discussion of emotional regulation during stressful parts of the term.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了学期里压力大时的「情绪调节」。

examples.en: I asked the tutor what emotional regulation meant in our wellbeing course outline.
examples.zh: 我问导师，身心健康课程大纲里的「情绪调节」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: care and understanding offered when someone is upset or struggling

examples.en: I found emotional support in a group that meets after the evening lecture.
examples.zh: 下午晚些时候下课后有个聚会小组，我在那里得到了「情绪支持」。

examples.en: We talked about the difference between emotional support and help with practical tasks.
examples.zh: 我们聊了聊「情绪支持」和帮忙做实际事务有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: how well someone is able to experience and handle emotions

examples.en: Our seminar discussed how moving away from home can affect emotional wellbeing over time.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论了离家生活如何逐渐影响「情绪健康」。

examples.en: The student survey asked about emotional wellbeing during the first month on campus.
examples.zh: 学生调查问到了到校第一个月的「情绪健康」。

words.enDefinition: to bring a particular meeting with a counselor to a close

examples.en: I asked how to end a counseling session if the building was closing early.
examples.zh: 如果大楼要提前关门，我问了该怎么「结束心理咨询会谈」。

examples.en: The training showed several ways to end a counseling session without rushing the client.
examples.zh: 培训展示了几种「结束心理咨询会谈」的方式，不用催促来访者。

collocations: prepare to end a counseling session
time to end a counseling session
decide when to end a counseling session

words.enDefinition: a dentist specializing in the tissues inside teeth and root canals

examples.en: My dentist gave me the contact details for an endodontist near the station.
examples.zh: 牙医给了我一位在车站附近执业的「牙髓专科医生」的联系方式。

examples.en: The endodontist looked at the images the clinic had sent before my appointment.
examples.zh: 「牙髓专科医生」在我就诊前看了诊所发来的影像。

words.enDefinition: a tablet with a coating designed to resist stomach acid

examples.en: The pharmacist explained that enteric-coated tablet described the formulation shown on this package.
examples.zh: 药师解释说，「肠溶片」指的是这个包装上注明的剂型。

examples.en: I checked that the words enteric-coated tablet matched the entry on my list.
examples.zh: 我核查了「肠溶片」几个字是否与清单里的记录一致。

words.enDefinition: a review of which equipment fits a person's needs and environment

examples.en: The clinic called to confirm the address for my equipment assessment next week.
examples.zh: 诊所打电话确认我下周做「辅助设备需求评估」的地址。

examples.en: I asked which parts of my home the equipment assessment would cover.
examples.zh: 我问「辅助设备需求评估」会涉及我家哪些地方。

collocations: a report from an equipment assessment

words.enDefinition: an appointment to check that equipment suits its intended user

examples.en: I scheduled the equipment fitting for an afternoon when my tutor was free.
examples.zh: 我把「辅助器具适配」安排在导师有空的一个下午。

examples.en: The therapist confirmed which items were included in the equipment fitting this week.
examples.zh: 治疗师确认了本周「辅助器具适配」包括哪些物品。

words.enDefinition: the process of giving back equipment that was lent

examples.en: I asked which door to use for the equipment return at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问去诊所「归还设备」应该走哪个门。

examples.en: The service sent me a confirmation email after the equipment return was recorded.
examples.zh: 系统记下「设备归还」后，服务机构给我发了一封确认邮件。

words.enDefinition: a person who has already received care from a practice

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I was an established patient before checking the clinic's schedule.
examples.zh: 前台在查医生排班前，先问我是不是「在本诊所就诊过的患者」。

examples.en: I selected established patient on the website because the same practice had seen me last year.
examples.zh: 因为去年在同一家诊所看过病，我在网站上选了「本诊所就诊过的患者」。

collocations: an established patient at the practice

words.enDefinition: a prediction of the amount a patient will owe after coverage

examples.en: My form shows estimated patient responsibility in bold beneath the total charge.
examples.zh: 表格在总费用下方用粗体标了「预计患者自付金额」。

examples.en: I asked which items were included in the estimated patient responsibility on the quote.
examples.zh: 我问报价中「预计患者自付金额」包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: an approximation of how long someone must wait

examples.en: The screen showed an estimated wait time of thirty minutes after I checked in.
examples.zh: 我报到后，屏幕上显示的「预计等待时间」是三十分钟。

examples.en: I asked reception for the estimated wait time before deciding whether to call my tutor.
examples.zh: 我先问了前台「预计等待时间」，再决定要不要给导师打电话。

collocations: ask for the estimated wait time

words.enDefinition: a room where healthcare staff see or examine patients

examples.en: The receptionist told me to wait in the exam room until the clinician arrived.
examples.zh: 前台让我在「诊室」等医务人员过来。

examples.en: I left my umbrella in the exam room after my appointment on a rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我看完诊把伞忘在了「诊室」。

words.enDefinition: more gas than usual in the stomach or intestines

examples.en: I noticed excess gas throughout the afternoon and felt uncomfortable during class.
examples.zh: 整个下午我都觉得「肠胃胀气」，上课时很不舒服。

examples.en: The nurse asked when the excess gas first started and whether it came and went.
examples.zh: 护士问「肠胃胀气」是什么时候开始的，会不会时好时坏。

words.enDefinition: feeling a much stronger need to drink than usual

examples.en: I noticed excessive thirst even though I'd already finished my water bottle.
examples.zh: 我把一整瓶水喝完了，还是觉得「异常口渴」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the excessive thirst continued after I left the gym.
examples.zh: 护士问我离开健身房后，是不是还是「异常口渴」。

words.enDefinition: an insurer statement summarizing charges and coverage for a claim

examples.en: The explanation of benefits showed a patient share that differed from the clinic bill.
examples.zh: 「理赔结算说明」显示的患者自付额与诊所账单不同。

examples.en: I kept the explanation of benefits because it was separate from the clinic's bill.
examples.zh: 我留存了「理赔结算说明」，因为它和诊所的账单是分开的。

words.enDefinition: a tablet designed to release its medicine gradually over time

examples.en: I asked which abbreviation on the box stood for extended-release tablet in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问盒子上哪个缩写对应说明书里的「缓释片」。

examples.en: The pharmacist identified the extended-release tablet in the photograph of my old package.
examples.zh: 药师从我旧包装的照片上认出了「缓释片」。

words.enDefinition: a review of a decision by a body outside the insurer

examples.en: The notice explains what external review means for my particular type of decision.
examples.zh: 通知解释了对我这类决定做「外部复核」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether external review was available after the plan completed its appeal process.
examples.zh: 保险计划方完成申诉处理后，我问还能不能申请「外部复核」。

words.enDefinition: how well the two eyes point in the same direction

examples.en: The clinician wrote down the results for eye alignment in my exam notes.
examples.zh: 医务人员在检查记录里记下了「双眼对位」的结果。

examples.en: I asked what the comment about eye alignment meant before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我问了关于「双眼对位」的那条备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a chart of symbols or letters for measuring visual clarity

examples.en: I could read the larger letters on the eye chart from across the room.
examples.zh: 从房间对面，我能看清「视力表」上较大的字母。

examples.en: The examiner asked which line on the eye chart looked the clearest to me.
examples.zh: 检查人员问我，在我看来「视力表」上哪一行最清楚。

collocations: a line on the eye chart

words.enDefinition: a clinic that specializes in examining and caring for eyes

examples.en: I called the eye clinic from campus to check which entrance to use.
examples.zh: 我在学校给「眼科诊所」打了电话，确认该从哪个入口进去。

examples.en: The eye clinic shares a waiting room with another department across the hall.
examples.zh: 「眼科诊所」和走廊对面的另一个科室共用一间候诊室。

words.enDefinition: a liquid medicine packaged for delivery in drops into the eye

examples.en: The print was small, so I checked the eye drops label with the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 标签字太小，我就和药师一起核对了「滴眼液」的标签。

examples.en: I asked if the eye drops box included a leaflet with larger print.
examples.zh: 我问「滴眼液」盒里有没有字号更大的说明书。

words.enDefinition: the pressure inside the eye

examples.en: The clinician recorded my eye pressure on the same page as my other results.
examples.zh: 医务人员把我的「眼压」和其他检查结果记在了同一页上。

examples.en: I asked whether both eye pressure readings were included in the printout.
examples.zh: 我问打印出来的报告上是不是有双眼的「眼压」读数。

words.enDefinition: drooping of part of the face, often on one side

examples.en: My friend noticed a facial droop on my right side while we were talking.
examples.zh: 聊天时，朋友注意到我的右侧「面部下垂」。

examples.en: The nurse asked when the facial droop first became visible to my roommate.
examples.zh: 护士问我室友最早是什么时候看见我「面部下垂」的。

words.enDefinition: temporary redness of the face, often with warmth

examples.en: I noticed facial flushing halfway through the walk even though the weather was cool.
examples.zh: 虽然天气凉，我走到半路还是发现自己「脸部潮红」。

examples.en: The clinician asked whether the facial flushing felt hot or just looked red.
examples.zh: 医生问「脸部潮红」的时候我觉得发烫，还是只是看上去红。

words.enDefinition: a mutual support group guided by a designated person

examples.en: The brochure described a facilitated support group run by two staff members on campus.
examples.zh: 宣传册介绍了一个由校内两位工作人员组织的「有带领者的互助小组」。

examples.en: I asked whether the facilitated support group would stay with the same members all term.
examples.zh: 我问「有带领者的互助小组」一整个学期是不是都由同一批人参加。

words.enDefinition: a charge for using a healthcare facility and its resources

examples.en: The hospital statement shows a facility fee in addition to the clinician's charge.
examples.zh: 医院账单除了医生的收费，还列了一笔「医疗机构场地费」。

examples.en: I called the clinic to ask whether the estimate included a facility fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话给诊所，问估价中是否含有「医疗机构场地费」。

words.enDefinition: a brief episode in which someone loses consciousness

examples.en: I had a fainting spell in the hallway before my morning seminar.
examples.zh: 上午的研讨课还没开始，我在走廊里「短暂晕厥了一次」。

examples.en: My roommate described the fainting spell because I couldn't remember what had happened.
examples.zh: 我记不清发生了什么，室友描述了那次「短暂晕厥」。

words.enDefinition: a negative test finding when the target issue is present

examples.en: The screening booklet included a short example of what a false negative means.
examples.zh: 筛查册子里有个简短的例子，说明「假阴性」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked what the term false negative meant in the program information sheet.
examples.zh: 我问项目资料单上「假阴性」这个词是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a positive test finding when the target issue is absent

examples.en: The clinician explained what false positive meant without commenting on my particular result.
examples.zh: 医生解释了「假阳性」的意思，没有对我那份结果作判断。

examples.en: The workshop used a fictional example to explain a false positive to students.
examples.zh: 讲座用一个虚构例子给学生解释「假阳性」。

words.enDefinition: a deductible amount that applies across people on a family plan

examples.en: The policy lists a family deductible as well as a separate amount for each member.
examples.zh: 保单列有一项「家庭免赔额」，同时也列出了每位成员各自的金额。

examples.en: I asked which charges counted toward the family deductible after my spouse's visit.
examples.zh: 配偶看诊后，我问了哪些费用计入「家庭免赔额」。

words.enDefinition: health information about conditions that affected biological relatives

examples.en: The questionnaire asked about family medical history, so I checked with my parents that evening.
examples.zh: 问卷问了「家族病史」，我当晚就向父母核实了情况。

examples.en: I said I knew very little about my family medical history when the nurse asked.
examples.zh: 护士问起时，我说自己对「家族病史」了解不多。

words.enDefinition: a space set aside for relatives waiting for information

examples.en: My aunt waited in the family waiting area while the team finished its assessment.
examples.zh: 团队做完评估之前，我姨妈在「家属等候区」等着。

examples.en: The clerk gave my roommate directions to the family waiting area near the lifts.
examples.zh: 接待人员告诉我室友，电梯附近的「家属等候区」怎么走。

collocations: wait in the family waiting area
directions to the family waiting area
an emergency department family waiting area

words.enDefinition: a unit for patients expected to need simpler care

examples.en: The nurse directed me to the fast-track area after looking at my assessment notes.
examples.zh: 护士看过我的评估记录后，指引我去「快速诊疗区」。

examples.en: I asked whether my roommate could wait with me in the fast-track area that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问那天下午室友能不能陪我在「快速诊疗区」等候。

collocations: direct someone to the fast-track area

words.enDefinition: a feeling of tiredness that makes normal activities harder

examples.en: The nurse asked when the fatigue started and whether it affected my classes.
examples.zh: 护士问「疲劳乏力」是从什么时候开始的，是否影响了上课。

examples.en: By the afternoon, the fatigue makes it difficult for me to study.
examples.zh: 到了下午，「疲劳乏力」让我很难继续学习。

words.enDefinition: worry about not succeeding at a task or goal

examples.en: My tutor asked whether fear of failure made it harder to start my assignments.
examples.zh: 导师问，「对失败的恐惧」是否让我更难动笔写作业。

examples.en: The workshop discussed fear of failure among students preparing for their first practical exams.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了准备第一次实操考试的学生所经历的「对失败的恐惧」。

words.enDefinition: feel hot or chilled as though you have a fever

examples.en: I started to feel feverish during class, but I didn't have a thermometer.
examples.zh: 上课时我开始「感觉像在发烧」，但手边没有体温计。

examples.en: I feel feverish in the evening, though I usually feel better by morning.
examples.zh: 我晚上「感觉像在发烧」，不过通常早上会好些。

words.enDefinition: feel weak or dizzy as if you could faint

examples.en: I sometimes feel lightheaded when I stand up after a long lecture.
examples.zh: 坐着听完一节长课后，有时站起来会觉得「头晕发飘」。

examples.en: I began to feel lightheaded while waiting in the student centre for my friend.
examples.zh: 我在学生活动中心等朋友时，开始觉得「头晕发飘」。

collocations: feel lightheaded in a warm room

words.enDefinition: to feel tense and unable to settle

examples.en: I often feel on edge before meeting a new group of classmates.
examples.zh: 见新的同学小组前，我经常「感到紧张不安」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what happens when I feel on edge after class.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，下课后「感到紧张不安」时会有什么反应。

words.enDefinition: to feel unable to deal with everything happening at once

examples.en: I sometimes feel overwhelmed when several project deadlines fall in the same week.
examples.zh: 几项项目截止日期赶到同一周时，我有时「觉得应付不过来」。

examples.en: We talked about times when I feel overwhelmed at the student support meeting.
examples.zh: 在学生支持会上，我们聊了聊我什么时候会「觉得应付不过来」。

words.enDefinition: have the uncomfortable feeling that you might vomit

examples.en: I started to feel queasy halfway through the long bus ride this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上坐长途公交到半路时，我开始「感觉恶心想吐」。

examples.en: I still feel queasy whenever I smell food from the cafeteria downstairs.
examples.zh: 只要闻到楼下食堂的饭菜味，我还是会「感觉恶心想吐」。

words.enDefinition: feel weak and tired for some time

examples.en: I began to feel run-down toward the end of the exam period.
examples.zh: 到考试周快结束时，我开始「感觉疲惫没精神」。

examples.en: Even on days when I sleep well, I still feel run-down by midafternoon.
examples.zh: 哪怕晚上睡得好，到了下午我还是「感觉疲惫没精神」。

words.enDefinition: feel unable to balance steadily while standing or walking

examples.en: I feel unsteady for a moment when I first get out of bed.
examples.zh: 我刚下床时，会有一会儿「感觉站不稳」。

examples.en: The clinician asked when I began to feel unsteady on the stairs.
examples.zh: 医生问我什么时候开始在楼梯上「感觉走不稳」。

words.enDefinition: feel less healthy than usual without naming a specific problem

examples.en: I started to feel unwell during my afternoon lecture and went home early.
examples.zh: 下午上课时我开始「感觉不舒服」，就提前回家了。

examples.en: I always feel unwell in the mornings, but by lunchtime I feel fine.
examples.zh: 我早上总「感觉不舒服」，但到了午饭时间就没事了。

words.enDefinition: feeling unable to keep eating after a small amount

examples.en: I mentioned feeling full quickly, even after only a few bites of dinner.
examples.zh: 我提到自己「很快就有饱腹感」，晚饭才吃几口就饱了。

examples.en: Feeling full quickly has made it hard to finish my lunches this week.
examples.zh: 因为「很快就有饱腹感」，这周我很难吃完午饭。

collocations: feeling full quickly after starting a meal

words.enDefinition: prepare and supply medicine listed on a prescription

examples.en: I called ahead to ask if the pharmacy could fill a prescription before my evening class.
examples.zh: 我提前打电话，问药房能不能在我晚上上课前「按处方配药」。

examples.en: The new pharmacy needed my details before it could fill a prescription in its system.
examples.zh: 新药房得先录入我的信息，才能在系统里「按处方配药」。

collocations: the pharmacy can fill a prescription

words.enDefinition: the date on which a pharmacy supplied a prescribed medicine

examples.en: My pharmacist asked for the fill date printed on the old label.
examples.zh: 药师请我提供旧标签上印着的「配药日期」。

examples.en: The receipt showed a fill date next to the pharmacy's order number.
examples.zh: 收据上药房订单编号旁边写着「配药日期」。

words.enDefinition: a request for help covering a bill or charges

examples.en: The hospital sent me a financial assistance application along with the billing statement.
examples.zh: 医院把「费用援助申请」和费用对账单一起发给了我。

examples.en: I asked which documents to attach to the financial assistance application for my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次看诊的「费用援助申请」要附哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: the ability to make small controlled movements, especially with the hands

examples.en: The report described fine motor skills in a section about everyday tasks.
examples.zh: 报告在日常活动一节里记录了我的「精细动作能力」。

examples.en: I asked whether using a keyboard was relevant to the notes on fine motor skills.
examples.zh: 我问使用键盘和「精细动作能力」的记录有没有关系。

words.enDefinition: a UK document recording medical advice about ability to work

examples.en: My employer asked whether I could provide a fit note after more than a week off sick.
examples.zh: 我因病请假超过一周后，雇主问我能否提供「工作能力医疗证明」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where I could find the fit note in my account.
examples.zh: 我问前台在我的账户里哪里能找到「工作能力医疗证明」。

words.enDefinition: well enough to start attending classes again

examples.en: I asked who would assess whether I was fit to resume classes after my leave.
examples.zh: 我问请假之后，会由谁判断我的「身体状况是否允许复课」。

examples.en: My adviser explained who would need confirmation that I was fit to resume classes.
examples.zh: 顾问说了哪些人需要确认我的「身体状况允许复课」。

collocations: confirm someone is fit to resume classes
assess whether someone is fit to resume classes

words.enDefinition: a document confirming someone can work under stated conditions

examples.en: I asked who could issue a fitness-to-work certificate for my new placement.
examples.zh: 我问新的实习岗位要交「适岗健康证明」，这份证明可以由谁开。

examples.en: The office asked whether the fitness-to-work certificate showed the date of the assessment.
examples.zh: 办公室问「适岗健康证明」上有没有注明评估日期。

words.enDefinition: a bonded orthodontic device holding teeth in position

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me where the fixed retainer sat behind the front teeth.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我看了「固定式保持器」在前牙背面的哪个位置。

examples.en: The treatment summary listed a fixed retainer separately from the device I could remove.
examples.zh: 治疗摘要把「固定式保持器」和我能取下来的那个装置分开列。

words.enDefinition: skin shedding small visible pieces from its surface

examples.en: I noticed flaky skin around my nose while getting ready for class.
examples.zh: 我准备去上课时，发现鼻子周围「皮肤起屑」。

examples.en: The flaky skin on my hands first appeared early in the semester.
examples.zh: 我手上「皮肤起屑」的情况在学期刚开始时就出现了。

words.enDefinition: become noticeably worse after being mild or calm

examples.en: My symptoms tend to flare up at night and settle by morning.
examples.zh: 我的症状往往夜里「突然加重」，到早上就缓解了。

examples.en: Sometimes the pain will flare up while I am just sitting still.
examples.zh: 有时我只是坐着不动，疼痛也会「突然加重」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing some variation in when or how someone attends

examples.en: I asked about flexible attendance because two appointments fell during the same module.
examples.zh: 我的两次就诊预约都跟同一门课冲突，就问了能不能「弹性出勤」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how flexible attendance would be recorded during my recovery.
examples.zh: 导师说明了我康复期间，「弹性出勤」会怎么记录。

words.enDefinition: a small handled tool with floss stretched across a fork

examples.en: The hygienist showed me a floss pick and explained its name in English.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师给我看了一根「牙线棒」，还解释了对应的英语名称。

examples.en: I recognized the floss pick from the sample the dentist had on display.
examples.zh: 我从牙医摆着的样品中认出了「牙线棒」。

words.enDefinition: toothpaste containing a fluoride compound as an ingredient

examples.en: The hygienist pointed to the section on fluoride toothpaste in the printed handout.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师指了指纸质资料上介绍「含氟牙膏」的一节。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where the fluoride toothpaste label listed the ingredients.
examples.zh: 我问药师，「含氟牙膏」的标签上哪个位置列了成分。

words.enDefinition: a concentrated fluoride coating applied to teeth by a professional

examples.en: I asked what the words fluoride varnish meant on the clinic's service list.
examples.zh: 我问诊所服务清单上的「氟化物涂膜」是什么意思。

examples.en: The staff highlighted fluoride varnish as a separate item on my appointment record.
examples.zh: 工作人员在我的就诊记录上，把「氟化物涂膜」单独标了出来。

words.enDefinition: the metal foil layer on the back of a pack

examples.en: I could see the product code printed on the foil backing of each blister pack.
examples.zh: 我看得见每板泡罩包装「背面箔膜」上印着的产品代码。

examples.en: The pharmacist looked at the foil backing to confirm which version was in the box.
examples.zh: 药师看了看「背面箔膜」，确认盒子里装的是哪个版本。

words.enDefinition: a later consultation to review earlier care or findings

examples.en: The clinic offered me a follow-up appointment after the doctor had finished reviewing my notes.
examples.zh: 医生看完我的记录后，诊所问我是否想约一次「复诊」。

examples.en: I moved my follow-up appointment to Thursday because I had a presentation on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我星期二有展示，就把「复诊预约」改到了星期四。

words.enDefinition: a later phone call to check on a previous matter

examples.en: The nurse arranged a follow-up call so I could ask about the written summary.
examples.zh: 护士安排了「后续电话联系」，方便我询问书面摘要。

examples.en: I left my morning class earlier than usual because I was expecting a follow-up call.
examples.zh: 我在等「后续电话联系」，就比平时早一点离开了上午的课堂。

words.enDefinition: a later meeting with a counselor to continue the conversation

examples.en: My follow-up counseling session was online because I was already home for the break.
examples.zh: 我已经回家过假期了，所以「后续心理咨询」在线上进行。

examples.en: I made a note of the date for my follow-up counseling session before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，我把「后续心理咨询」的日期记了下来。

words.enDefinition: directions explaining what to do after a visit

examples.en: The receptionist printed the follow-up instructions because the portal was temporarily unavailable that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午平台暂时打不开，前台打印了「后续事项说明」。

examples.en: I read the follow-up instructions to find the department I should contact about the appointment.
examples.zh: 我看了「后续事项说明」，找到了预约应该联系的科室。

words.enDefinition: an outline of what will happen after a consultation

examples.en: I asked for the follow-up plan before leaving because I wanted to note the dates.
examples.zh: 离开之前，我要了「后续安排」，想把几个日期记下来。

examples.en: The after-visit summary described a follow-up plan and gave the number for the booking office.
examples.zh: 就诊后摘要说明了「后续安排」，还给了预约办公室的电话。

words.enDefinition: a screening check that follows an earlier check or assessment

examples.en: The clinic's letter included a contact number for questions about follow-up screening.
examples.zh: 诊所的信上留了一个电话，可以咨询「后续筛查」。

examples.en: I asked how follow-up screening would appear in my online appointment record.
examples.zh: 我问网上就诊记录会怎样显示「后续筛查」。

words.enDefinition: crutches with cuffs that rest around the forearms

examples.en: The staff asked whether my forearm crutches would fit in the taxi.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我的「前臂拐杖」能不能放进出租车。

examples.en: I checked the label on the forearm crutches before taking them to the desk.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「前臂拐杖」上的标签，再把它们拿到服务台。

words.enDefinition: a change to how a glasses frame fits the wearer

examples.en: I asked about a frame adjustment when the new glasses felt uneven.
examples.zh: 新眼镜戴起来一边高一边低，我就问能不能做「镜框调整」。

examples.en: The optician included a frame adjustment in the appointment after my classes finished.
examples.zh: 我下课后去配镜，那次预约还包含一次「镜框调整」。

words.enDefinition: a joint connecting a glasses arm to the front frame

examples.en: The optician examined the frame hinge after I brought in my damaged glasses.
examples.zh: 我带来损坏的眼镜后，配镜师检查了「镜架铰链」。

examples.en: The assistant pointed out the frame hinge when I asked which part could be replaced.
examples.zh: 我问哪个零件能换，店员给我指出了「镜架铰链」。

words.enDefinition: a promise covering certain faults in a glasses frame

examples.en: I asked whether the frame warranty was printed on the back of my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问收据背面是不是印了「镜框保修」条款。

examples.en: The assistant looked up the frame warranty when I brought the glasses back.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜带回店里时，店员查了「镜框保修」条款。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal measurement from one side of a frame to the other

examples.en: The frame width on this pair was close to that of my old glasses.
examples.zh: 这一副的「镜框总宽」和我的旧眼镜差不多。

examples.en: I asked where the frame width was listed on the shop's website.
examples.zh: 我问商店的网站把「镜框总宽」标在了哪里。

words.enDefinition: frames press uncomfortably against the sides of the nose

examples.en: These frames pinch my nose after an hour, even though they looked fine.
examples.zh: 这副眼镜看着没问题，可戴一小时后「镜框就夹得我鼻子疼」。

examples.en: I told the optician the frames pinch my nose on the right side.
examples.zh: 我告诉配镜师，这副「镜框夹得我鼻子右侧疼」。

collocations: notice the frames pinch my nose
say the frames pinch my nose

words.enDefinition: needing to pass urine more often than usual

examples.en: I noticed frequent urination after waking twice to use the bathroom last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我起来去了两次厕所，这才留意到自己「尿频」。

examples.en: The clinician asked whether the frequent urination happened during the day as well.
examples.zh: 医生问白天是不是也有「尿频」。

words.enDefinition: removable artificial teeth replacing all natural teeth in a jaw

examples.en: The teaching clinic had a model showing how full dentures fit over the gums.
examples.zh: 教学诊所有个模型，展示「全口义齿」如何贴合牙龈。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate for full dentures included any follow-up visits at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「全口义齿」的估价是否包含诊所的复诊费用。

words.enDefinition: the return to a person's previous state of health or function

examples.en: I asked what full recovery meant for the activities I normally did.
examples.zh: 我问，以我平时做的那些活动来说，「完全康复」意味着什么。

examples.en: The therapist explained that returning to class was separate from a full recovery.
examples.zh: 治疗师解释，回去上课和「完全康复」是两回事。

collocations: the timing of a full recovery

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with rims completely surrounding both lenses

examples.en: The shop had full-rim frames in several widths on the same display.
examples.zh: 同一个展示架上摆着好几种宽度的「全框眼镜架」。

examples.en: I chose full-rim frames with a color that matched my everyday clothes.
examples.zh: 我选了一副颜色和日常衣服很搭的「全框眼镜架」。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of what a person can do in ordinary activities

examples.en: The functional assessment included a discussion of the tasks I do at home.
examples.zh: 「功能评估」时，我们谈到了我在家做哪些事。

examples.en: I asked what the functional assessment report would say about using public transport.
examples.zh: 我问「功能评估」报告会怎么描述我乘公共交通的情况。

words.enDefinition: restrictions on what someone can do in everyday activities

examples.en: The therapist described my functional limitations without sharing detailed information about my diagnosis.
examples.zh: 治疗师描述了我的「活动能力受限」情况，没有分享诊断细节。

examples.en: I asked how the report on functional limitations would be used by student services.
examples.zh: 我问学生服务部门会如何使用「活动能力受限」的报告。

words.enDefinition: the ability to move during everyday tasks and situations

examples.en: The therapist asked how my functional mobility affected getting around the residence hall.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，我的「功能性移动能力」对在宿舍楼里走动有什么影响。
