examples.en: I read the section on functional mobility before my meeting with student services.
examples.zh: 和学生服务部门开会前，我读了关于「功能性移动能力」的部分。

words.enDefinition: the return of abilities used for movement or daily tasks

examples.en: The report described functional recovery in terms of the tasks I could do again.
examples.zh: 报告用我重新能做哪些事来说明「功能恢复」的情况。

examples.en: I asked the therapist how my functional recovery would be recorded over time.
examples.zh: 我问治疗师，之后会如何记录我的「功能恢复」。

words.enDefinition: a review of a person's pattern and manner of walking

examples.en: The therapist sent an explanation of the gait assessment before my first visit.
examples.zh: 第一次就诊前，治疗师发来了「步态评估」的说明。

examples.en: I asked the clinician where the results of the gait assessment would be kept.
examples.zh: 我问医务人员，「步态评估」的结果会保存在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a charge the patient pays above the insurance benefit in Australia

examples.en: The Australian clinic quoted a gap fee that I wrote down before booking.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的诊所报了一个「就医自付差额」，我在预约前记了下来。

examples.en: I asked the billing officer to explain the gap fee shown on the estimate.
examples.zh: 我请账单专员解释估价上标的「就医自付差额」。

words.enDefinition: a doctor providing general rather than specialized medical care

examples.en: I asked the general practitioner who I should contact about the booking after our call.
examples.zh: 通话结束前，我问「全科医生」之后该联系谁确认预约。

examples.en: The student adviser explained how to find a general practitioner near my new accommodation.
examples.zh: 学生顾问给我讲了怎么在新住处附近找「全科医生」。

words.enDefinition: a widespread lack of strength rather than weakness in one area

examples.en: I reported general weakness because even carrying my bag to class felt difficult.
examples.zh: 我说自己「全身无力」，连背着包去上课都觉得吃力。

examples.en: The doctor asked if the general weakness was present even when I stayed in bed.
examples.zh: 医生问我躺在床上时是否也「全身无力」。

words.enDefinition: a medicine equivalent to a reference brand-name product

examples.en: The pharmacist explained why the generic medicine came in a different box this month.
examples.zh: 药师解释了这个月「仿制药」为何换了个盒子。

examples.en: I checked the name of the generic medicine in the pharmacy's app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在药房应用里查了「仿制药」的名称。

words.enDefinition: dispensing an equivalent generic instead of a prescribed brand

examples.en: I asked about generic substitution when the box had a different name from my prescription.
examples.zh: 药盒名称和处方上不一样，我便问了「仿制药替换」是怎么回事。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained generic substitution before asking me to review the new package label.
examples.zh: 药师先解释了「仿制药替换」，再请我核对新包装上的标签。

words.enDefinition: to be asked to enter when one's turn comes

examples.en: I kept my headphones off so I would hear when it was time to get called in.
examples.zh: 我没戴耳机，免得「被叫进去」的时候听不见。

examples.en: We were told where to wait until it was time to get called in.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我们「被叫进去」看诊前在哪里等。

collocations: be next to get called in
get called in for an appointment

words.enDefinition: happening more often now than before

examples.en: The headaches are getting more frequent, though they still go away quickly.
examples.zh: 头痛「发生得越来越频繁」，不过还是很快就会消失。

examples.en: I told the nurse the cramps were getting more frequent this week.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，这周痉挛「发生得越来越频繁」。

words.enDefinition: inflammation of gum tissue without loss of tooth support

examples.en: I asked what gingivitis meant after reading the note beneath my dental photographs.
examples.zh: 我在牙齿照片下面看到一条备注，就问其中的「牙龈炎」是什么意思。

examples.en: The dentist showed me where gingivitis appeared in the examination summary on screen.
examples.zh: 牙医在屏幕上给我指出了检查摘要里提到「牙龈炎」的位置。

words.enDefinition: glasses repeatedly move downward out of their intended position

examples.en: I told the optician that my glasses keep slipping when I look down.
examples.zh: 我告诉配镜师，我一低头，「眼镜就老往下滑」。

examples.en: My glasses keep slipping during lectures, so I asked about the frame fit.
examples.zh: 上课时我的「眼镜老往下滑」，我就问是不是镜框不合适。

collocations: explain why my glasses keep slipping

words.enDefinition: a written record specifying lens correction for a pair of glasses

examples.en: I saved a copy of my glasses prescription before moving into student housing.
examples.zh: 搬进学生公寓前，我留存了一份「眼镜处方」的副本。

examples.en: The optical shop asked whether my glasses prescription was from the current year.
examples.zh: 眼镜店问我的「眼镜处方」是不是今年开的。

collocations: a copy of a glasses prescription

words.enDefinition: a group of eye conditions that harm the optic nerve

examples.en: The clinic's questionnaire asked whether anyone in my family had a history of glaucoma.
examples.zh: 诊所问卷询问我家里有没有人有「青光眼」病史。

examples.en: I asked why glaucoma was mentioned on the information sheet accompanying the referral.
examples.zh: 我问随转诊单附上的资料为什么提到「青光眼」。

words.enDefinition: a British term for a clinic providing general medical care

examples.en: I walked past the GP surgery twice because its entrance was behind the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 「全科诊所」的入口在药房后面，我走过两次都没看到。

examples.en: The GP surgery emailed me directions to its second branch before my first visit.
examples.zh: 我第一次去之前，「全科诊所」发邮件告诉我第二个分诊点怎么走。

words.enDefinition: a bar fixed in place to hold for support or balance

examples.en: I asked whether the temporary room had a grab rail beside the shower.
examples.zh: 我问临时房间的淋浴旁有没有「支撑扶手」。

examples.en: The housing officer noted where the grab rail was on the room checklist.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在房间清单上记下了「支撑扶手」的位置。

collocations: a bathroom with a grab rail

words.enDefinition: the slow appearance of a symptom over a period

examples.en: The gradual onset made it difficult to say exactly when I first felt tired.
examples.zh: 因为是「逐渐起病」，我很难说清最早是什么时候觉得疲倦。

examples.en: I described the gradual onset of the pain over several weeks of classes.
examples.zh: 我描述了几周上课期间疼痛如何「逐渐出现」。

words.enDefinition: regaining health or ability slowly over a period of time

examples.en: I told my tutor about the gradual recovery and our revised return date.
examples.zh: 我把「逐步恢复」的情况和调整后的返校日期告诉了导师。

examples.en: The report described a gradual recovery since I had left the hospital.
examples.zh: 报告描述了我离开医院后「逐步恢复」的情况。

words.enDefinition: the force a hand can exert when holding something

examples.en: The therapist recorded grip strength alongside the other results from today's visit.
examples.zh: 治疗师把「握力」和今天就诊的其他结果记在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the grip strength was recorded separately for each hand.
examples.zh: 我问是不是分别记录了两只手的「握力」。

words.enDefinition: shared rules for the way members take part in a group

examples.en: We read the group agreement before the first meeting of the peer support group.
examples.zh: 同伴互助小组第一次见面前，我们读了「小组共同约定」。

examples.en: The facilitator checked whether anyone had questions about the group agreement we had just read.
examples.zh: 带领者问大家，对刚读过的「小组共同约定」有没有疑问。

words.enDefinition: the person who guides discussion and participation in a group

examples.en: The group facilitator explained how we would take turns speaking during the meeting.
examples.zh: 「小组带领者」说明了开会时大家怎么轮流发言。

examples.en: I asked the group facilitator when the next wellbeing workshop would take place.
examples.zh: 我向「小组带领者」打听下一场身心健康工作坊什么时候开。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying an employer or school plan group

examples.en: My card lists a group number just below the name of the university.
examples.zh: 我的卡上在学校名称正下方印有「团体保险编号」。

examples.en: The billing office asked for my group number after I updated my plan.
examples.zh: 我更新保险方案后，账单部门问我要了「团体保险编号」。

words.enDefinition: a therapy meeting where a professional works with several clients together

examples.en: The group therapy session began once everyone had found a seat in the circle.
examples.zh: 大家围成一圈坐好后，「团体心理治疗会谈」开始了。

examples.en: I checked how many people would attend the group therapy session before signing up.
examples.zh: 报名之前，我问了会有多少人参加「团体心理治疗会谈」。

words.enDefinition: a deepened space between the gum and the tooth

examples.en: The dentist explained what a gum pocket looked like on the diagram.
examples.zh: 牙医在图上讲解了「牙周袋」是什么样子。

examples.en: I noticed a number beside each gum pocket in the specialist's report.
examples.zh: 我注意到专科报告里每个「牙周袋」旁边都有一个数字。

words.enDefinition: distance from the gum margin to the bottom of a pocket

examples.en: I asked which numbers indicated gum pocket depth on the chart from my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次就诊的检查记录图上，哪些数字表示「牙周袋深度」。

examples.en: The specialist compared gum pocket depth values from my recent and previous visits.
examples.zh: 专科医生比较了我最近和以往就诊时的「牙周袋深度」数值。

words.enDefinition: the soft tissue surrounding teeth along the jaw

examples.en: The dentist used a model to show how gum tissue surrounds each tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型展示了「牙龈组织」怎样包围每颗牙。

examples.en: I asked what the note about gum tissue meant in my examination summary.
examples.zh: 我问检查摘要里关于「牙龈组织」的备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the boundary where the gums meet the teeth

examples.en: The hygienist pointed to an area near the gumline on my chart.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师在检查记录图上指了指「龈缘」附近的一处。

examples.en: I asked what the small marks along the gumline meant in the photograph.
examples.zh: 我问照片上沿着「龈缘」的那些小印记是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the abilities needed to use the hand in everyday tasks

examples.en: The clinic asked what difficulties with hand function I noticed during lab classes.
examples.zh: 诊所问我上实验课时遇到了哪些「手部功能」方面的困难。

examples.en: I saved the notes on hand function before my appointment with the therapist.
examples.zh: 见治疗师之前，我把有关「手部功能」的记录保存了下来。

words.enDefinition: a rigid container for protecting a pair of glasses

examples.en: I kept my glasses in a hard glasses case inside my backpack.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜放进「硬壳眼镜盒」，再收进背包。

examples.en: The optical shop included a hard glasses case in the price of the frame.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把一个「硬壳眼镜盒」算在了镜框价格里。

collocations: put glasses in a hard glasses case

words.enDefinition: an identification card used to access healthcare in some systems

examples.en: The clinic asked me to show my health card when I arrived for the appointment.
examples.zh: 我到诊所赴约时，前台请我出示「医疗服务卡」。

examples.en: I asked which details from my health card I needed to enter on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格里需要填写「医疗服务卡」上的哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: confirmation that someone has met specified health requirements

examples.en: My placement coordinator told me where to check whether I had health clearance.
examples.zh: 实习协调员告诉我在哪里能查自己是否已「健康审核通过」。

examples.en: I asked what health clearance meant in the university's message about my placement.
examples.zh: 我问学校那封关于实习的消息里，「健康审核通过」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a form recording information needed to confirm health requirements

examples.en: The department asked me to submit a health clearance form before my first placement.
examples.zh: 院系要求我在第一次实习前提交一份「健康审核表」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic which sections of the health clearance form it could complete.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，「健康审核表」的哪些部分可以由他们填写。

words.enDefinition: a form where a person reports specified information about their health

examples.en: I asked whether I could submit the health declaration form before arriving at the residence.
examples.zh: 我问能否在抵达宿舍前提交「健康申报表」。

examples.en: The office emailed a new health declaration form because the previous link had expired.
examples.zh: 之前的链接过期了，办公室发来一份新的「健康申报表」。

words.enDefinition: documents recording someone's health information or completed checks

examples.en: The placement office asked me where I had uploaded my health documentation.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问我把「健康资料文件」传到了哪个位置。

examples.en: I kept copies of the health documentation I submitted at the start of term.
examples.zh: 我保存了学期初提交的「健康资料文件」的副本。

words.enDefinition: a card that identifies someone enrolled in a health plan

examples.en: I brought my health insurance card to the campus clinic after morning class.
examples.zh: 上午下课后，我带着「医疗保险卡」去了校医院。

examples.en: The receptionist asked to see my health insurance card when I checked in.
examples.zh: 我签到时，前台请我出示「医疗保险卡」。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering to receive coverage under a health plan

examples.en: The insurance office asked me to complete health plan enrollment before the new term.
examples.zh: 保险办公室让我在新学期前完成「医疗保险投保登记」。

examples.en: I checked my health plan enrollment after the university updated my student record.
examples.zh: 学校更新学籍后，我核对了「医疗保险投保登记」状态。

words.enDefinition: work that helps people improve health or reduce health risks

examples.en: The university's health promotion team set up a table outside the dining hall.
examples.zh: 学校的「健康促进」团队在食堂外摆了张咨询桌。

examples.en: I took a health promotion leaflet because it listed services available to students.
examples.zh: 我拿了一份「健康促进」宣传单，因为上面列了学生可以使用的服务。

words.enDefinition: a list for checking whether specified health requirements are met

examples.en: I used the health requirements checklist to see which documents were still missing.
examples.zh: 我用「健康要求核对清单」查看还有哪些材料没交。

examples.en: The department updated its health requirements checklist after changing the online submission process.
examples.zh: 院系调整网上提交流程后，更新了「健康要求核对清单」。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of factors that may affect a person's health

examples.en: The campus clinic sent a health risk assessment form with the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 校园诊所随预约确认一起发来了一份「健康风险评估」表。

examples.en: I asked who would see my answers on the health risk assessment questionnaire.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到我在「健康风险评估」问卷里填的答案。

words.enDefinition: a system sending sound directly to compatible hearing devices

examples.en: The lecture hall has a hearing loop that the facilities map identifies.
examples.zh: 报告厅装有「听力感应环路」，设施地图上标了出来。

examples.en: I asked the event organizer whether a hearing loop was available in that room.
examples.zh: 我问活动组织者，那间房能不能用「听力感应环路」。

collocations: a room fitted with a hearing loop

words.enDefinition: a brief check to identify people who may have hearing difficulties

examples.en: The campus health fair listed hearing screening among the services available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 校园健康活动把「听力筛查」列为当天下午可用的服务之一。

examples.en: I asked whether my hearing screening results would be available on a printed sheet.
examples.zh: 我问能不能拿到一张印有「听力筛查」结果的单子。

words.enDefinition: a burning feeling behind the breastbone or up the throat

examples.en: I sometimes get heartburn after dinner when I lie down too soon.
examples.zh: 有时晚饭后躺得太早，我会觉得「烧心」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the heartburn was worse at night or after meals.
examples.zh: 护士问我是夜里「烧心」更厉害，还是饭后更厉害。

words.enDefinition: a recorded check of how tall a person is

examples.en: The nurse added my height measurement to the form before saving it.
examples.zh: 护士保存表格前，把我的「身高测量」结果加了上去。

examples.en: I asked whether the height measurement on the summary was from this visit.
examples.zh: 我问摘要里的「身高测量」结果是不是这次就诊记的。

words.enDefinition: lenses made from a material that bends light more strongly

examples.en: The optician brought out a sample of high-index lenses beside the standard lenses.
examples.zh: 配镜师拿出「高折射率镜片」的样品，摆在标准镜片旁边。

examples.en: I saved the quote for high-index lenses to compare with another shop later.
examples.zh: 我保留了「高折射率镜片」的报价，打算之后和另一家店比较。

words.enDefinition: a description of how the current health problem developed

examples.en: The clinician checked my history of present illness before asking about changes since that morning.
examples.zh: 医务人员先查看了我的「现病史」，再问从那天早上起有什么变化。

examples.en: The history of present illness section covered the events that led to my visit.
examples.zh: 「现病史」一栏记录了这次来就诊的前因后果。

collocations: take the history of present illness
document the history of present illness
a brief history of present illness

words.enDefinition: raised itchy areas of skin that appear as welts

examples.en: I noticed hives on both arms when I changed my shirt after class.
examples.zh: 下课后换衬衫时，我发现两条手臂上都起了「风团」。

examples.en: I took a photo of the hives before they faded later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午「风团」消退前，我拍了张照片。

words.enDefinition: a speaking voice that sounds rough, weak, or strained

examples.en: I woke up with a hoarse voice on the day of my presentation.
examples.zh: 我在做汇报的当天醒来时，发现自己「声音沙哑」。

examples.en: The nurse asked if the hoarse voice had sounded worse after class yesterday.
examples.zh: 护士问我昨天下课后，「声音沙哑」有没有更明显。

collocations: wake up with a hoarse voice

words.enDefinition: changes making a home safer or easier for someone to use

examples.en: The occupational therapist asked which home adaptations we could discuss with my landlord.
examples.zh: 作业治疗师问，哪些「居家适应性改造」可以和房东商量。

examples.en: The report listed possible home adaptations beside a photo of our bathroom.
examples.zh: 报告在我家卫生间的照片旁列出了可能的「居家适应性改造」。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation care or support provided in the person's home

examples.en: I asked what would be included in home-based rehabilitation after leaving hospital.
examples.zh: 我问出院后的「居家康复」会包括哪些服务。

examples.en: The letter explained who would contact me about my home-based rehabilitation appointments.
examples.zh: 信里说明了谁会联系我安排「居家康复」上门时间。

words.enDefinition: a US worker providing basic personal support in someone's home

examples.en: The home health aide confirmed which days she would visit my apartment.
examples.zh: 「居家照护助理」确认了她会在哪几天来我的公寓。

examples.en: I asked the agency whether a home health aide would be available on weekends.
examples.zh: 我问服务机构周末有没有「居家照护助理」能来。

collocations: support from a home health aide

words.enDefinition: health services delivered where a person lives

examples.en: The hospital explained how to contact the agency providing home health care.
examples.zh: 医院说明了怎样联系提供「居家医疗照护」的机构。

examples.en: I asked which services were included in my home health care plan.
examples.zh: 我问我的「居家医疗照护」计划包含哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: a review of the home environment for access and potential hazards

examples.en: The therapist took notes about the entrance during the home safety assessment.
examples.zh: 「居家安全评估」时，治疗师记录了入口的情况。

examples.en: I checked that the home safety assessment would cover our shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 我确认了「居家安全评估」会包括我们共用的卫生间。

collocations: carry out a home safety assessment
a report from a home safety assessment

words.enDefinition: a care or support appointment held at a person's home

examples.en: The community nurse asked whether Tuesday morning would suit me for a home visit.
examples.zh: 社区护士问我星期二上午是否方便「上门访视」。

examples.en: I showed my flatmate the message that confirmed my home visit next week.
examples.zh: 我把确认下周「上门访视」的消息给室友看了。

words.enDefinition: formally taking a patient into hospital for inpatient care

examples.en: The team discussed hospital admission and explained who would update me about a possible ward bed.
examples.zh: 团队讨论了「住院收治」，并说明会由谁告诉我有没有病房床位。

examples.en: The school office asked for the date of hospital admission when I explained my absence.
examples.zh: 我向学校办公室说明缺课情况时，对方问了「住院收治」的日期。

words.enDefinition: the official end of a patient's stay or visit

examples.en: At hospital discharge, the office gave me a summary and showed me where it was online.
examples.zh: 「出院」时，办公室给了我一份摘要，还告诉我在哪里能在线看到。

examples.en: I asked who could confirm my hospital discharge for the university absence form.
examples.zh: 为填学校的缺勤表，我问谁能确认我的「出院」情况。

words.enDefinition: help a hospital offers to reduce eligible patients' costs

examples.en: The student adviser showed me who to contact about hospital financial assistance.
examples.zh: 学生顾问告诉我，要咨询「医院费用援助」可以联系谁。

examples.en: I asked what hospital financial assistance was available before sending my supporting papers.
examples.zh: 发证明材料前，我问了有哪些「医院费用援助」可以申请。

words.enDefinition: a loose garment provided for patients to wear in hospital

examples.en: The nurse told me where I could change into a hospital gown before the assessment.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我评估前可以在哪里换「病号服」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought my clothes while I was still sitting in a hospital gown.
examples.zh: 我还穿着「病号服」坐着时，室友把我的衣服送来了。

words.enDefinition: a hospital worker who moves patients, equipment, or supplies

examples.en: The hospital porter took me to the imaging department after the nurse called downstairs.
examples.zh: 护士给楼下打电话后，「医院转运员」带我去了影像科。

examples.en: I asked the hospital porter whether my roommate could come with me to the next ward.
examples.zh: 我问「医院转运员」，室友能不能陪我到下一处病房。

words.enDefinition: an admission to hospital after a previous hospital stay

examples.en: The form asked whether there had been a hospital readmission since my last review.
examples.zh: 表格询问我上次复查之后是否曾「再次入院」。

examples.en: I asked which dates to list for the hospital readmission on my university form.
examples.zh: 我问学校表格上该填写「再次入院」的哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: a professional who helps hospital patients access practical and social support

examples.en: The hospital social worker helped me find the contact details for my local service.
examples.zh: 「医院社工」帮我找到了本地服务机构的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked the hospital social worker about support after I returned to student housing.
examples.zh: 我向「医院社工」咨询了回到学生公寓后能获得的支持。

collocations: speak to a hospital social worker
a referral to a hospital social worker

words.enDefinition: a test looking for certain types of human papillomavirus

examples.en: I asked the nurse what HPV test meant on the printed requisition.
examples.zh: 我问护士，打印出来的申请单上「人乳头瘤病毒检测」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clinic told me when my HPV test report would be available.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我什么时候可以查看「人乳头瘤病毒检测」报告。

words.enDefinition: a focusing condition often making close objects harder to see clearly

examples.en: I asked what hyperopia meant after seeing it on my new eye report.
examples.zh: 我在新的眼部检查报告上看到「远视」，就问了这个词的意思。

examples.en: The term hyperopia appeared below the results for the focusing test in my notes.
examples.zh: 我的记录里，聚焦测试结果下方写着「远视」。

words.enDefinition: a written order that is too difficult to read

examples.en: The pharmacist called the clinic to clarify an illegible prescription before preparing the order.
examples.zh: 药师先打电话给诊所核实那张「字迹难辨的处方」，之后才配药。

examples.en: The clinic replaced the illegible prescription with a clearly printed copy that afternoon.
examples.zh: 诊所当天下午把「字迹难辨的处方」换成了一张打印清晰的副本。

words.enDefinition: the part of a hospital that performs medical imaging

examples.en: The porter showed me which corridor led to the imaging department from the emergency area.
examples.zh: 运送人员告诉我，从急诊区出去走哪条走廊可以到「影像科」。

examples.en: My friend waited outside the imaging department while I spoke to the staff at reception.
examples.zh: 我和前台工作人员沟通时，朋友在「影像科」门口等我。

words.enDefinition: a clinician's request for a medical imaging examination

examples.en: The nurse confirmed that the imaging request had reached the department on the lower floor.
examples.zh: 护士确认「影像检查申请」已经送到了楼下的科室。

examples.en: I asked whether my name could be corrected before the team processed the imaging request.
examples.zh: 我问团队处理「影像检查申请」之前，能不能把我的姓名改对。

words.enDefinition: a tablet without a design that delays release of its medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist compared the immediate-release tablet label with the older version in the system.
examples.zh: 药师把「速释片」的标签与系统里的旧版本作了对照。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet described the immediate-release tablet form of this product.
examples.zh: 我问说明书哪里介绍了这款药的「速释片」剂型。

words.enDefinition: a record listing vaccinations a person has received

examples.en: I requested a copy of my immunization record before leaving for the exchange.
examples.zh: 出发去交换以前，我先申请了一份自己的「免疫接种记录」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the date on my immunization record against the clinic's notes.
examples.zh: 护士把我的「免疫接种记录」上的日期和诊所记录对了一下。

collocations: a copy of the immunization record

words.enDefinition: a database that combines vaccination records for registered individuals

examples.en: The clinic looked up my previous record in its regional immunization registry.
examples.zh: 诊所在地区「免疫接种登记系统」里查找了我先前的记录。

examples.en: I asked who could access my record through the immunization registry after I moved.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我问谁可以通过「免疫接种登记系统」查看我的记录。

collocations: an entry in the immunization registry
retrieve a record from the immunization registry

words.enDefinition: a condition specifying vaccination evidence needed for an activity

examples.en: The placement handbook listed an immunization requirement and named an office for questions.
examples.zh: 实习手册列了一项「免疫接种要求」，并写了负责解答问题的部门。

examples.en: I asked when the immunization requirement had been added to this year's checklist.
examples.zh: 我问这项「免疫接种要求」是什么时候加到今年的清单上的。

words.enDefinition: a plan indicating when particular vaccinations are generally due

examples.en: I asked which immunization schedule the campus health page was referring to.
examples.zh: 我问校园健康网页指的是哪一份「免疫接种时间表」。

examples.en: The nurse showed me where the immunization schedule appeared in the reference material.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，参考材料中哪里有「免疫接种时间表」。

words.enDefinition: persistent doubts about whether one deserves one's achievements or position

examples.en: I heard about impostor syndrome during a discussion with other first-year doctoral students.
examples.zh: 和其他博士一年级学生讨论时，我听说了「冒名顶替感」。

examples.en: The seminar explored impostor syndrome among students who had just entered a competitive programme.
examples.zh: 研讨课探讨了刚进入竞争激烈项目的学生所面临的「冒名顶替感」。

words.zhGloss: 保险网络内医疗服务方
words.enDefinition: a healthcare provider contracted with a particular insurance plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险网络内医疗服务方

examples.en: I picked an in-network provider near campus so the appointment wouldn't involve a long commute.
examples.zh: 我选了学校附近的「保险网络内医疗服务方」，去看诊不用跑太远。

examples.en: The number on my card can help me find an in-network provider.
examples.zh: 打我卡上的电话，可以帮我找到「保险网络内医疗服务方」。

words.enDefinition: prices contracted between a health plan and its network providers

examples.en: The insurance office explained how the in-network rates affected what the clinic could charge.
examples.zh: 保险办公室解释了「网络内费率」会怎样影响诊所的收费。

examples.en: I asked whether the new plan had different in-network rates for campus visits.
examples.zh: 我问新的保险方案对校内就诊是否有不同的「网络内费率」。

words.enDefinition: with the most urgent people or issues dealt with first

examples.en: The board said people were usually seen in order of urgency rather than arrival time.
examples.zh: 公告板说，通常是「按紧急程度」看诊，不是按到达时间。

examples.en: The nurse explained that referrals were reviewed in order of urgency throughout the evening.
examples.zh: 护士解释说，整晚的转诊申请都是「按紧急程度」审查的。

words.enDefinition: a consultation attended physically at the clinic

examples.en: I chose an in-person appointment because I was already on campus near the clinic.
examples.zh: 我当时就在诊所附近的校园里，就选了「现场就诊预约」。

examples.en: The confirmation listed the building entrance to use for my in-person appointment next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 确认消息注明，下星期三「现场就诊」应走哪个楼门。

words.enDefinition: a component of a medicine other than its active substance

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to identify an inactive ingredient I didn't recognize on the label.
examples.zh: 标签上有一种「非活性成分」我没见过，就请药师认一下。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked whether the inactive ingredient was present in both products on the shelf.
examples.zh: 药师查了架子上两款药品是否都含有这种「非活性成分」。

words.enDefinition: a front tooth with a thin edge for cutting food

examples.en: The diagram showed which incisor the dentist had checked during the visit.
examples.zh: 图上标出了牙医就诊时检查的是哪颗「切牙」。

examples.en: I asked why the left incisor was shaded on the printed diagram.
examples.zh: 我问打印出来的图上，为什么左边那颗「切牙」涂了颜色。

words.enDefinition: a finding that does not support a definite interpretation

examples.en: The clinic called to explain the inconclusive result shown on the report.
examples.zh: 诊所打电话解释了报告上写的「未能判定的结果」。

examples.en: I asked who could answer my questions about the inconclusive result after class.
examples.zh: 我问下课后可以找谁咨询这个「未能判定的结果」。

collocations: a letter with an inconclusive result

words.enDefinition: private sessions between a client and a counselor

examples.en: I read about individual counseling on the same page that listed the support groups.
examples.zh: 我在列出互助小组的同一页看到了「一对一心理咨询」的介绍。

examples.en: The service offered individual counseling, and my first session was in the main building.
examples.zh: 学校提供「一对一心理咨询」，我第一次去的是主楼。

words.enDefinition: someone providing unpaid care outside a professional service, typically a relative or friend

examples.en: The assessor asked if an informal caregiver would be available when I got home.
examples.zh: 评估人员问我，回家后有没有「非正式照护者」能来帮忙。

examples.en: My brother became my informal caregiver for a short time after discharge.
examples.zh: 出院后，我哥哥短暂当过我的「非正式照护者」。

words.enDefinition: a device that delivers medicine in a form breathed in

examples.en: I brought my old inhaler package so the pharmacist could check the exact model.
examples.zh: 我带去了旧的「吸入器」包装，方便药师核对具体型号。

examples.en: The leaflet included a labeled drawing of the inhaler next to the contents list.
examples.zh: 说明书在内装物品清单旁印了带标注的「吸入器」示意图。

words.enDefinition: the first appointment to discuss a particular concern

examples.en: The doctor reviewed my main concern during the initial consultation and explained what would happen next.
examples.zh: 医生在「首次问诊」中了解了我最想咨询的问题，并说明下一步安排。

examples.en: I brought the previous clinic's summary to my initial consultation with the new specialist.
examples.zh: 我带着上一家诊所的摘要去见新专科医生，参加了「首次问诊」。

words.enDefinition: the first meeting a client has with a counselor

examples.en: I asked what to expect from an initial counseling session at the university.
examples.zh: 我问了在学校做「首次心理咨询」一般会聊些什么。

examples.en: My initial counseling session was on the same day as my last lecture.
examples.zh: 我的「首次心理咨询」和我最后一节课安排在同一天。

words.enDefinition: a fitted restoration that sits within a tooth without covering its cusps

examples.en: The dentist used a diagram to show how an inlay fits inside the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图展示了「牙科嵌体」如何嵌在牙齿里。

examples.en: I asked whether inlay meant the same thing as filling on this estimate.
examples.zh: 我问这份估价单上的「牙科嵌体」和补牙填充体是不是同一种东西。

words.enDefinition: a hospital bed for someone formally admitted for care

examples.en: The nurse said my roommate was waiting for an inpatient bed in another ward.
examples.zh: 护士说，室友正在等另一个病区的「住院床位」。

examples.en: I asked what would happen once an inpatient bed became available on the upper floor.
examples.zh: 我问楼上的「住院床位」空出来之后会怎么安排。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation received while staying overnight in a care facility

examples.en: The team explained inpatient rehabilitation when we discussed where I would stay next.
examples.zh: 我们讨论下一步去哪儿住时，团队介绍了「住院康复」。

examples.en: I asked whether the leaflet about inpatient rehabilitation listed visiting hours for families.
examples.zh: 我问有关「住院康复」的小册子有没有写家属探视时间。

words.enDefinition: a sample too small for the laboratory to complete a test

examples.en: I called the clinic about the insufficient sample message on the results page.
examples.zh: 我打电话给诊所，询问结果页面上「样本量不足」的提示。

examples.en: The lab recorded an insufficient sample and the clinic sent me a message.
examples.zh: 检验室记录了「样本量不足」，诊所给我发来一条通知。

words.enDefinition: a request for an insurer to pay for a covered expense

examples.en: My insurance claim showed up in the portal a week after the visit.
examples.zh: 看诊一周后，我的「保险理赔申请」出现在了在线系统。

examples.en: I asked the office who was responsible for filing the insurance claim.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，应该由谁提交这笔「保险理赔申请」。

words.enDefinition: the part of an insurer that handles requests for payment

examples.en: The insurance claims department asked for an updated receipt from the university clinic.
examples.zh: 「保险理赔部门」要校医院出一份更新后的收据。

examples.en: I called the insurance claims department after my online submission stayed pending for weeks.
examples.zh: 网上提交几周都显示待处理，我就打给了「保险理赔部门」。

collocations: send documents to the insurance claims department

words.enDefinition: the insurance details a provider already has in its records

examples.en: The office asked me to confirm the insurance information on file before billing.
examples.zh: 开账之前，办公室请我核对「已存档的保险资料」。

examples.en: My insurance information on file still pointed to the plan I had last year.
examples.zh: 「已存档的保险资料」还是我去年的保险方案。

collocations: confirm the insurance information on file

words.enDefinition: the identifier a health plan assigns to an enrolled member

examples.en: The form asks for the insurance member ID printed on my digital card.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写我电子卡上印的「保险会员编号」。

examples.en: I read the insurance member ID aloud when I called the benefits office.
examples.zh: 我打电话给福利办公室时，念出了「保险会员编号」。

collocations: look up an insurance member ID

words.enDefinition: a number that identifies a particular insurance contract

examples.en: I copied my insurance policy number into the form for overseas study.
examples.zh: 我把「保单号」填到了海外学习申请表上。

examples.en: The insurance policy number on my confirmation letter matches the number online.
examples.zh: 确认函上的「保单号」和网站上的号码相同。

words.enDefinition: a recurring amount paid to maintain insurance coverage

examples.en: My tuition statement shows the insurance premium on a separate line this term.
examples.zh: 这学期的学费账单把「保险费」单列了一行。

examples.en: We compared the total insurance premium before choosing plans for our exchange year.
examples.zh: 为交换学年选保险方案之前，我们对比了全部「保险费」。

words.enDefinition: a form collecting basic information before an appointment

examples.en: The clinic emailed an intake form asking about previous care and how to contact me.
examples.zh: 诊所发来一份「接诊信息表」，询问之前的就诊情况和联系方式。

examples.en: I took my intake form to the receptionist after filling it out at home.
examples.zh: 我在家填好「接诊信息表」，拿给了前台。

words.enDefinition: a small brush shaped to fit between adjacent teeth

examples.en: The hygienist showed me an interdental brush on a model of the teeth.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师用一个牙齿模型给我看了「牙缝刷」。

examples.en: I asked which symbol on the interdental brush package showed the brush size.
examples.zh: 我问「牙缝刷」包装上哪个图标表示刷子的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: moving a patient from one hospital to another

examples.en: The team arranged an interhospital transfer after another hospital agreed to receive my friend.
examples.zh: 另一家医院同意接收我朋友后，医疗团队安排了「院间转运」。

examples.en: I asked which building my roommate would go to after the interhospital transfer was complete.
examples.zh: 我问「院间转运」结束后，室友会到哪栋楼。

words.enDefinition: short-term support between hospital care and more independent living

examples.en: The discharge team mentioned intermediate care while we discussed support at home.
examples.zh: 我们讨论居家支持时，出院团队提到了「过渡照护」。

examples.en: I asked who would coordinate my intermediate care once I left the hospital.
examples.zh: 我问出院后谁会协调我的「过渡照护」。

words.enDefinition: pain that starts and stops over a period of time

examples.en: The intermittent pain in my knee often disappears before my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我膝盖的「间歇性疼痛」常常在早课开始前就消失了。

examples.en: I marked the times of the intermittent pain to show the doctor.
examples.zh: 我记下「间歇性疼痛」发作的时间，准备给医生看。

words.enDefinition: a referral to another service within the same organization

examples.en: The clinician submitted an internal referral to another department in the same outpatient building.
examples.zh: 医务人员给同一栋门诊楼里的另一个科室提交了「机构内部转诊」。

examples.en: I asked whether the internal referral would appear in the same patient portal account.
examples.zh: 我问在同一个患者平台账户里能不能看到「机构内部转诊」。

collocations: follow up on an internal referral

words.enDefinition: a therapy focusing on relationships and important life changes

examples.en: The counselor briefly explained interpersonal therapy when we discussed the service's leaflet together.
examples.zh: 我们一起看宣传页时，咨询师简要介绍了「人际心理治疗」。

examples.en: I first heard the term interpersonal therapy during a seminar about campus wellbeing.
examples.zh: 我第一次听到「人际心理治疗」，是在一场校园身心健康研讨会上。

words.enDefinition: a digital three-dimensional recording of teeth and nearby tissues

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me the intraoral scan on a tablet after the appointment.
examples.zh: 就诊结束后，正畸医生用平板给我看了「口内扫描」结果。

examples.en: I asked if the clinic could send my intraoral scan to another practice.
examples.zh: 我问诊所能不能把我的「口内扫描」发给另一家诊所。

words.enDefinition: unwanted thoughts that enter the mind and may feel upsetting

examples.en: I described the intrusive thoughts I had noticed while trying to concentrate in class.
examples.zh: 我描述了自己努力听课时留意到的「闯入性想法」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what the phrase intrusive thoughts meant to me personally.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，「闯入性想法」这个说法对我个人来说意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: skin that produces a strong urge to scratch

examples.en: I have itchy skin on my arms that gets worse at night.
examples.zh: 我的手臂「皮肤发痒」，而且到了晚上更明显。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long I had noticed the itchy skin on my back.
examples.zh: 护士问我发现背上的「皮肤发痒」多久了。

words.enDefinition: a bill with each service and charge shown separately

examples.en: I asked the hospital for an itemized bill so I could see each charge.
examples.zh: 我向医院要了「明细账单」，这样能看清每项收费。

examples.en: The itemized bill helped me match a lab fee to the correct appointment.
examples.zh: 这份「明细账单」让我把一笔化验费和对应的就诊对上了。

words.enDefinition: a clicking sound when the jaw is moved

examples.en: I mentioned jaw clicking when the dentist asked about sounds near my jaw.
examples.zh: 牙医问我下颌周围有没有响声，我提到了「下颌弹响」。

examples.en: The form asked whether jaw clicking occurred when eating or at other times.
examples.zh: 表格问到「下颌弹响」是在吃饭时出现，还是在其他时候也有。

words.enDefinition: discomfort in one or more places where bones meet

examples.en: The joint pain is mostly in my knees and feels worse after climbing stairs.
examples.zh: 「关节疼痛」主要在膝盖，上下楼之后更厉害。

examples.en: The clinician asked if the joint pain was on both sides or only one.
examples.zh: 医生问「关节疼痛」是两边都有，还是只在一边。

words.enDefinition: in the area directly underneath the lowest ribs

examples.en: The ache is just below the ribs and stays in one spot.
examples.zh: 酸痛「就在肋骨下方」，一直在同一个地方。

examples.en: I pointed to a spot just below the ribs on my left side.
examples.zh: 我指了指左侧「就在肋骨下方」的一个位置。

collocations: feel pressure just below the ribs

words.enDefinition: to retain a patient temporarily for ongoing assessment

examples.en: The doctor used the words keep under observation when explaining why I would stay longer.
examples.zh: 医生用「继续留院观察」解释我为什么需要多待一会儿。

examples.en: The nurse explained how the team decides which patients to keep under observation after assessment.
examples.zh: 护士说明团队在评估后怎么决定让哪些患者「继续留院观察」。

collocations: decide whom to keep under observation

words.enDefinition: a wheeled mobility aid with a platform supporting one knee

examples.en: I asked the equipment desk whether it could lend me a knee scooter.
examples.zh: 我问辅助设备服务台能不能借给我一辆「膝托代步车」。

examples.en: My roommate measured our hallway to see if a knee scooter would fit.
examples.zh: 室友量了我们家走廊的宽度，看「膝托代步车」能不能通过。

words.enDefinition: an allergic sensitivity that a person already knows about

examples.en: The nurse asked me to report any known allergy before she finalized the intake form.
examples.zh: 护士让我说明是否有「已知过敏情况」，再完成接诊资料表。

examples.en: I checked the portal to make sure my known allergy was still on the list.
examples.zh: 我看了一眼平台，确认「已知过敏情况」仍在清单上。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit to a medical laboratory

examples.en: I moved my lab appointment to the morning before my first lecture of the week.
examples.zh: 我把「检验预约」改到了这周第一节课前的上午。

examples.en: The clinic sent a message confirming the address for my lab appointment next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 诊所发消息确认了下周二「检验预约」的地址。

words.enDefinition: a clinician's request specifying laboratory tests to be done

examples.en: The lab asked when the clinic had submitted my lab order electronically.
examples.zh: 检验室问诊所是什么时候用电子系统提交我的「实验室检验医嘱」的。

examples.en: I asked which tests appeared under the new lab order on screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上新的「实验室检验医嘱」下面列了哪些检测。

words.enDefinition: the work a laboratory performs to prepare or analyze samples

examples.en: The portal showed that lab processing had started after the sample arrived.
examples.zh: 样本送达后，网上平台显示已经开始「检验室处理」。

examples.en: I asked who to contact about the stage marked lab processing online.
examples.zh: 我问网上标着「检验室处理」的阶段应该联系谁咨询。

words.enDefinition: a trip to a medical laboratory for testing or to provide a sample

examples.en: I went back to class after a short lab visit at the campus health centre.
examples.zh: 我在校园健康中心「到检验室做检查」，很快就回去上课了。

examples.en: My lab visit finished before noon, so I caught the earlier bus home.
examples.zh: 我「到检验室做检查」时没耽误太久，中午前就做完了，所以赶上了更早一班回家的公交。

collocations: go in for a lab visit
the date of the lab visit

words.enDefinition: a document summarizing findings from tests performed in a laboratory

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the laboratory test report after the clinic called.
examples.zh: 诊所打来电话后，我索要了一份「实验室检验报告」副本。

examples.en: The nurse asked me to bring my previous laboratory test report to the appointment.
examples.zh: 护士请我就诊时带上以前的「实验室检验报告」。

collocations: a copy of the laboratory test report

words.enDefinition: reaching an appointment after the scheduled time

examples.en: I phoned the clinic about my late arrival after the bus stopped running that morning.
examples.zh: 当天早上公交停运了，我打电话跟诊所说我会「迟到」。

examples.en: The clinic asked me to explain the late arrival when I checked in at reception.
examples.zh: 我到前台报到时，诊所请我说明「迟到」的原因。

words.enDefinition: to record a spoken message for someone to hear later

examples.en: I decided to leave a voicemail after hearing that the reception desk was closed.
examples.zh: 听到语音提示说前台下班了，我决定「留一条语音留言」。

examples.en: The booking office asked me to leave a voicemail with my name and phone number.
examples.zh: 预约办公室让我「留一条语音留言」，说清姓名和电话号码。

collocations: leave a voicemail after the tone
leave a voicemail with your number
ask someone to leave a voicemail

words.enDefinition: time formally taken away from studies because of health concerns

examples.en: I asked how leave for health reasons might affect my place on the course.
examples.zh: 我问「因健康原因休学」可能对我的课程名额有什么影响。

examples.en: The adviser explained which forms were used to request leave for health reasons.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了申请「因健康原因休学」需要哪些表格。

collocations: apply for leave for health reasons

words.enDefinition: departed before being evaluated by the treating clinical team

examples.en: The record said left without being seen, but my roommate remembered speaking to a triage nurse.
examples.zh: 记录上写着「未获看诊即离院」，但室友记得和分诊护士说过话。

examples.en: The clerk explained why left without being seen could appear next to a visit entry.
examples.zh: 接待人员解释了为什么某条就诊记录旁边可能会写「未获看诊即离院」。

collocations: marked as left without being seen
patients who left without being seen
a record showing left without being seen

words.enDefinition: the total time a person remains in a healthcare facility

examples.en: The clerk checked the length of stay before completing the form for my university.
examples.zh: 接待人员先核对了「留院时长」，再填给我学校的表格。

examples.en: I asked why the length of stay in the report was different from my notes.
examples.zh: 我问报告里的「留院时长」为什么和我自己记的不一样。

words.enDefinition: a soft cloth made for cleaning the surface of lenses

examples.en: The assistant put a lens cloth in the box with my glasses.
examples.zh: 店员把一块「擦镜布」和我的眼镜一起放进了盒里。

examples.en: I found the lens cloth inside the spare case I keep at my desk.
examples.zh: 我在书桌上备用的眼镜盒里找到了「擦镜布」。

words.enDefinition: the strength with which a lens changes the focus of light

examples.en: The sample lens had its lens power printed in small letters on the sleeve.
examples.zh: 样品镜片的包装纸套上用小字标了「镜片度数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the lens power was the same for both of my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问我两只眼睛的「镜片度数」是不是一样。

words.enDefinition: the distance between a lens's front and back surfaces

examples.en: The optician showed me how the lens thickness differed across the three samples.
examples.zh: 配镜师向我展示了这三种样品的「镜片厚度」有何不同。

examples.en: I asked about lens thickness because my previous pair had felt heavy.
examples.zh: 我上一副眼镜戴起来有点重，所以问了一下「镜片厚度」。

words.enDefinition: the horizontal measurement across one lens opening in a frame

examples.en: I compared the lens width of both pairs before choosing the smaller frame.
examples.zh: 我先比较了两副眼镜的「单片镜片宽度」，才选了较小的镜框。

examples.en: The assistant pointed to the lens width printed inside the frame's arm.
examples.zh: 店员指出了镜腿内侧印着的「单片镜片宽度」。

collocations: a frame with a narrower lens width

words.enDefinition: a counselor authorised to practise under a local licensing system

examples.en: The website identifies each licensed counselor by name and lists their training and qualifications.
examples.zh: 网站列出了每位「持证心理咨询师」的姓名、受训经历和资质。

examples.en: I asked whether the referral list included a licensed counselor who spoke Mandarin.
examples.zh: 我问转介名单里有没有说普通话的「持证心理咨询师」。

words.enDefinition: circumstances in which information may be shared under applicable rules

examples.en: The counselor explained the limits of confidentiality before our first conversation on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五第一次谈话前，咨询师解释了哪些情况属于「保密范围的例外」。

examples.en: I asked about the limits of confidentiality while reading the consent form at home.
examples.zh: 我在家读同意书时，对「保密范围的例外」提出了疑问。

words.enDefinition: a group of blood tests measuring different fats in blood

examples.en: The report listed a lipid panel with several values beneath the heading.
examples.zh: 报告里有一项「血脂全套检查」，标题下面列着好几个数值。

examples.en: I asked the clinician to explain what the lipid panel heading covered.
examples.zh: 我请医生解释「血脂全套检查」这个标题下面包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: pain confined to one specific small area of the body

examples.en: I have localized pain just below my ribs on the left side.
examples.zh: 我左侧肋骨正下方有「局部疼痛」。

examples.en: The localized pain has stayed in the same spot since I first noticed it.
examples.zh: 最初察觉后，「局部疼痛」一直在原来的位置。

words.enDefinition: a doctor filling in temporarily for another doctor

examples.en: The receptionist told me a locum doctor was covering while my usual doctor was away.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，常看的医生不在，有一位「临时代诊医生」替班。

examples.en: I showed the locum doctor the letter I had received from my regular clinic.
examples.zh: 我把常去的诊所寄来的信给「临时代诊医生」看了。

collocations: arrange cover with a locum doctor
an appointment with a locum doctor

words.enDefinition: bowel movements that are softer or more watery than usual

examples.en: I have had loose stools for two days, mostly in the morning.
examples.zh: 这两天我有「稀便」，大多在早上。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether I had been having loose stools more often since yesterday.
examples.zh: 护士问我从昨天开始是不是更频繁地「排稀便」了。

words.enDefinition: a tooth that moves more than it normally should

examples.en: I pointed to the loose tooth when the dentist asked where the movement was.
examples.zh: 牙医问我哪里会动，我就指了指那颗「松动的牙齿」。

examples.en: The clinic asked when I had first noticed the loose tooth at home.
examples.zh: 诊所问我在家最早是什么时候发现这颗「松动的牙齿」的。

words.enDefinition: having less desire to eat than you normally do

examples.en: The loss of appetite began on Monday, when I left most of my dinner untouched.
examples.zh: 「食欲减退」是星期一开始的，那天我晚饭几乎没动。

examples.en: I mentioned the loss of appetite when the nurse asked about my eating habits.
examples.zh: 护士问我平常怎么吃饭时，我提到了「食欲减退」。

words.enDefinition: becoming less certain about one's abilities or judgments

examples.en: I noticed a loss of confidence after receiving feedback on my first essay.
examples.zh: 第一篇论文收到反馈后，我察觉自己「信心减退」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the loss of confidence also affected how I spoke in class.
examples.zh: 顾问问「信心减退」是否也影响了我在课堂上的发言。

words.enDefinition: reduced interest in activities that previously mattered to someone

examples.en: I mentioned a loss of interest in the clubs I used to enjoy.
examples.zh: 我提到，自己对以前喜欢的社团活动「兴趣减退」。

examples.en: We talked about when the loss of interest in my usual hobbies had started.
examples.zh: 我们谈了谈我从什么时候开始对平时的爱好「兴趣减退」。

words.enDefinition: feeling less willing or able to begin and continue activities

examples.en: I noticed a loss of motivation when I sat down to start my coursework.
examples.zh: 坐下来准备写作业时，我感到自己的「动力减退」。

examples.en: The adviser asked about loss of motivation after I described a difficult week.
examples.zh: 我讲了上周有多难熬后，顾问问起了「动力减退」的情况。

words.enDefinition: a reduced or absent ability to detect smells

examples.en: I first noticed the loss of smell when I opened a bag of coffee.
examples.zh: 我打开一袋咖啡时，第一次发现自己「闻不出味道」了。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the loss of smell had lasted more than one day.
examples.zh: 护士问「嗅觉减退或丧失」是否持续了一天以上。

collocations: report a sudden loss of smell

words.enDefinition: a reduced or absent ability to detect basic tastes

examples.en: I noticed a loss of taste when my very salty soup seemed plain.
examples.zh: 很咸的汤喝起来却很淡，我这才注意到自己「味觉减退」了。

examples.en: The clinician asked when the loss of taste started and whether it was complete.
examples.zh: 医生问「味觉减退或丧失」从什么时候开始，以及是不是完全尝不出味道。

words.enDefinition: a filling that has come out of the tooth

examples.en: The dentist asked when I first noticed the lost filling on the back tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医问我最早是什么时候发现后牙上「补牙材料脱落」的。

examples.en: I described the lost filling to the receptionist while booking my visit that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上预约就诊时，我向前台说明了「补牙材料脱落」的情况。

collocations: a tooth with a lost filling

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a group of products made together

examples.en: The pharmacist asked for the lot number printed on the side of the carton.
examples.zh: 药师让我提供纸盒侧面印着的「生产批号」。

examples.en: I couldn't read the lot number on the tiny label without my reading glasses.
examples.zh: 那张小标签上的「生产批号」，我不戴眼镜就看不清。

words.enDefinition: a fever with a comparatively small rise in temperature

examples.en: I had a low-grade fever yesterday, but my temperature was normal this morning.
examples.zh: 我昨天有「低烧」，不过今天早上体温正常了。

examples.en: The doctor asked when I last recorded a low-grade fever at home.
examples.zh: 医生问我上次在家量到「低烧」是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: a period of feeling sad, down or lacking energy

examples.en: I described my low mood to the campus counselor during our first conversation.
examples.zh: 第一次谈话时，我向校内咨询师描述了自己的「情绪低落」。

examples.en: The student guide mentions low mood as something people sometimes discuss with an adviser.
examples.zh: 学生指南说，「情绪低落」是大家有时会和顾问谈起的情况。

words.enDefinition: a persistently low opinion of one's own value

examples.en: I asked what low self-esteem meant in the student health service's information booklet.
examples.zh: 我问学生健康服务手册里的「低自尊」是什么意思。

examples.en: The counselor asked if low self-esteem affected how I interpreted other people's comments.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，「低自尊」是否会影响我理解别人评论的方式。

words.enDefinition: pain in the belly area below the navel

examples.en: I noticed lower abdominal pain while walking back from my morning class.
examples.zh: 我早上下课往回走时，出现了「下腹部疼痛」。

examples.en: The lower abdominal pain was mild at first but got worse overnight.
examples.zh: 「下腹部疼痛」一开始很轻，但过了一夜变严重了。

words.enDefinition: the movable bone supporting the lower row of teeth

examples.en: The specialist used a drawing of the lower jaw to explain the report.
examples.zh: 专科医生用一张「下颌」的图给我解释报告。

examples.en: I showed the dentist which side of my lower jaw felt different while eating.
examples.zh: 我给牙医指出，吃饭时「下颌」的哪一侧感觉不一样。

collocations: an image of the lower jaw
the front of the lower jaw

words.enDefinition: a small solid preparation designed to dissolve slowly in the mouth

examples.en: The leaflet used the word lozenge rather than tablet on the front page.
examples.zh: 说明书首页用的是「含片」这个词，没有写片剂。

examples.en: I showed the pharmacist the lozenge packaging because the name was hard to read.
examples.zh: 药名太难看清，我就把「含片」的包装拿给药师看。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy that ships medicines to customers by post

examples.en: I checked whether the mail-order pharmacy could deliver to my student residence during term.
examples.zh: 我查了「邮寄药房」能不能在学期内送到我的学生宿舍。

examples.en: My clinic asked whether I used a local pharmacy or a mail-order pharmacy.
examples.zh: 诊所问我用的是本地药房，还是「邮寄药房」。

words.enDefinition: a misalignment of the upper and lower teeth when they meet

examples.en: The report used the word malocclusion, so I asked the dentist what it meant.
examples.zh: 报告用了「咬合不正」这个词，我就问牙医是什么意思。

examples.en: The orthodontist explained the notation for malocclusion on a diagram of my teeth.
examples.zh: 正畸医生在我的牙齿图上解释了「咬合不正」的标注。

words.enDefinition: to help people have a realistic idea of what to expect

examples.en: We discussed how to manage expectations when I could only attend on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了我只能周五参加时，怎样「协调彼此的预期」。

examples.en: My adviser asked what I was doing to manage expectations in the group project.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在小组项目里怎么「协调彼此的预期」。

words.enDefinition: a wheelchair moved by hand rather than by a motor

examples.en: The arena asked whether my manual wheelchair would fit in the reserved space.
examples.zh: 会场问我的「手动轮椅」是否能放进预留的位置。

examples.en: I called the equipment service to check when the manual wheelchair would arrive.
examples.zh: 我给辅助器具服务处打了电话，问「手动轮椅」什么时候送到。

words.enDefinition: a service bringing prepared meals to a person's address

examples.en: The student office sent me information about a meal delivery service near campus.
examples.zh: 学生事务办公室发给我学校附近一家「送餐服务」的信息。

examples.en: I asked whether the meal delivery service could use the residence hall entrance.
examples.zh: 我问「送餐服务」能不能从宿舍楼入口进来。

words.enDefinition: the standard unit used to express a measured quantity

examples.en: I asked what measurement unit the lab used for that particular entry.
examples.zh: 我问检验室那一项用的是什么「计量单位」。

examples.en: The report placed the measurement unit beside the number in a separate column.
examples.zh: 报告把「计量单位」放在数字旁边的单独一栏。

words.enDefinition: the event or force by which an injury occurred

examples.en: The nurse asked about the mechanism of injury, so I described how I had fallen.
examples.zh: 护士问到「受伤方式」，我就描述了自己是怎么摔倒的。

examples.en: The report described the mechanism of injury and noted where it happened on campus.
examples.zh: 报告描述了「受伤方式」，并记录了校园里发生意外的位置。

collocations: ask about the mechanism of injury

words.enDefinition: time away from study or work because of a health issue

examples.en: I reported the medical absence through the university portal before contacting my tutor.
examples.zh: 联系导师之前，我先通过学校平台报备了「因病缺勤」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which dates to include in my medical absence record.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「因病缺勤」记录需要包括哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: a worker supporting a clinic with basic tasks and administration

examples.en: The medical assistant showed me to the room where the doctor would see me.
examples.zh: 「医疗助理」带我去了医生给我看诊的房间。

examples.en: I gave the medical assistant the completed form before returning to the waiting room.
examples.zh: 我把填好的表格交给「医疗助理」，然后回了候诊室。

words.enDefinition: the date by which a healthcare bill should be paid

examples.en: I put the medical bill due date on my calendar before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，我把「医疗账单缴费期限」记进了日历。

examples.en: The office confirmed the medical bill due date had changed after an adjustment.
examples.zh: 办公室确认，账单调整过后，「医疗账单缴费期限」也改了。

collocations: check the medical bill due date
confirm the medical bill due date
extend the medical bill due date

words.enDefinition: an arrangement to pay a medical bill in installments

examples.en: I asked about a medical bill payment plan after opening my statement.
examples.zh: 打开账单后，我问了「医疗账单分期方案」的事。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a written medical bill payment plan with the agreed dates.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份书面的「医疗账单分期方案」，上面列着约定日期。

collocations: request a medical bill payment plan
agree to a medical bill payment plan
set up a medical bill payment plan

words.enDefinition: an impartial observer present during a medical examination

examples.en: The clinician explained the role of a medical chaperone before asking what I would prefer.
examples.zh: 医务人员先解释了「检查在场见证员」的职责，再问我希望怎么安排。

examples.en: I told the receptionist I would like a medical chaperone present during the examination.
examples.zh: 我告诉前台，希望检查时有「检查在场见证员」在场。

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming medical suitability for a specified activity

examples.en: The exchange office asked me to upload a medical clearance letter for the placement.
examples.zh: 交换项目办公室请我为实习上传一份「健康合格证明函」。

examples.en: I asked whether the medical clearance letter needed to name the particular activity.
examples.zh: 我问「健康合格证明函」是否需要写明具体是哪项活动。

words.enDefinition: official records or notes supporting a health-related request

examples.en: I asked the registrar what medical documentation was needed for my request.
examples.zh: 我问教务处，这项申请需要什么「医疗证明材料」。

examples.en: The office told me where to upload the medical documentation securely online.
examples.zh: 办公室告诉我，在网上哪里可以安全地上传「医疗证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: a document used to record findings from a physical examination

examples.en: I took the medical examination form to the clinic on Friday morning before class.
examples.zh: 周五上午上课前，我带着「体检表」去了诊所。

examples.en: The receptionist told me when the completed medical examination form would be ready for collection.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，填好的「体检表」什么时候可以来取。

collocations: a copy of the medical examination form

words.enDefinition: information about a person's past and present health

examples.en: The nurse reviewed my medical history before asking about the dates of my earlier appointments.
examples.zh: 护士先看了我的「病史」，再问我之前几次就诊的日期。

examples.en: I brought a short summary of my medical history from the clinic near my old university.
examples.zh: 我带来了一份原学校附近诊所出具的简短「病史」摘要。

words.enDefinition: an interpreter who helps people communicate during healthcare visits

examples.en: I asked whether a medical interpreter could join my appointment at the local clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「医疗口译员」能不能参加我在当地诊所的就诊。

examples.en: The medical interpreter joined the call after the receptionist confirmed which language I preferred.
examples.zh: 前台确认了我希望使用的语言后，「医疗口译员」加入了通话。

words.enDefinition: a payment document listing healthcare services and their charges

examples.en: I attached the medical invoice to the claim after my appointment at the clinic.
examples.zh: 在诊所看完病后，我把「医疗账单」附到了理赔申请上。

examples.en: The medical invoice lists the clinic's address and the date of my visit.
examples.zh: 「医疗账单」列有诊所地址和我的看诊日期。

words.enDefinition: an approved period away from work or study for health reasons

examples.en: I arranged a meeting with the adviser before submitting my medical leave request.
examples.zh: 提交「病假」申请前，我约了和顾问见面。

examples.en: The university portal showed the expected end date for my medical leave.
examples.zh: 学校平台显示了我的「病假」预计结束日期。

words.enDefinition: whether care is considered clinically appropriate for a condition

examples.en: The insurer sent a form asking the provider to explain the medical necessity of the test.
examples.zh: 保险公司发了一张表，请提供者解释这项检查的「医疗必要性」。

examples.en: I asked what medical necessity meant in the letter about the coverage decision.
examples.zh: 我问了关于保障决定的信里「医疗必要性」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: permission for specified health records to be shared with someone

examples.en: I signed a medical records release so the campus clinic could request my old record.
examples.zh: 我签了「病历共享授权」，让校园诊所可以向原来的诊所要我的病历。

examples.en: The medical records release named the clinic authorized to receive the selected documents.
examples.zh: 「病历共享授权」写明哪家诊所获准接收指定文件。

words.enDefinition: a request to obtain or send copies of healthcare records

examples.en: I filed a medical records request when I transferred from one university to another.
examples.zh: 从一所大学转到另一所时，我提交了「医疗记录申请」。

examples.en: The office emailed to confirm that my medical records request had reached the correct department.
examples.zh: 办公室发邮件确认，我的「医疗记录申请」已转到正确的部门。

words.enDefinition: judged by the care team to no longer need inpatient-level medical care

examples.en: The doctor said I was medically ready for discharge, but my ride was late.
examples.zh: 医生说我已经「达到医学出院条件」，但接我的车还没来。

examples.en: I asked the interpreter what the phrase medically ready for discharge meant.
examples.zh: 我请口译员解释「达到医学出院条件」是什么意思。

collocations: be assessed as medically ready for discharge
record when someone is medically ready for discharge

words.enDefinition: a U.S. patient handout with required information for certain medicines

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me the Medication Guide that came with my prescription in the US.
examples.zh: 我在美国取药时，药师给我看了随处方药附带的「美国处方药患者指南」。

examples.en: I asked whether the printed Medication Guide was available in another language at that branch.
examples.zh: 我问这家分店有没有其他语言的纸质「美国处方药患者指南」。

collocations: a copy of the Medication Guide

words.enDefinition: a record of medicines a person currently takes

examples.en: I printed my medication list so I could hand it to the clinician at reception.
examples.zh: 我打印了「用药清单」，方便在前台交给医务人员。

examples.en: The nurse compared my medication list with the information in the previous clinic's records.
examples.zh: 护士把我的「用药清单」和上一家诊所记录里的信息核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: the amount per unit or concentration of the active ingredient

examples.en: I couldn't tell which number described the medication strength, so I asked the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 我分不清哪个数字表示「药品含量规格」，于是问了药师。

examples.en: The medication strength appeared below the formulation name on the pharmacy's computer screen.
examples.zh: 药房电脑屏幕上的「药品含量规格」显示在剂型名称下方。

words.enDefinition: getting rid of medicines that are unwanted, unused, or expired

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy whether its medicine disposal service was available on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我问药房的「废弃药品处理」服务星期六开不开。

examples.en: The clinic website had a page about medicine disposal that listed local drop-off locations.
examples.zh: 诊所网站有一页介绍「废弃药品处理」，列了本地的回收点。

words.enDefinition: the removal or correction of an affected medicine or batch

examples.en: I called the pharmacy to ask whether the medicine recall affected my earlier order.
examples.zh: 我给药房打电话，问这次「药品召回」是否涉及我之前的订单。

examples.en: The notice about the medicine recall listed several product codes and a contact number.
examples.zh: 「药品召回」公告列了几个产品代码和一个联系电话。

words.enDefinition: to pay enough qualifying costs to reach the plan's deductible

examples.en: The chart shows how much I still need to spend to meet the deductible.
examples.zh: 图表显示，我还需付多少费用才能「达到免赔额」。

examples.en: My adviser explained what happens after I meet the deductible on this particular plan.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了在这份方案中「达到免赔额」之后会怎样计算费用。

words.enDefinition: tiredness that makes thinking or paying attention harder

examples.en: I noticed mental fatigue after spending most of the week reading for my course.
examples.zh: 那周大部分时间都在读课程材料，我感到了「脑力疲劳」。

examples.en: The seminar discussed mental fatigue in students who spend long stretches studying alone.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论了长时间独自学习的学生所感受到的「脑力疲劳」。

words.zhGloss: 心理健康相关学习便利
words.enDefinition: adjustments that help people with mental health needs take part
acceptedZhAnswers: 心理健康相关学习便利

examples.en: I asked which mental health accommodations were available for my laboratory classes this term.
examples.zh: 我问这学期的实验课可以提供哪些「心理健康相关学习便利」。

examples.en: The student office explained who handles requests for mental health accommodations at our university.
examples.zh: 学生办公室说明了本校由谁处理「心理健康相关学习便利」的申请。

words.enDefinition: brief questions or tools used to identify possible mental health concerns

examples.en: The university explained what mental health screening was for before sending out its survey.
examples.zh: 学校发问卷之前，解释了「心理健康筛查」是做什么的。

examples.en: I asked whether the mental health screening was part of the first appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「心理健康筛查」是不是第一次会面的其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: a social worker supporting people with mental health needs

examples.en: The mental health social worker explained how to contact the university's support office.
examples.zh: 「心理健康社工」解释了如何联系学校的支持办公室。

examples.en: I met a mental health social worker when I wanted help arranging services after graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业后想接着安排相关服务，我见了一位「心理健康社工」。

collocations: meet a mental health social worker
contact a mental health social worker
referral to a mental health social worker

words.enDefinition: fixed orthodontic appliances with brackets made of metal

examples.en: The clinic showed me a model with metal braces attached to the front teeth.
examples.zh: 诊所给我看了一个模型，前牙上装着「金属牙套」。

examples.en: I asked where metal braces were listed in the comparison sheet from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问诊所发的对照表把「金属牙套」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a British service that assesses and treats less serious injuries

examples.en: The hospital map showed the minor injuries unit in a separate building behind the main entrance.
examples.zh: 医院地图显示，「轻伤门诊」在主入口后面一栋单独的楼里。

examples.en: The receptionist called the minor injuries unit to check where my friend's notes had been sent.
examples.zh: 前台打电话给「轻伤门诊」，核实我朋友的记录送到了哪里。

words.enDefinition: a counseling appointment the person did not attend

examples.en: I emailed reception about a missed counseling appointment from earlier in the week.
examples.zh: 这周早些时候有次「未到场的咨询预约」，我为此给前台发了邮件。

examples.en: The centre said I could contact the desk about my missed counseling appointment.
examples.zh: 中心说我可以联系前台，了解那次「未到场的咨询预约」怎么处理。

collocations: follow up on a missed counseling appointment
email about a missed counseling appointment

words.enDefinition: a tooth that is absent from its usual position

examples.en: The dentist marked my missing tooth on a diagram before discussing the available options.
examples.zh: 牙医先在图上标出我那颗「缺失的牙齿」，再和我讨论有哪些选择。

examples.en: The photograph clearly showed the space left by the missing tooth on the right.
examples.zh: 照片清楚地显示了右侧那颗「缺失的牙齿」留下的空隙。

collocations: the position of a missing tooth

words.enDefinition: a screening service that travels to different locations

examples.en: The mobile screening clinic was parked near the gym on Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 周三上午，车载「流动筛查点」停在健身馆附近。

examples.en: I checked which days the mobile screening clinic would be available near campus.
examples.zh: 我查了「流动筛查点」哪几天会到学校附近。

words.enDefinition: equipment helping someone move from one place to another

examples.en: The adviser asked if my mobility aid would fit in the shuttle bus.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「移动辅助器具」能不能放进校车。

examples.en: I listed the mobility aid I use on my updated campus access form.
examples.zh: 我在更新后的校园通行表上填了自己使用的「移动辅助器具」。

collocations: a loan of a mobility aid

words.enDefinition: a review of someone's ability to move safely and independently

examples.en: I asked how long the mobility assessment would take before confirming the appointment.
examples.zh: 确认预约前，我问了「移动能力评估」要花多久。

examples.en: The mobility assessment report described which places I was having difficulty reaching.
examples.zh: 「移动能力评估」报告描述了有哪些地方我很难到达。

words.enDefinition: a broad back tooth used to crush and grind food

examples.en: The dentist asked me to point to the molar on the bottom row.
examples.zh: 牙医让我指出下面一排的那颗「后槽牙」。

examples.en: I referred to the molar when asking a question about my old image.
examples.zh: 我拿着之前的片子提问时，说的是那颗「后槽牙」。

words.enDefinition: the distance from the center of one pupil to the nose bridge midline

examples.en: The optician wrote two values for monocular pupillary distance on the fitting sheet.
examples.zh: 配镜师在配镜单上写了两个「单眼瞳距」数值。

examples.en: I asked why my monocular pupillary distance had a separate measurement for each eye.
examples.zh: 我问为什么两只眼睛的「单眼瞳距」要分别测量。

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed for a monthly replacement cycle

examples.en: I asked whether monthly contact lenses were available in the brand on my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问处方上的牌子有没有「月抛隐形眼镜」。

examples.en: The assistant found a quote for monthly contact lenses in the shop's system.
examples.zh: 店员在商店系统里找到了「月抛隐形眼镜」的报价。

collocations: a box of monthly contact lenses

words.enDefinition: differences in how a person feels over time

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the mood changes followed any particular pattern during the week.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，一周里的「情绪变化」有没有什么特别的规律。

examples.en: I wrote down my mood changes so I could describe them clearly at the appointment.
examples.zh: 我记下了自己的「情绪变化」，方便看诊时说清楚。

words.enDefinition: a record of feelings and the situations in which they occur

examples.en: I brought my mood diary to the meeting and talked about a few entries.
examples.zh: 我把「情绪日记」带到会谈里，聊了几条记录。

examples.en: The entries in my mood diary were mostly about coursework and relationships with friends.
examples.zh: 我「情绪日记」里的记录大多关于课程作业和与朋友的关系。

words.enDefinition: contact lenses with different optical powers for different viewing distances

examples.en: The handout listed multifocal contact lenses in a different section from standard lenses.
examples.zh: 资料把「多焦点隐形眼镜」和标准款分在不同部分。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist who I could contact about the quote for multifocal contact lenses.
examples.zh: 我问验光师，「多焦点隐形眼镜」的报价可以向谁咨询。

collocations: a fitting for multifocal contact lenses
a quote for multifocal contact lenses

words.enDefinition: sudden painful tightening of muscles that you cannot control

examples.en: The muscle cramps woke me twice during the night and then stopped.
examples.zh: 我夜里两次被「肌肉抽筋」弄醒，后来就不抽了。

examples.en: I get muscle cramps in my calves after long periods of standing.
examples.zh: 我站久了，小腿「肌肉就会抽筋」。

words.enDefinition: small involuntary movements in a muscle or part of one

examples.en: I noticed muscle twitching in my eyelid while sitting quietly in the library.
examples.zh: 我安静坐在图书馆时，发现眼皮在不自主地「跳动」。

examples.en: The muscle twitching lasts a few seconds and comes back later in the day.
examples.zh: 「肌肉跳动」持续几秒，过一会儿当天还会出现。

words.enDefinition: a focusing condition in which faraway objects often look blurry

examples.en: My report listed myopia in both eyes, with a different measurement for each.
examples.zh: 我的报告写着两只眼睛都有「近视」，但测量结果不一样。

examples.en: The optometrist explained what myopia meant and showed me where it appeared in the notes.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了「近视」的意思，并指出它记录在什么位置。

words.enDefinition: a UK general practitioner assigned to oversee a patient's care

examples.en: I used the patient portal to find out who my named GP was.
examples.zh: 我通过患者门户查到了「指定的全科医生」是谁。

examples.en: The letter showed my named GP along with the number for the practice reception.
examples.zh: 信上列出了我的「指定的全科医生」和诊所前台的电话。

words.enDefinition: a liquid or powder preparation delivered as a spray into the nose

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which number on the nasal spray box was the lot number.
examples.zh: 我问药师，「鼻喷剂」盒子上的哪个号码是生产批号。

examples.en: The nasal spray carton was smaller than the one shown in the pharmacy's photograph.
examples.zh: 「鼻喷剂」的外盒比药房照片上那盒小。

words.enDefinition: how clearly someone sees details at a close distance

examples.en: The examiner noted my near visual acuity after giving me a small reading card.
examples.zh: 检查人员递给我一张小阅读卡，然后记下我的「近视力」。

examples.en: I asked whether near visual acuity was the score printed beside the reading test.
examples.zh: 我问阅读测试旁边印的分数是不是「近视力」。

words.enDefinition: a screening outcome that does not flag the target condition

examples.en: I checked what the program meant by a negative screening result in its leaflet.
examples.zh: 我查看了项目说明单上「筛查阴性结果」的含义。

examples.en: The letter gave the date on which my negative screening result was recorded.
examples.zh: 信里注明了我的「筛查阴性结果」是哪天记入记录的。

collocations: a letter with a negative screening result
ask about a negative screening result

words.enDefinition: critical or discouraging things a person says to themselves

examples.en: I noticed negative self-talk while preparing to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 准备在全班面前发言时，我留意到自己的「消极自我对话」。

examples.en: The workshop discussed negative self-talk that sometimes follows a difficult group project.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了做完较困难的小组项目后有时会出现的「消极自我对话」。

words.enDefinition: whether a provider belongs to a particular insurer's network

examples.en: Please check the clinic's network status under the plan listed on my card.
examples.zh: 请查一下这家诊所在我卡上所列保险方案下的「入网状态」。

examples.en: The plan confirmed the specialist's network status after I gave them the address.
examples.zh: 我报了地址后，保险计划方确认了这位专科医生的「入网状态」。

words.enDefinition: an appointment for someone attending the practice for the first time

examples.en: The receptionist emailed me two forms to complete before my new patient appointment.
examples.zh: 前台发了两份表格，让我在「新患者预约」就诊前填好。

examples.en: I chose a new patient appointment because I had never visited that practice before.
examples.zh: 我之前没去过那家诊所，就选了「新患者预约」。

collocations: prepare for a new patient appointment

words.enDefinition: the earliest open time for someone to be seen

examples.en: I asked for the next available appointment because my timetable was flexible that week.
examples.zh: 那周我的课表比较灵活，就问了「最早可约的时间」。

examples.en: The next available appointment was on Friday, so I wrote it down before ending the call.
examples.zh: 「最早可约的时间」是星期五，我在挂电话前记了下来。

collocations: ask for the next available appointment

words.enDefinition: a dental appliance worn during sleep to protect teeth

examples.en: The dentist asked me to bring my night guard to my next appointment.
examples.zh: 牙医请我下次就诊时带上自己的「夜间护牙套」。

examples.en: I left the night guard in its case before packing my overnight bag.
examples.zh: 收拾过夜包之前，我把「夜间护牙套」放回了盒子。

words.enDefinition: episodes of sweating heavily while asleep

examples.en: I woke up with night sweats and found that my shirt and pillow were damp.
examples.zh: 我半夜因「夜间盗汗」醒来，发现上衣和枕头都潮了。

examples.en: The nurse asked how often the night sweats had woken me this month.
examples.zh: 护士问这个月我有多少次因为「夜间盗汗」醒过来。

words.enDefinition: a statement that no allergies have been identified so far

examples.en: I saw no known allergies in my record and asked the nurse what it meant.
examples.zh: 我在档案里看到「无已知过敏」，就问护士这是什么意思。

examples.en: The form offered “no known allergies” as an option next to the allergy question.
examples.zh: 表格在询问过敏情况的题目旁提供了「无已知过敏」选项。

words.enDefinition: arranged transport for patients who do not need an emergency response

examples.en: I asked the ward desk who to contact about non-emergency patient transport.
examples.zh: 我问病区服务台，要咨询「非紧急医疗接送」该联系谁。

examples.en: The leaflet gave a phone number for questions about non-emergency patient transport.
examples.zh: 宣传单上给了一个电话，可以咨询「非紧急医疗接送」的相关问题。

words.enDefinition: a medical condition not immediately threatening a person's life

examples.en: The team recorded a non-life-threatening condition after completing its assessment and reviewing the earlier notes.
examples.zh: 医疗团队完成评估并核对之前的记录后，记下了「未危及生命的状况」。

examples.en: The report used the phrase non-life-threatening condition and listed where I had been seen.
examples.zh: 报告用了「未危及生命的状况」这个说法，还写了我在哪儿看的诊。

words.enDefinition: a finding classified as expected under the test's criteria

examples.en: I asked what the words normal result meant in the clinic's report.
examples.zh: 我问诊所报告里「正常结果」这个标签是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse pointed out which line was marked as a normal result.
examples.zh: 护士给我指出了哪一行标着「正常结果」。

collocations: a report showing a normal result

words.enDefinition: small supports resting against the sides of the nose

examples.en: The optician showed me how these nose pads differed from the ones on my old glasses.
examples.zh: 配镜师给我看了这款「眼镜鼻托」和旧眼镜上的有何不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the nose pads were included in the price of the frame.
examples.zh: 我问镜框的价格是否包括「眼镜鼻托」。

words.enDefinition: bleeding from inside one or both sides of the nose

examples.en: I had a nosebleed on the bus and missed the start of class.
examples.zh: 我在公交上「鼻出血」，错过了课程的开头。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long the nosebleed lasted and whether it happened before.
examples.zh: 护士问「鼻出血」持续了多久，以前有没有出现过。

words.enDefinition: assistance with recording important points from classes or meetings

examples.en: I contacted the department to ask about note-taking support for my Monday lecture.
examples.zh: 我联系了系里，咨询星期一的课能否提供「课堂笔记支持」。

examples.en: The adviser confirmed which classes would receive note-taking support during my first week.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了我复课第一周，哪些课会提供「课堂笔记支持」。

words.enDefinition: partial or complete loss of normal feeling in an area

examples.en: I noticed numbness in two of my fingers halfway through the lecture.
examples.zh: 课听到一半，我发现两根手指「麻木」了。

examples.en: The clinician asked whether the numbness had spread to my left hand.
examples.zh: 医生问「麻木」有没有蔓延到我的左手。

words.enDefinition: a nurse with advanced training who provides clinical care

examples.en: The receptionist offered me an appointment with a nurse practitioner at the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 前台帮我约了校园诊所的一位「高级执业护士」。

examples.en: I met the nurse practitioner who had reviewed the notes from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 我见到了之前看过我上次就诊记录的那位「高级执业护士」。

words.enDefinition: a hospital bed used while a patient is monitored

examples.en: The nurse was waiting for an observation bed to become available on the next floor.
examples.zh: 护士在等相邻楼层的「留观床位」空出来。

examples.en: The team explained how my friend could find me once I had an observation bed.
examples.zh: 团队解释了我有「留观床位」后，朋友可以怎么找到我。

words.enDefinition: a chart recording changes in a patient's measured condition

examples.en: The nurse updated the observation chart before handing it to the team on the next shift.
examples.zh: 护士更新了「观察记录表」，然后交给下一班的团队。

examples.en: I noticed my arrival time at the top of the observation chart beside the bed.
examples.zh: 我注意到床边的「观察记录表」顶端写着我的到院时间。

words.enDefinition: a hospital unit for patients requiring short-term monitoring

examples.en: The doctor told me I would move to the observation unit once a bed became free.
examples.zh: 医生说，空出床位后我会转到「留观病区」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought my charger after finding the observation unit on the hospital map.
examples.zh: 室友在医院地图上找到「留观病区」后，把我的充电器送了过来。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of how health relates to a person's work

examples.en: I asked which documents to bring to my occupational health assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周参加「职业健康评估」时要带哪些材料。

examples.en: The clinic sent confirmation of my occupational health assessment to the placement coordinator.
examples.zh: 诊所把我的「职业健康评估」确认通知发给了实习协调员。

words.enDefinition: a field concerned with health and safety in the workplace

examples.en: My placement coordinator referred my question to the occupational health team at the hospital.
examples.zh: 我的实习协调员把我的问题转给了医院的「职业健康」团队。

examples.en: The training pack listed an email address for occupational health enquiries from students.
examples.zh: 培训资料列了一个邮箱，供学生咨询「职业健康」相关问题。

words.enDefinition: lenses designed around visual distances needed for particular work tasks

examples.en: The optician asked about my workspace before showing the samples of occupational lenses.
examples.zh: 配镜师先问了我的工作环境，再给我看「职业用镜片」的样品。

examples.en: The price sheet listed occupational lenses separately from standard reading glasses.
examples.zh: 价目表把「职业用镜片」和普通阅读眼镜分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a professional helping people participate in everyday activities

examples.en: The occupational therapist asked me to describe a typical day in my residence hall.
examples.zh: 「作业治疗师」请我描述平常在宿舍的一天怎么过。

examples.en: I brought a photo of my doorway to show the occupational therapist.
examples.zh: 我带了一张门口的照片给「作业治疗师」看。

collocations: a home visit by an occupational therapist

words.enDefinition: care focused on making meaningful everyday activities easier to carry out

examples.en: The occupational therapy leaflet included examples of work, study, and household tasks.
examples.zh: 「作业治疗」的宣传单列举了工作、学习和家务方面的活动。

examples.en: I asked whether occupational therapy would consider the setup of my shared room.
examples.zh: 我问「作业治疗」是否会考虑我的合住寝室怎么布置的。

words.enDefinition: a scan using light to show cross-sections of tissue

examples.en: The technician explained how long the OCT scan of my retina would take.
examples.zh: 技术人员说明了我的视网膜「光学相干断层扫描」需要多长时间。

examples.en: The ophthalmologist compared the OCT scan with one taken at another clinic.
examples.zh: 眼科医生把这次的「光学相干断层扫描」和另一家诊所拍的对照了一下。

collocations: an OCT scan of the retina
the results of an OCT scan

words.enDefinition: a thick semisolid preparation used on the skin or another surface

examples.en: I asked whether the ointment in the photograph was the one listed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问照片里的「软膏」是不是收据上列的那一种。

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out where the carton said ointment in smaller print.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了外盒上用小字印着「软膏」的地方。
