words.enDefinition: a specialist available to respond when needed

examples.en: The emergency physician said an on-call specialist would review the information after the handover.
examples.zh: 急诊医生说，交接之后会有一位「值班专科医生」查看相关资料。

examples.en: I asked whether the on-call specialist had received the notes from my earlier visit.
examples.zh: 我问「值班专科医生」有没有收到我之前那次就诊的记录。

collocations: a review by the on-call specialist

words.enDefinition: affecting only the left side or only the right side

examples.en: The swelling is on one side of my face, mainly below my cheekbone.
examples.zh: 我的脸「只肿了一侧」，主要在颧骨下方。

examples.en: The nurse asked if the soreness was on one side of my back.
examples.zh: 护士问酸痛是不是「只在背部的一侧」。

words.enDefinition: an order intended for one dispensing without authorized refills

examples.en: The receptionist explained that this was a one-time prescription when I asked about refills.
examples.zh: 我问能否续配时，前台解释说这是「单次处方」。

examples.en: My app listed the one-time prescription separately from orders that still had refills available.
examples.zh: 我的应用把「单次处方」和还有续配次数的处方分开显示。

words.enDefinition: a fitted restoration covering at least one tooth cusp

examples.en: The dentist drew an outline to show where the onlay covers the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医画了个轮廓，说明「牙科高嵌体」覆盖牙齿哪里。

examples.en: I asked whether the onlay on my estimate was shown on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我问图上有没有画出估价单上写的「牙科高嵌体」。

words.enDefinition: the process of reserving an appointment through a website

examples.en: The practice offers online booking for a small number of appointments each morning.
examples.zh: 诊所每天上午会放少量号供「网上预约」。

examples.en: I tried online booking first because the phone line was busy during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时电话占线，我就先试了「网上预约」。

words.enDefinition: counseling conducted through an internet platform rather than face to face

examples.en: I arranged online counseling while I was spending the semester at another university.
examples.zh: 在另一所学校交换的那个学期，我约了「网络心理咨询」。

examples.en: The email explained how to join online counseling from a private space on campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说了从校内比较私密的地方怎么加入「网络心理咨询」。

words.enDefinition: a gap where some upper and lower teeth do not meet

examples.en: The dentist demonstrated an open bite using a picture instead of the printed description.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图片展示了「开牙合」，没有照着打印出来的描述讲。

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the space between teeth to illustrate the open bite.
examples.zh: 正畸医生指了指上下牙之间的空隙，说明「开牙合」。

words.enDefinition: a physician who specializes in medical and surgical eye care

examples.en: The ophthalmologist showed me the images that had been taken during my appointment.
examples.zh: 「眼科医生」给我看了这次就诊时拍摄的影像。

examples.en: I asked the ophthalmologist who would send the report to my campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「眼科医生」会由谁把报告发给校医院。

words.enDefinition: the nerve carrying visual signals from the eye to the brain

examples.en: The doctor showed me where the optic nerve appeared in the printed image.
examples.zh: 医生指给我看「视神经」在打印影像上的哪个位置。

examples.en: I asked what the comment about the optic nerve meant in the visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问就诊摘要里关于「视神经」的那条备注是什么意思。

collocations: the appearance of the optic nerve
an image of the optic nerve

words.enDefinition: the point on a spectacle lens with no prismatic deviation

examples.en: The optician marked the optical center on a sketch of the sample lens.
examples.zh: 配镜师在样品镜片的示意图上标出了「光学中心」。

examples.en: I asked what the optical center meant on the fitting form for my new glasses.
examples.zh: 我问新眼镜配镜表上的「光学中心」是什么意思。

collocations: check the optical center of a lens

words.enDefinition: a store selling items such as glasses and contact lenses

examples.en: The optical shop near the bus stop had several frames within my budget.
examples.zh: 公交站附近的「眼镜店」有好几款在我预算内的镜框。

examples.en: I was able to collect my new frames at the optical shop after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我能到「眼镜店」取新镜框。

collocations: order glasses from an optical shop

words.enDefinition: an eye-care professional who examines vision and prescribes corrective lenses

examples.en: The optometrist compared my new results with the prescription I brought from home.
examples.zh: 「验光师」对照了这次检查的结果和我从家里带来的处方。

examples.en: I asked the optometrist for a written copy before leaving the eye clinic.
examples.zh: 离开眼科诊所前，我向「验光师」要了一份书面处方。

collocations: book an appointment with an optometrist

words.enDefinition: an examination that looks for possible signs of oral cancer

examples.en: I asked whether oral cancer screening was covered during the checkup at this clinic.
examples.zh: 我问这家诊所做检查时，是否包括「口腔癌筛查」。

examples.en: The dentist explained how oral cancer screening was recorded on the examination form.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了「口腔癌筛查」在检查表上是怎么记录的。

words.enDefinition: practices and conditions related to keeping the mouth clean

examples.en: The hygienist asked about oral hygiene and noted my answers on the form.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师问了我「口腔卫生」方面的问题，并把回答记在了表上。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic had an oral hygiene leaflet in my first language.
examples.zh: 我问诊所有没有用我母语写的「口腔卫生」说明单。

words.enDefinition: a liquid medicine with its ingredients dissolved for use by mouth

examples.en: The prescription listed an oral solution with a product name I hadn't seen before.
examples.zh: 处方上列了一种「口服溶液」，产品名我以前没见过。

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed to oral solution on the bottle so I could distinguish the packages.
examples.zh: 药师指出瓶上写的「口服溶液」，让我能分辨这几种包装。

words.enDefinition: a specialist who performs surgery involving the mouth and jaws

examples.en: I checked whether the oral surgeon had received the panoramic image from my dentist.
examples.zh: 我确认了「口腔外科医生」有没有收到我的牙医发去的全景片。

examples.en: The clinic gave me the oral surgeon's office number and asked me to bring identification.
examples.zh: 诊所给我「口腔外科医生」的办公室电话，并请我带上证件。

collocations: a referral to an oral surgeon

words.enDefinition: a liquid for oral use with undissolved solid particles dispersed throughout

examples.en: The pharmacist explained the words oral suspension as she pointed at the bottle.
examples.zh: 药师指着瓶子，给我解释了「口服混悬液」这几个字。

examples.en: I asked whether the oral suspension was the item listed on the clinic's note.
examples.zh: 我问这瓶「口服混悬液」是不是诊所便条上列的那种药。

words.enDefinition: a needleless device for measuring or delivering liquid by mouth

examples.en: The leaflet showed a picture of the oral syringe supplied with the bottle.
examples.zh: 说明书上印着随瓶附带的「无针口服给药器」的示意图。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether an oral syringe was meant to come with the package.
examples.zh: 我问药师，包装里是不是应该附一支「无针口服给药器」。

collocations: the markings on an oral syringe

words.enDefinition: a solid compressed medicine formulated for use by mouth

examples.en: I asked whether the prescription specified an oral tablet or a liquid medicine.
examples.zh: 我问这张处方注明的是「口服片剂」还是液体药。

examples.en: The pharmacy's database showed an oral tablet next to the medicine name.
examples.zh: 药房的数据库在药名旁边标注了「口服片剂」。

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which people came to a facility

examples.en: The receptionist said the order of arrival was recorded but did not determine every wait.
examples.zh: 前台说会记录「到院先后顺序」，但等待时长并不完全由它决定。

examples.en: I asked whether the list on the screen followed the order of arrival that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上屏幕上的名单是不是按「到院先后顺序」排的。

collocations: according to the order of arrival

words.enDefinition: a tablet designed to disintegrate quickly in the mouth

examples.en: My pharmacist showed me which wording identified this as an orodispersible tablet.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了包装上哪些字样表明这是「口崩片」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed an orodispersible tablet separately from the standard version of the medicine.
examples.zh: 说明书把「口崩片」和这种药的普通版本分别列出。

words.enDefinition: a planned change to how a corrective dental appliance fits

examples.en: My orthodontic adjustment was scheduled for the week after our final exams.
examples.zh: 我的「正畸调节」约在期末考试结束后一周。

examples.en: I asked how long the orthodontic adjustment appointment would take before changing my schedule.
examples.zh: 调整自己的日程前，我先问了「正畸调节」这次就诊会花多久。

collocations: an appointment for an orthodontic adjustment

words.enDefinition: a small attachment bonded to a tooth to hold a wire

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the orthodontic bracket on the model while describing the device.
examples.zh: 正畸医生介绍这个装置时，指了指模型上的「正畸托槽」。

examples.en: I called the clinic about the orthodontic bracket mentioned in my follow-up report.
examples.zh: 我给诊所打电话，询问随访报告里提到的那个「正畸托槽」。

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits available for certain treatments that align teeth

examples.en: I asked the insurer where the plan explained orthodontic coverage for university students.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司，保险方案里哪里讲了大学生的「正畸保险保障」。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether orthodontic coverage was mentioned on the separate benefits page.
examples.zh: 顾问查了单独的保障页面上有没有提到「正畸保险保障」。

words.enDefinition: small rubber loops used with certain orthodontic appliances

examples.en: The orthodontist explained why orthodontic elastics were mentioned on the written treatment plan.
examples.zh: 正畸医生解释了为什么书面治疗方案上提到了「正畸橡皮圈」。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet identified the orthodontic elastics in the package diagram.
examples.zh: 我问说明书的包装示意图里，哪里标着「正畸橡皮圈」。

words.enDefinition: a specialist in correcting tooth alignment and bite problems

examples.en: The dentist suggested an appointment with an orthodontist to discuss my uneven bite.
examples.zh: 牙医建议我去见「口腔正畸医生」，问问我咬合不齐的情况。

examples.en: I asked the orthodontist to write down the names of the devices we discussed.
examples.zh: 我请「口腔正畸医生」写下我们谈过的那些矫治器的名称。

words.zhGloss: 非通常时段营业的药房
words.enDefinition: a pharmacy open outside the usual business hours
acceptedZhAnswers: 非通常时段营业的药房

examples.en: My flatmate found an out-of-hours pharmacy near the station after the local one closed.
examples.zh: 附近那家关门后，室友在车站边找到一家「非通常时段营业的药房」。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a list of places including an out-of-hours pharmacy across town.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份名单，其中有一家在城另一边「非通常时段营业的药房」。

words.enDefinition: assistance available outside a service's ordinary opening hours

examples.en: The website explains where students can find out-of-hours support during the winter break.
examples.zh: 网站说明了学生寒假期间在哪里能找到「非工作时间支持」。

examples.en: I wrote down the details for out-of-hours support listed in the student handbook.
examples.zh: 我记下了学生手册里列的「非工作时间支持」信息。

words.enDefinition: plan coverage for care received from providers outside its network

examples.en: I checked the out-of-network benefits after learning that the nearby clinic wasn't contracted.
examples.zh: 得知附近诊所没有签约后，我查了「网络外保障」。

examples.en: Our benefit guide explains which out-of-network benefits apply away from campus during breaks.
examples.zh: 保障指南说明了放假离开学校时，可以用哪些「网络外保障」。

words.zhGloss: 保险网络外医疗服务方
words.enDefinition: a healthcare provider without a contract with a particular health plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险网络外医疗服务方

examples.en: The clinic told me it was an out-of-network provider under my current policy.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，按我现在的保单，它属于「保险网络外医疗服务方」。

examples.en: I asked my plan how it handles visits to an out-of-network provider.
examples.zh: 我问保险计划方，如果去「保险网络外医疗服务方」那里就诊，怎么算费用。

words.enDefinition: a cap on what you pay for qualifying care during a plan year

examples.en: The summary lists an out-of-pocket maximum next to the annual deductible for my plan.
examples.zh: 保障摘要把我的「年度自付上限」列在年度免赔额旁边。

examples.en: I asked which charges would count toward the out-of-pocket maximum on my student plan.
examples.zh: 我问了学生保险中有哪些费用会计入「年度自付上限」。

words.enDefinition: the outer cardboard package surrounding the medicine and its leaflet

examples.en: The pharmacy asked me to bring the outer carton with the product code visible.
examples.zh: 药房请我带上「药品外盒」，让他们看得清产品代码。

examples.en: I kept the outer carton because it had information absent from the small bottle label.
examples.zh: 我留着「药品外盒」，因为小瓶的标签上没有印外盒上的一些信息。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled healthcare visit without an overnight admission

examples.en: My outpatient appointment was in a different building from the one shown on the campus map.
examples.zh: 我的「门诊预约」所在的楼和校园地图上标的不一样。

examples.en: I emailed my tutor because the outpatient appointment clashed with a seminar in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「门诊预约」和下午的研讨课冲突了，我就给导师发了邮件。

collocations: the date of an outpatient appointment

words.enDefinition: a healthcare clinic where patients do not stay overnight

examples.en: The signs for the outpatient clinic were beside the main hospital entrance near the lifts.
examples.zh: 「门诊诊所」的指示牌就在医院主入口旁边，靠近电梯。

examples.en: I rang the outpatient clinic to confirm the appointment after receiving the letter yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天收到信后，我给「门诊诊所」打电话确认了预约。

collocations: check in at the outpatient clinic

words.enDefinition: later care provided without staying overnight in hospital

examples.en: My summary said outpatient follow-up would be handled by a clinic closer to campus.
examples.zh: 摘要说「门诊复诊安排」由更靠近校区的一家诊所负责。

examples.en: I asked which phone number to use when checking the date of my outpatient follow-up.
examples.zh: 我要核对「门诊复诊安排」的日期，就问应该打哪个电话号码。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation received at visits without an overnight stay

examples.en: I asked whether outpatient rehabilitation could be arranged around my university timetable.
examples.zh: 我问「门诊康复」可不可以配合我的大学课表来安排。

examples.en: The letter gave the address for outpatient rehabilitation and a number for questions.
examples.zh: 信里写了「门诊康复」的地点和咨询电话。

words.enDefinition: the vertical overlap of the front upper and lower teeth

examples.en: I asked what the measurement beside overbite referred to on the printed chart.
examples.zh: 我问打印的记录图上，「覆牙合」旁边的测量值指什么。

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me how my overbite appeared in the profile photograph.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我看了侧面照片上我的「覆牙合」是什么样子。

words.enDefinition: agreeing to do more than one can reasonably manage

examples.en: My counselor used overcommitment to describe the pattern we noticed in my weekly schedule.
examples.zh: 咨询师用「承担过多任务」来形容我们在我每周安排中发现的情况。

examples.en: The workshop discussed overcommitment during the first semester of studying away from home.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了离家上学第一学期「承担过多任务」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a monitored hospital stay lasting through the night

examples.en: I called my roommate after the doctor said I would stay for overnight observation.
examples.zh: 医生说我要「留院过夜观察」后，我给室友打了电话。

examples.en: The staff member showed me where to leave my belongings before overnight observation began.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，「留院过夜观察」开始前可以把随身物品放在哪里。

collocations: after a period of overnight observation

words.enDefinition: remaining in a hospital until at least the next day

examples.en: I packed a clean shirt after the nurse mentioned an overnight stay at the hospital.
examples.zh: 护士提到可能要在医院「留院过夜」后，我准备了一件干净衬衫。

examples.en: The letter confirmed an overnight stay during the first week of the university term.
examples.zh: 信上确认我在大学开学第一周「留院过夜」了。

words.enDefinition: assistance made available to someone through the night

examples.en: The care coordinator asked who could provide overnight support during the first weekend.
examples.zh: 照护协调员问第一个周末谁可以提供「夜间照护支持」。

examples.en: I checked whether the letter included any details about overnight support at home.
examples.zh: 我查看了信里有没有提到居家「夜间照护支持」的安排。

words.enDefinition: Australian health insurance for international students studying in the country

examples.en: The university sent me information about overseas student health cover before my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 交换学期开始前，学校给我发了「赴澳留学生医疗保险」资料。

examples.en: I checked whether my overseas student health cover was listed in the student portal.
examples.zh: 我查了学生系统里有没有登记我的「赴澳留学生医疗保险」。

words.enDefinition: Australian health insurance designed for people visiting from overseas

examples.en: My parents asked about overseas visitor health cover when planning their graduation trip.
examples.zh: 爸妈规划参加毕业典礼的行程时，问起了「访澳人士医疗保险」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how overseas visitor health cover differed from my university student plan.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「访澳人士医疗保险」与我的大学生保险有何不同。

words.enDefinition: a measurement of the percentage of hemoglobin carrying oxygen

examples.en: The nurse recorded the oxygen saturation reading alongside the other numbers from my assessment.
examples.zh: 护士把「血氧饱和度读数」和我评估时的其他数据一起记录下来。

examples.en: The doctor reviewed my oxygen saturation reading while checking the notes from the emergency department.
examples.zh: 医生核对急诊科记录时，看了我的「血氧饱和度读数」。

words.enDefinition: a sheet of official product information included inside the packaging

examples.en: Could you show me which part of the package insert lists the ingredients?
examples.zh: 能不能指给我看，「药品包装内附页」的哪一部分列了药品成分？

examples.en: The pharmacist compared the package insert with the brief directions on the outside label.
examples.zh: 药师对照了「药品包装内附页」和外标签上的简要说明。

collocations: a copy of the package insert

words.enDefinition: the amount or number of items contained in a pack

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which package size matched the order on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问药师哪种「包装规格」和屏幕上的订单相符。

examples.en: The package size was printed in small lettering near the bottom of the box.
examples.zh: 「包装规格」用小字印在盒子靠下的位置。

collocations: print the package size on the label

words.enDefinition: pain present even when the body part is not moving

examples.en: I noticed pain at rest for the first time while sitting on the bus.
examples.zh: 我第一次「静止时感到疼痛」是在坐公交车的时候。

examples.en: The clinician asked if I had pain at rest or only while walking.
examples.zh: 医生问我是否「静止时也疼」，还是只有走路时疼。

words.enDefinition: pain felt when the teeth press together during a bite

examples.en: I told the dentist about pain on biting and showed her which side hurt.
examples.zh: 我告诉牙医我「咬合时疼痛」，并指出了疼的是哪边。

examples.en: The intake form asked if I had noticed pain on biting during meals.
examples.zh: 初诊登记表问我，吃饭时有没有出现过「咬合时疼痛」。

words.enDefinition: pain that starts or worsens when an area moves

examples.en: I get pain on movement when I try to reach for a top shelf.
examples.zh: 我伸手够最上层的架子时，会「一活动就疼」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether I had pain on movement or only some stiffness.
examples.zh: 护士问我是「活动时疼痛」，还是只是有点僵硬。

collocations: pain on movement of the shoulder

words.enDefinition: a way of rating the intensity of pain

examples.en: The nurse used a pain scale with numbers from zero to ten.
examples.zh: 护士用了一个从零到十的「疼痛评分量表」。

examples.en: I pointed to the pain scale to show how bad it felt.
examples.zh: 我指着「疼痛评分量表」，说明我觉得有多疼。

words.enDefinition: pain felt while swallowing food, drink, or saliva

examples.en: I noticed pain when swallowing even though my voice still sounded normal.
examples.zh: 虽然声音听上去还是正常的，但我发现自己「吞咽时疼痛」。

examples.en: I told the clinician that the pain when swallowing was worse in the morning.
examples.zh: 我告诉医生，早上「吞咽时疼痛」更明显。

words.enDefinition: pain or discomfort that happens while passing urine

examples.en: I told the nurse that the painful urination had started the previous evening.
examples.zh: 我告诉护士，「排尿时疼痛」是前一天晚上开始的。

examples.en: The clinician asked whether the painful urination stopped once I left the bathroom.
examples.zh: 医生问「排尿时的疼痛」是不是在离开厕所后就消失了。

words.enDefinition: a wide dental image showing both jaws and their teeth

examples.en: The specialist asked whether I already had a panoramic X-ray from my regular dentist.
examples.zh: 专科医生问，我常去的牙医那儿有没有现成的「牙科全景片」。

examples.en: I requested a copy of the panoramic X-ray before transferring to the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 转到校园诊所之前，我申请了一份「牙科全景片」副本。

words.enDefinition: a test checking cells from the cervix for abnormal changes

examples.en: I asked how a Pap test would appear in the clinic's appointment system.
examples.zh: 我问「宫颈细胞学检测」在诊所预约系统上会怎么显示。

examples.en: The clinician explained where the result of the Pap test was filed.
examples.zh: 医生告诉我，「宫颈细胞学检测」结果存在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a prescription presented as a printed or handwritten document

examples.en: The doctor handed me a paper prescription to take to the pharmacy across the street.
examples.zh: 医生给了我一张「纸质处方」，让我带到街对面的药房。

examples.en: I folded the paper prescription into my notebook after leaving the campus clinic that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午离开校园诊所时，我把「纸质处方」折好夹进了笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a trained clinician providing emergency care outside a hospital

examples.en: The paramedic introduced herself and asked which hospital my previous records were kept at.
examples.zh: 「院前急救医护人员」做了自我介绍，问我之前的病历存在哪家医院。

examples.en: My friend remembered the paramedic explaining where the ambulance would take us that evening.
examples.zh: 我朋友记得「院前急救医护人员」说明过，那天晚上救护车会送我们去哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a removable appliance replacing some but not all teeth in an arch

examples.en: My aunt asked whether the clinic could adjust her partial denture during the visit.
examples.zh: 我姨妈问这次就诊时，诊所能不能调整她的「局部义齿」。

examples.en: The dentist used a model to describe where the partial denture would sit.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型讲解了「局部义齿」佩戴的位置。

collocations: a partial denture for the lower jaw

words.enDefinition: supplying only part of the quantity authorized on a prescription

examples.en: The receipt showed a partial fill, so I asked the pharmacist about the remaining items.
examples.zh: 收据上写的是「部分配药」，所以我向药师问了剩下的药。

examples.en: The pharmacist called about a partial fill after checking what the shop had available.
examples.zh: 药师确认店里的库存后，打电话和我说了「部分配药」的事。

words.enDefinition: repayment of only part of an expense

examples.en: I received partial reimbursement and asked which items the insurer had excluded.
examples.zh: 我拿到了「部分报销」，就问保险公司哪些项目没有报。

examples.en: The notice shows partial reimbursement for the appointment and no payment for the extra service.
examples.zh: 通知显示这次看诊得到「部分报销」，额外服务没有赔付。

words.enDefinition: care or treatment a person received before the current visit

examples.en: The doctor asked about past treatment and read the information my old practice had sent.
examples.zh: 医生问了「既往治疗」情况，还看了原来诊所发来的资料。

examples.en: I brought a summary of my past treatment because I did not remember every detail.
examples.zh: 有些细节我记不清，就带了一份「既往治疗」的摘要。

words.enDefinition: how serious or urgent a patient's condition is

examples.en: The notice explained that patient acuity can affect the order in which people are seen.
examples.zh: 告示解释说，「患者病情紧急程度」会影响就诊顺序。

examples.en: My instructor explained patient acuity when we discussed the language on a hospital dashboard.
examples.zh: 我们讨论医院信息板上的用词时，老师解释了「患者病情紧急程度」。

words.enDefinition: the amount still owed by a patient on an account

examples.en: I called the clinic after a patient balance appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 系统里出现一笔「患者待付金额」后，我给诊所打了电话。

examples.en: The billing office updated the patient balance after it processed my last payment.
examples.zh: 账单部门处理完我的上一笔付款后，更新了「患者待付金额」。

words.enDefinition: personal items a patient takes to a healthcare service

examples.en: The porter checked the patient belongings before moving the bed to another part of the department.
examples.zh: 运送人员先核对「患者随身物品」，再把床移到科室的另一个区域。

examples.en: The nurse explained where patient belongings could be stored during a transfer to another ward.
examples.zh: 护士介绍了转到另一病区时，「患者随身物品」可以存在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the account where a provider records a patient's charges and payments

examples.en: I created a patient billing account so I could view the clinic statement online.
examples.zh: 我开了「患者账单账户」，这样就能在网上看诊所账单。

examples.en: The receptionist checked which email address was linked to my patient billing account.
examples.zh: 前台核对了我的「患者账单账户」绑定的是哪个邮箱地址。

words.enDefinition: protection of personal information shared during healthcare

examples.en: The clinic explained patient confidentiality before asking me to share my history with the nurse.
examples.zh: 诊所先说明了「患者信息保密」的规定，再请我把病史告诉护士。

examples.en: I asked what patient confidentiality meant for messages sent through the clinic's online portal.
examples.zh: 我问，诊所网上平台发送消息时，「患者信息保密」具体意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: a copy of a document intended for the patient's records

examples.en: I asked whether I could get a patient copy of the completed form.
examples.zh: 我问能不能给我一份填好表格的「患者留存联」。

examples.en: The clerk handed me the patient copy to keep with my other papers.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「患者留存联」交给我，让我和其他材料一起保存。

words.enDefinition: someone assigned to accompany a patient between locations

examples.en: A patient escort met us at the lift and took us to the ward.
examples.zh: 一位「患者陪送人员」在电梯口等我们，带我们去了病房。

examples.en: The nurse said a patient escort would stay until I reached the other department.
examples.zh: 护士说，「患者陪送人员」会陪着我，直到到达另一个科室。

words.enDefinition: the movement of patients through steps in a service

examples.en: The hospital changed the reception layout to improve patient flow during the busiest hours.
examples.zh: 医院调整了接待区布局，改善高峰时段的「患者流转」。

examples.en: My lecturer used patient flow to describe how people move between the assessment areas.
examples.zh: 老师用「患者流转」来描述患者如何在各个评估区之间流动。

words.enDefinition: a number or code identifying a patient's record

examples.en: The receptionist asked for my patient ID after I said I had visited the clinic before.
examples.zh: 我说之前来过诊所，前台就问了我的「患者识别号」。

examples.en: I found the patient ID at the top of the letter from the medical practice.
examples.zh: 我在诊所寄来的信件顶端找到了「患者识别号」。

words.enDefinition: a short handout explaining what patients need to know

examples.en: The clinic gave me a patient information leaflet with a map and the reception number.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份「患者须知折页」，上面有地图和前台电话。

examples.en: I found the answers to several booking questions in the patient information leaflet they sent.
examples.zh: 他们发来的「患者须知折页」里解答了我好几个预约问题。

collocations: a copy of the patient information leaflet

words.enDefinition: the process of gathering information before clinical care

examples.en: The first part of patient intake involved checking my address and completing a short form.
examples.zh: 「接诊信息采集」的第一部分是确认地址，并填一份简短的表。

examples.en: The clinic usually completes patient intake before the clinician calls someone into the exam room.
examples.zh: 诊所通常会在医务人员叫人进诊室前完成「接诊信息采集」。

words.enDefinition: a label displaying information that identifies a specific patient

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient label before attaching it to the outside of my folder.
examples.zh: 护士先核对「患者身份标签」，再贴到我文件夹外面。

examples.en: I noticed that the patient label and wristband had different spellings of my last name.
examples.zh: 我注意到「患者身份标签」和腕带上我的姓拼法不同。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps patients communicate with hospital staff

examples.en: The patient liaison told my roommate where to ask about the updated visiting hours.
examples.zh: 「患者联络员」告诉室友，去哪里打听更新后的探视时间。

examples.en: I spoke with a patient liaison after receiving two different messages about the transfer.
examples.zh: 收到两条说法不一的转运消息后，我找了「患者联络员」沟通。

words.enDefinition: a secure online service for accessing clinic information

examples.en: The patient portal displayed the new address after I submitted the change last week.
examples.zh: 我上周提交地址变更后，「患者服务平台」上显示了新地址。

examples.en: I found the clinic's message about my appointment by signing into the patient portal.
examples.zh: 我登录「患者服务平台」，找到了诊所发来的预约消息。

collocations: upload a document to the patient portal

words.enDefinition: a set of written questions for a patient to answer

examples.en: The patient questionnaire asked which language I preferred to use during an appointment at the clinic.
examples.zh: 「患者问卷」问我在诊所看病时希望用哪种语言。

examples.en: I completed the patient questionnaire on my phone while waiting for the morning bus.
examples.zh: 等早班公交时，我在手机上填了「患者问卷」。

words.enDefinition: the process of recording someone as a practice patient

examples.en: The clinic's patient registration process took less time than I had expected that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，诊所的「患者登记」流程比我预计的快。

examples.en: I checked whether patient registration had gone through before asking about appointment times.
examples.zh: 我先确认「患者登记」有没有办妥，再问可以约什么时间。

words.enDefinition: a band worn on the wrist identifying a patient

examples.en: The receptionist gave me a patient wristband after asking me to spell my surname.
examples.zh: 前台请我拼写姓氏后，给了我一条「患者腕带」。

examples.en: I noticed a misspelling on my patient wristband and asked the nurse to check it.
examples.zh: 我看到「患者腕带」上有拼写错误，就请护士核对。

words.enDefinition: to cover a charge yourself using your own money

examples.en: I wanted to know how much I would pay out of pocket for the visit.
examples.zh: 我想知道那次就诊自己得「掏多少费用」。

examples.en: We asked whether we'd need to pay out of pocket before getting reimbursed.
examples.zh: 我们问，在拿到报销前是否需要「自掏费用」。

collocations: have to pay out of pocket
choose to pay out of pocket

words.enDefinition: pay the clinic before or at the visit without waiting for insurance

examples.en: I had to pay the clinic upfront and keep the itemized receipt afterward.
examples.zh: 我得「先向诊所付款」，然后留好明细收据。

examples.en: We asked if students must pay the clinic upfront for visits during the exchange.
examples.zh: 我们问了交换期间看诊，学生是否必须「先向诊所付款」。

collocations: need to pay the clinic upfront
agree to pay the clinic upfront
ask whether to pay the clinic upfront

words.enDefinition: a dentist trained to provide oral care for children

examples.en: My sister asked whether a pediatric dentist was available at the university clinic.
examples.zh: 我姐姐问大学的诊所有没有「儿童牙科医生」。

examples.en: The pediatric dentist explained the names of the teeth to my niece before the examination.
examples.zh: 检查前，「儿童牙科医生」给我外甥女讲了几种牙齿的名称。

collocations: a visit to a pediatric dentist

words.enDefinition: a group where people with shared experiences support each other

examples.en: My adviser introduced me to a peer support group for first-year international students.
examples.zh: 顾问给我介绍了一个面向大一国际学生的「同伴互助小组」。

examples.en: The peer support group meets in the student centre on alternate Mondays during term.
examples.zh: 学期里，「同伴互助小组」每隔一个周一在学生中心见面。

words.enDefinition: a person who offers support to others with shared experience

examples.en: A peer supporter helped me find the room where the international student group meets.
examples.zh: 一位「同伴支持人员」帮我找到了国际学生小组聚会的房间。

examples.en: I spoke to a peer supporter at the orientation fair about available campus groups.
examples.zh: 在迎新活动上，我向「同伴支持人员」打听校内有哪些小组。

words.enDefinition: a claim that has not yet received a final decision

examples.en: I called to ask what information was missing from my pending claim.
examples.zh: 我打电话问这笔「待处理理赔」还缺什么信息。

examples.en: The pending claim remained in the portal while the clinic checked its records.
examples.zh: 诊所核对记录期间，系统里仍显示这笔「待处理理赔」。

words.enDefinition: a refill request that has not yet been completed

examples.en: I opened the pharmacy app to check on the pending refill before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，我打开药房应用查看那笔「待处理的续配」。

examples.en: The pharmacy couldn't see the pending refill until it refreshed the account page.
examples.zh: 药房刷新账户页面后，才看到那笔「待处理的续配」。

collocations: a pending refill in the app

words.enDefinition: test findings that are not yet available

examples.en: The summary listed pending results and explained where new information would appear online.
examples.zh: 摘要列出了「尚未出具的结果」，并说明新信息会在网上哪里显示。

examples.en: I asked which team I should contact about pending results after changing clinics this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期换了诊所，我问该联系哪个团队查询「尚未出具的结果」。

words.enDefinition: a tendency to expect extremely high standards and avoid mistakes

examples.en: I brought up perfectionism when we talked about how I rewrote my assignments.
examples.zh: 我们谈我怎么反复改作业时，我提到了「完美主义」。

examples.en: Our adviser discussed perfectionism with students who worried about submitting their first draft.
examples.zh: 顾问和担心交初稿的学生们讨论了「完美主义」。

words.enDefinition: fear or worry about being judged during a performance

examples.en: My music tutor asked how performance anxiety affected me during practice and auditions.
examples.zh: 音乐导师问，「表现焦虑」在练习和试演时对我有什么影响。

examples.en: The skills workshop included a discussion of performance anxiety before graded recitals at college.
examples.zh: 技能工作坊讨论了学院评分演奏会之前的「表现焦虑」。

words.enDefinition: a dental image showing a tooth and its root area

examples.en: The dentist compared the new periapical X-ray with one from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 牙医把新的「根尖片」和我上次就诊时拍的那张作了比较。

examples.en: I asked which periapical X-ray belonged to the tooth mentioned in the report.
examples.zh: 我问哪一张「根尖片」对应报告里提到的那颗牙。

words.enDefinition: painful cramps associated with a menstrual period

examples.en: My period cramps were worse than usual during my afternoon class yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天下午上课时，我的「经期腹痛」比平时更厉害。

examples.en: I noted when my period cramps started and when they began to ease.
examples.zh: 我记下了「经期腹痛」何时开始、何时开始缓解。

collocations: get period cramps in the morning

words.enDefinition: a dentist specializing in gums and tissues supporting teeth

examples.en: I asked what records the periodontist needed from my previous dental office.
examples.zh: 我问「牙周专科医生」需要我原来的牙科诊所提供哪些记录。

examples.en: The periodontist explained the numbers written beside each tooth on my chart.
examples.zh: 「牙周专科医生」解释了牙位图上每颗牙旁边写的数字。

words.enDefinition: gum disease that damages the tissues supporting the teeth

examples.en: The specialist explained periodontitis after comparing the measurements recorded during my last two visits.
examples.zh: 专科医生对照我最近两次就诊时测量的数据后，解释了什么是「牙周炎」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the report were relevant to the discussion of periodontitis.
examples.zh: 我问报告中哪些部分和刚才谈的「牙周炎」有关。

words.enDefinition: what someone sees toward the edges of their field of view

examples.en: The clinician asked whether I had noticed any change in my peripheral vision lately.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我最近有没有觉得「周边视野」发生变化。

examples.en: The small light appeared in my peripheral vision while I looked straight ahead.
examples.zh: 我直视前方时，有个小亮点出现在我的「周边视野」里。

words.enDefinition: a tooth belonging to the adult set of teeth

examples.en: The dentist explained why this permanent tooth was marked in a different color.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么这颗「恒牙」用了不同的颜色标记。

examples.en: I asked whether the image showed a permanent tooth below the one on top.
examples.zh: 我问那张片子上，上面那颗牙下方显示的是不是一颗「恒牙」。

words.enDefinition: worry that continues for a long time or often returns

examples.en: I brought up persistent worry during my appointment at the student health centre.
examples.zh: 我在学生健康中心看诊时提到了「持续担忧」。

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the persistent worry began before or after I moved.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，「持续担忧」是在搬家之前还是之后开始的。

words.enDefinition: a therapy centred on the person's own experiences and choices

examples.en: The brochure mentioned person-centered therapy and explained what sessions could look like at the clinic.
examples.zh: 宣传册提到了「以人为中心疗法」，还介绍了在诊所会怎么进行。

examples.en: I asked my counselor what person-centered therapy meant in the description of her work.
examples.zh: 我问咨询师，她介绍的工作中「以人为中心疗法」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the limits someone sets for their relationships and personal space

examples.en: The workshop discussed personal boundaries in shared housing and between classmates working together.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了合租生活及同学合作中的「个人界限」。

examples.en: I explained how my personal boundaries had changed after moving into a shared flat.
examples.zh: 我解释了搬进合租公寓后，「个人界限」怎么变了。

words.enDefinition: a conversation with a pharmacist about a medicine or question

examples.en: I booked a pharmacist consultation because I had several questions about the new leaflet.
examples.zh: 我对新说明书有几个疑问，于是预约了「药师咨询」。

examples.en: The pharmacist consultation took place in a small room away from the main counter.
examples.zh: 「药师咨询」在一间远离主柜台的小房间里进行。

words.enDefinition: a worker who helps with routine tasks in a pharmacy

examples.en: The pharmacy assistant found my order and then called the pharmacist to answer my question.
examples.zh: 「药房助理」找到了我的订单，然后请药师来回答我的问题。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy assistant where I should wait after checking in on the screen.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上登记后，问「药房助理」应该在哪里等。

collocations: a pharmacy assistant at the counter

words.enDefinition: a service that brings pharmacy orders to an address

examples.en: I asked about pharmacy delivery because I would be away from campus that week.
examples.zh: 那周我不在学校，就问了有没有「药房配送」服务。

examples.en: My housemate confirmed the address before we set up pharmacy delivery for Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们约周五下午「药房配送」之前，室友先核对了地址。

words.enDefinition: a nonprescription medicine supplied through a pharmacy under professional supervision

examples.en: A British pharmacist explained why the pharmacy-only medicine wasn't on the normal store shelf.
examples.zh: 一位英国药师解释了这种「药房专售药品」为何不在普通货架上。

examples.en: I asked if the label identified the product as a pharmacy-only medicine in this shop.
examples.zh: 我问，这家店的标签是否把这种产品标为「药房专售药品」。

collocations: a pharmacy-only medicine at the counter

words.enDefinition: the times when a pharmacy is open to customers

examples.en: I checked the pharmacy opening hours before walking over from the university library.
examples.zh: 从学校图书馆走过去之前，我查了「药房营业时间」。

examples.en: The clinic's website lists the pharmacy opening hours for weekends and public holidays separately.
examples.zh: 诊所网站单独列出了周末和公共假期的「药房营业时间」。

words.enDefinition: a trained worker who helps pharmacists prepare and process orders

examples.en: The pharmacy technician checked my name and asked me to wait for the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 「药房技术员」核对了我的姓名，请我等药师过来。

examples.en: I handed the collection slip to the pharmacy technician at the window near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我把取药单交给了入口附近窗口的「药房技术员」。

words.enDefinition: a gradual return to regular study over several planned stages

examples.en: The adviser asked which classes to include first in my phased return to study.
examples.zh: 顾问问我开始「分阶段复学」时，想先上哪些课。

examples.en: I shared the dates for my phased return to study with my placement supervisor.
examples.zh: 我把「分阶段复学」的日期告诉了实习主管。

collocations: arrange a phased return to study
discuss a phased return to study
a plan for a phased return to study

words.enDefinition: a gradual return to usual working hours or duties

examples.en: My manager asked how a phased return to work would fit around my lectures.
examples.zh: 经理问，「分阶段返岗」怎么安排才不会和我的课冲突。

examples.en: I put the dates for my phased return to work in the shared calendar.
examples.zh: 我把「分阶段返岗」的日期记进了共享日历。

collocations: arrange a phased return to work
agree on a phased return to work
a plan for a phased return to work

words.enDefinition: an interpreter who translates spoken communication by telephone

examples.en: The clinic arranged a phone interpreter to help when the doctor asked about my medical history.
examples.zh: 医生要询问病史，诊所安排了「电话口译员」协助沟通。

examples.en: I asked whether a phone interpreter could help me understand the nurse during the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问看诊时能不能请「电话口译员」帮我听懂护士的话。

words.enDefinition: an instrument with selectable test lenses for checking refraction

examples.en: The optometrist changed the lenses in the phoropter while I looked at the chart.
examples.zh: 我看着视力表时，验光师切换了「综合验光仪」里的镜片。

examples.en: I had not seen a phoropter until my appointment at the optical shop.
examples.zh: 在眼镜店做检查之前，我没见过「综合验光仪」。

words.enDefinition: lenses that darken and then lighten in response to changes in light exposure, typically ultraviolet light

examples.en: I asked how photochromic lenses differed from the tinted option on the quote.
examples.zh: 我问「变色镜片」和报价单上的染色镜片有什么不同。

examples.en: The leaflet showed photochromic lenses indoors and outdoors in two separate pictures.
examples.zh: 小册子用两张图分别展示了「变色镜片」在室内和室外的样子。

words.enDefinition: an examination of the body by a healthcare professional

examples.en: The clinician explained what the physical exam would involve before asking for my agreement.
examples.zh: 医务人员先说明「身体检查」会做什么，再征求我的同意。

examples.en: The form said to ask the clinician any questions before the physical exam began.
examples.zh: 表格写明，「身体检查」开始前有问题可以问医务人员。

words.enDefinition: a professional who helps people improve movement and physical function

examples.en: The physical therapist asked what activities were most important to me on campus.
examples.zh: 「物理治疗师」问，在学校的活动中哪些对我最重要。

examples.en: I called the physical therapist to confirm the location in the appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我给「物理治疗师」打了电话，确认预约信上写的地点。

collocations: a referral to a physical therapist

words.enDefinition: care focused on improving movement and physical ability

examples.en: My student clinic gave me the contact number for the physical therapy department.
examples.zh: 校医院给了我「物理治疗」科室的联系电话。

examples.en: I asked whether physical therapy appointments were available after my morning lab.
examples.zh: 我问上午实验课结束后，有没有可以预约的「物理治疗」时段。

words.enDefinition: a trained clinician who provides care within a medical team

examples.en: The physician assistant introduced herself before asking which clinic had sent the referral.
examples.zh: 「医师助理」先做了自我介绍，再问是哪家诊所发来的转诊。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist whether my appointment was with the physician assistant that day.
examples.zh: 我问前台，那天我约的是不是「医师助理」。

collocations: an appointment with a physician assistant

words.enDefinition: collect medicine prepared by a pharmacy for an order

examples.en: I went across campus to pick up a prescription after the pharmacy sent me a text.
examples.zh: 收到药房的短信后，我穿过校园去「领取处方药」。

examples.en: Can I pick up a prescription on Saturday if I can't get there before closing today?
examples.zh: 我今天关门前要是赶不过去，周六能「领取处方药」吗？

collocations: pick up a prescription in person
pick up a prescription after work
arrange to pick up a prescription

words.enDefinition: a divided container for keeping pills organized by time or day

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which pill organizer had larger labels on its compartments.
examples.zh: 我问药师哪款「分格药盒」的格子标签字号大一点。

examples.en: My roommate found a small pill organizer in the pharmacy section beside the counter.
examples.zh: 我室友在柜台旁边的药房货区找到了一个小「分格药盒」。

words.enDefinition: a prickling feeling like many tiny needles against the skin

examples.en: I started getting pins and needles in my foot during the film.
examples.zh: 看电影时，我的脚开始有「针刺样麻感」。

examples.en: The pins and needles faded after a few minutes but returned before lunch.
examples.zh: 「针刺样麻感」几分钟后消失了，但午饭前又出现了。

collocations: pins and needles in my hand

words.enDefinition: instructions written with everyday words instead of technical language

examples.en: I asked whether the pharmacy had plain-language instructions that I could take home.
examples.zh: 我问药房有没有可以带回去看的「通俗版说明」。

examples.en: The pharmacist offered plain-language instructions after I said the leaflet was hard to follow.
examples.zh: 我说说明书看不太懂，药师就提出可以提供「通俗版说明」。

words.enDefinition: the official written terms and information about an insurance plan

examples.en: The adviser sent me the plan documents after I asked about clinic fees.
examples.zh: 我问门诊费用后，顾问把「保险方案正式资料」发给了我。

examples.en: The plan documents show where to find both the benefits summary and the full policy.
examples.zh: 「保险方案正式资料」说明了去哪里找保障摘要和完整保单。

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period used to administer a health plan

examples.en: Our plan year starts before classes and ends during the following summer break.
examples.zh: 我们的「保险计划年度」在开学前开始，到次年暑假结束。

examples.en: I checked the new plan year before booking a follow-up at the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 在校医院预约复诊前，我查了新的「保险计划年度」。

words.enDefinition: an accumulation of a sticky bacterial film on teeth

examples.en: The hygienist showed me where plaque buildup was visible in the photograph.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师在照片上给我指出了能看到「牙菌斑堆积」的位置。

examples.en: The dental chart recorded plaque buildup on the inside surfaces of several teeth.
examples.zh: 牙科检查记录上写明，有几颗牙的内侧出现了「牙菌斑堆积」。

words.enDefinition: testing done near the patient instead of in a distant lab

examples.en: The nurse explained the term point-of-care testing while checking where I would be seen.
examples.zh: 护士核对我会在哪里看诊时，解释了「即时检验」这个词。

examples.en: The leaflet described point-of-care testing and listed several areas where staff might perform it.
examples.zh: 折页介绍了「即时检验」，还列出工作人员可能在哪些地方做这种检查。

words.enDefinition: lenses with a filter that reduces some reflected glare

examples.en: I tried on sunglasses with polarized lenses while looking out the shop window.
examples.zh: 我试戴了配「偏光镜片」的太阳镜，朝商店窗外看了看。

examples.en: The assistant used a display to show how polarized lenses differed from standard tinted ones.
examples.zh: 店员用展示装置演示了「偏光镜片」与普通染色镜片的区别。

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses made of a lightweight impact-resistant plastic

examples.en: The shop showed me where polycarbonate lenses were listed on the price sheet.
examples.zh: 眼镜店给我指出了价目表上「聚碳酸酯镜片」所在的位置。

examples.en: I asked how the price of polycarbonate lenses compared with the standard option.
examples.zh: 我问「聚碳酸酯镜片」的价格和标准选项相比如何。

words.enDefinition: a movable sloping platform for crossing a step or raised edge

examples.en: The hall office confirmed there was a portable ramp for the side entrance.
examples.zh: 宿舍办公室确认侧门有一块「便携坡道」。

examples.en: I asked who was responsible for bringing the portable ramp to the venue.
examples.zh: 我问由谁负责把「便携坡道」带到场地。

words.enDefinition: a screening finding meeting criteria for a possible target issue

examples.en: I asked whether a positive screening result and a diagnosis meant different things in the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告里「筛查阳性结果」和诊断是不是两回事。

examples.en: The clinic listed a contact number next to the positive screening result in my letter.
examples.zh: 诊所在我的信里「筛查阳性结果」旁留了联系电话。

collocations: a letter with a positive screening result
ask about a positive screening result

words.enDefinition: unwanted effects that a medicine may cause in some people

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where possible side effects were listed in the longer leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问药师，较长的那份说明书在哪里列了「可能的副作用」。

examples.en: The app linked to a section about possible side effects on the manufacturer's website.
examples.zh: 应用链接到了生产商网站上关于「可能的副作用」的内容。

collocations: a section on possible side effects

words.enDefinition: care or practical support arranged after a hospital stay

examples.en: Before leaving, I asked who would organize my post-discharge care at home.
examples.zh: 离院前，我问谁会安排我在家的「出院后照护」。

examples.en: The hospital sent details of my post-discharge care to the community team.
examples.zh: 医院把我的「出院后照护」细节发给了社区团队。

words.enDefinition: a later check on someone after they leave hospital

examples.en: The ward sent a message to confirm the date of my post-discharge follow-up.
examples.zh: 病区发来消息，确认我的「出院后随访」日期。

examples.en: I asked if the post-discharge follow-up would be by phone or in person.
examples.zh: 我问「出院后随访」是通过电话还是当面进行。

words.enDefinition: mucus draining from the back of the nose into the throat

examples.en: I described the postnasal drip as a trickling feeling behind my throat.
examples.zh: 我形容「鼻涕倒流」时，觉得有东西沿着喉咙后方往下流。

examples.en: The postnasal drip was more noticeable once I lay down at night.
examples.zh: 晚上躺下以后，「鼻涕倒流」就更明显了。

words.enDefinition: a strong headache that feels like repeated or heavy blows

examples.en: I woke up with a pounding headache and turned off my alarm.
examples.zh: 我醒来后觉得「头一跳一跳地疼得厉害」，就关掉了闹钟。

examples.en: The pounding headache started on the train and lasted until I reached home.
examples.zh: 「剧烈的跳动性头痛」从火车上开始，一直到我回家才结束。

collocations: wake up with a pounding headache

words.enDefinition: a small sealed wrapper filled with a powdered preparation

examples.en: The manufacturer printed the product name on each powder sachet inside the box.
examples.zh: 生产商在盒内每个「粉剂小袋」上都印了产品名。

examples.en: I took a powder sachet to the counter so the pharmacist could identify it.
examples.zh: 我拿了一包「粉剂小袋」到柜台，请药师帮我确认里面是什么。

words.enDefinition: a wheelchair moved by an electric motor

examples.en: The transport office asked for the overall width of my powered wheelchair.
examples.zh: 交通服务办公室要我提供「电动轮椅」的总宽度。

examples.en: I checked whether the venue could accommodate a powered wheelchair in its seating area.
examples.zh: 我确认了场馆座位区是否能容纳「电动轮椅」。

collocations: a space for a powered wheelchair

words.enDefinition: a nurse who works in a general medical practice

examples.en: The practice nurse called my name while I was checking a message from class.
examples.zh: 我正看班上的消息时，「全科诊所护士」叫到了我的名字。

examples.en: The receptionist told me which appointments were available with the practice nurse that week.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，那周「全科诊所护士」有哪些可预约的时间。

collocations: an appointment with the practice nurse

words.enDefinition: a physical examination arranged before someone starts a job

examples.en: The placement office asked if I had a date for the pre-employment physical yet.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问我有没有定下「入职前体检」的日期。

examples.en: I asked which clinic could complete the paperwork for my pre-employment physical.
examples.zh: 我问哪家诊所可以帮我填好「入职前体检」的材料。

words.enDefinition: a health condition already present before a specified point

examples.en: The nurse asked whether a pre-existing condition had been recorded before my first appointment.
examples.zh: 护士问，我首次就诊前有没有登记过某项「既有健康问题」。

examples.en: I asked whether the questionnaire wanted details of any pre-existing condition or only current symptoms.
examples.zh: 我问问卷要填的是所有「既有健康问题」，还是只填目前的症状。

words.enDefinition: a provision excluding some conditions that existed before a policy began

examples.en: I asked the adviser what the pre-existing condition exclusion meant in that policy.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，这份保单中的「既往病症除外条款」是什么意思。

examples.en: The comparison sheet includes a row for the pre-existing condition exclusion on each plan.
examples.zh: 对比表给每份保险都列出了「既往病症除外条款」这一项。

words.enDefinition: a projected price given before healthcare is delivered

examples.en: The clinic sent me a pre-service estimate before my scheduled appointment next month.
examples.zh: 诊所在我下个月预约就诊前，发来了一份「诊疗前费用估算」。

examples.en: I saved the pre-service estimate to compare it with the statement after my visit.
examples.zh: 我保留了「诊疗前费用估算」，方便就诊后跟账单核对。

words.enDefinition: a form with questions to answer before a session

examples.en: I completed the pre-session questionnaire during a quiet moment before the counseling office opened.
examples.zh: 咨询办公室开门前，我趁空填了「咨询前问卷」。

examples.en: The counselor asked if anything had changed since I submitted the pre-session questionnaire.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，我提交「咨询前问卷」后情况有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: the way someone would most like to be contacted

examples.en: I selected text messages as my preferred contact method because I am usually in class.
examples.zh: 我经常在上课，就把短信选为「首选联系方式」。

examples.en: The receptionist confirmed my preferred contact method before sending a message about the appointment.
examples.zh: 前台先确认了我的「首选联系方式」，然后发来了有关预约的消息。

words.enDefinition: a tooth positioned between a canine and the back molars

examples.en: My dentist marked the second premolar on the left side of the chart.
examples.zh: 牙医在图上标出了左侧第二颗「前磨牙」。

examples.en: The premolar was easier to identify once she showed me the diagram.
examples.zh: 她把图给我看之后，那颗「前磨牙」就容易辨认多了。

words.enDefinition: age-related loss of the eye's ability to focus up close

examples.en: I saw the word presbyopia in the booklet we translated for the clinic.
examples.zh: 我在我们给诊所翻译的小册子里看到了「老视」这个词。

examples.en: The optometrist mentioned presbyopia when explaining the figures on my mother's glasses prescription.
examples.zh: 验光师给妈妈解释眼镜处方上的数字时，提到了「老视」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare professional authorized to write medicine orders

examples.en: The pharmacist wanted to speak to the prescriber before preparing my order.
examples.zh: 药师想在配药前先跟「处方开具者」沟通。

examples.en: My prescriber answered a message from the pharmacy while I waited at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我在诊所等的时候，我的「处方开具者」回复了药房的消息。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy bag containing medicines prepared for a patient

examples.en: The prescription bag had a printed label with my name and the collection date.
examples.zh: 「处方药外袋」上贴着印有我姓名和取药日期的标签。

examples.en: I noticed a leaflet inside the prescription bag after I got back to residence.
examples.zh: 回到宿舍后，我发现「处方药外袋」里面有一张说明书。

words.enDefinition: a difference between new and previous optical prescription values

examples.en: I asked the optometrist to point out the prescription change on the form.
examples.zh: 我请验光师指出表格里的「处方度数变化」。

examples.en: The shop noticed a prescription change before preparing the quote for my new lenses.
examples.zh: 眼镜店在给我的新镜片报价前，发现了「处方度数变化」。

words.enDefinition: the amount a patient is charged when collecting prescription medicine

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist in England what the NHS prescription charge on my receipt covered.
examples.zh: 我问英格兰的药师，收据上的「NHS 处方药收费」包含什么。

examples.en: The website showed the prescription charge separately from the cost of home delivery.
examples.zh: 网站把「处方药收费」和送货上门费分开显示。

words.enDefinition: a fixed amount a patient pays for a covered medicine

examples.en: I checked the prescription copay listed in the summary while comparing health plans.
examples.zh: 比较医疗保险时，我查了摘要上列出的「处方药定额自付额」。

examples.en: The pharmacist told me the prescription copay before I paid for the medication.
examples.zh: 我付药费前，药师告诉了我「处方药定额自付额」。

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits that help pay for prescription medications

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to read about prescription coverage in the plan.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了在哪儿看保险方案的「处方药保障」。

examples.en: I compared prescription coverage as well as clinic charges when choosing my student plan.
examples.zh: 我选学生保险时既比较了门诊费用，也比较了「处方药保障」。

words.enDefinition: a place at a pharmacy where patients hand in orders

examples.en: I took my paper order to the prescription drop-off rather than joining the pickup line.
examples.zh: 我把纸质处方拿到「处方提交处」，没有排进取药的队伍。

examples.en: The prescription drop-off was near the entrance with a sign above the counter.
examples.zh: 「处方提交处」在入口附近，柜台上方挂了标牌。

words.enDefinition: incorrect information on an order that needs to be checked

examples.en: The pharmacist spotted a prescription error and contacted the clinic before giving me anything.
examples.zh: 药师发现了「处方错误」，先联系诊所，没有把药交给我。

examples.en: I asked the clinic who could check the possible prescription error shown on screen.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，屏幕上显示的疑似「处方错误」可以由谁核查。

words.enDefinition: a status that removes certain charges for prescription medicines

examples.en: The pharmacy in England asked me to confirm my NHS prescription exemption in the portal.
examples.zh: 英格兰的药房请我在系统里确认自己的「NHS 处方费减免资格」。

examples.en: I asked where to check my prescription exemption because I had recently moved.
examples.zh: 我最近搬了家，所以想问在哪里核查我的「处方费减免资格」。

words.enDefinition: the date after which a prescription is no longer valid

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to point out the prescription expiry date on the paper order.
examples.zh: 我请药师指给我看，纸质处方上的「处方失效日期」在哪里。

examples.en: The prescription expiry date was shown next to the clinic name in the online record.
examples.zh: 网上记录里，「处方失效日期」显示在诊所名称旁边。

collocations: ask about the prescription expiry date

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy label identifying a medicine and providing patient-specific details

examples.en: I checked my name on the prescription label before leaving the pharmacy that evening.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚离开药房前，我核对了「处方药标签」上的姓名。

examples.en: Could you show me which line of the prescription label contains the medicine's name?
examples.zh: 能不能指给我看，「处方药标签」上的哪一行是药名？

collocations: the name on the prescription label

words.enDefinition: a reference code that identifies a specific prescription order

examples.en: The phone recording asked for the prescription number printed near the top of my label.
examples.zh: 电话录音提示我输入标签靠上位置印着的「处方编号」。

examples.en: I used my prescription number to track the order in the pharmacy's app.
examples.zh: 我用「处方编号」在药房的应用里查询订单进度。

words.enDefinition: a prescription already held in the pharmacy's records

examples.en: The pharmacist said I already had a prescription on file at the campus pharmacy.
examples.zh: 药师说，我在校园药房已有一张「已存档的处方」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a prescription on file before contacting my clinic again.
examples.zh: 再次联系诊所前，我先问了有没有一张「已存档的处方」。

collocations: check for a prescription on file

words.enDefinition: a medicine that requires an authorized prescription to obtain

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether the product I had written down was a prescription-only medicine.
examples.zh: 我问药师，我记下名字的这种产品是不是「处方药」。

examples.en: The receipt listed a prescription-only medicine that the clinic had ordered for me.
examples.zh: 收据上列着诊所给我开的「处方药」。

words.enDefinition: a pad of blank forms for writing medicine orders

examples.en: The clinician used a prescription pad while the computer system was temporarily offline.
examples.zh: 电脑系统暂时离线时，医生用了一本「处方笺本」。

examples.en: I recognized the clinic name printed across the top of the prescription pad.
examples.zh: 我认出了「处方笺本」顶部印着的诊所名称。

words.enDefinition: the process of collecting medicine prepared for a patient

examples.en: I chose prescription pickup after class because the pharmacy was on my way home.
examples.zh: 药房就在回家路上，所以我选了下课后「领取处方药」。

examples.en: The app showed that prescription pickup was available from the window beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 应用显示，可以到入口旁边的窗口「领取处方药」。

words.enDefinition: the time needed for a pharmacy to prepare an order

examples.en: I asked about the prescription processing time before deciding when to walk back from campus.
examples.zh: 决定什么时候从学校走回来前，我问了「处方配药处理时长」。

examples.en: The pharmacy's app showed a longer prescription processing time during the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 假期周末，药房应用显示的「处方配药处理时长」更长。

words.enDefinition: a document showing payment or collection for prescription medicine

examples.en: I kept the prescription receipt with the documents for my student insurance claim.
examples.zh: 我把「处方药收据」和学生保险的报销材料放在一起。

examples.en: The name on the prescription receipt was spelled correctly after the clerk updated my profile.
examples.zh: 药房人员更新了我的资料后，「处方药收据」上的姓名拼写就正确了。

words.enDefinition: stored details of a prescription in a pharmacy or clinic system

examples.en: The pharmacist opened my prescription record to look up the order from last month.
examples.zh: 药师打开我的「处方记录」，查询上个月的药品订单。

examples.en: I asked how to request a copy of the prescription record for my own files.
examples.zh: 我问怎样申请一份「处方记录」副本，以便自己留存。

collocations: keep a copy of the prescription record

words.enDefinition: issuing a new prescription when the previous one ends

examples.en: The pharmacist told me to ask the clinic about a prescription renewal before the holiday.
examples.zh: 药师让我放假前向诊所询问能否「续开处方」。

examples.en: I checked the clinic's website for the form used to request a prescription renewal.
examples.zh: 我去诊所网站找了找用来申请「续开处方」的表格。

words.enDefinition: protective glasses that also contain a corrective lens prescription

examples.en: I asked the laboratory office where I could order prescription safety glasses.
examples.zh: 我问实验室办公室，可以在哪里订购「有度数的防护眼镜」。

examples.en: The shop sent me an estimate for prescription safety glasses with the chosen frame.
examples.zh: 商店发来了选定镜框的「有度数的防护眼镜」报价。

collocations: a quote for prescription safety glasses

words.enDefinition: the stage an order has reached in the pharmacy system

examples.en: The prescription status changed after the pharmacy received a reply from my clinic.
examples.zh: 药房收到诊所的回复后，「处方处理状态」变了。

examples.en: I asked where the app displayed the prescription status while waiting near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近等待时，我问应用在哪里显示「处方处理状态」。

words.enDefinition: sunglasses made with lenses that correct the wearer's vision

examples.en: I asked how long it would take to make a pair of prescription sunglasses.
examples.zh: 我问配一副「有度数的太阳镜」要多久。

examples.en: The shop sent two quotes, one for glasses and one for prescription sunglasses.
examples.zh: 店里给了两份报价，一份是眼镜，一份是「有度数的太阳镜」。

words.enDefinition: a code or document allowing a pharmacy to retrieve an electronic prescription

examples.en: My clinic in Australia sent a prescription token by text after the appointment.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亚看诊后，诊所发短信给我一个「电子处方凭证」。

examples.en: The pharmacy asked me to show the prescription token on my phone screen.
examples.zh: 药房请我出示手机屏幕上的「电子处方凭证」。

words.enDefinition: the process of checking the current status of a prescription order

examples.en: The pharmacy added prescription tracking to its app, which I check before visiting.
examples.zh: 药房应用加了「处方配药进度查询」，我到店之前会先看一下。

examples.en: I asked whether prescription tracking worked for orders sent from the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问校园诊所发的订单能不能用「处方配药进度查询」。

words.enDefinition: a small pharmacy container used to supply prescription medicine

examples.en: The clerk checked the label printed on my prescription vial before handing over the bag.
examples.zh: 药房人员核对了「处方药分装瓶」上的标签，才把袋子交给我。

examples.en: My pharmacist showed me where to find the pharmacy phone number on the prescription vial.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了「处方药分装瓶」上药房联系电话的位置。

words.enDefinition: anxiety about presenting information in front of an audience

examples.en: I noticed presentation anxiety when my tutor assigned me the opening slide for our project.
examples.zh: 导师把项目开场那张幻灯片交给我时，我感觉到了「汇报焦虑」。

examples.en: The student workshop mentioned presentation anxiety during its discussion of speaking in class.
examples.zh: 学生工作坊在谈课堂发言时提到了「汇报焦虑」。

words.enDefinition: the main problem that brought someone for medical care

examples.en: The clinician wrote down my presenting complaint before asking for more details about my history.
examples.zh: 医务人员记下我的「主诉」，然后询问更详细的病史。

examples.en: The assessment form has a space for presenting complaint just below the patient's details.
examples.zh: 评估表在患者资料下方留了一栏填「主诉」。

words.enDefinition: pain that feels like pressing or squeezing against an area

examples.en: I described a pressure-like pain behind my eyes that lasted all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我形容说眼睛后面有「压迫样疼痛」，持续了一下午。

examples.en: The clinician asked how long the pressure-like pain near my chest lasted.
examples.zh: 医生问我胸口附近的「压迫样疼痛」持续了多久。

collocations: a pressure-like pain behind the eyes

words.enDefinition: a calculation made before treatment of likely charges and benefits

examples.en: The dental office asked whether I wanted a pretreatment estimate sent to my insurer.
examples.zh: 牙科诊所问我，要不要把「治疗前费用预估」发给保险公司。

examples.en: I kept the pretreatment estimate with the other documents from the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 我把「治疗前费用预估」和牙科诊所给的其他文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: healthcare focused on reducing risks or finding problems early

examples.en: The campus clinic listed preventive care separately from its drop-in services on the website.
examples.zh: 校园诊所网站把「预防性保健」和免预约服务分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked which office could explain preventive care for students living off campus.
examples.zh: 我问哪个部门能介绍住在校外的学生可以获得哪些「预防性保健」。

words.enDefinition: insurance protection for services intended to prevent or detect health problems early

examples.en: I asked how preventive care coverage was described in the summary for international students.
examples.zh: 我问面向国际学生的摘要里怎样介绍「预防性保健保障」。

examples.en: The university adviser showed me the preventive care coverage section in the plan.
examples.zh: 学校顾问给我看了保险方案里「预防性保健保障」那一节。

words.enDefinition: health services intended to prevent or detect health problems

examples.en: The clinic publishes a list of preventive services at the beginning of each term.
examples.zh: 诊所每学期开始时会公布「预防性医疗服务」清单。

examples.en: I asked which preventive services were included in the clinic's printed price list.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印的价目表包含哪些「预防性医疗服务」。

words.enDefinition: a visit focused on preventing problems rather than treating symptoms

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether my booking was for a preventive visit or a specific concern.
examples.zh: 前台问我约的是「预防保健就诊」，还是有具体问题要咨询。

examples.en: The clinic described a preventive visit in the information it sent to new students.
examples.zh: 诊所在发给新生的资料里介绍了「预防保健就诊」。

collocations: discuss options during a preventive visit

words.enDefinition: a clinician who provides general first-contact care

examples.en: The form asked me to name my primary care provider before submitting the referral request.
examples.zh: 表格让我填上自己的「初级保健人员」，再提交转诊申请。

examples.en: I called my primary care provider to find out whether the clinic had received my records.
examples.zh: 我打电话给我的「初级保健人员」，想确认诊所是否收到了我的记录。

words.enDefinition: the insurance plan that considers a claim before another plan

examples.en: The clinic asked me to identify my primary insurance before sending the claim.
examples.zh: 诊所提交理赔前，请我说明哪份是我的「第一顺位保险」。

examples.en: My benefits adviser helped me check which policy counted as my primary insurance.
examples.zh: 福利顾问帮我查清哪份保单算我的「第一顺位保险」。

words.enDefinition: the initial set of vaccine doses intended to build protection

examples.en: The nurse showed me where the primary series was listed on my printout.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，打印单上哪里写着「基础免疫程序」。

examples.en: I asked whether the record from home showed my full primary series.
examples.zh: 我问从家乡带来的记录是否列出了我的完整「基础免疫程序」。

collocations: the dates of a primary series

words.enDefinition: approval a plan requires before certain services or medicines are supplied

examples.en: The billing office was waiting for prior authorization when I called on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一打电话时，账单部门还在等「事前授权」。

examples.en: I asked the insurer whether prior authorization was needed for the proposed visit.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司，安排的那次就诊是否需要「事前授权」。

words.enDefinition: the direction the thicker edge of a corrective prism faces

examples.en: The form listed the prism base in words instead of using a number.
examples.zh: 表格用文字标注了「棱镜基底方向」，没有用数字。

examples.en: I asked which of the arrows indicated the prism base on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我问图上哪个箭头标的是「棱镜基底方向」。

collocations: the direction of the prism base

words.enDefinition: an optical correction that shifts where an image appears

examples.en: I asked which part of the prescription showed the prism correction for my glasses.
examples.zh: 我问处方的哪部分写的是我眼镜的「棱镜矫正」。

examples.en: The optometrist explained why prism correction has an entry separate from lens power.
examples.zh: 验光师解释了为什么「棱镜矫正」和镜片度数分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a curtain that separates patients from view in shared areas

examples.en: The nurse drew the privacy curtain before speaking to me about my visit notes.
examples.zh: 护士先拉上了「遮挡帘」，再和我谈就诊记录。

examples.en: My roommate waited outside the privacy curtain until the staff member called her back.
examples.zh: 工作人员喊室友回来前，她一直在「遮挡帘」外面等。

words.enDefinition: a statement explaining how an organization handles personal information

examples.en: I read the privacy notice before entering my contact details on the clinic's website.
examples.zh: 我在诊所网站填写联系方式之前，先看了「隐私告知书」。

examples.en: The receptionist pointed out where I could find the privacy notice in the registration pack.
examples.zh: 前台指给我看，登记资料中的「隐私告知书」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a standard code identifying a medical procedure or service

examples.en: The claim shows a procedure code beside the name of the lab test.
examples.zh: 理赔记录在化验名称旁列有「医疗操作代码」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic to confirm the procedure code printed on my statement.
examples.zh: 我请诊所确认账单上印的「医疗操作代码」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for the work of a clinician or other professional

examples.en: I received a separate statement for the professional fee after my campus referral.
examples.zh: 学校转诊后，我收到一份单列「医务人员服务费」的账单。

examples.en: The billing clerk told me which part of the total was the professional fee.
examples.zh: 账单员告诉我总费用里的哪一部分是「医务人员服务费」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting or assessment to consider changes since an earlier stage

examples.en: I received the date for my progress review in a letter from the therapist.
examples.zh: 治疗师在信里告诉了我「进展回顾」的日期。

examples.en: During the progress review, I mentioned that my university timetable had changed.
examples.zh: 「进展回顾」时，我提到自己的大学课表变了。

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses whose optical power changes gradually across viewing regions

examples.en: The optician used a diagram to show how progressive lenses changed across the surface.
examples.zh: 配镜师用图说明了「渐进多焦点镜片」的度数如何沿镜片表面变化。

examples.en: I asked whether progressive lenses and varifocals meant the same thing in the catalogue.
examples.zh: 我问目录里的「渐进多焦点镜片」和 varifocals 指的是不是同一种镜片。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a patient attended a healthcare service

examples.en: I asked for proof of attendance because I had missed a compulsory university session.
examples.zh: 我错过了一节必须参加的课，就申请了一份「到院就诊凭证」。

examples.en: The office sent proof of attendance with the time and date of my hospital visit.
examples.zh: 办公室发了「到院就诊凭证」，上面有我到医院看诊的日期和时间。

collocations: a letter as proof of attendance

words.enDefinition: evidence that another policy provides a similar level of protection

examples.en: The waiver form requests proof of comparable coverage from my current insurance company.
examples.zh: 豁免表要求提交现有保险公司出具的「同等保障证明」。

examples.en: She asked which documents counted as proof of comparable coverage at this university.
examples.zh: 她问这所学校认可哪些文件作为「同等保障证明」。

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a person has insurance

examples.en: The exchange office requested proof of coverage before approving my semester abroad.
examples.zh: 交换项目办公室要求先提供「投保证明」，再批准我出国一学期。

examples.en: I downloaded proof of coverage from the insurer's website for my student records.
examples.zh: 我从保险公司网站下载了「投保证明」，放进自己的学生档案。

words.enDefinition: documentation showing that a person has received specified vaccinations

examples.en: The placement office asked for proof of immunization in a separate upload field.
examples.zh: 实习办公室要求在单独的上传栏提交「接种证明材料」。

examples.en: I asked whether my clinic's printout counted as proof of immunization for this program.
examples.zh: 我问这诊所打印的单子能不能算这个项目的「接种证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: a dental specialist who restores teeth or replaces missing teeth

examples.en: The clinic booked me with a prosthodontist to discuss replacing a missing tooth.
examples.zh: 诊所帮我约了一位「口腔修复专科医生」，讨论缺牙修复。

examples.en: I brought my old treatment summary to the appointment with the prosthodontist.
examples.zh: 我去见「口腔修复专科医生」时，带了以前的治疗摘要。

words.enDefinition: a searchable list of providers linked to an insurance plan

examples.en: I used the provider directory to find an office near the campus shuttle stop.
examples.zh: 我用「医疗服务者名录」找到了校园班车站附近的一家诊所。

examples.en: The provider directory showed an old address, so I rang the clinic first.
examples.zh: 「医疗服务者名录」显示的是旧地址，所以我先给诊所打了电话。

words.enDefinition: a group of providers with contracts under a health plan

examples.en: My student plan added a nearby clinic to its provider network last year.
examples.zh: 去年，我的学生医保把附近一家诊所加入了「医疗服务网络」。

examples.en: The campus clinic showed me how to search the provider network by location.
examples.zh: 校医院教我怎么按地点搜索「医疗服务网络」里的机构。

words.enDefinition: an early diagnosis that has not been confirmed

examples.en: The clinician called it a provisional diagnosis and explained that the notes might change.
examples.zh: 医务人员说这是「暂定诊断」，并解释记录之后可能会改。

examples.en: I asked whether the provisional diagnosis was printed in the copy I received.
examples.zh: 我问收到的那份副本里，是不是印了「暂定诊断」。

words.enDefinition: a medical doctor specialising in mental health conditions

examples.en: The student health service sent me contact details for a psychiatrist near campus.
examples.zh: 学生健康服务发给我一位学校附近「精神科医生」的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked whether the psychiatrist would need the notes from my previous appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「精神科医生」需不需要上次看诊的记录。

words.enDefinition: a professional who practises psychological therapy through structured sessions

examples.en: I asked whether the psychotherapist saw students in person during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我问「心理治疗师」在暑假是否还会和学生面谈。

examples.en: The psychotherapist explained how our sessions would be arranged around my class schedule.
examples.zh: 「心理治疗师」解释了会如何参照我的课表安排咨询时间。

words.enDefinition: an official message informing people about a health issue or service

examples.en: The university linked to a public health notice in its weekly newsletter.
examples.zh: 学校在每周简讯里附了「公共卫生公告」的链接。

examples.en: I asked whether the public health notice was also available in another language.
examples.zh: 我问「公共卫生公告」有没有其他语言版本。

words.enDefinition: how a pupil changes in response to light or another stimulus

examples.en: The clinician recorded the pupil response to light during the first part of the exam.
examples.zh: 检查刚开始时，医务人员记录了「瞳孔对光的反应」。

examples.en: I asked what the note about pupil response meant in the test summary.
examples.zh: 我问检查摘要里关于「瞳孔反应」的那条记录是什么意思。

collocations: record the pupil response to light

words.enDefinition: the distance between the centers of the pupils

examples.en: The optician measured my pupillary distance after I chose a pair of frames.
examples.zh: 我选定一副镜框后，配镜师给我量了「瞳距」。

examples.en: I asked whether my pupillary distance was recorded on the receipt or the form.
examples.zh: 我问「瞳距」是记在收据上还是表格上。

words.enDefinition: a walking cane with four short feet for extra support

examples.en: I asked whether the equipment service had a quad cane I could examine.
examples.zh: 我问辅助器具服务处有没有「四脚手杖」可以看一下。

examples.en: The therapist showed me the difference between a quad cane and my old stick.
examples.zh: 治疗师给我看了「四脚手杖」和我的旧手杖有什么区别。

collocations: compare a quad cane with a standard cane
a quad cane with a broad base

words.enDefinition: a place with little noise or activity where someone can spend time

examples.en: The student centre has a quiet space away from the main corridor.
examples.zh: 学生中心有一处远离主走廊的「安静空间」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a quiet space for my online counseling call.
examples.zh: 我问有没有「安静空间」，方便我接线上咨询通话。

words.enDefinition: a sensation that the heart is beating much faster than usual

examples.en: I woke up with a racing heart and felt wide awake immediately.
examples.zh: 我醒来时「心跳很快」，一下子就完全清醒了。

examples.en: I mentioned a racing heart while describing what happened on the bus.
examples.zh: 我描述公交上发生的事时，提到了当时「心跳很快」。

collocations: wake up with a racing heart

words.enDefinition: thoughts that arrive quickly and are difficult to slow down

examples.en: I noticed racing thoughts in the evening even after all my coursework was finished.
examples.zh: 即使作业都做完了，晚上我还是发现自己「思绪飞转」。

examples.en: The counselor asked when the racing thoughts usually started and how long they lasted.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我通常从什么时候开始「思绪飞转」，会持续多久。

words.enDefinition: pain that spreads from one area to another part

examples.en: The doctor asked where the radiating pain started and which way it went.
examples.zh: 医生问「放射痛」从哪里开始、往哪个方向扩散。

examples.en: I mentioned radiating pain from my lower back to the outside of my thigh.
examples.zh: 我提到从腰部到大腿外侧有「放射痛」。

words.enDefinition: an adapted seat that raises the sitting height of a toilet

examples.en: The checklist listed a raised toilet seat under equipment for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 清单把「增高马桶座」列在卫生间设备那一栏。

examples.en: I asked the equipment team whether the raised toilet seat was included in the delivery.
examples.zh: 我问辅助设备团队，这次配送是否包含「增高马桶座」。

words.enDefinition: how far a joint can move in a particular direction

examples.en: The therapist recorded my range of motion in the notes after the assessment.
examples.zh: 评估结束后，治疗师在记录里写下了我的「关节活动范围」。

examples.en: I asked what range of motion meant on the first page of the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告第一页的「关节活动范围」是什么意思。

words.zhGloss: 独立生活能力恢复服务
words.enDefinition: short-term support helping people manage daily activities more independently
acceptedZhAnswers: 独立生活能力恢复服务

examples.en: The social worker explained reablement while we discussed support after I left hospital.
examples.zh: 我们讨论出院后的支持时，社工介绍了「独立生活能力恢复服务」。

examples.en: I asked how reablement would differ from the regular home help already arranged.
examples.zh: 我问「独立生活能力恢复服务」和已经安排好的日常上门帮助有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: to contact someone to ask for help or understanding

examples.en: It took me a while to reach out for support after moving overseas.
examples.zh: 搬到国外一段时间后，我才「主动寻求支持」。

examples.en: We talked about how to reach out for support during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 迎新会上，我们讨论了怎么「主动寻求支持」。

collocations: decide to reach out for support
encourage someone to reach out for support
feel able to reach out for support

words.enDefinition: a tool with a long handle for picking up distant items

examples.en: The equipment catalogue showed a reacher beside the other items for home use.
examples.zh: 辅助器具目录把「长柄取物器」和其他居家用具放在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the reacher on the list was small enough for my bag.
examples.zh: 我问清单上的「长柄取物器」够不够小，能否放进我包里。

collocations: a reacher with a gripping end

words.enDefinition: extra lens power specified for reading or other near work

examples.en: The optometrist showed my mother where the reading addition was printed on her prescription.
examples.zh: 验光师指出了妈妈处方上「近用附加度数」的印刷位置。

examples.en: I asked what the reading addition meant in the form we were translating.
examples.zh: 我问我们正在翻译的表格上，「近用附加度数」是什么意思。

collocations: a reading addition on the prescription

words.enDefinition: glasses intended to make nearby text easier to see

examples.en: My mother left her reading glasses beside the books she had brought.
examples.zh: 妈妈把「阅读眼镜」落在了她带来的几本书旁边。

examples.en: The shop displayed reading glasses next to the cases and cleaning cloths.
examples.zh: 眼镜店把「阅读眼镜」陈列在眼镜盒和擦镜布旁边。

collocations: use reading glasses for close work

words.enDefinition: lens specifications for glasses used to see nearby text

examples.en: The optometrist printed a separate reading prescription and put it in my folder.
examples.zh: 验光师另外打印了一份「阅读眼镜处方」，放进我的文件夹。

examples.en: I asked whether my reading prescription was the one labeled for near work.
examples.zh: 我问标着近距离使用的那份是不是我的「阅读眼镜处方」。

collocations: glasses made to a reading prescription

words.enDefinition: available to be collected at the designated location

examples.en: The pharmacy texted that my order was ready for pickup just after my tutorial.
examples.zh: 辅导课刚结束，药房就发短信说我的订单「可以领取」了。

examples.en: The clerk checked the system to confirm my prescription was ready for pickup.
examples.zh: 药房人员查了系统，确认我的处方药「可以领取」。

collocations: notify someone it's ready for pickup

words.enDefinition: noncustom reading glasses sold in standard lens strengths

examples.en: The pharmacy had a stand of ready-made reading glasses beside the main counter.
examples.zh: 药房主柜台旁摆着一架「成品阅读眼镜」。

examples.en: I asked how the label on ready-made reading glasses differed from my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问「成品阅读眼镜」的标签和我的处方有什么区别。

collocations: a display of ready-made reading glasses

words.enDefinition: the explanation for why someone came for care

examples.en: The clerk asked me to give my reason for attendance in one short sentence.
examples.zh: 接待人员请我用一句简短的话说明「就诊原因」。

examples.en: The report listed my reason for attendance next to the date of the visit.
examples.zh: 报告上把我的「就诊原因」列在就诊日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: a suitable change that removes a barrier for a person with a disability

examples.en: We discussed a reasonable adjustment after the lecture room moved to another building.
examples.zh: 报告厅换到另一栋楼后，我们商量了一项「合理便利安排」。

examples.en: I asked who could approve a reasonable adjustment for the campus placement.
examples.zh: 我问在校内实习期间，谁可以批准「合理便利安排」。

words.enDefinition: another review of a situation after an earlier evaluation

examples.en: The nurse returned for a reassessment and asked what had changed during the wait.
examples.zh: 护士回来做「再次评估」，问我等候期间有什么变化。

examples.en: I checked whether my reassessment would take place in the same room as before.
examples.zh: 我确认「再次评估」是不是在之前那个房间做。

words.enDefinition: gum tissue pulling back and exposing more of a tooth

examples.en: I asked the dentist to show me what receding gums looked like on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我请牙医在图上给我看看「牙龈退缩」是什么样子。

examples.en: The report mentioned receding gums near two of the teeth on my left side.
examples.zh: 报告提到，我左边有两颗牙附近发生了「牙龈退缩」。

words.enDefinition: proof of payment kept to support a request to be paid back

examples.en: I kept the receipts for reimbursement in a folder with my programme documents.
examples.zh: 我把「报销用收据」和项目资料放进了同一个文件夹。
