examples.en: The adviser asked me to send copies of the receipts for reimbursement by email.
examples.zh: 顾问让我把「报销用收据」的副本发到邮箱。

words.enDefinition: the hospital accepting a patient from another facility

examples.en: The nurse at the receiving hospital asked whether the earlier records were already available.
examples.zh: 「接收医院」的护士问，能不能查到之前的病历。

examples.en: I called the receiving hospital after my friend told me which ambulance had taken her.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我是哪辆救护车送的她之后，我打电话给「接收医院」。

words.enDefinition: the staff taking responsibility when a patient is transferred

examples.en: The receiving team checked my name before opening the folder sent with me.
examples.zh: 「接收医疗团队」先核对了我的姓名，再打开随我一同送来的档案。

examples.en: My roommate asked where the receiving team would provide an update after the transfer.
examples.zh: 室友问，转运后「接收医疗团队」会在哪里通报情况。

collocations: hand over to the receiving team

words.enDefinition: a record of changes and personal experiences during recovery

examples.en: I brought my recovery diary so the therapist could see what had changed.
examples.zh: 我带来了「康复日记」，好让治疗师了解有哪些变化。

examples.en: My recovery diary kept track of the first time I managed different tasks again.
examples.zh: 我的「康复日记」记下了我第一次重新做成各项活动的时间。

words.enDefinition: a noticeable step or achievement during someone's recovery

examples.en: Getting back to the library for the first time felt like a recovery milestone.
examples.zh: 能够在康复后第一天回到图书馆，对我来说是一个「康复阶段性成果」。

examples.en: The therapist asked which recovery milestone was most important to me that month.
examples.zh: 治疗师问我，那个月哪个「康复阶段性成果」对我最重要。

words.enDefinition: the time spent regaining health or function after a setback

examples.en: I stayed with my cousin for the first part of my recovery period.
examples.zh: 「恢复期」的前一段，我住在表姐家。

examples.en: My tutor asked what dates I expected to be away during the recovery period.
examples.zh: 导师问，在「恢复期」里，我估计哪几天会缺课。

words.enDefinition: to rest and regain strength after illness or injury

examples.en: I went home to recuperate and asked my tutor to send the seminar notes.
examples.zh: 我回家「休养」，请导师把研讨课的笔记发给我。

examples.en: My roommate stayed with family to recuperate before returning to our shared flat.
examples.zh: 室友先和家人住在一起「休养恢复」，之后才回合租公寓。

words.enDefinition: symptoms that return after being absent for some time

examples.en: The clinician asked whether my recurrent symptoms followed the same pattern over time.
examples.zh: 医生问我这些「反复出现的症状」每次出现时表现是不是一样。

examples.en: I wrote down the recurrent symptoms before my appointment so I wouldn't forget them.
examples.zh: 看诊前我把「反复出现的症状」记了下来，免得忘记。

words.enDefinition: to make the amount of work you are responsible for smaller

examples.en: The workshop leader asked how you could reduce your workload during busy weeks.
examples.zh: 工作坊带领者问，忙碌的几周里你可以怎么「减少任务量」。

examples.en: The workshop discussed how to reduce your workload when too many commitments overlap.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了承诺的事情挤在一起时，怎么「减少任务量」。

collocations: find a way to reduce your workload

words.enDefinition: a comparison interval supplied by the lab for interpreting a measurement

examples.en: I asked why the report printed a reference range alongside each recorded value.
examples.zh: 我问报告为什么在每个记录的数值旁边都印一个「参考区间」。

examples.en: The nurse pointed to the reference range before explaining what the column meant.
examples.zh: 护士先指了指「参考区间」，再解释那一栏的意思。

words.enDefinition: a worker who helps arrange and track referrals

examples.en: The referral coordinator called to check whether I could attend the appointment after my lab.
examples.zh: 「转诊协调员」打电话问我上完实验课后能不能来赴约。

examples.en: I sent the referral coordinator a message when the specialist changed the clinic address.
examples.zh: 专科医生换了诊所地址后，我给「转诊协调员」发了消息。

words.enDefinition: a document giving information needed for a referral

examples.en: I noticed the wrong phone number on the referral form before the clinic sent it.
examples.zh: 诊所发出之前，我发现「转诊表」上的电话号码错了。

examples.en: The hospital asked the practice to attach the earlier notes to the referral form.
examples.zh: 医院请诊所把之前的记录附在「转诊表」后面。

words.enDefinition: the steps and services involved in arranging onward care

examples.en: The adviser explained the referral pathway and showed me who handled each stage.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「转诊流程」，还指明了每一阶段由谁办理。

examples.en: The clinic's website outlined the referral pathway before listing the relevant contact numbers.
examples.zh: 诊所网站先概述了「转诊流程」，再列出相关联系电话。

words.enDefinition: a rule that makes a referral necessary for some visits

examples.en: I asked the plan about its referral requirement before booking the specialist visit.
examples.zh: 约专科前，我先向保险计划方询问了「转诊要求」。

examples.en: The clinic explained which type of referral requirement applied to my particular plan.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了我的这份保险方案适用哪种「转诊要求」。

words.enDefinition: the current stage of a request for onward care

examples.en: I checked the referral status before calling the hospital booking line again this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午我先看了「转诊进度」，才再给医院预约专线打电话。

examples.en: The receptionist explained why my referral status had not changed in the online system.
examples.zh: 前台解释了为什么网上系统里的「转诊进度」一直没变。

words.enDefinition: a recommendation to continue therapy with a service offering longer-term care

examples.en: The counselor offered a referral to long-term therapy as the semester was ending.
examples.zh: 学期快结束时，咨询师建议给我做「长期心理治疗转介」。

examples.en: I asked whether the referral to long-term therapy could be sent to a clinic nearby.
examples.zh: 我问「长期心理治疗转介」能不能发到附近的诊所。

collocations: arrange a referral to long-term therapy
request a referral to long-term therapy
receive a referral to long-term therapy

words.enDefinition: the healthcare professional who sends someone for further care

examples.en: The hospital asked for the name of the referring clinician before looking up my appointment.
examples.zh: 医院先问「转诊医务人员」的姓名，再查我的预约。

examples.en: I let the referring clinician know that the specialist had received my earlier notes.
examples.zh: 我告诉「转诊医务人员」，专科医生已经收到我之前的记录了。

words.enDefinition: a notice prompting a patient to request another supply

examples.en: I received a refill reminder while I was using the library computers.
examples.zh: 我在用图书馆的电脑时，收到了一条「续配提醒」。

examples.en: The pharmacy asked whether I wanted a refill reminder sent by email.
examples.zh: 药房问我想不想通过电子邮件接收「续配提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a request for another supply under an existing prescription

examples.en: My refill request showed up in the app after I confirmed my current pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我确认了现在的药房后，「处方药续配申请」出现在应用里。

examples.en: I called to ask whether the clinic had received my refill request on Monday.
examples.zh: 我打电话问诊所，周一有没有收到我的「处方药续配申请」。

words.enDefinition: the number of further supplies still authorized on a prescription

examples.en: I couldn't find the refills remaining field, so I asked the pharmacy assistant.
examples.zh: 我没找到「剩余续配次数」一栏，就问了药房助理。

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where my refills remaining appeared in the app on screen.
examples.zh: 药师在屏幕上指给我看，应用里哪里显示我的「剩余续配次数」。

words.enDefinition: a test to determine which lens powers help vision focus

examples.en: During the refraction test, I described which set of lenses made the letters clearer.
examples.zh: 「验光检查」时，我比较了两种镜片下哪个看字母更清楚。

examples.en: I asked for the refraction test results so I could compare them with my old prescription.
examples.zh: 我要了「验光检查」的结果，好和原来的处方对照。

collocations: the results of the refraction test

words.enDefinition: a focusing problem that prevents light from forming a clear image

examples.en: The optometrist explained the term refractive error after showing me the printed report.
examples.zh: 验光师给我看了打印出的报告，然后解释了「屈光不正」这个词。

examples.en: I asked where the refractive error was recorded for each of my eyes.
examples.zh: 我问每只眼睛的「屈光不正」记录在报告的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: a label identifying something that needs refrigerated storage

examples.en: The pharmacy bag had a refrigeration label, so I asked what it referred to.
examples.zh: 药袋上有「冷藏标识」，我就问它指的是哪样东西。

examples.en: I showed the pharmacist the refrigeration label because I could not read its small print.
examples.zh: 「冷藏标识」字太小，我看不清，就拿给药师看。

words.enDefinition: money returned after a person has paid too much

examples.en: The clinic offered a refund of overpayment after checking both of my receipts.
examples.zh: 核对我的两张收据后，诊所提出办理「多付款退款」。

examples.en: I asked how the refund of overpayment would appear on my card statement.
examples.zh: 我问「多付款退款」会怎样显示在银行卡账单上。

words.enDefinition: become able to manage everyday life without the same help

examples.en: The team asked what would help me regain independence in my shared flat.
examples.zh: 团队问，在我合租的公寓里，什么能帮助我「恢复独立生活的能力」。

examples.en: I wanted to regain independence before I moved back into my student accommodation.
examples.zh: 我想先「恢复独立生活的能力」，再搬回学生公寓。

words.enDefinition: become able to move around again after losing some ability

examples.en: The therapist asked what I wanted to do first as I began to regain mobility.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，开始「恢复活动能力」后，我最想先做什么。

examples.en: I wrote down what would make it easier to regain mobility around campus.
examples.zh: 我记下了什么能让我更容易「恢复在学校里活动的能力」。

words.zhGloss: 登记成为全科医生的患者
words.enDefinition: to join a general practitioner's practice as a patient
acceptedZhAnswers: 登记成为全科医生的患者

examples.en: I wanted to register with a GP close to the flat I had just rented.
examples.zh: 我刚租了公寓，想在附近「登记成为一位全科医生的患者」。

examples.en: The university adviser showed me where to register with a GP after I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到了以后，学校顾问给我指了可以「登记成为全科医生的患者」的地方。

collocations: help someone register with a GP

words.enDefinition: the counter where clinic visitors register or report arrival

examples.en: The sign at the hospital entrance showed which floor had the outpatient registration desk.
examples.zh: 医院入口的指示牌标出了门诊「挂号窗口」在几楼。

examples.en: I showed the appointment message at the registration desk and waited for further instructions.
examples.zh: 我在「挂号窗口」出示预约消息，然后等工作人员下一步指示。

words.enDefinition: organized support for restoring or adapting abilities after illness or injury

examples.en: The ward team explained which local services offered rehabilitation after a hospital stay.
examples.zh: 病区团队说明了哪些本地机构提供出院后的「康复服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether rehabilitation would take place at the same hospital or elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我问「康复服务」是在同一家医院进行，还是在别的地方进行。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of abilities and support needs for rehabilitation

examples.en: The therapist asked about my weekday routine during the rehabilitation assessment on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五做「康复评估」时，治疗师问了我平时工作日的作息。

examples.en: I asked which building would be used for the rehabilitation assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周的「康复评估」要在哪栋楼做。

collocations: a report from a rehabilitation assessment

words.enDefinition: a worker supporting a rehabilitation team and the people it serves

examples.en: The rehabilitation assistant showed me which room the appointment would be in.
examples.zh: 「康复助理」告诉我预约在哪个房间。

examples.en: I asked the rehabilitation assistant who to contact about updating my address.
examples.zh: 我问「康复助理」，要更新地址应该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: a place providing organized care to help people regain function

examples.en: The social worker showed me where the rehabilitation facility was on the map.
examples.zh: 社工在地图上给我指出了「康复机构」的位置。

examples.en: I asked the rehabilitation facility which entrance our visitors should use on weekends.
examples.zh: 我问「康复机构」，周末探访的人应该走哪个入口。

words.enDefinition: specific outcomes someone wants to work toward during rehabilitation

examples.en: I talked about getting back to my lab classes when setting rehabilitation goals.
examples.zh: 制定「康复目标」时，我提到了希望能回去上实验课。

examples.en: The therapist asked which rehabilitation goals mattered most for my everyday routine.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，哪些「康复目标」对我的日常生活最重要。

words.enDefinition: a coordinated set of services and goals to support recovery

examples.en: The clinician sent me a written explanation of the rehabilitation program before I enrolled.
examples.zh: 我接受服务前，医务人员给我发了一份「康复方案」说明。

examples.en: I checked whether the rehabilitation program included any appointments near my student housing.
examples.zh: 我问了「康复方案」里会不会安排离学生公寓近的就诊。

words.enDefinition: changes in ability or participation as someone goes through rehabilitation

examples.en: The therapist used my own notes when reviewing rehabilitation progress with me.
examples.zh: 治疗师和我一起回顾「康复进展」时，参考了我自己记的笔记。

examples.en: I asked who would be able to read the report on my rehabilitation progress.
examples.zh: 我问哪些人能看我的「康复进展」报告。

words.enDefinition: a group of professionals working together to support someone's recovery

examples.en: The rehabilitation team introduced its members before asking about my plans for the term.
examples.zh: 「康复团队」的成员先作了自我介绍，然后问了我这学期的计划。

examples.en: I copied the rehabilitation team into the email about my change of address.
examples.zh: 我发邮件告知地址变更时，抄送了「康复团队」。

collocations: a member of the rehabilitation team

words.enDefinition: a request to be paid back for an expense already paid

examples.en: I sent a reimbursement claim after paying for the visit during my exchange.
examples.zh: 交换期间看诊付完费后，我提交了「报销申请」。

examples.en: The reimbursement claim asked how much I had paid at the clinic that day.
examples.zh: 「报销申请」问我那天在诊所付了多少费用。

words.enDefinition: the share of a qualifying expense paid back by a plan

examples.en: The reimbursement rate differed between the two plans in the comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 对比表里的两个保险方案，「报销比例」不同。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to find the reimbursement rate for that type of visit.
examples.zh: 我问顾问去哪里查那类就诊的「报销比例」。

words.enDefinition: the authorized sharing of protected information with another party

examples.en: The form explained what the release of information would allow the new clinic to receive.
examples.zh: 表格说明了「授权提供医疗资料」后，新诊所可以收到哪些信息。

examples.en: The practice asked for permission before the release of information to my university adviser.
examples.zh: 诊所在「向学校顾问提供医疗资料」之前，先征求了我的授权。

collocations: consent to the release of information

words.enDefinition: taking part in an activity without being physically present

examples.en: The department arranged remote participation for the seminar I could not attend in person.
examples.zh: 系里安排我「远程参与」无法到场的那次研讨课。

examples.en: I asked whether remote participation would also be possible during the group presentation.
examples.zh: 我问小组汇报时能不能也「远程参与」。

words.enDefinition: a tooth-positioning appliance that the person can take out

examples.en: I asked what kind of case came with the removable retainer in the estimate.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上的「可摘式保持器」配的是什么样的盒子。

examples.en: The orthodontist took a picture of my removable retainer for the follow-up notes.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我的「可摘式保持器」拍了张照，放进随访记录。

collocations: a case for a removable retainer

words.enDefinition: dispensing planned supplies in stages under one repeat authorization

examples.en: The pharmacist explained repeat dispensing after the GP mentioned it during my review.
examples.zh: 全科医生在复查时提起过「按同一授权分次配药」，药师后来解释了这个词。

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether it had set up repeat dispensing for my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，我这份处方有没有安排「按同一授权分次配药」。

words.enDefinition: a further set of measurements to track someone's condition

examples.en: The nurse returned to record repeat observations before my friend came back from the café.
examples.zh: 朋友从咖啡馆回来前，护士回来记录了「复测的生命体征」。

examples.en: The clinician compared the repeat observations with the measurements taken immediately after my arrival.
examples.zh: 医务人员把「复测的生命体征」和我刚到时的测量结果做了比较。

collocations: compare repeat observations with earlier measurements

words.enDefinition: a UK prescription arrangement for requesting ongoing medicine again

examples.en: The GP explained where to request a repeat prescription through the NHS app.
examples.zh: 全科医生给我指了在 NHS 应用里到哪里申请「长期用药重复处方」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic to send the repeat prescription to the pharmacy near my hall.
examples.zh: 我请诊所把「长期用药重复处方」发到宿舍附近的药房。

words.enDefinition: another instance of a test that has already been performed

examples.en: The clinic told me where the repeat test would be shown in my records.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，「重复检测」会在我的记录里什么位置显示。

examples.en: I asked why the appointment was described as a repeat test on the portal.
examples.zh: 我问为什么平台上把这次预约写成「重复检测」。

collocations: a request for a repeat test

words.enDefinition: new lenses fitted to take the place of old ones

examples.en: I asked for a quote for replacement lenses without buying a new frame.
examples.zh: 我问能不能不买新镜框，只给「替换镜片」报个价。

examples.en: The shop sent me a message when the replacement lenses were ready.
examples.zh: 「替换镜片」备好后，店里给我发了消息。

words.enDefinition: the planned frequency for replacing an item such as contact lenses

examples.en: I asked the optometrist where the replacement schedule was written on the information sheet.
examples.zh: 我问验光师，资料单上的「更换周期」写在哪儿。

examples.en: The brochure lists the replacement schedule separately from the price of each box.
examples.zh: 小册子把「更换周期」和每盒的价格分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to ask someone to phone you at a later time

examples.en: I used the form to request a callback after my tutorial finished on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一辅导课结束后，我用表单「请求回电」。

examples.en: The receptionist said I could request a callback if I could not stay on hold.
examples.zh: 前台说如果我不能一直在线等待，可以「请求回电」。

collocations: use the portal to request a callback
request a callback from the clinic

words.enDefinition: to ask for more time with a healthcare professional

examples.en: I called the clinic to request a longer appointment because I wanted time to ask questions.
examples.zh: 我想留出时间提问，就打电话给诊所「申请延长就诊时间」。

examples.en: The booking page explains how to request a longer appointment if you need an interpreter.
examples.zh: 预约页面说明，如果需要口译员，如何「申请延长就诊时间」。

collocations: call to request a longer appointment
email to request a longer appointment
request a longer appointment when booking

words.enDefinition: to arrange a new time for an existing counseling appointment

examples.en: I had to reschedule a counseling session because the department moved my lab.
examples.zh: 院里调整了我的实验课时间，我只好「改约心理咨询」。

examples.en: The website says to call reception if you want to reschedule a counseling session.
examples.zh: 网站写着，想「改约心理咨询」的话可以打给前台。

collocations: call to reschedule a counseling session
ask to reschedule a counseling session
need to reschedule a counseling session

words.enDefinition: a doctor receiving supervised training in a medical specialty

examples.en: The resident physician asked when I had arrived and made a note of my answer.
examples.zh: 「住院医师」问我什么时候到的，并把我的回答记了下来。

examples.en: I spoke to a resident physician while the nurse verified the name on my chart.
examples.zh: 护士核对病历上的姓名时，我和一位「住院医师」谈了谈。

words.enDefinition: a group session about adapting to challenges and recovering after setbacks

examples.en: The resilience workshop included a discussion about adjusting after our first term abroad.
examples.zh: 「心理韧性工作坊」讨论了出国第一学期后的适应问题。

examples.en: I asked when the resilience workshop would run again because the first session was full.
examples.zh: 第一次已经报满了，我问「心理韧性工作坊」什么时候还会开。

words.enDefinition: the number of breaths taken in a specified time

examples.en: The nurse recorded my respiratory rate along with my temperature shortly after I arrived.
examples.zh: 我刚到不久，护士把我的「呼吸频率」和体温一起记录了下来。

examples.en: I saw respiratory rate listed in the observation chart next to several other measurements.
examples.zh: 我看到「呼吸频率」和其他几项测量数据一起列在观察记录表上。

collocations: note a change in respiratory rate

words.enDefinition: temporary care provided so a regular caregiver can take a break

examples.en: The adviser explained how respite care could cover the weekend my aunt was away.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了，姨妈周末不在时「替代照护」可以怎么安排。

examples.en: We asked which local service offered respite care for a few hours.
examples.zh: 我们问本地哪家机构可以提供几小时的「替代照护」。

collocations: a short period of respite care

words.enDefinition: short periods of rest during a longer activity

examples.en: The invigilator explained how rest breaks would be logged during the exam.
examples.zh: 监考老师解释了考试期间怎么记录「中途休息」。

examples.en: I asked whether the revised lab schedule already included time for rest breaks.
examples.zh: 我问调整后的实验课安排里，是不是已经留了「中途休息」时间。

words.enDefinition: the number of heartbeats per minute when a person is resting

examples.en: The nurse showed me where resting heart rate appeared on the checkup summary.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我体检摘要上哪里写着「静息心率」。

examples.en: I asked which number on the form referred to my resting heart rate.
examples.zh: 我问表上的哪个数字指的是我的「静息心率」。

collocations: a field for resting heart rate

words.enDefinition: to send an insurance claim again after fixing or adding information

examples.en: I needed to resubmit a claim with the itemized receipt attached this time.
examples.zh: 我需要「重新提交理赔」，这次要附上明细收据。

examples.en: The office said it could resubmit a claim after correcting the service code.
examples.zh: 办公室说改正服务代码后，可以「重新提交理赔」。

collocations: ask the clinic to resubmit a claim

words.enDefinition: a message that lets someone know a result is available

examples.en: I got the result notification on my phone during the bus ride home.
examples.zh: 我坐公交回家的时候，手机上收到了「结果发布通知」。

examples.en: The result notification linked to the portal without including my health details.
examples.zh: 「结果发布通知」有平台链接，里面没有我个人的健康详情。

words.enDefinition: the date a test result is made available to its recipients

examples.en: I asked where the result release date would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问「结果发布日期」会出现在我账户里的哪个位置。

examples.en: The clinic wrote the result release date next to the report number.
examples.zh: 诊所把「结果发布日期」写在报告编号旁边。

words.enDefinition: a consultation arranged to discuss the outcome of tests

examples.en: The clinic texted me about a results appointment when my test results came back.
examples.zh: 检查结果出来后，诊所发短信通知我「检查结果解读预约」的安排。

examples.en: I asked whether the results appointment would take place by phone or in the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「检查结果解读预约」是电话沟通，还是到诊所现场。

words.enDefinition: an equipped emergency care area for critically ill patients

examples.en: The map showed the resuscitation bay near the ambulance entrance rather than beside the main doors.
examples.zh: 地图上「复苏抢救区」靠近救护车入口，不在大门旁边。

examples.en: The nurse told us where to wait while the team worked in the resuscitation bay.
examples.zh: 医疗团队在「复苏抢救区」工作时，护士告诉我们该在哪里等候。

collocations: move a patient to the resuscitation bay

words.enDefinition: an appliance that holds teeth in their corrected positions

examples.en: I showed the receptionist the retainer named in my appointment reminder.
examples.zh: 我给前台看了预约提醒里提到的那个「正畸保持器」。

examples.en: The orthodontist asked me to bring my retainer and its case next time.
examples.zh: 正畸医生请我下次把「正畸保持器」和盒子一起带来。

words.enDefinition: the light-sensitive tissue lining the back of the eye

examples.en: The doctor pointed to the retina on the diagram beside the exam chair.
examples.zh: 医生指着检查椅旁边示意图上的「视网膜」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the retina were shown in the image on screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的影像显示了「视网膜」的哪些部位。

words.enDefinition: making images of the light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye

examples.en: The clinic explained how long the retinal imaging appointment would take that afternoon.
examples.zh: 诊所说明了当天下午的「视网膜成像」预约需要多长时间。

examples.en: I asked the specialist where the retinal imaging results would appear in my record.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，「视网膜成像」的结果会显示在我的记录哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: a picture showing the retina at the back of an eye

examples.en: The doctor put my retinal photograph on the screen next to an older image.
examples.zh: 医生把我的「视网膜照片」和一张较早的影像并排放在屏幕上。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the retinal photograph to take to my next appointment.
examples.zh: 我要了一份「视网膜照片」的副本，打算下次就诊时带去。

words.enDefinition: instructions describing when a patient should seek reassessment

examples.en: The clinician asked whether I had any questions about the return precautions on the printed sheet.
examples.zh: 医务人员问我，对打印单上的「返院就医提示」有没有疑问。

examples.en: I asked whether the return precautions would also appear in the online visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问「返院就医提示」会不会也出现在网上的就诊摘要里。

words.enDefinition: an agreed plan for returning to classes after a break

examples.en: My adviser and I discussed a return-to-study plan before the new term started.
examples.zh: 新学期开始前，我和顾问讨论了「复学计划」。

examples.en: The return-to-study plan included a meeting with the department during my first week back.
examples.zh: 「复学计划」里安排我在回校第一周和院里见面。

words.enDefinition: to check the health information you have supplied

examples.en: The doctor said, “I will review your medical history before we discuss the referral.”
examples.zh: 医生说：“讨论转诊前，我会先「查看你的病史」。”

examples.en: The appointment page says the clinician will review your medical history at the first visit.
examples.zh: 预约页面写着，医务人员在你第一次看诊时会「查看你的病史」。

collocations: review your medical history before the visit
ask a clinician to review your medical history

words.enDefinition: to look through and discuss the findings with you

examples.en: The doctor said, “I’ll review your results with you before we finish the appointment.”
examples.zh: 医生说：“就诊结束前，我会和你一起「查看你的检查结果」。”

examples.en: The reminder says the clinician can review your results during the visit next week.
examples.zh: 提醒消息说，医务人员可以在下周就诊时「查看你的检查结果」。

collocations: review your results at the clinic
wait for a clinician to review your results

words.enDefinition: firm contact lenses made of material that allows oxygen through

examples.en: The leaflet explained how rigid gas-permeable lenses differ from the soft kind.
examples.zh: 小册子介绍了「硬性透气隐形眼镜」和软性隐形眼镜的区别。

examples.en: I asked why rigid gas-permeable lenses were listed separately on the clinic website.
examples.zh: 我问诊所网站为什么把「硬性透气隐形眼镜」单独列出来。

collocations: a fitting for rigid gas-permeable lenses
a leaflet on rigid gas-permeable lenses

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with no rims around the lenses

examples.en: The rimless frames felt lighter than the pair I had tried earlier.
examples.zh: 这副「无框眼镜架」感觉比我之前试的那副轻。

examples.en: I asked to see rimless frames with a bridge similar to my old pair.
examples.zh: 我想看看鼻梁处和旧眼镜类似的「无框眼镜架」。

words.enDefinition: a walking frame with wheels and often hand brakes

examples.en: I asked where I could leave my rollator during the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我问下午上课时可以把「带轮助行车」放在哪里。

examples.en: The leaflet showed a rollator with a small seat and a storage bag.
examples.zh: 宣传单上有一款带座位和收纳袋的「带轮助行车」。

words.enDefinition: a procedure treating the inside of a tooth and its canals

examples.en: The dentist explained why root canal treatment was mentioned in the notes sent to the specialist.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么发给专科医生的记录里提到了「根管治疗」。

examples.en: I asked for an estimate for root canal treatment before checking my insurance benefits.
examples.zh: 查看保险保障前，我先索要了一份「根管治疗」的估价单。

collocations: book a root canal treatment appointment
a referral for root canal treatment

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning and smoothing of tooth root surfaces

examples.en: I asked the specialist to explain root planing when it appeared on my plan.
examples.zh: 「根面平整」出现在我治疗方案上时，我请专科医生解释了一下。

examples.en: The receptionist showed me where root planing was listed on the appointment summary.
examples.zh: 前台给我指了就诊摘要上列出「根面平整」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a standard consultation for something that can wait

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I wanted a routine appointment with my regular doctor next week.
examples.zh: 前台问我是否想约下周和常看的医生做一次「常规就诊」。

examples.en: The practice texted me a reminder about my routine appointment while I was in class.
examples.zh: 我上课时，诊所发短信提醒我有一次「常规预约」。

words.enDefinition: a set of blood tests ordered as part of regular care

examples.en: The nurse explained where my routine blood work results would appear after the visit.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，就诊后我的「常规验血」结果会显示在哪里。

examples.en: I asked which tests were included in the routine blood work listed on my form.
examples.zh: 我问表格上写的「常规验血」包括哪些检测项目。

collocations: a request for routine blood work

words.enDefinition: a regular visit to assess the health of teeth and gums

examples.en: My routine dental checkup happened to fall on the same day as my seminar.
examples.zh: 我的「常规牙科检查」恰好和研讨课在同一天。

examples.en: I asked whether the routine dental checkup fee included any pictures of my teeth.
examples.zh: 我问「常规牙科检查」的费用是否包含牙齿拍片。

words.enDefinition: a general physical examination done as part of regular care

examples.en: I asked how long the routine physical would take before booking a morning appointment.
examples.zh: 约早上的时段前，我先问了「常规体格检查」大概需要多久。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a summary of the routine physical to keep with my records.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份「常规体格检查」摘要，让我和自己的记录一起保存。

collocations: the cost of a routine physical

words.enDefinition: a referral made through the ordinary scheduling process

examples.en: The practice sent a routine referral and told me which department would contact me.
examples.zh: 诊所提交了「常规转诊」，并告诉我哪个科室会联系我。

examples.en: I asked about the status of my routine referral before leaving town for the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假离开这座城市之前，我问了「常规转诊」的进度。

words.enDefinition: have a body temperature above its normal range

examples.en: I tend to run a fever late in the evening and feel cooler by morning.
examples.zh: 我往往深夜会「发烧」，到了早上感觉就没那么热了。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether I still run a fever as often as last week.
examples.zh: 护士问我现在是不是还像上周那么频繁地「发烧」。

collocations: run a fever for two days

words.enDefinition: taking longer than the original timetable allowed

examples.en: The receptionist said the doctor was running behind schedule and offered to text me an update.
examples.zh: 前台说医生「看诊进度比预定晚」，可以发短信告诉我最新情况。

examples.en: I called my flatmate after reception explained that the clinic was running behind schedule.
examples.zh: 前台解释诊所「进度比预定晚」后，我给室友打了电话。

collocations: running behind schedule by twenty minutes

words.enDefinition: a nose that releases more fluid or mucus than usual

examples.en: I had a runny nose throughout the afternoon, especially on the walk home.
examples.zh: 我一下午都在「流鼻涕」，走回家的路上尤其明显。

examples.en: The runny nose started before I noticed any discomfort in my throat.
examples.zh: 我先开始「流鼻涕」，后来才觉得喉咙不舒服。

words.enDefinition: counseling with appointments available on the day of contact

examples.en: The website showed where to check for same-day counseling during the exam period.
examples.zh: 网站上写了考试期间在哪里查「当天可约的心理咨询」。

examples.en: I called about same-day counseling before my afternoon shift at the university library.
examples.zh: 去大学图书馆上下午班前，我打电话问了「当天可约的心理咨询」。

words.enDefinition: an NHS service providing assessment and care without overnight admission

examples.en: The receptionist showed me where same-day emergency care was explained on the hospital website.
examples.zh: 前台指给我看医院网站上哪里介绍了「同日急症照护」。

examples.en: The hospital leaflet described same-day emergency care and listed the location of the assessment area.
examples.zh: 医院折页介绍了「同日急症照护」，并标出了评估区的位置。

collocations: refer someone to same-day emergency care

words.enDefinition: a container used to hold material for a test

examples.en: The clerk compared the label on the sample container with the request.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「样本容器」上的标签与申请单作了核对。

examples.en: I asked whether the sample container barcode was the number shown in the portal.
examples.zh: 我问「样本容器」的条码是不是网上平台显示的那个编号。

words.enDefinition: the process of taking a test sample to the receiving site

examples.en: I called the lab to ask about sample drop-off before my morning class.
examples.zh: 上午上课前，我给检验室打电话问了「样本交送」。

examples.en: The sign listed sample drop-off hours separately from the front desk opening hours.
examples.zh: 牌子把「样本交送」的时间和前台开门的时间分开列。

words.enDefinition: a school form for recording a student's health information

examples.en: I forgot the school health form, so the office emailed me another copy.
examples.zh: 我忘带「学校健康登记表」了，办公室又发给我一份。

examples.en: The school health form had a space for the clinic's contact details and signature.
examples.zh: 「学校健康登记表」上留有填写诊所联系方式和签名的位置。

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet with a groove across its surface

examples.en: The package contained a scored tablet shown in the small diagram on the leaflet.
examples.zh: 包装里的「带刻痕片剂」在说明书的小图上有展示。

examples.en: The pharmacist recognized the scored tablet when I showed her the package photograph.
examples.zh: 我把包装照片给药师看，她认出了「带刻痕片剂」。

collocations: a picture of a scored tablet

words.enDefinition: a surface layer that helps protect a lens from scratches

examples.en: I asked whether the lens price already included a scratch-resistant coating on both sides.
examples.zh: 我问镜片的价格是否已经包含双面的「耐刮镀膜」。

examples.en: The brochure compared the standard scratch-resistant coating with the premium coating option.
examples.zh: 小册子对比了标准「耐刮镀膜」和高端镀膜选项。

words.enDefinition: lenses with marks caused by something scraping the surface

examples.en: The optician examined my scratched lenses under a light at the counter.
examples.zh: 配镜师在柜台的灯光下检查了我「有划痕的镜片」。

examples.en: I brought my old pair with scratched lenses to ask about replacing them.
examples.zh: 我带上旧眼镜，问能不能把「有划痕的镜片」换掉。

words.enDefinition: a throat that feels dry, irritated, or slightly rough

examples.en: I woke up with a scratchy throat but could still talk normally.
examples.zh: 我醒来时「喉咙干痒」，但还是能正常说话。

examples.en: The scratchy throat bothered me most when I read aloud in class.
examples.zh: 「喉咙干痒」在我上课朗读时最难受。

collocations: wake up with a scratchy throat

words.enDefinition: look for signs of a condition using a screening test

examples.en: I asked what the check was intended to screen for before booking.
examples.zh: 预约之前，我问这项检查是为了「筛查」什么问题。

examples.en: The leaflet explained what the program was designed to screen for that year.
examples.zh: 宣传单介绍了这个项目当年要「筛查」哪些问题。

collocations: a test to screen for disease
offer to screen for a health risk

words.enDefinition: an arranged visit for a check intended to spot possible problems

examples.en: I moved my screening appointment because the original time overlapped with a lecture.
examples.zh: 原来的时间和一节课撞了，我把「筛查预约」改了期。

examples.en: The confirmation email listed a separate entrance for the screening appointment on Monday.
examples.zh: 确认邮件说，周一的「筛查预约」要从另一个入口进去。

words.enDefinition: a chest X-ray examination carried out to look for signs of a condition

examples.en: I asked which date referred to the screening chest X-ray on the printed form.
examples.zh: 我问打印表上的哪个日期对应那次「筛查性胸部X线检查」。

examples.en: The clinic asked whether I needed a copy of the screening chest X-ray report.
examples.zh: 诊所问我需不需要一份「筛查性胸部X线检查」报告副本。

collocations: a report on a screening chest X-ray
an appointment for a screening chest X-ray

words.enDefinition: the requirements for being offered a particular screening check

examples.en: I asked who decided screening eligibility for people joining the program this term.
examples.zh: 我问，谁负责确认本学期报名者的「筛查参与条件」。

examples.en: The website listed an email address for questions about screening eligibility.
examples.zh: 网站列了一个邮箱，可以咨询「筛查参与条件」。

words.enDefinition: a record of the screening checks someone has previously had

examples.en: The clinic asked whether I had a copy of my screening history from home.
examples.zh: 诊所问我有没有家乡那边的「筛查记录」副本。

examples.en: The portal displayed my screening history next to the most recent appointment date.
examples.zh: 平台把我的「筛查记录」显示在最近一次就诊日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: the time between one screening check and the next

examples.en: I asked what screening interval meant in the letter from the screening program.
examples.zh: 我问筛查项目寄来的信里，「筛查间隔」是什么意思。

examples.en: The nurse explained where the screening interval appeared on my printed summary.
examples.zh: 护士指给我看打印出来的摘要上哪里写着「筛查间隔」。

words.enDefinition: a message inviting someone to take part in a screening check

examples.en: My screening invitation gave an address for the clinic closest to my residence.
examples.zh: 我的「筛查邀请」上写了离住处最近的诊所地址。

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether the screening invitation applied to exchange students, so I asked.
examples.zh: 我不确定这份「筛查邀请」是否面向交换生，就问了一下。

words.enDefinition: a breast X-ray examination used to look for early signs of cancer

examples.en: The nurse explained which document was the screening mammogram report in my file.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，档案里哪份文件是「乳腺X线筛查」报告。

examples.en: I asked which office kept copies of the images from the screening mammogram.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室留有「乳腺X线筛查」的影像副本。

collocations: an invitation for a screening mammogram

words.enDefinition: an organized service offering checks for a particular health issue

examples.en: I read about the screening program in a booklet from the campus health office.
examples.zh: 我在校园健康办公室发的册子里读到了这个「筛查项目」。

examples.en: The screening program had a phone line for students who needed information in another language.
examples.zh: 这个「筛查项目」有电话咨询，学生需要其他语言的说明时可以拨打。

words.enDefinition: a questionnaire used to identify possible issues for further assessment

examples.en: The counselor explained who would see the screening questionnaire after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 咨询师解释了我交完「筛查问卷」之后会有哪些人看。

examples.en: I filled out the screening questionnaire in the waiting area before my appointment started.
examples.zh: 咨询开始前，我在等候区填了「筛查问卷」。

words.enDefinition: initial questions used to decide what further review is needed

examples.en: The online form began with screening questions before asking which appointment time worked for me.
examples.zh: 在线表单先列出「筛查问题」，然后才问我哪个预约时间合适。

examples.en: I asked the nurse why the clinic repeated the screening questions at my second visit.
examples.zh: 我问护士，为什么第二次去诊所时又问了「筛查问题」。

words.enDefinition: a notice about an upcoming or available screening check

examples.en: I got a screening reminder on my phone just after the seminar ended.
examples.zh: 研讨课刚结束，我手机上就收到一条「筛查提醒」。

examples.en: The screening reminder included a link where I could check my appointment details.
examples.zh: 「筛查提醒」里有个链接，可以查看我的预约详情。

words.enDefinition: findings from a check for possible disease or increased risk

examples.en: The clinic said my screening results would appear in the portal after review.
examples.zh: 诊所说，审核后我的「筛查结果」会显示在网上平台里。

examples.en: I asked when I could discuss my screening results with someone from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候可以和诊所的工作人员谈谈我的「筛查结果」。

words.enDefinition: a plan showing when screening checks occur or are available

examples.en: The university posted the screening schedule outside the student health office yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午，学校把「筛查时间安排」贴在了学生健康办公室外。

examples.en: I compared the screening schedule with my timetable before contacting the clinic.
examples.zh: 我把「筛查时间安排」跟自己的课表对了一下，才联系诊所。

words.enDefinition: a test that looks for a condition or an increased chance of it

examples.en: I asked how the screening test would be listed in my medical record.
examples.zh: 我问「筛查检测」会怎样注明在我的医疗记录里。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a leaflet explaining the purpose of the screening test.
examples.zh: 诊所给我一份说明单，解释做这项「筛查检测」的目的。

words.enDefinition: an organized effort offering vaccination during a particular time of year

examples.en: The college announced a seasonal vaccination campaign in a message about autumn health services.
examples.zh: 学院在秋季健康服务通知中公布了一项「季节性接种活动」。

examples.en: I asked whether the seasonal vaccination campaign would have a site on our campus.
examples.zh: 我问「季节性接种活动」会不会在我们校区设点。

collocations: information about a seasonal vaccination campaign

words.enDefinition: an assessment by another professional after an initial opinion

examples.en: I asked whom I could contact for a second opinion about the specialist's assessment.
examples.zh: 我问该联系谁，就这位专科医生的评估征求「第二诊疗意见」。

examples.en: My adviser explained where to look for a second opinion and which documents to bring.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我去哪里征求「第二诊疗意见」、需要带哪些资料。

words.enDefinition: the insurance plan that may contribute after the first plan responds

examples.en: The billing team needed my secondary insurance details to review the remaining balance.
examples.zh: 账单部门需要我的「第二顺位保险」资料，才能核对剩下的余额。

examples.en: I asked whether my secondary insurance had received the paperwork from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问了自己的「第二顺位保险」有没有收到诊所发来的材料。

words.enDefinition: to attend a consultation with an expert in a medical field

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where I would need to go to see a specialist.
examples.zh: 我问前台要去哪里才能「看专科医生」。

examples.en: My tutor asked when I would see a specialist so we could move our meeting.
examples.zh: 导师问我什么时候要「看专科医生」，好重新安排见面时间。

words.enDefinition: harsh judgment of one's own actions, qualities, or mistakes

examples.en: We talked about self-criticism and how it showed up after I received feedback.
examples.zh: 我们聊了「自我苛责」，以及我收到反馈后会怎么责怪自己。

examples.en: I noticed more self-criticism when I compared my progress with other students' work.
examples.zh: 把自己的进展和其他同学的成果一比，我发现自己更容易「自我苛责」。

words.enDefinition: a patient who pays the provider without billing insurance

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether I was listed as a self-pay patient for that visit.
examples.zh: 前台核对那次就诊是否把我登记成了「自费患者」。

examples.en: A self-pay patient can ask the office to explain the total on the estimate.
examples.zh: 「自费患者」可以请办公室解释估价单上的总额。

words.enDefinition: the price charged to patients who pay without using insurance

examples.en: The campus clinic quoted a self-pay rate when I asked about the visit.
examples.zh: 我问校医院那次就诊要多少钱，他们报了一个「自费价格」。

examples.en: I asked for the self-pay rate in writing so I could compare both figures.
examples.zh: 我请对方把「自费价格」写下来，好对比两个数字。

words.enDefinition: to come to a healthcare facility on your own initiative

examples.en: The form asked whether I had been referred or had chosen to self-present that evening.
examples.zh: 表格问我当天晚上是经转诊来的，还是「自行到院就诊」。

examples.en: I chose to self-present after checking which hospital entrance was open that evening.
examples.zh: 我确认了那天晚上医院哪个入口开放后，决定「自行到院就诊」。

words.enDefinition: requesting access to a service without another clinician's referral

examples.en: I asked about self-referral because the service's website offered an online form for students.
examples.zh: 该服务网站上有供学生用的在线表格，我就问了「自行申请就诊」。

examples.en: The receptionist explained which services accepted self-referral when I called to ask about booking.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问预约时，前台解释了哪些服务受理「自行申请就诊」。

words.enDefinition: careful thinking about one's own experiences, feelings, or behaviour

examples.en: We spent the last part of the workshop writing notes for self-reflection.
examples.zh: 工作坊最后一段时间，我们写笔记进行「自我反思」。

examples.en: The counselor asked what self-reflection had been like for me during the semester.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，学期里「自我反思」对我来说是什么样的体验。

words.enDefinition: glasses frames with rims only partly surrounding each lens

examples.en: The assistant showed me semi-rimless frames in several colors near the mirror.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了镜子附近陈列的几种颜色的「半框眼镜架」。

examples.en: I compared two pairs of semi-rimless frames before choosing the darker one.
examples.zh: 我比较了两副「半框眼镜架」，才选了颜色更深的那副。

words.enDefinition: an assessment carried out again by a senior clinician

examples.en: The nurse said the team was waiting for a senior review before updating my record.
examples.zh: 护士说，团队正在等「高年资医生复核」，之后再更新我的记录。

examples.en: I asked where the senior review would take place while my roommate went downstairs for coffee.
examples.zh: 室友下楼买咖啡时，我问「高年资医生复核」会在哪里进行。

words.enDefinition: feeling discomfort from light that others might tolerate easily

examples.en: I noticed sensitivity to light when I stepped outside after my lecture.
examples.zh: 下课走到室外时，我觉得自己「对光敏感」。

examples.en: The sensitivity to light made the bright library lights especially uncomfortable yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天因为「对光敏感」，图书馆明亮的灯光让我很不舒服。

words.enDefinition: finding ordinary sounds unusually loud, painful, or uncomfortable

examples.en: My sensitivity to noise became more noticeable in the busy dining hall.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的食堂里，我「对声音更敏感了」。

examples.en: The clinician asked if the sensitivity to noise started before the headache.
examples.zh: 医生问我是不是头疼前就开始「对声音敏感」。

words.enDefinition: the practice of issuing different bills for related services

examples.en: The receptionist mentioned separate billing for the lab work and the clinic appointment.
examples.zh: 前台提到，化验和诊所看诊会「分开计费」。

examples.en: I didn't expect separate billing, so I called when the second statement arrived.
examples.zh: 我没想到会「分开计费」，所以收到第二份账单时打了电话。

words.enDefinition: written notes about what happened at a counseling or therapy meeting

examples.en: I asked whether I could see my session notes after meeting the counselor.
examples.zh: 和咨询师见面后，我问能不能看自己的「会谈记录」。

examples.en: The therapist explained how she keeps session notes at the student health service.
examples.zh: 治疗师说明了她在学生健康服务部门怎么保存「会谈记录」。

words.enDefinition: to decide and communicate a limit on what you will accept

examples.en: We talked about how to set a boundary when friends ask for favours during exam week.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了考试周朋友求帮忙时，怎样「设定界限」。

examples.en: I wanted to set a boundary around late-night project messages in our group chat.
examples.zh: 我想针对群里深夜发来的项目消息「设定界限」。

collocations: set a boundary with a friend
find it hard to set a boundary

words.enDefinition: hands that shake in repeated movements without your intending it

examples.en: I had shaky hands for several minutes after my morning lab session.
examples.zh: 上午实验课结束后，我的「手发抖」了好几分钟。

examples.en: I noticed my shaky hands when I tried to open a small envelope.
examples.zh: 我想打开一个小信封时，才注意到「手在发抖」。

words.enDefinition: taking small breaths without drawing much air each time

examples.en: My friend noticed shallow breathing while I was sitting on the bench.
examples.zh: 我坐在长椅上时，朋友注意到我「呼吸很浅」。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long the shallow breathing had continued after I sat down.
examples.zh: 护士问我坐下后，「呼吸浅」的情况持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: pain that feels acute, pointed, or cutting

examples.en: I felt a sharp pain in my foot when I stepped off the bus.
examples.zh: 我下公交车时，脚上突然一阵「尖锐疼痛」。

examples.en: I get a sharp pain in my side whenever I bend to the right.
examples.zh: 我每次往右侧弯腰，身侧就会有「尖锐疼痛」。

collocations: a sharp pain in the side

words.enDefinition: sudden pain that rapidly travels along part of the body

examples.en: I felt a shooting pain down my leg when I bent to tie my shoe.
examples.zh: 我弯腰系鞋带时，疼痛一下「窜到」了腿上。

examples.en: The shooting pain went from my shoulder to my elbow and quickly faded.
examples.zh: 这阵「窜痛」从肩膀传到手肘，很快就消退了。

words.enDefinition: a unit for patients expected to need a brief stay

examples.en: I called my flatmate after being moved to the short-stay unit on the second floor.
examples.zh: 被转到二楼的「短期留院病区」后，我给室友打了电话。

examples.en: The nurse explained where my bag could be stored in the short-stay unit overnight.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，晚上可以把我的包放在「短期留院病区」的哪里。

words.enDefinition: feeling unable to get enough air or breathe comfortably

examples.en: I noticed shortness of breath while walking uphill to the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我上坡走去报告厅时，觉得有些「气短」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether I had shortness of breath even while sitting.
examples.zh: 护士问我坐着时是不是也会「气短」。

words.enDefinition: a water-resistant seat designed for showering while seated

examples.en: I asked the residence office whether I could borrow a shower chair during term.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍办公室学期内能不能借一把「淋浴椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate made space for the shower chair before the equipment arrived.
examples.zh: 辅助器具送来之前，室友腾出了放「淋浴椅」的地方。

collocations: a bathroom with a shower chair

words.enDefinition: a medication order authenticated by the person who issued it

examples.en: I left the clinic with a signed prescription and a note about the pharmacy's location.
examples.zh: 我离开诊所时带着一张「已签署的处方」，还有一张写着药房位置的便条。

examples.en: The receptionist gave me the signed prescription after checking that it belonged to me.
examples.zh: 前台确认是我的之后，把「已签署的处方」交给了我。

words.enDefinition: removal of a tooth without a surgical approach to expose it

examples.en: The estimate listed a simple extraction separately from the cost of taking images.
examples.zh: 估价单把「简单拔牙」和拍片的费用分开列。

examples.en: I asked what the clinic meant by a simple extraction on the written plan.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，书面方案上所说的「简单拔牙」是什么意思。

collocations: a quote for a simple extraction

words.enDefinition: a small container intended to be used on one occasion

examples.en: The printed diagram showed what a single-use vial looked like inside the box.
examples.zh: 印出来的图示展示了盒中「一次性小药瓶」的样子。

examples.en: I checked whether each single-use vial was marked with the same product name.
examples.zh: 我查看了每个「一次性小药瓶」上标的产品名称是不是一样。

collocations: each single-use vial in the box

words.enDefinition: eyeglass lenses with one optical prescription across the viewing area

examples.en: The assistant explained why the first quote was for single-vision lenses only.
examples.zh: 店员解释了为什么第一份报价只包含「单光镜片」。

examples.en: I asked whether single-vision lenses were listed on the receipt for my glasses.
examples.zh: 我问眼镜收据上是否标了「单光镜片」。

words.enDefinition: a sensation of fullness or pressure in the sinus area

examples.en: I felt sinus pressure around my cheeks when I bent to pick up my bag.
examples.zh: 我弯腰捡包时，觉得脸颊附近有「鼻窦压迫感」。

examples.en: The sinus pressure grew more noticeable in the afternoon and eased before dinner.
examples.zh: 「鼻窦压迫感」下午更明显，到晚饭前才缓解。

words.enDefinition: a group focused on learning and practising a defined set of skills

examples.en: The counseling centre runs a skills group that meets once a week during term.
examples.zh: 咨询中心有个「技能练习小组」，学期里每周见一次。

examples.en: I asked whether the skills group was open to students from other departments.
examples.zh: 我问其他院系的学生能不能参加这个「技能练习小组」。

words.enDefinition: an examination looking for possible early signs of skin cancer

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic offered skin cancer screening at that particular location.
examples.zh: 我问诊所在那个点是否提供「皮肤癌筛查」。

examples.en: The service list had a short explanation of skin cancer screening near the bottom.
examples.zh: 服务清单靠下的位置有一段「皮肤癌筛查」的简短说明。

words.enDefinition: a visible change in skin color or texture over an area

examples.en: I noticed a skin rash on my arm while getting dressed this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上穿衣服的时候，我发现手臂上有「皮疹」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the skin rash had spread since I first saw it.
examples.zh: 护士问我最初发现后，「皮疹」有没有扩散。

words.enDefinition: a sensation that one heartbeat is missing or delayed

examples.en: I noticed what felt like a skipped heartbeat while lying in bed.
examples.zh: 我躺在床上时，感觉「心跳像是漏了一拍」。

examples.en: The clinician asked when I had first noticed the occasional skipped heartbeat.
examples.zh: 医生问我什么时候开始察觉偶尔「心跳漏一拍」。

words.enDefinition: a record of when someone sleeps and wakes

examples.en: I showed the clinician the sleep diary I had kept during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我把假期记的「睡眠日记」给医生看。

examples.en: My sleep diary recorded when I woke up as well as my bedtime.
examples.zh: 我的「睡眠日记」记了何时醒来，也记了几点睡觉。

words.enDefinition: a disruption to normal sleep habits or quality

examples.en: The student questionnaire asked about sleep disturbance over the past two weeks.
examples.zh: 学生问卷询问了过去两周「睡眠受扰」的情况。

examples.en: I told my counselor that sleep disturbance was affecting my concentration during lectures.
examples.zh: 我告诉咨询师，「睡眠受扰」影响了我上课时的注意力。

words.zhGloss: 按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询
words.enDefinition: counseling priced according to what the client can afford
acceptedZhAnswers: 按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询

examples.en: My adviser showed me a directory of clinics offering sliding-scale counseling near campus.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份学校附近提供「按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询」的诊所名录。

examples.en: I called about sliding-scale counseling and asked what documents the centre would need.
examples.zh: 我打电话咨询「按经济情况分档收费的心理咨询」，问中心需要哪些材料。

words.enDefinition: a fee adjusted according to a person's ability to pay

examples.en: The community clinic told me how it calculated a sliding-scale fee for eligible patients.
examples.zh: 社区诊所告诉我，他们怎样给符合条件的患者计算「按收入浮动的收费」。

examples.en: I asked which documents the clinic needed to assess my sliding-scale fee.
examples.zh: 我问诊所需要哪些文件来核定我的「按收入浮动的收费」。

words.enDefinition: an eye exam using a lit microscope to see structures closely

examples.en: I asked what slit-lamp examination meant on the list of planned tests.
examples.zh: 我问了检查项目单上的「裂隙灯检查」是什么意思。

examples.en: The optometrist talked me through the results of the slit-lamp examination afterward.
examples.zh: 「裂隙灯检查」结束后，验光师逐条给我解释了结果。

words.enDefinition: speaking with words that sound unclear or run together

examples.en: My roommate noticed slurred speech while I was describing what had happened.
examples.zh: 我描述当时发生的事时，室友注意到我「口齿含糊」。

examples.en: I told the clinician how long the slurred speech had lasted that morning.
examples.zh: 我告诉医生，那天早上「口齿含糊」持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: a letter chart with rows of decreasing sizes for acuity testing

examples.en: The examiner pointed to a row of letters halfway down the Snellen chart.
examples.zh: 检查人员指着「斯内伦视力表」中间位置的一行字母。

examples.en: The clinic uses a Snellen chart with black letters on a white background.
examples.zh: 诊所用的是白底黑字的「斯内伦视力表」。

collocations: the bottom row of a Snellen chart

words.enDefinition: fear or worry about social situations and others' judgments

examples.en: My counselor asked which campus activities brought up social anxiety for me.
examples.zh: 咨询师问我，哪些校园活动会让我感到「社交焦虑」。

examples.en: I read about social anxiety after finding it hard to speak during group projects.
examples.zh: 小组项目中开口发言让我觉得困难，之后我读了关于「社交焦虑」的资料。

words.enDefinition: a lack of regular social contact or connection with other people

examples.en: The workshop discussed social isolation among students who live far from the main campus.
examples.zh: 工作坊讨论了住得离主校区较远的学生面临的「社交孤立」。

examples.en: I wanted to know how the student association addressed social isolation during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我想了解学生会在假期怎么回应「社交孤立」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a device that helps someone put on a sock

examples.en: I asked what a sock aid was after seeing it on the equipment list.
examples.zh: 我在辅助器具清单上看到「穿袜辅助器」，就问了它是什么。

examples.en: The equipment desk had a packaged sock aid next to the sample dressing tools.
examples.zh: 辅助设备服务台的穿衣工具样品旁边摆着一个包装好的「穿袜辅助器」。

collocations: a demonstration model of a sock aid

words.enDefinition: a toothbrush made with softer flexible cleaning bristles

examples.en: The dentist's display showed a soft-bristled toothbrush next to several other types.
examples.zh: 牙医的展示区把「软毛牙刷」和好几种其他牙刷放在了一起。

examples.en: I asked which box on the shelf contained the soft-bristled toothbrush from the picture.
examples.zh: 我问架子上哪个盒子里装的是图片里的「软毛牙刷」。

words.enDefinition: contact lenses made of flexible materials that bend easily

examples.en: The optometrist showed me a sample package of soft contact lenses during my visit.
examples.zh: 就诊时，验光师给我看了一盒「软性隐形眼镜」的样品。

examples.en: I asked whether soft contact lenses were listed on my previous prescription.
examples.zh: 我问自己上一张处方上写的是不是「软性隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a fitting for soft contact lenses
a package of soft contact lenses

words.enDefinition: a flexible sealed capsule usually containing liquid or oil

examples.en: The label used softgel in the description, so I asked what it meant.
examples.zh: 标签介绍用了「软胶囊」这个词，我就问是什么意思。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked whether the carton for the softgel matched the prescription.
examples.zh: 药师核对了「软胶囊」的外盒是否和处方一致。

words.enDefinition: an acidic taste that remains in the mouth

examples.en: I woke up with a sour taste in my mouth on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 星期二早上醒来时，我「嘴里有酸味」。

examples.en: The sour taste stayed in my mouth for several minutes after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭过后，我「嘴里有酸味」，过了好几分钟才散。

collocations: a sour taste in the mouth

words.enDefinition: an extra pair kept in case the main one is unavailable

examples.en: I left a spare pair of glasses in my room before going abroad.
examples.zh: 出国之前，我在房间里留了「备用的一副」眼镜。

examples.en: The assistant asked if my old glasses would still work as a spare pair.
examples.zh: 店员问我的旧眼镜能不能继续当「备用的一副」。

collocations: take a spare pair on a trip

words.enDefinition: a window for enrolling outside the regular enrollment period

examples.en: I asked whether graduating early could qualify me for a special enrollment period.
examples.zh: 我问提前毕业是否符合「特殊投保期」的申请条件。

examples.en: The adviser explained which documents I needed for the special enrollment period.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「特殊投保期」内我需要哪些材料。

collocations: qualify for a special enrollment period
apply during a special enrollment period

words.enDefinition: an order placed for something not normally carried in stock

examples.en: The pharmacy offered to place a special order because it didn't usually carry that brand.
examples.zh: 药房平时没有那个牌子，就提出可以「特别订货」。

examples.en: I asked when the special order would arrive before making another trip to the shop.
examples.zh: 再次去药房之前，我先问了「特别订货」什么时候到。

words.enDefinition: a request for a patient to receive specialist care

examples.en: The clinic said it had sent my specialist referral to the hospital near campus.
examples.zh: 诊所说已经把我的「专科转诊」提交给校区附近的医院。

examples.en: I checked the address on the specialist referral before phoning the hospital's booking team.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「专科转诊」上的地址，再打电话给医院的预约部门。

collocations: follow up on a specialist referral

words.enDefinition: an assessment or advice requested from a specialist team

examples.en: The clinician requested a specialty consultation and explained which team would be contacted next.
examples.zh: 医务人员申请了「专科会诊」，并说明接下来会联系哪个团队。

examples.en: My roommate took a seat outside while I waited for the specialty consultation to begin.
examples.zh: 我等「专科会诊」开始时，室友在外面找了个座位。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to contain and transport a test specimen

examples.en: The clerk compared the code on the specimen bag with my form.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「标本袋」上的代码与我的表格作了核对。

examples.en: I asked which number on the specimen bag was the reference on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「标本袋」上的哪个编号是我收据上的参考号。

collocations: a barcode on the specimen bag

words.enDefinition: the process of obtaining material for a laboratory test

examples.en: I asked where my specimen collection appointment would take place on campus.
examples.zh: 我问校园里的「标本采集」预约在哪儿进行。

examples.en: The receptionist pointed to the sign for the specimen collection area nearby.
examples.zh: 前台指了指附近那块写着「标本采集」区的指示牌。

words.enDefinition: a code uniquely identifying a sample in a laboratory system

examples.en: The clerk asked for the specimen ID visible beneath the printed barcode.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我提供印刷条码下方的「标本识别编号」。

examples.en: I used the specimen ID on the receipt when calling about my report.
examples.zh: 我打电话问报告时，用了收据上的「标本识别编号」。

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a sample and its associated information

examples.en: The technician checked the specimen label before accepting the package at reception.
examples.zh: 技术人员先核对了「标本标签」，才在接待处接收包裹。

examples.en: I asked which date on the specimen label matched the date on the form.
examples.zh: 我问「标本标签」上的哪个日期和表格上的日期一致。

collocations: a barcode on the specimen label

words.enDefinition: care for difficulties with communication or swallowing

examples.en: I asked the clinic where the speech and language therapy appointments would take place.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，「言语语言治疗」要去哪里做。

examples.en: The leaflet explained which professionals worked in the speech and language therapy service.
examples.zh: 宣传单介绍了有哪些专业人员在「言语语言治疗」机构工作。

collocations: a referral for speech and language therapy
a speech and language therapy service

words.enDefinition: a clinician trained to assess communication and swallowing difficulties

examples.en: The speech-language pathologist introduced herself before asking me about my usual routines.
examples.zh: 「言语语言治疗师」先自我介绍，然后问了我平时的生活习惯。

examples.en: I asked the speech-language pathologist to send the appointment details in writing.
examples.zh: 我请「言语语言治疗师」把预约信息以文字形式发给我。

collocations: a referral to a speech-language pathologist

words.enDefinition: lens power that is the same in every meridian

examples.en: The optometrist circled the spherical power in the first column of the form.
examples.zh: 验光师圈出了表格第一列的「球镜度数」。

examples.en: I asked where the spherical power was shown for my left eye on this copy.
examples.zh: 我问这份副本上左眼的「球镜度数」显示在哪儿。

words.zhGloss: 两次月经间的点滴出血
words.enDefinition: light vaginal bleeding in the time between menstrual periods
acceptedZhAnswers: 两次月经间的点滴出血

examples.en: I noticed spotting between periods for the first time during my field placement.
examples.zh: 我在外实习期间，第一次发现「两次月经间有点滴出血」。

examples.en: The clinician asked when the spotting between periods had first appeared this month.
examples.zh: 医生问我这个月「两次月经间的点滴出血」最早是什么时候出现的。

words.enDefinition: glasses joints with springs that let the arms flex outward

examples.en: The assistant brought out a pair of glasses fitted with spring hinges.
examples.zh: 店员拿出一副装有「弹簧铰链」的眼镜。

examples.en: The product page listed spring hinges under the frame features and included a photograph.
examples.zh: 商品页在镜框特点中列出了「弹簧铰链」，还附了一张照片。

words.enDefinition: a clinical state that is not changing significantly at the time

examples.en: The nurse said my friend was in stable condition when I asked for an update.
examples.zh: 我询问朋友的情况时，护士说他当时「病情稳定」。

examples.en: The transfer note mentioned stable condition but did not include the expected time of arrival.
examples.zh: 转运记录提到了「病情稳定」，但没有写预计到达时间。

words.enDefinition: access to a place without having to go up or down steps

examples.en: I emailed the department to ask about step-free access to the laboratory.
examples.zh: 我给系里发邮件，询问去实验室有没有「无台阶通行」的路线。

examples.en: The building map marks the route with step-free access from the library.
examples.zh: 大楼地图标出了从图书馆过去的「无台阶通行」路线。

words.enDefinition: joints that feel hard to bend or move freely

examples.en: I wake up with stiff joints, especially in my fingers, on colder mornings.
examples.zh: 早上天气冷的时候，我睡醒会觉得「关节僵硬」，手指尤其明显。

examples.en: The stiff joints make it harder for me to open jars in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上「关节僵硬」，我拧罐子盖会更吃力。

words.enDefinition: a neck that feels hard or painful to move

examples.en: I woke up with a stiff neck and found it hard to turn left.
examples.zh: 我醒来时「脖子僵硬」，很难把头转向左边。

examples.en: My stiff neck felt worse after sitting through the long lecture on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五坐着听完一节长课后，我的「脖子更僵硬了」。

collocations: wake up with a stiff neck

words.enDefinition: a check for whether a product is currently available

examples.en: The pharmacist ran a stock check before saying when I could collect the order.
examples.zh: 药师做了「库存查询」之后，才告诉我什么时候可以来取药。

examples.en: I phoned the other branch and asked for a stock check before walking over.
examples.zh: 走过去之前，我打电话到另一家分店，请他们做一下「库存查询」。

words.enDefinition: sudden tightening pains felt in the belly

examples.en: I had stomach cramps on the bus just after leaving the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我刚离开食堂，在公交上突然「肚子绞痛」。

examples.en: The stomach cramps woke me up early, but they did not last long.
examples.zh: 我一大早被「肚子绞痛」弄醒，不过疼痛没持续多久。

words.enDefinition: a portion of feces provided for analysis by a laboratory

examples.en: The technician confirmed receipt of the stool sample on the following morning.
examples.zh: 技术人员在第二天上午确认收到了「粪便样本」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the stool sample entry in the results portal.
examples.zh: 我问结果平台上哪里显示「粪便样本」的记录。

words.enDefinition: written information describing how a product should be kept

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to go over the storage instructions in the folded leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师讲解折叠说明书里的「储存说明」。

examples.en: The storage instructions were printed beside a small box headed other information.
examples.zh: 「储存说明」印在标题为其他信息的小方框旁边。

collocations: follow the storage instructions on the label

words.enDefinition: a condition in which the eyes are not properly aligned

examples.en: The ophthalmologist noted my history of strabismus after reviewing the older clinic letters.
examples.zh: 眼科医生看过以前的诊所函件后，记下了我的「斜视」病史。

examples.en: I asked the specialist to explain the word strabismus on the referral sheet.
examples.zh: 我请专科医生解释转诊单上的「斜视」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: how much stress a person is experiencing

examples.en: My adviser asked whether my stress level changed during weeks with fewer deadlines.
examples.zh: 顾问问，在截止日期比较少的几周，我的「压力程度」会不会变化。

examples.en: The survey asked me to rate my stress level at the end of term.
examples.zh: 调查请我给学期末的「压力程度」打个分。

words.enDefinition: a session where participants learn and discuss ways to handle stress

examples.en: I found the stress management workshop listed under the department's exam support activities.
examples.zh: 我在院里的考试支持活动列表上找到了「压力管理工作坊」。

examples.en: A classmate recommended the stress management workshop after seeing a notice at the library.
examples.zh: 一位同学在图书馆看到公告后，向我推荐了「压力管理工作坊」。

collocations: register for a stress management workshop

words.enDefinition: something that can bring on a stress response

examples.en: I noticed that unexpected changes to my timetable were a stress trigger for me.
examples.zh: 我发现课表突然变动对我来说是一个「压力触发因素」。

examples.en: We discussed which stress trigger appeared most often during the weeks before exams.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了考前几周哪种「压力触发因素」出现得最频繁。

words.enDefinition: a situation or demand that causes stress for someone

examples.en: My counselor asked whether the move had been the biggest stressor that month.
examples.zh: 咨询师问，那个月搬家对我来说是不是最大的「压力源」。

examples.en: I identified my upcoming presentation as a stressor during the wellbeing workshop on campus.
examples.zh: 在校内身心健康工作坊中，我发现即将进行的汇报是一个「压力源」。

words.enDefinition: a frame used to carry or move someone lying down

examples.en: The porter moved the stretcher through an empty corridor toward the hospital imaging area.
examples.zh: 运送人员推着「担架」经过空走廊，去往医院影像检查区。

examples.en: I held my friend's bag while the crew brought her in on a stretcher.
examples.zh: 救护人员用「担架」把朋友送进来时，我帮她拿着包。

words.enDefinition: a group where students discuss adjusting to new academic or social settings

examples.en: I joined a student adjustment group in my first month on the exchange programme.
examples.zh: 参加交换项目第一个月，我加入了「学生适应互助小组」。

examples.en: The student adjustment group met in the same room as my evening seminar.
examples.zh: 「学生适应互助小组」用的就是我晚间研讨课的教室。

words.enDefinition: a university charge supporting health services for students

examples.en: My tuition statement lists a student health fee and a separate insurance premium.
examples.zh: 我的学费账单列了「学生健康服务费」，保险费则在另一行。

examples.en: The student health fee was explained at orientation before we visited the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我们参观校医院之前，迎新会上介绍了什么是「学生健康服务费」。

collocations: included in the student health fee

words.enDefinition: a student-focused plan that helps pay for healthcare

examples.en: I read about the student health insurance plan before choosing my classes online.
examples.zh: 在网上选课前，我先了解了「学生医疗保险方案」。

examples.en: Our international office explained how the student health insurance plan works during summer break.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室说明了暑假期间「学生医疗保险方案」如何提供保障。

collocations: enrol in a student health insurance plan

words.enDefinition: a request to opt out of a school's insurance plan

examples.en: My student health insurance waiver was still pending when tuition charges appeared online.
examples.zh: 学费出现在网上时，我的「学生医保豁免申请」还在审核。

examples.en: The university asked me to attach my policy details to the student health insurance waiver.
examples.zh: 学校要求我在「学生医保豁免申请」里附上现有保单资料。

collocations: submit a student health insurance waiver
approve a student health insurance waiver
check a student health insurance waiver

words.enDefinition: an online system connecting students with health records or services

examples.en: I uploaded the form to the student health portal after my morning class.
examples.zh: 上午下课后，我把表格传到了「学生健康平台」。

examples.en: The student health portal showed a message from the nurse about my submitted record.
examples.zh: 「学生健康平台」上有护士发来的消息，说的是我提交的记录。

collocations: log into the student health portal
update the student health portal profile
upload to the student health portal

words.enDefinition: a record of health information held for an individual student

examples.en: I asked who could access my student health record after I transferred to another campus.
examples.zh: 转到另一个校区以后，我问谁能查看我的「学生健康档案」。

examples.en: The nurse checked my student health record to see whether the document had arrived.
examples.zh: 护士查看了我的「学生健康档案」，确认文件有没有收到。

words.enDefinition: the process of registering a student with a school's health service

examples.en: The university explained student health registration at the same orientation session as library registration.
examples.zh: 学校在同一场迎新会上介绍了「学生健康登记」和图书馆登记。

examples.en: I asked when student health registration would open for students arriving later this term.
examples.zh: 我问这学期晚到的学生什么时候可以办理「学生健康登记」。

words.enDefinition: required health-related records or checks specified by a school

examples.en: The orientation guide listed student health requirements for people starting a clinical placement.
examples.zh: 迎新指南列出了开始临床实习的「学生健康要求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the student health requirements applied to my particular exchange course.
examples.zh: 我问这些「学生健康要求」是否适用于我那门交换课程。

collocations: a list of student health requirements

words.enDefinition: a university service supporting students with mental health concerns

examples.en: The student mental health service had a separate page for students studying abroad.
examples.zh: 「学生心理健康服务」网站给在海外学习的学生单独设了一个页面。

examples.en: I called the student mental health service to ask what support was available.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「学生心理健康服务」部门，询问有哪些支持。

collocations: contact the student mental health service
information from the student mental health service
use a student mental health service

words.enDefinition: a staff member helping students find wellbeing support

examples.en: I met the student wellbeing adviser after my tutor mentioned the service.
examples.zh: 导师提到了这项服务之后，我见了「学生身心健康顾问」。

examples.en: The student wellbeing adviser emailed me an overview of the support available on campus.
examples.zh: 「学生身心健康顾问」发邮件给我，概述了校内可提供的支持。

words.enDefinition: a survey about how students are feeling and managing daily life

examples.en: Our department sent a student wellbeing survey at the end of the term.
examples.zh: 学期末，我们系发了一份「学生身心健康调查」。

examples.en: I completed the student wellbeing survey after reading how the university would use it.
examples.zh: 看了学校会如何使用调查结果后，我填了「学生身心健康调查」。

collocations: results from a student wellbeing survey

words.enDefinition: a nose that feels blocked and hard to breathe through

examples.en: I woke up with a stuffy nose after falling asleep on the train.
examples.zh: 我在火车上睡着了，醒来时觉得「鼻塞」。

examples.en: The stuffy nose was worse last night, but the cough had stayed the same.
examples.zh: 昨晚「鼻塞」更严重了，咳嗽却和之前一样。

collocations: wake up with a stuffy nose

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet designed to dissolve under the tongue

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the term sublingual tablet on the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释说明书里的「舌下片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The label described it as a sublingual tablet, which was unfamiliar to me.
examples.zh: 标签写的是「舌下片」，这个词我之前没见过。

words.enDefinition: to send an insurer a request for payment under a policy

examples.en: The clinic told me how to submit a claim after my appointment.
examples.zh: 看诊后，诊所告诉我怎么「提交理赔申请」。

examples.en: Can I submit a claim online if I paid the provider at reception?
examples.zh: 如果我在前台就付了钱，能在网上「提交理赔申请」吗？

words.enDefinition: the beginning of a symptom without a gradual buildup

examples.en: I mentioned the sudden onset of dizziness when the clinician asked about timing.
examples.zh: 医生问症状时间时，我提到头晕是「突然出现的」。

examples.en: We noted the sudden onset because she had felt fine all morning.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「突然起病」的情况，因为她整个上午都没觉得不舒服。

words.enDefinition: a short description of what a health plan covers

examples.en: The summary of benefits helped me find the section about campus clinic visits.
examples.zh: 我在「保障摘要」里找到了关于校医院就诊的部分。

examples.en: I compared the summary of benefits with the full policy to clarify a charge.
examples.zh: 我对照「保障摘要」和完整保单，想弄清一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: the people or organisations someone can turn to for help

examples.en: My support network now includes friends from the course and people at home.
examples.zh: 我的「支持网络」现在包括课程里的朋友和家乡的人。

examples.en: We talked about who was in my support network when I moved abroad.
examples.zh: 我搬到国外后，我们聊了聊哪些人属于我的「支持网络」。

words.enDefinition: someone who accompanies a patient to provide personal support

examples.en: I brought a support person to help me remember the questions I wanted to ask.
examples.zh: 我带了一位「就诊陪同人员」，帮我记住想问的问题。

examples.en: The clinic asked whether my support person would join the appointment in the room.
examples.zh: 诊所问我的「就诊陪同人员」会不会一起进诊室。

words.enDefinition: leaving hospital with organized support available after departure

examples.en: The ward team described a supported discharge while we discussed going home.
examples.zh: 我们商量回家的安排时，病区团队介绍了「有后续支持的出院」。

examples.en: I asked whether supported discharge included a contact for questions over the weekend.
examples.zh: 我问选择「有后续支持的出院」后，周末有问题能否联系相关人员。

words.enDefinition: a solid medicine form designed to dissolve inside a body opening

examples.en: I asked what the word suppository meant on the clinic's printed order.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印出的处方上，「栓剂」这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: The label showed a small picture of a suppository next to the product name.
examples.zh: 标签在产品名旁边印了一张「栓剂」的小图。

words.enDefinition: removal of a tooth using a surgical approach

examples.en: The dentist wrote surgical extraction on the referral and explained which tooth it concerned.
examples.zh: 牙医在转诊单上写了「手术拔牙」，并说明涉及的是哪颗牙。

examples.en: I asked whether the fee for surgical extraction was shown on a separate page.
examples.zh: 我问「手术拔牙」的费用是不是列在另一页。

words.enDefinition: a record of operations a person has had before

examples.en: The nurse asked about my surgical history while updating my record for the new practice.
examples.zh: 护士在给新诊所更新档案时，问了我的「手术史」。

examples.en: I left the surgical history section blank because I wanted to check the dates first.
examples.zh: 我想先核对日期，就把「手术史」这一栏留空了。

words.enDefinition: an unexpected charge for healthcare that a patient thought was covered

examples.en: I brought the surprise medical bill to the student support office for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我把「意外医疗账单」带到学生服务办公室，请他们帮我看。

examples.en: My roommate found a surprise medical bill in the mail after returning from break.
examples.zh: 室友放假回来后，在邮件里发现一张「意外医疗账单」。

words.enDefinition: material collected with a swab for a laboratory test

examples.en: I checked which label referred to the swab sample collected at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我确认了哪个标签对应在诊所采集的「拭子样本」。

examples.en: The nurse told me where the swab sample result would appear online.
examples.zh: 护士告诉我，「拭子样本」检测结果在网上哪里显示。

words.enDefinition: to move one's ongoing care to a different practice

examples.en: I decided to switch to another practice that was closer to my new accommodation.
examples.zh: 我决定「换到另一家诊所」，离我的新住处更近。

examples.en: The student adviser said I could ask how to switch to another practice after moving.
examples.zh: 学生顾问说，我搬家后可以问怎样「换到另一家诊所」。

collocations: plan to switch to another practice
ask how to switch to another practice
decide to switch to another practice

words.enDefinition: ankles that have become larger or puffy than usual

examples.en: I noticed swollen ankles after taking off my shoes on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 星期五晚上脱鞋后，我发现自己「脚踝肿胀」。

examples.en: The clinician asked whether my swollen ankles looked the same in the morning.
examples.zh: 医生问我早上的「脚踝肿胀」是不是也这么明显。

words.enDefinition: enlarged lymph nodes that may be felt under the skin

examples.en: I noticed swollen glands beneath my jaw while I was washing my face.
examples.zh: 我洗脸时发现下巴下面有「淋巴结肿大」。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the swollen glands were painful when I touched them.
examples.zh: 护士问我，碰到「肿大的淋巴结」时是否觉得痛。

words.enDefinition: gums that have become enlarged or puffy

examples.en: The dentist asked when I first saw swollen gums beside the back tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医问我，最早是什么时候发现后牙旁边有「牙龈肿胀」。

examples.en: My friend mentioned swollen gums when the receptionist asked why she wanted an appointment.
examples.zh: 前台问我朋友为什么要约就诊时，她提到了「牙龈肿胀」。

words.enDefinition: a record of when symptoms occur and how they feel

examples.en: I took my symptom diary to the appointment to show when the cramps started.
examples.zh: 我带着「症状日记」去看诊，说明痉挛是从什么时候开始的。

examples.en: My symptom diary shows that the dizziness usually lasts only a few minutes.
examples.zh: 我的「症状日记」显示，头晕通常只持续几分钟。

words.enDefinition: experiencing none of the symptoms being discussed

examples.en: I was symptom-free for nearly a week, and then the aches returned.
examples.zh: 我将近一个星期「没有症状」，然后酸痛又出现了。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long I had been symptom-free before the cough came back.
examples.zh: 护士问我咳嗽再次出现之前，有多久「没有症状」。

words.enDefinition: an account of when symptoms began and changed

examples.en: I made a symptom timeline so I could explain what had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 我整理了「症状时间线」，好说明自上学期以来有哪些变化。

examples.en: The clinician looked at my symptom timeline while checking the dates in the old notes.
examples.zh: 医务人员核对旧病历上的日期时，看了我的「症状时间线」。

collocations: bring a symptom timeline to an appointment

words.enDefinition: a sweet liquid preparation used as a form of medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist said the bottle was a syrup, which the label also showed.
examples.zh: 药师说瓶里是「糖浆剂」，标签上也标着。

examples.en: The pharmacy compared the syrup label with the product photo in its system.
examples.zh: 药房把「糖浆剂」的标签和系统里的产品照片作了对照。

words.enDefinition: a bottle designed to hold solid medicine tablets

examples.en: The pharmacy put the printed label on the front of the tablet bottle.
examples.zh: 药房把打印好的标签贴在了「片剂药瓶」正面。

examples.en: I brought the empty tablet bottle along so the pharmacist could read the old label.
examples.zh: 我带上了空的「片剂药瓶」，方便药师看之前的标签。

words.enDefinition: raised patterns on a surface providing tactile information to pedestrians

examples.en: The campus map marked the tactile paving outside the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了图书馆入口外的「触觉引导地砖」。

examples.en: I asked whether the new path would have tactile paving at the crossing.
examples.zh: 我问新路的过街点是否会铺设「触觉引导地砖」。

words.enDefinition: a service collecting unwanted medicines for appropriate disposal

examples.en: My pharmacy showed me a leaflet about the local take-back program in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 药房给我看了一份介绍我们社区「废药回收计划」的宣传单。

examples.en: I asked whether the take-back program operated during normal opening hours at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个分店的「废药回收计划」是否在正常营业时间开展。

words.enDefinition: psychological treatment involving discussion with a trained practitioner

examples.en: I wanted to understand what talking therapy meant before contacting the service.
examples.zh: 联系这项服务前，我想先弄清「谈话心理治疗」是什么意思。

examples.en: The leaflet listed several kinds of talking therapy offered by the community clinic.
examples.zh: 宣传页列举了社区诊所提供的几种「谈话心理治疗」。

words.enDefinition: a seal that shows whether a package has been opened

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where the tamper-evident seal was on the new bottle.
examples.zh: 我问药师，新药瓶上的「拆封显痕封签」在哪里。

examples.en: The pharmacy checked the tamper-evident seal after I showed them the torn outer carton.
examples.zh: 我拿给药房看破掉的外盒后，他们检查了「拆封显痕封签」。

words.enDefinition: an accumulation of hardened deposits formed from dental plaque

examples.en: The hygienist used a model to explain where tartar buildup was commonly seen.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师用模型解释了哪些地方常见「牙结石堆积」。

examples.en: I asked how tartar buildup was recorded in the notes from my dental visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次看牙的记录是怎么注明「牙结石堆积」的。

words.enDefinition: confirmation that someone meets a program's tuberculosis screening requirements

examples.en: My placement office asked whether my TB clearance was visible in the portal.
