examples.zh: 实习办公室问，我的「结核病筛查审核通过」状态在平台上看不看得到。

examples.en: I asked who could confirm my TB clearance after the clinic sent the document.
examples.zh: 诊所发出文件后，我问谁可以确认我「结核病筛查审核通过」。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of factors associated with possible tuberculosis exposure or disease

examples.en: I asked where to find the TB risk assessment form in the student portal.
examples.zh: 我问在学生平台上哪里能找到「结核病风险评估」表。

examples.en: The nurse explained who would review my TB risk assessment after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 护士说了我提交「结核病风险评估」后会由谁审核。

words.enDefinition: rubbing the upper and lower teeth against each other

examples.en: The dentist asked whether anyone had noticed teeth grinding while I was asleep.
examples.zh: 牙医问我睡觉时有没有人注意到我「磨牙」。

examples.en: I wrote down the term teeth grinding after my dentist mentioned it during the checkup.
examples.zh: 牙医在检查时提到了「磨牙」，我把这个词记了下来。

words.enDefinition: an appointment conducted over a telephone call

examples.en: I gave reception my mobile number for the telephone appointment booked for next Monday.
examples.zh: 我把手机号留给前台，用于下星期一的「电话问诊预约」。

examples.en: The clinic sent a time window for the telephone appointment instead of a room number.
examples.zh: 诊所发来的是「电话问诊」的时间段，没有给房间号。

words.enDefinition: counseling delivered through a telephone call

examples.en: The centre offered telephone counseling when I could not join the video call.
examples.zh: 我没法参加视频通话时，中心提供了「电话心理咨询」。

examples.en: I checked which number would call me for telephone counseling on Monday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我查了周一下午安排的「电话心理咨询」会从哪个号码打来。

words.enDefinition: assessing a request by phone to determine its priority

examples.en: The clinic uses telephone triage before deciding which team should handle an appointment request.
examples.zh: 诊所用「电话分诊」先了解情况，再决定由哪个团队办理预约。

examples.en: I confirmed my callback number before the receptionist passed my details to telephone triage.
examples.zh: 前台把我的资料交给「电话分诊」之前，我确认了回拨号码。

words.enDefinition: a quick noticeable rise in body temperature

examples.en: I recorded a temperature spike just after dinner, when I'd been feeling cold.
examples.zh: 刚吃完晚饭，我明明觉得冷，却记录到「体温骤升」。

examples.en: The nurse asked how long the temperature spike had lasted before my appointment.
examples.zh: 护士问我来看诊前那次「体温骤升」持续了多久。

words.enDefinition: the length of the frame's side arm reaching behind the ear

examples.en: The temple length was printed on the inside of my old frames.
examples.zh: 我的旧镜框内侧印着「镜腿长度」。

examples.en: I asked the assistant to compare the temple length of the two pairs.
examples.zh: 我请店员比较这两副眼镜的「镜腿长度」。

collocations: the temple length printed on the frame

words.enDefinition: a short-term cap protecting a prepared tooth before the final restoration

examples.en: The dentist showed me the temporary crown before adding it to my treatment record.
examples.zh: 牙医把「临时牙冠」给我看了看，然后记入我的治疗记录。

examples.en: I asked why the estimate showed a temporary crown and a permanent one separately.
examples.zh: 我问估价单为什么把「临时牙冠」和永久牙冠分开列。

collocations: a temporary crown on a back tooth

words.enDefinition: a physical or mental limitation expected to last a limited time

examples.en: I asked what campus support was available for someone with a temporary disability.
examples.zh: 我问学校能为有「暂时性功能障碍」的人提供什么支持。

examples.en: The form had a section where I could describe my temporary disability.
examples.zh: 表格上有一栏，我可以描述自己的「暂时性功能障碍」。

words.enDefinition: a short-term restoration placed in a prepared tooth

examples.en: My dentist noted a temporary filling on the report from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 牙医在我上次就诊的报告里注明了「临时补牙填充体」。

examples.en: I asked whether the temporary filling was listed separately on my account statement.
examples.zh: 我问账单上是否单独列出了「临时补牙填充体」。

collocations: a tooth with a temporary filling

words.enDefinition: moving a resident to a different room for a limited period

examples.en: I asked the residence adviser how to request a temporary room transfer after discharge.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍顾问，出院后怎么申请「临时换房」。

examples.en: The housing office offered a temporary room transfer while I was recovering.
examples.zh: 我康复期间，住宿办公室提出可以安排「临时换房」。

words.enDefinition: painful when light pressure is applied to an area

examples.en: There's a spot on my shoulder that is tender to the touch.
examples.zh: 我肩膀上有个地方「一碰就疼」。

examples.en: I told the doctor that my ankle was still tender to the touch.
examples.zh: 我告诉医生，我的脚踝还是「一碰就疼」。

collocations: a spot tender to the touch

words.enDefinition: a document requesting a laboratory or other medical test

examples.en: I asked whether I needed the original test requisition for my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问就诊时需不需要带「检验申请单」原件。

examples.en: The nurse showed me the clinic name printed on the test requisition.
examples.zh: 护士给我看了「检验申请单」上印的诊所名称。

collocations: a copy of the test requisition

words.enDefinition: the findings produced by a medical examination or test

examples.en: The receptionist explained which tab showed my test results on the clinic website.
examples.zh: 前台说明了在诊所网站的哪个标签页可以看到「检查结果」。

examples.en: I asked whether the specialist had received the test results from my previous clinic.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生有没有收到上一家诊所发来的「检查结果」。

words.enDefinition: the proportion correctly testing positive among people with the target condition

examples.en: I asked what test sensitivity meant in the information sheet for the program.
examples.zh: 我问项目资料单上的「检测敏感度」是什么意思。

examples.en: The lecturer contrasted test sensitivity with specificity using a fictional screening example.
examples.zh: 讲师用一个虚构的筛查例子，对比了「检测敏感度」和特异度。

words.enDefinition: the proportion correctly testing negative among people without the target condition

examples.en: The lecturer used a chart to explain test specificity during the health workshop.
examples.zh: 讲师在健康讲座上用图表解释了「检测特异度」。

examples.en: I asked where test specificity was defined in the screening program's booklet.
examples.zh: 我问筛查项目册子上哪里给了「检测特异度」的定义。

words.enDefinition: the time a test service takes to produce a result

examples.en: I asked about the test turnaround time before booking my follow-up appointment.
examples.zh: 预约后续就诊前，我先问了「检测出结果所需时间」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a test turnaround time for each category of checks.
examples.zh: 说明单为每类检查列了「检测出结果所需时间」。

words.enDefinition: the numerical measurement recorded as the result of an individual test

examples.en: I asked which test value the clinician was referring to on the report.
examples.zh: 我问医生指的是报告上的哪个「检测数值」。

examples.en: The test value appeared on the same line as the measurement unit.
examples.zh: 「检测数值」和计量单位显示在同一行。

words.enDefinition: the bottom part of the skull where it meets the neck

examples.en: I feel pressure around the base of the skull when I look down.
examples.zh: 我低头时，觉得「颅底」附近有压迫感。

examples.en: The pain begins at the base of the skull and moves upward.
examples.zh: 疼痛从「颅底」开始，然后向上蔓延。

collocations: soreness at the base of the skull
pain at the base of the skull
tension near the base of the skull

words.enDefinition: the lower inward-curving area just above the buttocks

examples.en: The soreness is in the small of the back and feels worse when I stand.
examples.zh: 酸痛在「腰背部」，站起来时更明显。

examples.en: I felt a dull ache in the small of the back after my bus ride.
examples.zh: 坐完公交车后，我的「腰背部」隐隐作痛。

collocations: pain in the small of the back
stiffness in the small of the back
pressure on the small of the back

words.enDefinition: the part of the belly above the navel

examples.en: I feel tightness in the upper abdomen, especially after a large meal.
examples.zh: 我觉得「上腹部」发紧，尤其是吃得多了以后。

examples.en: The nurse asked me to point to the upper abdomen where I felt discomfort.
examples.zh: 护士让我指出「上腹部」哪个位置不舒服。

words.enDefinition: the professional working relationship between a client and therapist

examples.en: We read about the therapeutic relationship during a workshop at the counseling centre.
examples.zh: 我们在咨询中心的工作坊里读到了「治疗关系」的相关介绍。

examples.en: The counselor said we could discuss the therapeutic relationship if any concerns came up.
examples.zh: 咨询师说，有任何顾虑都可以谈谈「治疗关系」。

words.enDefinition: a request for someone to be assessed by a therapy service

examples.en: I asked whether the therapy referral had reached the community rehabilitation team.
examples.zh: 我问那份「治疗转介」有没有送到社区康复团队。

examples.en: The hospital listed the therapy referral among the items in my discharge plan.
examples.zh: 医院把「治疗转介」列在出院后安排的事项里。

collocations: follow up on a therapy referral

words.enDefinition: a document recording an assessment or progress during therapy

examples.en: The therapy report described the tasks I found difficult at home and at university.
examples.zh: 「治疗情况报告」写了哪些事在家和在学校做起来对我有困难。

examples.en: I asked for a second copy of the therapy report for my own records.
examples.zh: 我另外要了一份「治疗情况报告」留档。

collocations: request a copy of the therapy report

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting with a therapist for psychological care

examples.en: My therapy session ended just before the last bus back to my student housing.
examples.zh: 我的「心理治疗会谈」在回学生宿舍的末班车之前刚好结束。

examples.en: I asked whether we could hold the next therapy session online during the holiday.
examples.zh: 我问能否把下次「心理治疗会谈」安排在假期线上进行。

words.enDefinition: pain felt in repeated pulses or beats

examples.en: The throbbing pain near my temple made it hard to follow the lecture.
examples.zh: 太阳穴附近的「搏动性疼痛」让我很难跟上课。

examples.en: I described the throbbing pain to the doctor as beating in regular pulses.
examples.zh: 我向医生形容，「搏动性疼痛」就像有节奏地一跳一跳。

words.enDefinition: bring stomach contents back up through the mouth

examples.en: I felt like I might throw up during my walk to class.
examples.zh: 我走去上课的路上觉得自己可能要「吐」。

examples.en: It felt like I might throw up again just after getting home.
examples.zh: 我刚到家，就觉得可能又要「吐」了。

collocations: feel like you might throw up

words.enDefinition: the time at which an injury happened

examples.en: I estimated the time of injury by checking when I had phoned my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我查看了自己给室友打电话的时间，估算了「受伤时间」。

examples.en: The nurse confirmed the time of injury before adding the details to the record.
examples.zh: 护士先确认了「受伤时间」，再把细节加到记录里。

words.enDefinition: the time at which a condition or symptom began

examples.en: I checked my messages to estimate the time of onset before answering the nurse's question.
examples.zh: 我先翻了翻消息，估算症状「开始出现的时间」，然后回答了护士的问题。

examples.en: The doctor asked if anyone with me could help confirm the time of onset.
examples.zh: 医生问和我在一起的人能不能帮忙确认「开始出现的时间」。

collocations: ask about the time of onset

words.enDefinition: a period away from studies or work for mental wellbeing

examples.en: I talked to my course adviser about taking time off for mental health.
examples.zh: 我跟课程顾问谈了谈「为照顾心理健康请假」的事。

examples.en: The student guide lists who to contact about time off for mental health.
examples.zh: 学生指南列出了要「为照顾心理健康请假」可以联系谁。

collocations: take time off for mental health
request time off for mental health
consider time off for mental health

words.enDefinition: lenses colored to change the amount or tone of transmitted light

examples.en: I compared the two pairs of tinted lenses near the window at the shop.
examples.zh: 我在店里窗边对照看了两副「有色镜片」。

examples.en: The catalogue lists tinted lenses in several shades next to the clear options.
examples.zh: 商品目录在透明款旁边列了几种不同深浅的「有色镜片」。

words.enDefinition: pressing the upper and lower teeth firmly together

examples.en: I mentioned tooth clenching after the dentist asked what happened when I was studying.
examples.zh: 牙医问我学习时有什么情况，我提到了「紧咬牙关」。

examples.en: The leaflet explained how tooth clenching differed from grinding the teeth at night.
examples.zh: 说明书解释了「紧咬牙关」和夜间磨牙有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: gradual breakdown of tooth structure in the process of caries

examples.en: The dentist showed me where she was checking for tooth decay in the photographs.
examples.zh: 牙医在照片上指给我看，她在哪个位置排查「龋坏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the line about tooth decay referred to a particular tooth.
examples.zh: 我问提到「龋坏」的那一行是不是指某颗特定的牙齿。

words.enDefinition: the hard outer layer covering the exposed part of a tooth

examples.en: The dentist used a diagram to show where tooth enamel covers the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图说明「牙釉质」覆盖牙齿的哪些部位。

examples.en: I asked what the note about tooth enamel meant before putting the report away.
examples.zh: 收起报告前，我问了关于「牙釉质」的那条备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the removal of a tooth by a dental professional

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether the tooth extraction fee was on the printed plan.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，打印出来的方案上有没有列「拔牙」的费用。

examples.en: The dentist explained which tooth the tooth extraction would involve in my case.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，我的情况涉及对哪颗牙进行「拔牙」。

words.enDefinition: a visible space between two adjacent teeth

examples.en: The dentist took a photograph of the tooth gap for my appointment record.
examples.zh: 牙医给「牙间隙」拍了张照片，作为这次就诊的记录。

examples.en: I asked whether the tooth gap we discussed appeared clearly in the new scan.
examples.zh: 我问刚谈到的「牙间隙」在新扫描里显示得清不清楚。

collocations: a tooth gap between the front teeth

words.enDefinition: a system for identifying individual teeth with numbers or symbols

examples.en: I asked which tooth numbering system the practice used on the printed diagram.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印出来的图使用的是哪种「牙位编号」系统。

examples.en: The dentist explained why the tooth numbering differed from that on my old records.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么「牙位编号」和旧记录上的编号不同。

words.enDefinition: soft tissue inside a tooth containing nerves and blood vessels

examples.en: The specialist used a picture to show where the tooth pulp sits.
examples.zh: 专科医生用一张图指出了「牙髓」的位置。

examples.en: I wrote down tooth pulp after the dentist named the soft tissue layer.
examples.zh: 牙医说出那层软组织的名称后，我把「牙髓」记了下来。

collocations: an image of the tooth pulp

words.enDefinition: the part of a tooth embedded beneath the gum

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the tooth root on the image before explaining her findings.
examples.zh: 牙医先在影像上指了指「牙根」，再解释她看到了什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the photograph showed the entire tooth root or just its tip.
examples.zh: 我问那张图上显示的是整个「牙根」，还是只有根尖。

collocations: the tip of a tooth root
an image of the tooth root

words.enDefinition: tooth discomfort triggered by stimuli such as cold or touch

examples.en: I mentioned tooth sensitivity when the dentist asked what brought me to the clinic.
examples.zh: 牙医问我为什么来诊所时，我提到了「牙齿敏感」。

examples.en: The form asked whether tooth sensitivity happened with cold drinks or at other times.
examples.zh: 表格问我，「牙齿敏感」是在喝凉饮料时发作，还是也会在其他时候出现。

words.enDefinition: pain that is felt in or around a tooth

examples.en: I described my toothache and pointed to the side where I felt it.
examples.zh: 我描述了「牙痛」，还指出了疼的是哪一边。

examples.en: My roommate had a toothache and called the clinic after our tutorial.
examples.zh: 我室友「牙痛」，辅导课结束后给诊所打了电话。

words.enDefinition: the bristled end of a toothbrush that cleans the teeth

examples.en: I checked whether the toothbrush head would fit the handle I already owned.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「牙刷刷头」装不装得上原来那支手柄。

examples.en: The shop assistant showed me where the toothbrush head size appeared on the packaging.
examples.zh: 店员指给我看包装上哪里标有「牙刷刷头」的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a semisolid medicine in cream form for application to the skin

examples.en: The pharmacist underlined the words topical cream on the printed order for me.
examples.zh: 药师在打印出来的处方上给我划出了「外用乳膏」几个字。

examples.en: The carton for the topical cream looked similar to another package on the pharmacy shelf.
examples.zh: 「外用乳膏」的外盒和药房货架上的另一个包装很像。

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed with different powers to correct astigmatism

examples.en: The optometrist showed me where toric contact lenses appeared on the comparison sheet.
examples.zh: 验光师给我指出了对比表上的「散光隐形眼镜」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote included toric contact lenses for both eyes.
examples.zh: 我问报价是否包括两个眼睛的「散光隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a fitting for toric contact lenses
a box of toric contact lenses

words.enDefinition: a patch designed to release medicine through the skin

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where the outer box said transdermal patch in bold.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了外盒上用粗体印着「透皮贴剂」的地方。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the transdermal patch separately from the other formulations on the page.
examples.zh: 说明书把「透皮贴剂」和页面上的其他剂型分别列出。

words.enDefinition: move a prescription record from one pharmacy to another

examples.en: I asked whether I could transfer a prescription after moving closer to a different pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我搬到离另一家药房更近的地方后，问能不能「转移处方」。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained what details she needed to transfer a prescription from my previous pharmacy.
examples.zh: 药师说明，从原来的药房「转移处方」需要我提供哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: the hospital or unit a patient is being moved to

examples.en: I wrote down the transfer destination so my roommate would know where to meet me.
examples.zh: 我记下了「转运目的地」，方便室友知道去哪里找我。

examples.en: The clerk checked the transfer destination after the original hospital said it had no bed.
examples.zh: 原定医院说没有床位后，接待人员核对了「转运目的地」。

words.enDefinition: to send a patient's health records to another provider

examples.en: I asked the old practice whether it could transfer medical records before my first visit.
examples.zh: 我首次就诊前，问原来的诊所能不能「转交医疗记录」。

examples.en: The new clinic explained how to transfer medical records after I changed universities last term.
examples.zh: 我上学期转学以后，新诊所说明了如何「转交医疗记录」。

words.enDefinition: a brief written record sent with a transferred patient

examples.en: The nurse checked the transfer note before the porter moved me to a different ward.
examples.zh: 运送人员把我转到另一个病区前，护士核对了「转运记录单」。

examples.en: I asked whether my flatmate could pick up a copy of the transfer note later.
examples.zh: 我问室友晚些时候能不能来领一份「转运记录单」的副本。

words.enDefinition: a request to move a patient to another service

examples.en: The nurse confirmed that the transfer request had reached the team at the larger hospital.
examples.zh: 护士确认，「转运申请」已经送到那家较大医院的团队手里。

examples.en: My friend asked who would review the transfer request and when they might respond.
examples.zh: 朋友问由谁审核「转运申请」，对方大概什么时候会回复。

words.enDefinition: the move from one healthcare setting or provider to another

examples.en: My counselor helped arrange a transition of care before I left the university.
examples.zh: 我离开学校之前，咨询师帮我安排了「照护交接」。

examples.en: The clinic asked for consent to share records during the transition of care.
examples.zh: 诊所征求我的同意，想在「照护交接」期间共享记录。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement reserving a journey for a particular time

examples.en: The ward clerk checked the transport booking before telling me the pickup time.
examples.zh: 病区办事员查询了「接送预约」，才告诉我接人的时间。

examples.en: I asked whether my transport booking showed the new address near campus.
examples.zh: 我问我的「接送预约」有没有写上学校附近的新地址。

collocations: a reference for a transport booking

words.enDefinition: specialists who work together to care for major injuries

examples.en: The nurse said the trauma team had received the notes from the ambulance crew.
examples.zh: 护士说，「创伤救治团队」已经收到了救护人员的记录。

examples.en: My friend asked who on the trauma team could give an update to the family.
examples.zh: 朋友问「创伤救治团队」里有谁能给家属通报情况。

collocations: a member of the trauma team

words.enDefinition: vaccination considered in connection with planned travel abroad

examples.en: The campus booklet listed contact information for the travel vaccination clinic nearby.
examples.zh: 校园册子上列出了附近那家「旅行相关接种」诊所的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked which page had information about travel vaccination for exchange students.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页介绍了交换生的「旅行相关接种」。

words.enDefinition: a small separated area used for examining or treating patients

examples.en: The porter took me to a treatment cubicle while my roommate waited nearby with my bag.
examples.zh: 运送人员把我送到一个「诊疗隔间」，室友拿着我的包在附近等。

examples.en: I asked the nurse which treatment cubicle my friend had been taken to that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问护士那天下午我朋友被带去了哪个「诊疗隔间」。

words.enDefinition: assessment that prioritizes patients according to urgency

examples.en: The sign explained that triage happens before most people are taken to a treatment bay.
examples.zh: 告示说明，大多数人会先做「分诊」，再由工作人员带去诊疗区。

examples.en: I asked my tutor what triage meant after seeing the word on the hospital paperwork.
examples.zh: 我在医院文件上看到「分诊」这个词，就问了导师它是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a level assigned to reflect how urgently care is needed

examples.en: The nurse explained what the triage category meant when I asked about my wait.
examples.zh: 我问还要等多久，护士解释了「分诊等级」是什么意思。

examples.en: The triage category appeared in my record next to the time I first arrived.
examples.zh: 我的病历上在首次到院时间旁标了「分诊等级」。

words.enDefinition: a station where staff organize or carry out triage

examples.en: I asked the person at the triage desk where my roommate could leave my bag.
examples.zh: 我问「分诊台」的工作人员，室友可以把我的包放在哪儿。

examples.en: The signs led from the hospital entrance to the triage desk next to reception.
examples.zh: 从医院入口沿着标牌走，可以到接待处旁的「分诊台」。

collocations: speak to someone at the triage desk

words.enDefinition: a written record of the first prioritization assessment

examples.en: I saw the triage note at the top of the folder when the nurse opened it.
examples.zh: 护士打开文件夹时，我看到最上面是「分诊记录」。

examples.en: The doctor read the triage note before asking me to confirm the details of my arrival.
examples.zh: 医生先阅读了「分诊记录」，再请我确认到院时的相关情况。

words.enDefinition: a nurse assessing urgency when patients first arrive

examples.en: The triage nurse asked what had happened before writing down the time of my arrival.
examples.zh: 「分诊护士」先问发生了什么，再记下我的到院时间。

examples.en: I gave the triage nurse a short account of what my friend had told me.
examples.zh: 我把朋友之前告诉我的情况简单说给了「分诊护士」。

words.enDefinition: sample contact lenses provided for evaluating the fit and vision

examples.en: The optometrist pointed out which box contained the trial contact lenses for my appointment.
examples.zh: 验光师给我指出了哪个盒子里装着本次预约的「试戴隐形眼镜」。

examples.en: I asked whether the trial contact lenses appeared on the itemized receipt.
examples.zh: 我问明细收据上是否列有「试戴隐形眼镜」。

collocations: a pack of trial contact lenses

words.enDefinition: lenses with three distinct areas for different viewing distances

examples.en: The display included trifocal lenses alongside the other options with visible segments.
examples.zh: 展示台把「三光镜片」和其他有明显分区的选项放在了一起。

examples.en: I asked the optician to explain the lines on the sample trifocal lenses.
examples.zh: 我请配镜师解释「三光镜片」样品上的分界线。

words.enDefinition: difficulty keeping your attention on one activity or thought

examples.en: I have trouble concentrating on my notes when the headache is particularly bad.
examples.zh: 头疼得特别厉害时，我「难以集中注意力」看笔记。

examples.en: I noticed trouble concentrating at home even when my room was completely quiet.
examples.zh: 即使家里的房间非常安静，我还是发现自己「难以集中注意力」。

words.enDefinition: put on eyeglass frames to see how they fit or look

examples.en: I stopped at the optical shop to try on frames after my lecture.
examples.zh: 下课后我顺路去眼镜店「试戴镜框」。

examples.en: The assistant gave me time to try on frames without making a decision.
examples.zh: 店员给了我时间慢慢「试戴镜框」，不用马上决定。

words.enDefinition: a check for possible tuberculosis or signs of infection

examples.en: The placement form had a section for the date of my tuberculosis screening.
examples.zh: 实习表格留了一栏，填我的「结核病筛查」日期。

examples.en: I asked which clinic could provide written evidence of tuberculosis screening for my records.
examples.zh: 我问哪家诊所能提供「结核病筛查」的书面材料让我留存。

words.enDefinition: contact lenses designed to be replaced according to a two-week cycle

examples.en: The brochure lists two-week contact lenses separately from the daily disposable range.
examples.zh: 小册子把「双周抛隐形眼镜」和日抛系列分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote for two-week contact lenses included the fitting fee.
examples.zh: 我问「双周抛隐形眼镜」的报价是否已包含验配费。

collocations: a pack of two-week contact lenses
a quote for two-week contact lenses

words.enDefinition: how well someone sees without glasses or contact lenses

examples.en: The assistant recorded my uncorrected vision before I put my glasses back on.
examples.zh: 我重新戴上眼镜前，助理记下了我的「裸眼视力」。

examples.en: The chart showed uncorrected vision separately from the results obtained with my glasses.
examples.zh: 表上把「裸眼视力」和我戴眼镜测出的结果分开列了。

collocations: compare uncorrected vision at different visits

words.enDefinition: crutches with padded supports that fit under the arms

examples.en: The receptionist asked when I would bring the underarm crutches back to the clinic.
examples.zh: 前台问我什么时候把「腋拐」还回诊所。

examples.en: I asked whether the padded item on the list meant underarm crutches.
examples.zh: 我问清单上写的带软垫的物品是不是「腋拐」。

words.enDefinition: a bite with lower incisors ahead of upper incisors

examples.en: The dentist used two models to demonstrate what an underbite looks like.
examples.zh: 牙医用两个模型给我展示了「前牙反牙合」是什么样子。

examples.en: I asked which picture in the report illustrated the underbite we had discussed.
examples.zh: 我问报告里哪张图展示了我们谈到的「前牙反牙合」。

words.enDefinition: discolored skin marks that appear without a known injury

examples.en: I noticed unexplained bruises on my shins while getting ready for bed.
examples.zh: 我准备上床时，注意到小腿有几处「不明原因的瘀青」。

examples.en: The clinician asked how often I had seen unexplained bruises that month.
examples.zh: 医生问那个月我多频繁地发现「不明原因的瘀青」。

words.enDefinition: a packet containing medicine packaged separately as one labeled dose

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the product name on each unit-dose packet in the carton.
examples.zh: 药师给我指出了盒里每个「单剂量包装袋」上的产品名称。

examples.en: The photograph in the leaflet showed the back of a single unit-dose packet.
examples.zh: 说明书里的照片展示了一个「单剂量包装袋」的背面。

words.enDefinition: a product container that has not yet been opened

examples.en: The pharmacist asked me to bring the unopened package so she could compare its label.
examples.zh: 药师请我带上「未拆封的包装」，方便她比对标签。

examples.en: I could see two different product numbers printed on the same unopened package.
examples.zh: 我看得见同一个「未拆封的包装」上印着两个不同的产品编号。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare bill that has not yet been paid

examples.en: I spotted an unpaid medical bill while sorting through mail after the break.
examples.zh: 假期回来整理邮件时，我发现了一张「未付医疗账单」。

examples.en: The billing team found an unpaid medical bill from my visit two months ago.
examples.zh: 账单部门找到了我两个月前看诊产生的一张「未付医疗账单」。

collocations: ask about an unpaid medical bill

words.enDefinition: sleep that does not leave you feeling rested afterward

examples.en: I've had unrefreshing sleep all week despite going to bed early every night.
examples.zh: 尽管每晚都早睡，这周我却「睡醒后仍不解乏」。

examples.en: I described several nights of unrefreshing sleep even though I hadn't woken up once.
examples.zh: 我说虽然夜里一次都没醒过，但连续好几晚「睡醒后仍不解乏」。

words.enDefinition: to replace the insurance details kept on file for someone

examples.en: I need to update insurance information in the portal before my next appointment.
examples.zh: 下次看诊前，我要在在线系统里「更新保险资料」。

examples.en: The form allows students to update insurance information at the start of term.
examples.zh: 这份表允许学生在学期开始时「更新保险资料」。

collocations: update insurance information before a visit

words.enDefinition: the bony structure that holds the upper row of teeth

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the upper jaw on the model before checking my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医先在模型上指了指「上颌」，才检查我的牙齿。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the image showing my left upper jaw.
examples.zh: 我索要了一份显示左侧「上颌」的影像副本。

collocations: an image of the upper jaw
the left side of the upper jaw

words.enDefinition: minor discomfort in the stomach, often with nausea

examples.en: I had an upset stomach after lunch and didn't want much dinner.
examples.zh: 午饭后我有些「胃部不适」，晚饭就没什么胃口。

examples.en: My roommate mentioned an upset stomach after we got back from the trip.
examples.zh: 我们旅行回来后，室友说有些「胃部不适」。

words.enDefinition: a consultation arranged to assess a concern promptly

examples.en: The receptionist passed my request for an urgent appointment to the nurse for review.
examples.zh: 前台把我的「加急就诊预约」申请交给护士审核。

examples.en: The clinic recorded the time of my call when I asked about an urgent appointment.
examples.zh: 我询问「加急就诊预约」时，诊所记下了我打电话的时间。

words.enDefinition: a strong sudden need to pass urine without delay

examples.en: I felt an urgent need to urinate halfway through my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的课听到一半，我突然「尿急」。

examples.en: The urgent need to urinate returned even after I had used the bathroom.
examples.zh: 即使刚上完厕所，我又开始「尿急」。

collocations: feel an urgent need to urinate
report an urgent need to urinate
a repeated urgent need to urinate

words.enDefinition: a referral sent for review sooner than usual

examples.en: The doctor mentioned an urgent referral and explained who would call me about the booking.
examples.zh: 医生提到了「加急转诊」，并说明谁会打电话告诉我预约安排。

examples.en: The office asked me to verify my phone number after logging the urgent referral.
examples.zh: 办公室登记了「加急转诊」后，请我核实电话号码。

words.enDefinition: the unintentional passage of urine

examples.en: I noticed urine leakage for the first time after a long walk.
examples.zh: 我走了很久以后，第一次发现自己有「漏尿」。

examples.en: The nurse asked when the urine leakage happened and whether I noticed it immediately.
examples.zh: 护士问「漏尿」是何时发生的，我有没有马上察觉。

words.enDefinition: a portion of urine provided for a laboratory test

examples.en: The clinician clarified which report was for my urine sample that morning.
examples.zh: 医生解释了哪份报告对应我那天上午的「尿液样本」。

examples.en: I asked whether the urine sample had reached the lab from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「尿液样本」有没有从诊所送到检验室。

collocations: a report for a urine sample

words.enDefinition: a feature that reduces exposure to ultraviolet light

examples.en: I looked for information about UV protection on the sunglasses tag before asking the assistant.
examples.zh: 询问店员之前，我先在太阳镜吊牌上找了「紫外线防护」信息。

examples.en: The brochure lists UV protection separately from the color of the lens.
examples.zh: 小册子把「紫外线防护」和镜片颜色分开列出。

words.enDefinition: an arranged visit to a service that provides vaccinations

examples.en: I checked the address on my vaccination appointment confirmation before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校之前，我核对了「疫苗接种预约」确认通知上的地址。

examples.en: My vaccination appointment overlapped with a tutorial, so I asked about another time.
examples.zh: 我的「疫苗接种预约」和辅导课撞了，就问能不能换个时间。

words.enDefinition: a card that holds written details of a person's vaccinations

examples.en: I showed my vaccination card when the clinic asked about my earlier appointments.
examples.zh: 诊所问我之前的预约时，我出示了「疫苗接种卡」。

examples.en: The date on my vaccination card was harder to read than the online entry.
examples.zh: 我的「疫苗接种卡」上的日期比网上记录更难看清。

collocations: a copy of a vaccination card

words.enDefinition: a formal document certifying one or more recorded vaccinations

examples.en: The university asked whether I had an English version of my vaccination certificate.
examples.zh: 学校问我的「疫苗接种证明书」有没有可供阅读的英文版。

examples.en: I asked where I could download the vaccination certificate after the office updated my record.
examples.zh: 办公室更新我的记录后，我问到哪里能下载「疫苗接种证明书」。

words.enDefinition: a service or site set up to provide vaccinations

examples.en: The temporary vaccination clinic was in the sports hall beside the library.
examples.zh: 临时「疫苗接种门诊」设在图书馆旁的体育馆。

examples.en: The university posted an accessible entrance for the vaccination clinic on its website.
examples.zh: 学校在网站上公布了「疫苗接种门诊」的无障碍入口。

words.enDefinition: a document used to record permission for vaccination

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the vaccination consent form before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我索要了一份「疫苗接种同意书」副本。

examples.en: The nurse gave me time to read the vaccination consent form and ask questions.
examples.zh: 护士留了时间让我看「疫苗接种同意书」并提问。

words.enDefinition: the day on which a vaccine was given

examples.en: The form asked for the vaccination date exactly as it appeared on my record.
examples.zh: 表格要求照着我的记录填写「接种日期」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the vaccination date before signing the copy for me.
examples.zh: 护士核对了「接种日期」，才在给我的副本上签字。

words.enDefinition: permission to be excused from a specified vaccination requirement

examples.en: The office told me who handled questions about a vaccination exemption for placement.
examples.zh: 办公室告诉我，要咨询实习的「接种豁免」应该找谁。

examples.en: I asked whether the uploaded document showed my vaccination exemption for this course.
examples.zh: 我问上传的文件有没有显示我在这门课上的「接种豁免」。

words.enDefinition: information about whether specified vaccinations have already been received

examples.en: The portal showed my vaccination status after a nurse checked the uploaded document.
examples.zh: 护士核对上传的文件后，平台显示了我的「疫苗接种状态」。

examples.en: I asked who could see my vaccination status on the placement checklist.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到实习清单上我的「疫苗接种状态」。

words.enDefinition: a record entry for an individual dose of a vaccine

examples.en: The nurse noticed that my vaccine dose record had the wrong appointment date.
examples.zh: 护士注意到我的「疫苗剂次记录」上就诊日期写错了。

examples.en: I requested a copy of the vaccine dose record from the clinic for my files.
examples.zh: 我向诊所索要了一份「疫苗剂次记录」副本留档。

collocations: a copy of the vaccine dose record

words.enDefinition: a CDC document explaining a vaccine's benefits and risks

examples.en: The U.S. clinic handed me a Vaccine Information Statement to read before the appointment.
examples.zh: 美国的诊所给了我一份「美国疫苗信息说明单」，让我在就诊前阅读。

examples.en: I asked where to find the date on the Vaccine Information Statement I received.
examples.zh: 我问拿到的「美国疫苗信息说明单」上哪里印着日期。

collocations: a copy of the Vaccine Information Statement

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular manufactured batch of vaccine

examples.en: I asked why the vaccine lot number was printed beside the product name.
examples.zh: 我问为什么产品名旁边印着「疫苗生产批号」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the vaccine lot number against what was listed in the record.
examples.zh: 护士把「疫苗生产批号」与记录上列的编号作了核对。

words.enDefinition: the product or vaccine type recorded for a vaccination

examples.en: I could not read the vaccine name on the handwritten card from home.
examples.zh: 我看不清从家乡带来的手写卡片上的「疫苗名称」。

examples.en: The clinic checked the vaccine name before sending the corrected record to me.
examples.zh: 诊所核对了「疫苗名称」，才把更正后的记录发给我。

words.enDefinition: a change that fixes inaccurate information in a vaccination record

examples.en: I asked how to request a vaccine record correction for my misspelled surname.
examples.zh: 我的姓拼错了，我问怎样申请「接种记录更正」。

examples.en: The clinic sent a message once the vaccine record correction appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 网上平台显示「接种记录更正」后，诊所发来了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: the sensation that you or your surroundings are moving or spinning

examples.en: I described the vertigo as feeling like the room was spinning around me.
examples.zh: 我形容「眩晕」的感觉，就像整间屋子绕着我转。

examples.en: The vertigo began while I was lying completely still in my room.
examples.zh: 我一动不动地躺在房间里时，突然出现了「眩晕」。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare consultation conducted through a video call

examples.en: The receptionist sent a link for the video consultation along with the scheduled start time.
examples.zh: 前台发来了「视频问诊」的链接和计划开始时间。

examples.en: I put on headphones before joining the video consultation so my flatmates could study in peace.
examples.zh: 为了不打扰室友学习，我戴上了耳机才参加「视频问诊」。

collocations: a link for a video consultation

words.enDefinition: a brief check for possible problems with sight

examples.en: The campus health fair offered vision screening in a quiet room upstairs.
examples.zh: 学校健康市集在楼上一间安静的房间提供了「视力筛查」。

examples.en: I brought the vision screening results to show what had already been checked.
examples.zh: 我带上「视力筛查」的结果，说明哪些项目已经检查过了。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of visits a plan covers for a benefit

examples.en: The plan summary shows a visit limit for appointments with that kind of provider.
examples.zh: 保障摘要里写着，这类提供者的预约有「就诊次数上限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the visit limit would reset at the beginning of the next term.
examples.zh: 我问「就诊次数上限」到下学期开始时会不会重置。

words.enDefinition: a nurse who provides care by visiting someone away from a clinic

examples.en: The visiting nurse called from reception because my building required a visitor pass.
examples.zh: 因为大楼要求有访客通行证，「上门护士」从前台给我打了电话。

examples.en: I asked whether the visiting nurse could contact me on my new number.
examples.zh: 我问「上门护士」能不能用新号码联系我。

collocations: a scheduled visit from a visiting nurse

words.enDefinition: a document or badge allowing someone into a controlled area

examples.en: The guard gave my friend a visitor pass after checking her name at the desk.
examples.zh: 保安在服务台核对朋友的姓名后，给了她一张「访客通行证」。

examples.en: I returned the visitor pass before leaving the hospital building at the end of the evening.
examples.zh: 晚上离开医院大楼前，我交还了「访客通行证」。

words.enDefinition: rules limiting who may visit a patient or when

examples.en: The nurse explained the visitor restrictions before my roommate invited our other friends to come.
examples.zh: 室友邀请其他朋友来之前，护士解释了「探视限制」。

examples.en: I checked whether the visitor restrictions also applied to the area where we were waiting.
examples.zh: 我确认了「探视限制」是否也适用于我们正在等候的区域。

words.enDefinition: the sharpness with which someone sees fine detail

examples.en: The report listed my visual acuity for each eye on a separate line.
examples.zh: 报告用两行分别记录了我每只眼睛的「视敏度」。

examples.en: I asked what visual acuity meant in the summary of my eye exam.
examples.zh: 我问眼部检查摘要里的「视敏度」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a test measuring the area someone can see while looking ahead

examples.en: The report from my visual field test included a diagram for each eye.
examples.zh: 我的「视野检查」报告给每只眼睛各附了一张图。

examples.en: The assistant explained how long the visual field test would take that morning.
examples.zh: 助理说明了那天上午的「视野检查」要花多长时间。

words.enDefinition: measurements of basic body functions such as pulse and temperature

examples.en: The nurse recorded my vital signs before I went into the room for the consultation.
examples.zh: 护士先记录了我的「生命体征」，我才进诊室问诊。

examples.en: I asked the nurse where the vital signs would appear in my visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「生命体征」会显示在就诊摘要的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the waist

examples.en: The nurse showed me where waist circumference appeared on my printed record.
examples.zh: 护士给我指了打印记录上「腰围」的位置。

examples.en: I asked if the number beside waist circumference was listed in centimeters.
examples.zh: 我问「腰围」旁边的数字是不是用厘米记的。

words.enDefinition: to wait until a clinician is able to assess you

examples.en: I was asked to wait for assessment in the area beside the main nursing station.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我在主护士站旁边的区域「等待评估」。

examples.en: My friend stayed with me while I continued to wait for assessment that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我一直「等待评估」，朋友留在那里陪我。

collocations: wait for assessment in the designated area

words.enDefinition: a display providing information for people waiting to be seen

examples.en: The waiting room screen showed which desk to use for questions about the next assessment.
examples.zh: 「候诊室显示屏」上写了，想问下一次评估的问题该去哪个服务台。

examples.en: I looked up at the waiting room screen while my flatmate was getting us water.
examples.zh: 室友去倒水时，我抬头看了看「候诊室显示屏」。

collocations: information on the waiting room screen

words.enDefinition: new information given to people waiting for emergency care

examples.en: The waiting room update warned that staff were still dealing with several earlier arrivals.
examples.zh: 「候诊进度通知」说，工作人员还在处理几位之前到院的患者。

examples.en: My roommate heard a waiting room update while I was speaking with the receptionist.
examples.zh: 我正在和前台说话时，室友听到了「候诊进度通知」。

collocations: listen for a waiting room update

words.enDefinition: to become awake after having fallen asleep at night

examples.en: I sometimes wake up during the night and remember what I was worrying about.
examples.zh: 我有时会「夜间醒来」，然后想起之前在担心什么。

examples.en: The questionnaire asked how often I wake up during the night these days.
examples.zh: 问卷问我最近「夜间醒来」的频率。

collocations: often wake up during the night
repeatedly wake up during the night
tend to wake up during the night

words.enDefinition: someone who comes to a clinic without a booking

examples.en: The receptionist explained what information I needed to provide as a walk-in patient that morning.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，作为当天上午「未预约就诊的患者」，需要提供哪些信息。

examples.en: As a walk-in patient, I was asked to confirm my contact number at the desk.
examples.zh: 我是「未预约就诊的患者」，前台请我确认联系电话。

words.enDefinition: a freestanding frame providing support as a person walks

examples.en: I needed space in my room to store the walking frame when not in use.
examples.zh: 我需要在房间里腾出地方，收放暂时不用的「助行架」。

examples.en: I asked whether the walking frame in the picture was the model being delivered.
examples.zh: 我问照片里的「助行架」是不是要送来的那个型号。

collocations: a walking frame provided on loan

words.enDefinition: a handheld stick that gives support while walking

examples.en: I left my walking stick beside the door before taking off my shoes.
examples.zh: 脱鞋前，我把「手杖」放在门边。

examples.en: The theatre asked where I would like to keep my walking stick during the show.
examples.zh: 剧院问我演出期间想把「手杖」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: how much walking someone can manage before needing to stop

examples.en: I described my walking tolerance in terms of how far I could get across campus.
examples.zh: 我用自己能在校园里走多远来说明「步行耐受度」。

examples.en: The report listed walking tolerance as one of the measures reviewed at each visit.
examples.zh: 报告把「步行耐受度」列为每次就诊都会复查的一项指标。

words.enDefinition: moving a patient between hospital units or wards

examples.en: The ward transfer was delayed while staff checked that my documents were in the folder.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认资料是否都在文件夹里，耽搁了我的「转病区」安排。

examples.en: My flatmate asked where to find me after the ward transfer had been completed.
examples.zh: 室友问，「转病区」结束后去哪里找我。

words.enDefinition: a transfer involving a direct introduction to the next person providing support

examples.en: The counselor offered a warm handoff and introduced me to the wellbeing adviser in person.
examples.zh: 咨询师提供了「直接引介式转接」，当面把我介绍给身心健康顾问。

examples.en: I had a warm handoff by video before my first meeting with the new service.
examples.zh: 我与新机构第一次见面前，通过视频接受了「直接引介式转接」。

words.enDefinition: a label drawing attention to a possible risk or restriction

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the symbol on the warning label.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释「警示标签」上的符号。

examples.en: The warning label was printed in black lettering near the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 「警示标签」用黑字印在纸盒靠近底部的位置。

words.enDefinition: a device that directs a stream of water around teeth

examples.en: I asked what the different tips in the water flosser box were called.
examples.zh: 我问「冲牙器」盒里那些不同的喷头都叫什么。

examples.en: The shop displayed a water flosser beside several powered toothbrushes near the counter.
examples.zh: 商店把「冲牙器」摆在柜台附近，旁边是几款电动牙刷。

words.enDefinition: the schedule describing when and how long a device is meant to be worn

examples.en: I asked whether the wearing schedule would appear in the notes from my optometrist.
examples.zh: 我问验光师给的记录里会不会写「佩戴时间安排」。

examples.en: The optometrist wrote the wearing schedule on a separate page of the handout.
examples.zh: 验光师把「佩戴时间安排」写在资料的另一页上。

words.enDefinition: a recorded check of how much a person weighs

examples.en: The report listed my weight measurement with the date of the appointment.
examples.zh: 报告列了我的「体重测量」结果，还注明了就诊日期。

examples.en: I asked if the weight measurement was shown in pounds or kilograms.
examples.zh: 我问「体重测量」结果是用磅还是千克显示的。

words.enDefinition: a group session about aspects of wellbeing

examples.en: I asked whether the wellbeing workshop was open to postgraduate students as well.
examples.zh: 我问研究生是否也能参加「身心健康工作坊」。

examples.en: The wellbeing workshop took place in the student union building after our morning classes.
examples.zh: 「身心健康工作坊」在我们上午下课后，于学生会大楼里举行。

words.enDefinition: arrangements that let people using wheelchairs enter and move around

examples.en: I asked about wheelchair access before booking a visit to the clinic's new building.
examples.zh: 预约去诊所的新楼前，我先问了「轮椅通行条件」。

examples.en: The receptionist sent a map showing which entrance provided wheelchair access from the street.
examples.zh: 前台发来地图，标明从街上进楼哪个入口有「轮椅通行条件」。

words.enDefinition: a cushion designed to fit on the seat of a wheelchair

examples.en: The equipment service delivered the wheelchair cushion in a box with my name.
examples.zh: 辅助设备服务机构把「轮椅坐垫」装在一个写有我名字的盒子里送过来。

examples.en: I asked if the wheelchair cushion was covered by the same loan agreement.
examples.zh: 我问「轮椅坐垫」是不是也包含在同一份借用协议里。

words.enDefinition: a slope providing a route for wheelchairs instead of steps

examples.en: The accessibility map showed the wheelchair ramp behind the student union building.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了学生会楼后面的「轮椅坡道」。

examples.en: I asked whether the wheelchair ramp would be available during the evening event.
examples.zh: 我问晚间活动期间「轮椅坡道」能不能用。

words.enDefinition: a high whistling sound that occurs as someone breathes

examples.en: I noticed wheezing when I breathed out after walking home last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚走回家后，我注意到自己「呼气有哨声」。

examples.en: The clinician asked if the wheezing was more noticeable at night or during exercise.
examples.zh: 医生问我的「呼吸哨声」是夜间更明显，还是运动时更明显。

words.enDefinition: while putting your body's weight on a particular limb

examples.en: My foot mainly hurts when bearing weight, such as while climbing stairs.
examples.zh: 我的脚主要在「负重时」疼，比如上楼时。

examples.en: The clinician asked if I felt tightness only when bearing weight on that leg.
examples.zh: 医生问我是不是只有那条腿「负重时」才会发紧。

words.enDefinition: at the time you draw a large breath in

examples.en: I get a sharp pain under my ribs when taking a deep breath.
examples.zh: 我在「深呼吸时」肋骨下面会突然疼一下。

examples.en: The nurse asked if I noticed more pain when taking a deep breath.
examples.zh: 护士问我「深呼吸时」疼痛会不会加剧。

collocations: hurt when taking a deep breath
feel discomfort when taking a deep breath
tightness when taking a deep breath

words.enDefinition: one of the third molars at the back of the mouth

examples.en: I asked the dentist to locate my wisdom tooth on the screen during the visit.
examples.zh: 就诊时，我请牙医在屏幕上指给我看「智齿」的位置。

examples.en: The report mentioned a wisdom tooth near the back of the lower jaw.
examples.zh: 报告提到，下颌最里面有一颗「智齿」。

words.enDefinition: the extraction of one or more backmost permanent molars

examples.en: I asked how the specialist would record wisdom tooth removal on the treatment estimate.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，治疗估价单上会怎么注明「拔除智齿」。

examples.en: The clinic called about my wisdom tooth removal consultation while I was walking to campus.
examples.zh: 我去学校的路上，诊所打电话和我确认了「拔除智齿」的咨询预约。

collocations: a consultation about wisdom tooth removal
an estimate for wisdom tooth removal

words.enDefinition: to take back permission that was previously given

examples.en: I asked how to withdraw consent for a copy of the records to be shared.
examples.zh: 我问怎样「撤回同意」，不再允许转交那份记录副本。

examples.en: The administrator explained whom to contact if I later chose to withdraw consent for that release.
examples.zh: 管理员说明，如果我后来决定「撤回同意」不再提供那些信息，该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: a workable balance between working demands and personal time

examples.en: The counselor asked about work-life balance because I had started a weekend job.
examples.zh: 我开始做周末兼职后，咨询师问起了我的「工作与生活平衡」。

examples.en: We discussed work-life balance while looking at the hours I spent studying and working.
examples.zh: 我们看了看我学习和工作花的时间，同时讨论了「工作与生活平衡」。

words.enDefinition: verification of a patient's identity using a wristband

examples.en: The nurse did a wristband check before handing my notes to a different member of staff.
examples.zh: 护士先做了「腕带身份核对」，再把记录交给另一位工作人员。

examples.en: The porter said the wristband check would help confirm he had found the right patient.
examples.zh: 运送人员说，「腕带身份核对」能帮助确认他找对了患者。

words.enDefinition: a change in the skin toward a yellow color

examples.en: My flatmate noticed yellowing of the skin around my face in daylight.
examples.zh: 在日光下，室友注意到我脸上的「皮肤发黄」。

examples.en: I mentioned the yellowing of the skin when my clinician asked about recent changes.
examples.zh: 医生问我最近有什么变化时，我提到了「皮肤发黄」。
